tei:div.tei:p: rtsom sgrig u yon lhan khang /kru'u rin/ dgra 'dul/kru'u rin gzhon pa/ gdugs dkar tshe ring /gco sgrig pa/ bsod nams tshe ring /gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ rta mgrin skyabs/ rin chen don grub/sgrol ma rgya mabyodro/rtsom sgrig u yon/ rdo rje tshe ring / tshe ring thar/ gsang bdagapadma rdo rje/ blo gros/ bde skyid sgrol ma/bkra rgyal/ zla ba tshe ring / dbang phyug mtsho mo/lis zha'o kru'u/ lha byams rgyal/

sngon 'gro'i gtam/legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs la 'jug pa'i sngon 'gro'i gtam/gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing ri klung bar khams thams cad rnam par dag pa'i bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir/bod mi rigs rnams lo ngo stong phrag du ma'i snga rol nas gzhis chags shing 'tsho gzhes gnang ste 'od stong rnam par bkra ba'i lo rgyus bskrun yod la/ khyad par du bod rig pa zhes mtshan snyan 'dzam gling yangs pa'i khyon la mngon par ldir ba'i rig gnas kyi bang mdzod zad mtha' med pa zhig nga tsho phyi rabs pa'i bgo skal du stsal cing / gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu'i mkhas dbang mang po rim par byon nas dus rabs so sor rnam pa mi 'dra ba'i rtsom rig gi brtsams chos sna tshogs shig rtsom gnang mdzad pa dang /bod rang gi khyad chos dang yongs su mthun pa'i legs bshad ces pa'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa gsar ba zhig gsar skrun bgyis pa des/1

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rtsom rig spyi'i rigs sam lus kyi rnam pa je mang je tshang du btang ba yin pas/ rtsom rig gi gzhung lugs thad bla na med pa'i mdzad rjes shig dang rmad du byung ba'i dge mtshan zhig bskrun par snang ngo / / skabs bab kyi brjod bya legs bshad ces pa'i tha snyad de don gang la 'jug ce na/ yongs grags su sgra yangs 'jug dang dog 'jug gnyis su dbye ste brjod par bya dgos te/ tshig sbyor snyan zhing don gyis phyug pa'i gsung rnam dag dang bstan bcos mtha' dag la legs bshad ces pa sgra yangs 'jug gi don yin la/ rtsom stangs nges can zhig gis 'ching ba'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa zhig la legs bshad ces pa sgra dog 'jug gi don yin no/ /de ltar 'jug pa'i don gnyis ni phan tshun 'gal bar mi 'gyur te/ de gnyis bdag nyid gcig pa'i 'brel ba yod pa'i phyir/ sgra dog 'jug gi don ldan pa'i brtsams chos yin na yangs 'jug gi don gyi rang bzhin ldan pas khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /yin na'ang sgra yangs 'jug gi don ldan pa'i brtsams chos yin na dog 'jug gi don gyi bdag 2

sngon 'gro'i gtam/nyid ldan pa'i brtsams chos yin pa'i nges pa ma mchis so/ /'dir brjod pa'i legs bshad ni sgra dog 'jug gi don yin te/ rtsom rig gi rnam pa zhig la brjod pa yin no/ /'di lta bu'i legs bshad ces pa'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa der khyad chos ci zhig ldan zhe na/ de la 'di ltar brtag dgos te/brjod bya sna mang phun tshogs la dpe don legs par sbyar te tshigs bcad kyi rnam pas ston pa'i rtsom rig gi brtsams chos la legs bshad ces pa'i tha snyad btags pa yin/ de'i brjod bya sna mang phun tshogs yin par smra bar rgyu mtshan yod de/ rtsom pa pos bod kyi spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab dang bstun nas chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ chos lugs/ slob gso/ dmag don la sogs pa chos dang 'jig rten gyi bya dngos mang po la legs par dpyad nas/chos lugs kyi bsam blo/ srid 'dzin gyi thabs lam/ mkhas blun gyi spyod pa/ blang dor gyi tshad gzhi bcas lkog gyur gyi don mang po la rang nyid kyi lta stangs dang bzhed tshul gsal bar ston pa'i brtsams chos yin pa'i phyir ro/ /legs bshad bstan bcos de sgyu 3

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rtsal gyi rang bzhin yongs su gtams pa'i rtsom rig gi brtsams chos yin pa'i dbang gis/ de'i rjod byed kyi tshig dang ston byed kyi thabs la brtsams chos gzhan dang mi mthun pa'i khyad chos mang po yod/ mdor sdud na/ legs bshad kyi brtsams chos mtha' dag tshigs bcad kyi rnam pa yin pa dang gcig sho lo ka gcig las tshig rkang gnyis dpe dang tshig rkang gnyis don snga phyi nges med du legs par sbyar te bstan bya rdzogs par ston pa dang gnyis/gsal byed kyi dpe skye bo mkhas blun thams cad kyis nyams su myong ba'am thos pa las byung ba'i yun ring du 'dris pa'i bya dngos yin pa dang gsum/ tshig sbyor bde zhing go sla ba/ dmangs khrod kyi gtam dpe'i rang bzhin ldan pa/ skye bo kun gyis dka' tshegs med par bde blag tu 'jug nus pa dang bzhi/ tshig snyan zhing ro nyams ldan pa/ skye bo mchog dman kun gyi mig gi bdud rtsir gyur pa dang lnga'i khyad par gyi yon tan ldan pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i yon tan lnga ldan gyi rtsom rig gi rnam pa de/ bod mi rigs kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus thog gal che zhing 'phang mtho ba'i go sa yod par mkhas pa 4

sngon 'gro'i gtam/rnams kyis yang yang du bsngags pa'o/ /legs bshad rtsom rig de bod la ji ltar byung ba dang ji ltar 'phel ba'i lo rgyus thad cung tsam dpyad na/ bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum dang tun hong yig cha nas zhal gdams zhes pa dpe don sbyar nas bslab bya'i rang bzhin yod pa'i brtsams chos byung / de dag ni legs bshad rtsom rig gi sa bon lta bur gyur te/ rtsom rig gi rnam pa de bod yul du thog mar gzhi chags so/ /de rjes spyi lo dus rabs bcu gsum par sa skya parnyi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis zhal gdams de dag gi srol rgyun gzhir byas shing / 'phags yul gyi rtsom rig skye bo gso thigs sogs brtsams chos 'ga' dper byas nas legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba'i sho lo ka bzhi brgya lhag yod pa'i brtsams chos mdzad de/ legs bshad rtsom rig gi rnam gzhag gtan la phab/ dus rabs bcu drug par paṇa chen bsod nams grags pas sa skya legs bshad kyi rnam gzhag dang cha yongs su mtshungs pa'i mkhas blun brtag pa'i bstan bcos dge ldan legs 5

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bshad padma dkar po'i chun po zhes bya ba sho lo ka brgya lhag ldan pa'i bstan bcos mdzad de/ legs bshad rtsom rig gi rnam pa de je rgyas je legs su btang / de rjes dus rabs bco brgyad par gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes gong smras legs bshad bstan bcos dag ma dper byas nas chu'i bstan bcos dang shing gi bstan bcos zhes bsdoms pas sho lo ka nyis brgya lhag yod pa'i bstan bcos gnyis mdzad pa dang / dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i mkhas dbang dkyil zur blo bzang sbyin pas gung thang pa'i chu shing bstan bcos kyi rtsom stangs dang yongs su mthun pa'i lugs zung ba dan g.yo ba'i legs bshad rlung gi bstan bcos zhes bya ba sho lo ka drug cu lhag yod pa'i bstan bcos dang / 'jig rten mi chos dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya gsal bar ston pa'i legs bshad zla ba'i bstan bcos zhes pa sho lo ka sum cu lhag yod pa'i bstan bcos sogs du ma mdzad/ brtsams chos de dag ni thog mtha' bar gsum du dpe chos can gcig gi steng du de'i skyon yon brtags shing don dang sbyar nas bslab bya'i tshul gyis ston pa yin 6

sngon 'gro'i gtam/pas legs bshad kyi rtsom stangs gsar ba zhig spel ba yin/gzhan yang mkhas dbang 'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtshos gong smras legs bshad rtsom stangs kyi legs cha yongs su bsdus nas rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos zhes bya ba le'u nyer gcig dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos mdzad de/ legs bshad kyi rtsom stangs gong nas gong du spel ba yin no/ /smras pa/ skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi pir rtse las/ /thon pa'i leṭa par bshad pa'i bstan bcos rnams/ /rang re gangs can rtsom rig bang mdzod du/ /'od 'bar nor bu gcig tu ci yang snang / /de yang 'dzam gling rig gnas dga' tshal du/ /legs bshad ces pa'i me tog mtshar sdug cig /rnam par bzhad pas phyi nang mkhas pa yi/ /yid kyi bung ba dbang med phyogs 'dir 'khor/ /'di ltar legs bshad kyi che ba brjod pa dang rtsom rig gi rin thang dpog pa ni/ rtog bzo dang sgro 'dogs kyi gtam tsam ma 7

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/yin te/ bstan bcos de dag gi dngos gzhi dang de las byung ba'i phan yon gyis bsgrubs pas so/ /'o na legs bshad bstan bcos las byung ba'i phan yon ci yod ce na/ gzhan phan dge phyogs la mos pa dang sdig pa mi dge ba spong dgos pa'i slob gso gtong ba dang gcig yon tan la bstod cing blun rmongs la smad pa'i bsam blo spel ba dang gnyis/ las la brtson pa dang le lo spong dgos pa'i gnas lugs bstan pa dang gsum/ che ba la gus shing chung ba la gces pa'i lugs bzang spel ba dang bzhi/ mthun sgril la dga' zhing dbyen 'byed la sdang ba'i spyod bzang dar spel gtong ba dang lnga'o/ /'di lta bu'i phyogs lnga las bslab bya'i tshul gyis gdams te/ mi rnams kyi bsam blo dag sbyong dang kun spyod legs skyong byed pa la phan yon dpag dka' ba byung zhing / bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas dpal yon dang bsam blo'i dpal yon 'dzugs skrun byed pa dang spyi tshogs mthun sgrig byed pa la phan nus gzhal dka' ba bton pa yin no/ /da res mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis legs bshad 8

sngon 'gro'i gtam/bstan bcos de dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs zhes pa'i dpe tshogs par skrun byas pa de/ spyi tshogs la phan pa'i dge mtshan dang / rig gnas la phan pa'i don snying ldan pa zhig yin no/ /gna' mo'i legs bshad bstan bcos kyis/ /spel ba'i dgongs pa'i dge mtshan de/ /deng gi bsam blo'i dpal yon gyi/ / don snying dang mthun e ma rmad/ /ces spyi lo2006lo'i zla3pa'i tshes24nyin gyi na ba blo bzang chos grags kyis bris pa'o/ /bkra shis/ dge'o/ /

dkar chagadakar chagatun hong yig cha las phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo bzhugs so/ / (1)shes rab brgya pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa bzhugs so/ / (96)lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so (122)lugs kyi bstan bcos skye bo gso ba'i thigs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (189)ma ṇi bka' 'bum glegs bam gnyis pa zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor bzhugs so/ / (213)slob dpon padmas bod kyi rje 'bangs rnams la bzhag pa'i zhal chems bzhugs so/ / (291)1

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/kha che pha lu'i 'jig rten las 'bras rtsi lugs kyi bslab bya zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (326)mnyam med jo bo chen po rgya gar la phebs khar lha bla ma byang chub 'od la zhal gdams su stsal pa thar 'dod dpa' bo'i snying nor zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (367)mi chos gnad kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (375)rang gi slob ma la zhe thag pa nas gros 'debs pa'i yi ge snying gi thur ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (384)

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/༄༅/ /tun hong gi yig cha las phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/lugs kyi bstan bcos khag dang po/༄/ /gna' yul gser zhwa g.yu spun du 'thams pa gnyis shig/ /mchin pa na ba'-i rtsi/ chu 'dug 'dug pa las/ /nu bo yul gzhan du las bskoste/ brnyas par gyur nas/ཿ/phu bo lo nyi shu rtsa dgu lon pas/ /(nu bo)(bcu)brgyad lon bar 'gro ba la//btams shing / bstan pa'i mdo/ lo nyi shu rtsa dgu lon ba la//nu bo na re/ /bdag gyang thon dang sbyong zhing slob du gtang gtang na/ /da ni yul dgos na/ /grogs gyi nang na/ /khyod las/ /bdag la byams pa bgyes pa yang / shin tu dka' ste/ /rtag tu dran ba ni/ /zhag du/ /rmyi lam na snango/ /yid la chags pa'i tshad ni/ /brjod cha kyang / /dka' ba 1

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/tsham du sems shing mchis/ /da slan chad gachig la/ /las gyis/ skal pas/ /mjal myi mjal pag kyang / /shin tu dka' na/ /bdag 'dra ba'i rnams gyi rigs par/ /bshad du gsol/ /byams pa'i bka' drin/ rna du bskyud na/ /btams shing bka' chi stsal pa'i rnams gyang / su bab pa la/ /cha nod ching mchis/ /phu na re/ /bdagi yid la pa gnyis shig dran te/ /gachig tu ni/ /yang dag par snying gachig myi dang bral bas /shin tu yang yid la chags/ gnyisu na/ /pho(khyed)la/ /gtan tu 'grogs pa yang / dkon te/ /myi dga' ba'i ma du ga la rung / /yong gis snying gachig phan chad/ /yul nye rings ste legs pa'i drod gyang / dpag tu myi rig/ /yid gyis rtag tu 'drul na/ /ngo phrad pa dang yang chi ma mtshungaste/ /khyod gyis las bde ba thob na/ /yul gyis bskal pa'i phyir/ /myi dga' ba'i mdor la ma bab pa tshun chad/ /gachig la gachig bsam ste/ /bral ba'i skabs myed par bya'o/ /yongs ni/ deng bye ba dang /2

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/da ste/ lo brgya na(bye)ba gnyis/ /yid gachig ste/ bye brag myedo/ /'dri ba'i rnams gyang mdza' ba'i phyir spobs par byas ste/ /yid la chi dran pas lan yongasdi/ /gdams shing bachos pa ni/ sla'/ /de bzhin tu nus shi bu pa ni dga'o/ /dkaste(da ko ste)/ /chung zad chi dran ba ni/ mdo nyi tshe zhig bstan gyis/ /yid la bab pa'-i rnams ni/ /gzungs zung zhig/ / bab na/ /slar dris shig/ /phu na re/ /tshig stong pa btems don ched po yun du yod par 'gyuro/ /nor yod pa byin ba mi zad sheso de lta bas na/bden ba'i tshig byin ba las/ che ba myedo/ bzung legasna/ /de blangs pa las/ nor du che ba yang myedo/ /gna' dus yul gser zhwa g.yu gzhong bya ba na/ shin tu byams pa'i bu spun gnyis shig 'bral mi phod pa'i brtse dung gis gdung bzhin gnas yod pa las/ gcung po yul gzhan du las la bskos te mi 'gro ka med du gyur pa'i skabs/ gcen po rang lo nyi shu rtsa dgu lon pas/ gcung po rang lo bco brgyad du son pa yul gzhan du 'gro ba la gdams shing bstan pa'i snying po 3

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gcung pos smras pa/ bdag da ni yul gzhan du 'gro dgos na/nye grogs kyi nang na gcen po khyed las bdag la byams pa dang / mnyes gshin ldan pa shin tu dkon te/ sems nang rtag tu dran pa ni nyal ba'i rmi lam du'ang snang ngo / /yid la 'khreng ba'i tshad ni brjod pa'i yul las 'das kyang / rang nyid dka' ba tsam sems shing mchis/ da phyin chad dus yun ring po gcig la yul gyis bskal pas mjal dang mi mjal gyi tshod dpag kyang shin tu byed dka' na/ bdag 'dra ba'i gsar bu rnams kyis slad du ji ltar bgyi bar rigs pa dag bstan du gsol/ byams pa'i bka' drin nam yang mi brjed la/ ji ltar gdams shing bka' ci stsal pa rnams kyang yul dang dus su bab pa la cha tsam mi 'gal bar snying la zab tu nod cing mchis zhes gsol to/ /gcen pos smras pa/ bdag gi yid la bsam pa gnyis shig dran te gcig tu ni/ don dam snying gcig pa'i mi dang kha bral bas shin tu yang yid la 'khreng / gnyis su na kho bo khyed dang gtan du 'grogs pa'ang mi srid pas/mi dga' ba ma spong du ga la rung / spyir na phan tshun snying gcig yin phan chad/ yul nye'am ring yang rung ste legs pa'i nus pa dpag tu ma mchis/yid kyi pho nyas rtag tu rgyu 'grul byed na/ dngos su phrad pa dang yang ci ste mi mtshungs/ khyod kyi bya ba lam du lhongs na/ yul gyis bskal pa'i phyir mi 4

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/dga' ba'i mtha' ma che'i dus la ma bab pa tshun chad/ gcig la gcig gis bsam ste bral ba'i skabs med par bya'o/ /lar nas de ring kha bral ba dang / da nas lo brgya na kha bral ba gnyis don gcig ste khyad par med do/ /gtam 'dri bar 'os pa dag kyang mdza' ba'i phyir spobs pa cher bskyed de dris shig yid la gang dran pa'i lan 'debs so/ /spyir na gzhan la gdams shing bcos pa ni sla mod/ de bzhin du nus shing sgrub pa ni dka'o/ /da lta cung zad gang dran pa ltar 'phral sel bslab bya mdo tsam zhig bstan par bya yi/ yid la babs pa rnams ni snying la chongs shig ma rtogs ma babs pa dag slar dris shig ces dang /yang gcen pos gsungs pa/ tshig stong pa gdams pa tsam la'ang don chen po yun du yod par 'gyur ro/ /nor yod rgu byin kyang mi ring bar zad par 'gyur srid do/ /de lta bas na bden pa'i gdams ngag byin pa las rin thang che ba gzhan med do/ /de bzung nas legs par spyod shes na de las lhag pa'i nor du che ba'ang gzhan med do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /nu na re/ /myir skyes pa la/ gang bde na bde ba'i mchog yin//phu na re/ /sems bde na bde ba'-i mchog yin/ /sems myi bde na/ /gzhan chi bde yang bde ba ma yino/ /gcung pos dris pa/ mi lus blangs pa la gang zhig bde na bde ba'i 5

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mchog yin nam/gcen pos lan du/ sems bde na bde ba'i mchog yin/ sems mi bde na gzhan dag gang zhig bde na yang bde ba ma yin no/ /nu na re/ /sems bde ba'-i thabs chi ltar bya/ /phu na re/ /bdag la mtshang myed par byasna/ mtho ba'i sa na yang mtho zhing bde'o/ /dma' ba'i sa na yang / dma' zhing bde'o/ /yongs kyi rgyal po'i khrims la/ /srog srid gnyis brtan te/ /chi la yang / ran par bya ba'i rigs so/ /de las 'gal dang / /dgrar ni grogs ltog /dpung ni rgyal pos byasna/ /ma snyems pa'i yang myi myed la/ /shags gdab du yang / /yus med na/ / chi la brtan/ /gcung pos dris pa/ sems bde bar yong ba'i thabs ji ltar bya'am/gcen pos lan du/ rang nyid la nyes skyon gyis ma 'gos pa zhig byed thub na/ mtho sar gnas kyang don dam mtho zhing bde'o/ /dma' sar gnas na'ang rtag tu sems bde'o/ /spyir na rgyal po'i khrims la srog dang khyim srid gnyis ka brten dgos pas/ bya ba gang dang gang yin yang 'os shing 'tsham pa zhig bya ba'i rigs so/ /de las 'gal na/ dgra bo'i grogs 6

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/su 'gyur zhing / rgyab dpung rgyal pos byas na/ mi kun gyis kyang dregs nyams ston la/ rtsod pa rgyag par yang rgyu mtshan med na sems bde bar ga la gnas thub/nu na re/ /dgos pa la ma stor bar bya ba gang / /phu na re/ /yongs ni dgos pa la stor bar bya ba gachig gyang myede/ /de'i nang na mchog bdams na/ /(srog)srid nyis ma stor par bya 'o/ /gcung pos dris pa/ dgos pa'i nang nas mi brlag par bya 'os pa gang lags sam/gcen pos lan du/ spyir na dgos pa'i nang brlag 'os pa gcig kyang med/ de'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa bdams na srog dang khyim srid gnyis mi brlag par bya'o/ /nu na re/ /de ltar na gzhung gang gis gzung pa phu na re/ /gzhung drang pos zung la/ yan lag ma nor bar sgrubo/ /gcung pos dris pa/ de ltar yin na rtsa ba gang zhig gis gzung dgos sam/gcen pos lan du/ rtsa ba drang pos zungs la/ yan lag rnams kyang 7

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ma nor bar bsgrub par bya'o/ /nu na re/ / yin/ ma nor bas chi ltar bsgrub/phu na re/ /rgyal po'i chos khrims la/ /snyoms na/ drang zhes bya'o/ /chos khrims las myi 'byung yang / yus ma yus yin ma yin/ /bye brag phyed par byas na/ /de ni yan lag ma nor pas bsgrub ches bya yongs ni/ /myi'i dpon po byed na/ /nam ka dang mtshungs par snyoms shing srang dang 'dra bar drang la/ /yus gyis ma rangs pa myed/ chis(tshis)gyis ma khyab pa myed par bya ba'i rigaso/ /gcung pos dris pa/ drang po'i tshad ci yin/ ma nor ba ji ltar sgrub bam/gcen pos lan du/ rgyal po'i chos/ khrims kun la snyoms na drang zhes bya'o/ /khrims las mi 'byung ba'i rigs kyang / bden dang mi bden/yin dang ma yin sogs dbye ba so sor 'byed thub pa byas na/ de ni yan lag ma nor bar sgrub pa zhes bya ba yin/ mdor na mi'i dpon po byed na nam mkha' dang mtshungs par snyoms shing / srang mda' dang 'dra bar drang la/ bden can gyis ma rangs pa med pa dang / 'tsho skyong gis ma khyab pa 8

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/med par bya ba'i rigs so/ /nu na re/ /de ltar byas na/ gzhan la phan zhing / /legs gyang bden na/ /bdag la phan ba chi yod/phu na re/ /yongs ni/ gzhan la phan na yun du/ bdag la phan/ /gzhan la gnod na/ /yun du bdag la gnod ches bya'o/ /myi'i dpon po snyoms par bya na/ /'phral du bdag la phan 'ba' shig gi mdo gzungs rung baṃ/ /bu dang dgra gnyis gyi legs nyes la yang / /yon po mi byed na/ /de la ma rangs so zhes zer ba su zhig yod/ /gcung pos dris pa/ de ltar byas na gzhan la phan zhing legs pa bden yang / rang la phan pa ci zhig yod dam/gcen pos lan du/ spyir na gzhan la phan na yun du bdag la phan/gzhan la gnod na yun du bdag la gnod ces bya ba yin/ mi'i dpon po kun la snyoms pa zhig bya dgos na/ 'phral gang rang la phan pa 'ba' zhig gi snying don 'dzin du rung ngam/ bu dang dgra bo gnyis la'ang so sos legs nyes gang byas ltar las/ 'khyog po mi byed na de la yi rangs mi byed mkhan su zhig yod/

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/nu na re/ /drang ༷ snyoms pa 'di lta bu'i gzhung gzung na/yul de na chi batshun bar bya/ /phu na re/ / phyug po bas ni/ drang po dbul po batshun par brtsi'o/ rkun po bas ni/ bar brtsi'o /gcung pos dris pa/ drang zhing snyoms pa 'di lta bu rtsa bar gzung na/yul de ru gang dang gang zhig bzang bar brtsi'am/gcen pos lan du/ g.yo can phyug po las ni/ drang ldan dbul po bzang bar brtsi'o/ /rkun po las ni phongs pa bzang bar brtsi'o/ /nu na re/ /de lta bu'i gzhung myed na/ chi batshun tu brtsi'/phu na re/ / yul de na/ /yon po phyug po la ni bstod ching batshun bar brtsi'o/ /drang po dbul ni/ 'phya' zhing smod do/ /rkun po gacham pu la ni dga'/ sprang po phongs pa la ni gshe'o/ /gcung pos dris pa/ gal te de lta bu'i rtsa 'dzin med na/ gang dag bzang bar brtsi'am/gcen pos lan du/ de 'dra ba'i yul du/ g.yo can phyug po la 10

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/ni bstod cing bzang por brtsi/ drang po dbul po la ni 'phya zhing smad par byed/ rkun po dang kha mkhas can sogs la dga' bar byed cing / sprang po dang phongs pa dag la tshig rtsub mos gshe bar byed do/ /nu na re/ /drang por myi byar myi rung ba zhig yod na/ sran chi tsham du gzugs/phu na re/ /nyes pa yon po byed byed de/ gson babs/ /drang po snyoms pa byed byede shi yang bla ba tsham du sran gzugs dgoso/ /phyi byad bzang zhing kha drang la snying yo dang khong gsob du 'dug par ma byed chigagacung pos dris pa/ drang po ma byas par mi 'grig pa zhig yod na/tshad ji tsam du sran tshugs par bya dgos sam/gcen pos lan du/ bya ngan g.yo thabs kho na byed bzhin du gson por sdod pa bas/ drang zhing tshad ma 'ba' zhig byed bzhin du shi dgos byung yang chog pa tsam gyi bar du sran tshugs par bya dgos so/ /phyi tshul bzang zhing kha snyan la zhe 'khyog pa'i khog rul du gnas par ma byed ciganu na re/ /chi mthong na/ myi dga' zhing myi zhim du brtsi'/phu na re/ /gastsugi nor mthong na 'dre mthong ba dang 'dra bar 11

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/myi dga' ba brtsi'o/ /bslu ba'i zas mthong na/ skyug bro ba dang 'dra bar/ myi zhim bar brtsi'o /gcung pos dris pa/ gang dang gang zhig mthong na mi dga' ba dang /mi zhim par brtsi dgos sam/gcen pos lan du/ lkog rngan gyi rgyu nor mthong na gdug 'dre mthong ba ltar mi dga' bar brtsi'o/ /bslu brid kyi zas mthong na mi gtsang ba mthong ba ltar zhe log par brtsi dgos so/ /nu na re/ /nor ni sdug/ /zas ni zhim na/ 'di gnyis ster pa/ byams pa 'dra na/ chi phyir de ltar brtsi'/(phu na re) nor zas gnyis ni/ /yon por 'gyur ba'i gnya' nan te/ /byams pa ma yin gyi/ /dgra dang brtsi dgoso/ /gcung pos dris pa/ nor ni yid la 'bab cing / zas ni dang gar 'gro na/ 'di gnyis ster ba ni byams pa 'dra bas de lta bur brtsi dgos don gang yin nam/gcen pos lan du/ rgyu nor dang zhim zas de rigs kyis mi'i gnya' nas mnan te/ 'khyog lam du 'khrid pas byams pa ma yin gyi/ dgra dang 'dra bar brtsi dgos so/ /nu na re/ /de lta bu ma yin bar/ nor yas ster de byams pa 12

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/yod rda/(phu na re)nyes gyis dogaste/ ston ching nor sbyin dang / yos dog ste/ gshe zhing zan byin ba ni yang dag ches bya'o/ /gcung pos dris pa/ de lta bu ma yin pa'i nor dang zas ster ba'i byams sems can yod dam/gcen pos lan du/ gang dag nyes kyis dogs nas ma nor ba'i lam ston cing rgyu nor sbyin pa dang / lam log par lhung gis dogs te tshig nan pos gshe zhing / zas sbyin pa sogs ni yang dag par byams sems dang ldan pa zhes bya'o/ /nu na re/ /drang po'i chos byas gyang / /la la 'khyams pa yod na/ chi nyes/phu na re/ /de lta bu ni dkon ba'i rigaste/ 'ga' zhig yod du zin gyang / /bdag gis ma nyen yang dag pa la/ /dbang myed par 'ongs na/ /sus gyang myi slon te/ /srog chad pa dang /'dras/ 'gyod pa'i sa myed do/ /yongs gyang / nyes bye byed de legs pa ni/ /brgya' la gachigo/ /legs byed byed legs pa ni/kun no/ /13

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ gcung pos dris pa/ drang bden tshul bzhin byas na'ang / la lar pham nyes yong 'gro ba de gang yin nam/gcen pos lan du/ de lta bu ni ha cang dkon pa yin te/ 'ga' zhig 'byung ba srid kyang / rang gis ma nyes pa dngos 'brel la dbang med du de ltar gyur pa yin na sus kyang mi bsnyon te/ srog chad pa dang 'dra bas 'gyod pa byed pa'i rgyu yang med do/ /spyir na/ bya ba ngan pa byas byas nas legs pa byung ba ni brgya la srid mtha' tsam mo/ /bya ba bzang po byas byas nas legs pa yong ba ni kun la yod do/ /nu na re/ /'dzangs pa la rnam pa du/ /bya ba la gzhung du/ /chig la/ chud ma zos pa gang / /phu na re/ /'dzangs pa la rnam gnyis ste/ /mkhas pa dang snyoms pa gnyis so/ /bya ba la gzhung gnyiste/ /drang po dang yon po gnyiso/ /tshig la chud ma zos pa ni/ /myi dgos pa la myi smra 'o/ /yongs ni/ /ya rabs gyi tshul bya na/ /ha chang gcam bu/ /ma rabs gyi chos chungu dang / byis ba'i tshig phran tshegs/ /gyang gtang ba'i rig phar myi rtogs pa/ /myi slob par/ /stsing chos gyi ra chod gyang ma smra dang legaso/ /14

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/gcung pos dris pa/ mdzangs pa la rnam grangs ji tsam dang / bya ba la lugs ji tsam yod dam/ gtam la chud zos mi 'gro ba gang yod dam/gcen pos lan du/ mdzangs pa la rnam grangs gnyis te mkhas pa dang / snyoms pa gnyis so/ /bya ba la lugs gnyis te drang po dang 'khyog po gnyis so/ /gtam la chud zos mi 'gro ba ni dgos med du mi smra ba'o/ /spyir yang ya rabs kyi tshul skyong na/ ha cang kha mkhas dang / ma rabs kyi tshul phra mo/ byis pa'i col chung ba'i tshig dbyen 'byed pa'i gtam gzhan la mi sems pa/ gang la'ang mi slob pa/ mi srun pa'i brlang tshig smra ba la sogs mi bya ba legs so/ /nu na re/ /lngi(lce)ches na/ /myi bde zhing pho che ba ma lags sam /phu na re/ /yongs ni/ /bya 'o(chog) kyang / /thog tu phebs par bya dgoste/ /myi bde ba zhig zer gyis dogs pa'i/ /phyi ma dris par gar smra/ /pho che zhes zer gyis dogs pa'i phyir/yang ba gacham/ byar rung ngam/ /ye lci ba'i chos ni/ /bdag la dga' ba zhig byung baṃ/ /bdagis legs par chung zad tsham byas sam/ /bdag la rung ba dga' ba zhig bdog na/ /15

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gzhan gyis myi tshor gyis dogs pa bzhin/ /ya ya mo/ drod myi thub pa 'dra bar/ myi byed myi spyom/ /myi dga' ba che chung zhig byung yang / /yi chad pa 'dra bar/ /myi byed mi smra/ /gzhan gyi phyugs nor dang(slas ma) mthong na/ /bzang rnga zhes myi smon/ /bdagi 'khor dang skal ba mthongs(na myi sdug) ngan ches/ phral du/ don myed par myi smra/ /myi gshe'/ /bdag myi(stod phar myi smod)/ /'phral du dad pa 'o/ /bdag la dgos pa zhig yod la/ /glags(yod gang snang / yang) chos khyims las 'gal phan chad/ /gzhan gyis ma tshor bla 'o(snyam du myi byedo/ /)bdagi nyid shes phan chad/ gzhan gyis ma tshor yang / myi phan ba(tsam du myi 'dzind/ /chos khrims las ma)'gal na/ /phral la myi bde ba dang nyon mongs pa byung(yang bzod par byed pa dang)tshul 'di lta bu la stsogs pa/ byed pa ni lci zhes gyang bya'o/ /(yong ni mdor na yul)chos dang sbyar te/ /bdag gi che bzhi bdagis byas/ /gyang ma(khrel na'/ /pho che ba ma yin gyi)lci zhing gzungs thub pa'o/ /yongasdi/ /myir skyeso chog gyang / /legs pa 16

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/gzhan myi nus na yang / /myi'i chos bzhin chi nusu bya ba'i rigaso/ /gcung pos dris pa/ sgam ches drags na mi bde zhing / dregs che ba ma lags sam/gcen pos lan du/ spyir na bya ba gang yin yang don thog tu 'khyol ba zhig bya dgos te/ gal srid mi snyan pa zhig zer gyis dogs nas gtam bskyar nan ma dris par ji ltar smra/ dregs che zhes zer gyis dogs nas zol sbyor dang kha mkhas byed du rung ngam/ nam yang sgam pa'i tshul ni rang la dga' ba zhig byung ba'am/ rang nyid kyis bya ba legs pa cung zad tsam byas pa'am/rang la gzhan 'du ba'i don bzang zhig thob na de dag mi gzhan gyis ma shes kyis dogs pa bzhin drod gsab gsab sgom mi thub pa 'dra ba mi byed cing /mi ngom/ de bzhin yang mi dga' ba che chung gang zhig byung na'ang / yi thang chad pa 'dra ba mi byed cing / mi smra/ gzhan gyi phyugs rigs dang / rgyu nor/ 'khor 'bangs sogs mthong na 'di ltar bzang ba la ang snyam pa'i yid smon mi bya zhing / rang gi 'khor dang mnga' thang mthong dus sems la mi 'bab par skyo drags zhes 'phral du don med la mi smra zhing / ngan smras mi bya/rang bstod gzhan dmod mi bya/ 'phral du 'dod par babs pa'am rang la dgos mkho yod la/ thob pa'i go skabs shig yod na yang / khrims las 'gal phan chad/ gzhan gyis ma shes na sla'o snyam pa mi bgyi'o/ /rang nyid 17

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/kyis shes phyin/ gzhan gyis ma shes kyang mi phan par/ khrims las ma 'gal na/ 'phral gang mi bde ba dang sdug bsngal ba sogs byung yang bzod par byed pa dang / tshul 'di lta bu la sogs pa byed pa ni sgam pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /mdor na yul chos dang sbyar te rang gi dpang po rang gis byas kyang ma khrel na/ de ni dregs che ba ma yin par sgam zhing tshugs thub pa yin no/ /tha na mi lus blangs tshad tshang mas bya ba bzang po gzhan dag sgrub ma nus na yang // mi'i chos bzhin sgrub gang thub bya ba'i rigs so/ /nu na re/ /myi'i chos ni gang / /myi chos ma yin pa ni gang / /phu na re/ /myi'i chos ni/ /drang zhing sri zhu dang / des shing mnyen ba dang / snying rje 'e zhing / dngan chan myed rjes dang khrel yod/ snying chung zhing brtson 'grus che ba yin te/ 'dzangs yid myur myed gyang / /'di rnams lus la yod na/ /kun gyi snying du 'ong zhing srid brtand no/ /myi chos ma yin pa ni yo zhing gathum/yang zhing khrel dang rjes myed/ /snying rje myi shes zhing dngan chan che bla khyad byed ching le lo che ba yin te/ /'di rnams lus la yod dang / kun gyi yid du myi 'ong ba yino/ /gcung pos dris pa/ mi'i chos ni gang dang / mi'i chos ma yin pa ni 18

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/gang lags sam/gcen pos lan du/ mi'i chos ni drang zhing sri zhu yod pa dang / des shing yid gzhungs pa dang / snying rje che zhing brnyas bcos mi byed pa/ byas rjes brtsi zhing khrel yod pa/ sems srab cing brtson 'grus che ba bcas yin te/ mdzangs myur shes rig med kyang / gong du brjod pa rnams yid la yod na/ kun gyi yid du 'ong zhing khyim srid brtan pa yin no/ /mi chos ma yin pa ni/ rgyud mi drang zhing gtum pa dang / yid mi brtan zhing khrel dang rjes med pa/ snying rje mi shes shing brnyas bcos bya rgyur dga' ba/ khengs dregs byed cing le lo che ba bcas yin te/ 'di rnams su la yod kyang kun gyi yid du mi 'ong ba yin no/ /nu na re/ /sri zhu che ba ni gacham bu ma yin nam/ /mnyen ba ni mdzi ma zham che ba ma yin nam/ /snying rje'i nang na/ /ngo slog mye phod pa'i shas myed dam/ gathum ba la dpa' ba'i shas myed tam/ /phu na re/ /chi bya'o chog la yang / /dmyigasu/ /phebs par bya dgoste/ /sri zhu yang dmigasu ma bab na/ /gacham bu'o/ /dmyigasu bab na sri zhu'o/ /bya 'og chog thog tu phebs par byas na/ /mnyen zhes 'dzi ma zham myi 'gyur ro/ /thog tu ma bab na/ chi 19

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ltar gatshabs gyang / ngo slog ma yin/ 'chal ba yino/ /snying rje zhes bya ba ni/ /nyams las myi dpog par/ /pags myed pa dang /yon po'i chos byaste/ ma nyes par/ stams las bachad/ /du rung ngam/ /dpa' zhes bya ba ni/ /dgra la stsogs pa la/ /drag shul dang / gathum po bya dgos pa'i dus na/ /dmyigasu phebs par byas na ni/ dpa' ba yin gyi/ myi dgos par gathum po la/ /dpa' zhes sus gyang bstod/ /'di ni dpa' ba ma yin gyi/ /ngan pa yino/ /gcung pos dris pa/ sri zhu che ba ni pad lad ma yin nam/ yid gzhungs pa ni 'jam po'i bslu brid ma yin nam/ snying rje'i nang na ngo bzlog mi phod pa'i cha shas shig med dam/ gtum pa la'ang dpa' ba'i cha shas shig med dam/gcen pos lan du/ bya ba gang dang gang thams cad kyang don dngos dang mthun pa zhig bya dgos pa ste/ sri zhu yang tshad las 'gal na pad lad du 'gro'o/ /don dngos dang mthun na sri zhu'o/ /bya ba gang yin yang don dngos dang mthun par byas na yid gzhungs pa las 'jam po'i bslu brid du mi 'gyur ro/ /tshad dang ma mthun na ji ltar 'bad kyang don la mi 'khel 20

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/bar 'chal ba yin no/ /snying rje zhes pa'ang legs par mi dpog par/ bag med pa dang 'khyog po'i lam du zhugs te ma nyes par btsan shed kyis chad pa gcod du rung ngam snyam pa lta bu la'o/ /dpa' zhes bya ba ni dgra bo la sogs par drag shul gtum pa bya dgos pa'i dus su gnad du 'khel bar byas na ni dpa' ba dngos yin gyi/ mi dgos par gtum spyod byed pa la dpa' bo zhes su zhig bstod par byed/ 'di ni dpa' ba ma yin gyi/ ngan pa yin no/ /nu na re/ /legs pa cher ma nus na/ /chung zad tsham byaste phan ba chi yod/ / phu na re/ /khong na/ /'dzangs gyi rgyu myede na yang / legs pa gzhan ma nus na yang / yul tshis gyis/ /nyes par brtsi ba'i rnams/ /myi byed par thub na yang / drang po brtan po zhes bya ba yin te/ /de nus gyang phan che'o/ /nyes pa ni chung yang thong shigalegs pa ni chung yang / byos shigagacung pos dris pa/ bya ba legs pa che rigs byed ma nus na/ cung zad tsam byed pa la phan pa ci yod dam/gcen pos lan du/ rang gi khong na mdzangs pa'i rgyu med pa'i rkyen gyis legs pa'i bya ba gzhan byed ma nus na yang / yul srol spyi tshis kyis nyes par brtsi ba rnams mi bya ba byed thub na/ de yang drang po brtan po zhes 21

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bya ba yin te/ de tsam nus kyang phan pa che'o/ /nyes pa ni chung yang spongs shig legs pa ni chung yang sgrubs shiganu na re/ /bya'o chog la grosu myi byar myi rung na/ /gros kyi thabs chi ltar bya/ /phu na re/ /gros gyi mgo rtsings la/ bachos pa'i rnams mangs dang / 'tshal ches bya'o/ /gros su bya'o chog thog ma nas gyang / /zhib tu(gzhigs)la/ dmyigasu/ phebs par byas dang / /'phyis 'chos myi dgoso/ /bgro zhing(bsam)mo chog /ni/ /yid glod de/yangs par bsams dang / dmyigasu phebs pa 'ong ngo ji la yang / /dogs pa dang / sha dang lan glan bar byas dang / /ched chung ngu la rdadu sems pas/ /don chen po thog tu myi phebs par 'ong ngo/ /grosu bya ba ni/ bdag gis bdag la lan bathab ste/ /rung ngam myi rung gi bye brag phye la/ /bya ba gachig yod / /grogs dang snying gachig dang / mtshang du myi 'gyur gyi/ /dpyas gyis dogs(pa tsam)spobs par byas la/ thel gyis(phab/ ste/)tshigs bslug la/ spyis(bya ba gcig yod)do/ /phal gyis bsdus na/ /bdagir('gyur ba gcig yod do/ /chig tu brjed pa dang /22

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/dpyad)du bya ba la yang / de yon ba(yin ba tsam gyi tshad/ der 'ong ba 'dra zhes bya ba'i rigs gyi/ gdon myi za zhes bya ba)ni dkaste/ /la la(rung ba 'dra ba las myi rung / la la myi)rung ba ('dra ba las rung ba yod de' thog tu ma bab dang bdag sngur par 'ong ngo/ /gros su bya ba la'/ la la bden ba zer zhing 'ong ba dang )bdagis/ bden ba'i tshig myi rung ba la/ rung zhes zer pas 'phyis ma rung ba mngon bzhin du/ bad rung bar mngon bzhin du log par drangs pa nyes che'o/ /gachig du na kha nas/ 'phrog ste/ bdag gis sngar dran ba skad du byas nas/ grogs gyi yid du ste/ /thel gyis 'bebasu myi 'thubo/ yong yang / gros bya ba ni/ /gachigis myi rig gyis dogaste mang du bsogaste/ /gang bden ba gzung ba yin na/ /bdag zer ba ltar/ myi byar myi rung na lta/ /gros byar yang / chi dgos/ /bden ba'i tshig su las 'ong gtol myed gyis/ /rus chung byad ngan ches brnyasu myi rung ngo/ /yang dag par/ bden te/ ma nor na/ /su'i ngag mnyan gyang bla'o/ /gzhan gyi tshig rda ma phrad pa 23

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/zhig zer na/ /dgos pa yod srid gyis/ /ma skyengs par rjes nas dris shig gachig du sla rnams/ yid ches pa ma yin na 'phral du dran no chog gzhan la brjod ching smrar myi rung ba zhig gyang yod do/ /bdag bden na yang / /gzhan la na zhing gnod pa dang /bya dgos na yang/ /thabs dang sbyar zhing bya ba'i rigaso/ /myi 'phyi zhing kha tshas zer ba'i nang na/ la la phral du dran ba dag yod srid gyis/ /snying tshod blang ba'i rigs so/ /gcung pos dris pa/ bya ba thams cad bsgrub par gros ma byas na mi 'grig tshe/ gros byed pa'i thabs ji ltar bya'am/gcen pos lan du/ gros kyi 'go rtsing la/ bcos pa'i rnam pa mang ba zhig byed ces grags kyang / gros gzhi gang zhig yin rung thog ma nas kyang zhib tu bsams la/ gnad du 'khel bar gyis dang rjes su bskyar bcos mi dgos pa 'ong ngo / /gros mol dang bsam gzhig thams cad ni/ blo sgo yangs por phye nas bsam blo lhug par thongs dang gnad du smin pa 'ong ngo / /gang dang gang la'ang dogs pa dang / dgra sha'am 'khon lan slog rtsis byed pa/ don dag chung rtsag dam por 'dzin pa sogs byas na/ don chen po thog tu mi 'khyol ba 'ong ngo / /gros su bya ba ni/ rang gis rang la lan btab ste 'grig dang mi 'grig gi dbye ba phye la bsgrub par bya ba gcig yod/ grogs po 24

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/dang phan tshun snying gcig lta bu yin na/ skyon mtshang du 'gyur mi srid pas 'phya dmod bya dogs kyi sems 'tshab spangs te spobs par gyis la/ gros tshig rnams bsdus pa'i yig mjug thel tse gnon zhing / spyis mos bya ba zhig yod/ phal mo che gcig tu bsdus na bdag gir 'gyur ba zhig yod do/ /tshig tu brjod pa dang dpyad pa bya ba la'ang / de ltar yin nam snyam pa'i tshod dpag las 'di lta bu 'ong ba 'dra zhes smra bar 'os kyi/ gdon mi za zhes tshig thag gcod pa ni dka' ste/ la la yin pa 'dra ba la min pa dang / la la min pa 'dra ba la yin pa lta bu yod de/ gal srid gnad du ma khel ba byung na rang nyid phung ba 'ong ngo / /gros su bya ba la'ang la las gtam bden par brjod du 'ong ba dang kha cig gis ni bdag gis bden pa'i tshig brjod pa phyin ci slog ste/ mi 'grig pa'i rigs la 'grigs zhes zer ba dang /rjes su ma 'grigs pa mngon bzhin du bdag gis 'grigs par brjod pa dag log par drangs pa ni nyes pa ches che'o/ /yang phyogs gcig nas mi gzhan gyi bden pa'i tshig kha nas phrogs te/ so sos sngon la dran pa lta bur bcos nas grogs po gzhan gyi yid du mi 'bab par byas na gros 'khrugs te thel tse 'bebs mi thub bo/ /lar nas gros zhes pa ni/ mi gcig gis legs par mi shes snyam nas mang du bgros te bsags pa de'i nang nas gang bden che ba de gzhir bzung ba yin mod/ gal te rang gis gang bshad pa ltar ma byas tshe 25

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mi 'grig na lta gros byed kyang dgos don med/ bden pa'i tshig su zhig las 'ong bar nges pa med pas na/ nyam chung dang mdog ngan sogs la bltas nas brnyas bcos bya mi rung ngo / /yang dag par bden zhing ma nor ba zhig yin na su'i skad char nyan yang chog go /gzhan gyis tshig brda ma 'phrod pa zhig zer na/ dgos pa yod srid pas 'tsher snang ma byas par bskyar nas dris shigagacig tu 'grogs sla ba rnams yid ches pa zhig ma yin na/ 'phral 'phral sems la dran tshad gzhan la shod mi rung ba zhig kyang yod do/ /rang bden na yang / gzhan la ngan zhing gnod pa zhig bya dgos pa byung rung / thabs mkhas dang bstun nas bya ba'i rigs so/ /mi rgas shing kha tsha ba'i gtam tshig gi nang / la la gang bsam thad kar bshad pa yang yod srid pas/ nyams tshod len par rigs so/ /nu na re/ /lasu bya 'o chog la dmyigasu phebs par bya na chi ltar bya/ /phu na re/ /myi la la gzhung la ni rtsing tshig la ni zhib pa yodo/ /myi la la myi dgos pa'i/ yan lag la ni zhib ching dgos pa'-i mdo la ni rtsing ba yang yod do/ /yang dag par na ni/ /mdo ma shor na/ /yan lag kun gyang zhar la 'duste/ de las 'da' ba yang myedo/ /gachig tu na myong zhing shes pa la/ /'dri ba yang ma nor 26

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/ba'i mchog yino/ /gcung pos dris pa/ bya ba gang yin yang gnad du 'khel ba zhig yong ba bya na ji ltar bya'am/gcen pos lan du/ mi la la rtsa don la hol spyod byed kyang / kha nas ni zhib cing tshags pa shod mkhan yod do/ /mi la la mi dgos pa'i phran tshegs kyi yan lag la zhib tshags shing / gal che ba'i snying don la lhod pa yang yod do/ /yang dag par bshad na/ snying don ma shor na yan lag kun kyang zhar la 'du zhing / de las 'da' ba yang med do/ /gcig tu na nyams myong mang zhing shes pa can la gros 'dri ba de yang / bya ba mi nor ba'i thabs mchog cig yin no/ /nu na re/ /las bya'o chog grogs dang 'grogaste bya dgos na/ /grogs myi dga' bar yang ma gyur la/ las gyang ma nor bar zin par bya na chi ltar bya/ /phu na re/ /gzhan gyi tshig bzang ngan chi byung yang / /sun dbyung ba dang / ltag chod bgab zung myi bya bar/ /yangs zhing shong bar byas ste/ /mdo gang gis gzung ba nyid ma nor bar bsdu'/ /sun myi dbyung du myi rung ba zhig yod na yang / /kho ma 27

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/skyengs par/ tshig 'jam pos/ /dal nas bzho ste byas na/ /gzhan myi dga' bar yang ma gyur la/ las gyang ma nor par zin du rungo/ /gcung pos dris pa/ bya ba gang yang las rogs dang mnyam du sgrub dgos na/ rogs pa mi dga' bar mi 'gyur zhing / bya ba yang ma nor bar legs sgrub yong ba bya na ji ltar bya'am/gcen pos lan du/ gzhan gyi tshig bzang ngan gang byung na'ang /sun 'byin dang / dgag pa/ tshig snyad sogs mi bya bar khong yangs dkyel che khog tu shong bar byas te/ snying don gang yin pa de ma nor bar gzung dgos/ skyon 'don ma byas na mi 'grig pa zhig mchis na yang / rogs zla kha mi skyengs par tshig 'jam zhing dal bus dge skyon bshad na/ gzhan mi dga' bar mi 'gyur la/ bya ba yang ma nor bar sgrub tu rung ba yin no/ /nu na re/ /myi nor dad chan la/ /yongs ni 'dzangs pa zhig dang / las lhan chig tu bab na chi ltar bya'/phu na re/ /de ni 'dzangs su zin gyang / /yongs gyis nor dad che dang / 'dzangs drang po zhes dpyad du myi dgyis/ thog ma nas myi 'grogasu rung na rtsod pa'i yu ba chado/ de ltar ma rung na/28

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/phugs 'jam du bgyis la/ bdag la mtshang gis ma 'gos pa dang drang po'i/ gzhung ma shor par gyis shig/ /gcung pos dris pa/ mi nor dad che la/ shes yon 'dzoms pa zhig dang mnyam du las ka byed dgos byung na ji ltar bya'am/gcen pos lan du/ de ni shes yon 'dzoms kyang / gtso bor nor dad che ba dang / mdzangs shing drang ba gnyis mthun thabs med pas/thog ma nas 'brel 'dris che ba ma byas par 'grigs na gyod gzhi yong don med do/ /gal srid 'brel 'dris ma byas mthu med byung na/ 'jam zhing thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas rang nyid la nyes skyon ma 'gos pa dang / drang po'i gzhung lugs ma shor bar gyis shiganu na re/ /gzhung ma shor par byas dang / /kho'i yid dang 'gal te/ /myi dga' bar 'gyur na chi ltar bya/ /phu na re/ /myi dga' ba'-i rim 'gro/ 'jam pos bya bar zad de/ /yong ni/ /myi dgos pa la ma byas/ smra mi dgos pa la/ /ma smras na/ /yon po'i yid dang 'thun bar ma byas pa ni/ /yon po ma yin gyi legs gyi ra ba 'o/ /ye ni/ las gyi ngo shes par byos shig ma rtos shig/ /29

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ gcung pos dris pa/ drang po'i gzhung ma shor bar byas na/ kho'i yid dang 'gal nas mi dga' bar gyur na ji ltar bya'am/gcen pos lan du/ mi dga' ba de 'jam po'i sgo nas sel thabs bya ba las thabs med/ spyir na bya mi dgos pa la ma byas shing / smra mi dgos pa la ma smras na/ g.yon can gyi 'dod blo dang mthun par ma byas pa ni/ nyes skyon ma yin gyi legs pa'i rtser son pa yin no/ /nam yin yang bya ba'i ngo bo shes par gyis la/ gzhan la ma ltos shiganu na re/ /blon gdab na chi ltar gdab/ /phu na re/ /blon gdab du chud do chog la/ /nyes pa yod na/ /ngor blon thob shig /ngor blon ma thebs na/ /dkog dpyas ma byed chig/ /yi ni pha rol po la/ /blon gdab du rung yang dag 'o/ /nyes yang dag par rtogs na/ /gdab bo/ /gzhan la 'phya' ba la ni/ /mkhas/ /bdag la ni myi rig pa mang ngo/ /pha log la dpyas bya ba 'dra bar/ /bdag la yang chi yod pa bsal te/ /yod dang phyi 'chad myi bya bar bachad na bdag gis bdag bachos zhes bya'o/ /de ltar bdag gis myi nus na/ /gzhan la dkon dpyas byar rung ngam/ /30

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/gcung pos dris pa/ gros gdab na ji ltar 'debs dgos sam/gcen pos lan du/ gros 'debs bya yul du gyur pa kun nyes skyon yod na gdong thug gis gros 'debs gyis shig gros btab kyang ma thebs na lkog tu 'phya dmod ma byed cig gzhi nas pha rol po la gros 'debs dgos nges yin pa'am/ nyes thag chod yin na gros 'debs bya'o/ /de min gzhan la 'phya ba la ni mkhas pa dang / rang la yod pa'i skyon ni mi mthong ba mang ngo / /phar phyogs la 'phya dmod byed pa dang 'dra bar rang la'ang skyon gang yod btsal te spong zhing / phyin chad mi bya bar bsdoms na rang gis rang bcos pa zhes bya'o/ /gal te rang gis de ltar byed mi nus na/ mi gzhan la lkog bshad byar rung ngam/nu na re/ /blon gdab pa'i tshad chis gzung / /bdag la bdag gis bachos pa ni dka' na/ /mdza' bo la la dang / /gachig gi g.yo gachigis gzung bar bya na rung ngam myi rung / /phu na re/ /blon gdab du rung ba'i tshad ni/ /blon btab gyang / /myi dga' ba'-i mdud par myi 'dzin/ /g.yo gtong bar 'gyur na/ /blon gdab du rungo/ /g.yo 'dzin pa'i zla ni/ /yang dag pa'i/ /snying gachig pa yod dang legs gyis/ /'dzi ma zham ma 31

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/byed chig/ /myi mang po'i nang na/ ma smra shig/ /gcung pos dris pa/ gros gdab 'os pa'i tshad gang la byed dam/gcen pos lan du/ gros gdab na 'os pa'i tshad ni/ gros btab kyang mi dga' ba'i 'khon 'dzin mi byed pa dang / yo bsrang byed par 'gyur tshe gros btab na 'grig go /gsang ba srung ba'i rogs zla ni don dam pa'i blo gcig sems gcig yin na legs pa yin gyi/ phyi ma nang ma byed cig mi mang po'i nang du ma shod ciganu na re/ /'khor bde dang bya na chis bsdu'/phu na re/ /chu gang dang gzungs yod par byas la sems 'thun bar byas dang / 'khor bde bar ma zad gyi/ /gar song yang bde bar 'ong gis/ /bu zhig na pha'i sems dang 'thun bar byos shig/ /nu bo zhig na/ /phu bo'i sems dang 'thun bar byos shig/ /bran zhig na rjo bo'i sems dang 'thun bar byos shig/ /chung ma zhig na/ /khyo'i sems dang 'thun bar byos shig/ /g.yog chig na/ dpon po'i sems dang 'thun bar byos shig/ /de lta ste/gzhung ma nor par bzang la/ /sems 'thun bas/ bsdus na/ /kun kyang bde bar rungo/ /sems myi 'thun ba las/ /nad che ba 32

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/myedo/ /gcung pos dris pa/ gnyen 'khor bde thabs byed na gang gis bsdu'am/gcen pos lan du/ sha zhen dang phyi thag yod par byas te sems mthun par gyis dang / gnyen 'khor bde ba tsam du ma zad/ gang du phyin kyang bde bar 'ong ngo / /bu zhig yin na pha'i sems dang mthun par gyis shigagacung po zhig yin na gcen po'i sems dang mthun par gyis shig bran 'khor zhig yin na rje bo'i sems dang mthun par gyis shig chung ma zhig yin na khyo bo'i sems dang mthun par gyis shig g.yog po zhig yin na dpon po'i sems dang mthun par gyis shig de ltar bgyis na lugs ma nor bar bzang zhing / sems mthun pas bsdus na kun kyang bde bar byed nus so/ /sems mi mthun pa las snying nad che ba med do/ /nu na re/ /de ltar rung na/ bde ba ni 'gyur na/ sems/'thun ba thabs chi ltar bya'/ /phu na re/ /de ni bla ma rnams gyis gyang / 'os shing ran pa dang / thog tu phebs shing / myi marnyas par byaste/ /legs pa drang po'i/ chos gyisaḥbakol lo/ /'og ma rnams gyis gyang / /lta rgyab gnyis rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / phugs bde bar dgongs pa 33

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/las bltas na/ /las kyang rgyun myi gachad par bsam mod/ /gachig du na/ bla ma batshun zhing phangs par brtsi ste/ /chi la yang /gus shing rim pa yod par byas na/ /legs bde bar 'thuno/ /yongs dga' na ni/ /skyid pa yin/ /myi dga' na ni sdug pa yin gyis/ /khyim na 'dug na/ a chang ma 'chur/ /myi dgos pa'i yo lang 'og ma la bskyed/ /ring por myi thogs pa la/ /'og la myi dga' bar ma gyur la/ las zin du rung ngo/ /gachig du/ rgan gzhon dang / dpon g.yog dang rje gol gyi tshul yong par byas la /yul chos gyi nyes pa byed du myi gzhugs par/ nan thur gyis khugs par bya'o/ /gcung pos dris pa/ de ltar thub na bde ba thob la/ sems mthun pa yong ba'i thabs ji ltar bya dgos sam/gcen pos lan du/ de ni gong rim rnams kyis kyang 'os shing 'tshams pa dang / don la 'khyol ba/ brnyas bcos ma yin pa bcas byas te/legs shing drang po'i tshul gyis bkol bar bya'o/ /'og rim rnams kyis kyang rgyun mi 'chad par rgyab mdun mtshungs pa dang / phugs bde bar dgongs pa la bltas na/ bya las kyang rgyun mi gcad par bsam mod/ gcig tu gong 34

da phubosanubor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/ —rim rnams btsun zhing gces par brtsi dgos te/ gang dang gang la yang gus shing rim pa yod par byas na/ legs shing bde bar mthun pa 'ong ngo / /yongs dga' na ni skyid pa yin/ mi dga' na ni sdug pa yin gyi/ khyim na 'dug na'ang / de las mi 'da'/ mi dgos pa'i yo lang 'og rim la ma bskyed na/ ring por ma thogs par 'og rim mi dga' bar mi 'gyur la/ bya las kyang zin du rung ngo / /gcig tu rgan gzhon dang / dpon g.yog rje 'bangs kyi tshul yod par gyis la/ yul srol dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa byed du mi 'jug par nan tan gyi sgo nas khugs par bya'o/ /nu na re/ /tshul yod pa chi lta bu/ /phu na re/ /gzhon ba dang / g.yog bran zhes/ /sa rdo dang mtshungs rjed nga ba dang / myi myi phangs pa dang / rgyud dang rten myed par myi bya'/ /bdagi nyams las blang ste/ /bkol zhing spyad pa yang / /ran bar bya'o/ /bu tsha dang gzhi rten yod par byas na/ /bdag la yang phan khong yang dga' zhing snying nye'o/ /'di ltar na/tshul yod ches bya'o/ /tshul yod na/ yul chos gyis nyes pa byed du myi gzhug sar/ /nan thur byas pa la/ myi dga' bar byed pa su zhig yod/ /de ltar ma gyur na/ /drang po legs pa'i chos yin te/ /35

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rje gol gnyis/ dpon g.yog gnyis rgan gzhon gnyisu/ drang po legs pa'i chos byed na/ /de la myi smon myi 'du' ba'-i myi su zhig yod/gcung pos dris pa/ tshul dang ldan pa bya ba ji lta bu lags sam/gcen pos lan du/ gzhon pa dag dang / g.yog bran zhes pa rnams sa rdo dang 'dra bar ci mi snyam pa dang / mir mi brtsi ba dang / rigs rgyud dang 'tsho rten med pa bcas mi bya bar/ rang nyid kyi myong tshor las dpags te bkol zhing spyod pa yang ran par bya'o/ /bu tsha dang 'tsho rten yod par byas na rang la yang phan/ khong tsho'ang dga' zhing snying nye ba 'ong ngo / /'di ltar byas na tshul dang ldan pa zhes bya'o/ /tshul dang ldan na yul srol las 'gal ba'i nyes pa byed du mi 'jug par nan tan gyis gcun 'doms bya ba la mi dga' ba byed mkhan su zhig yod/ de ltar gyur na/ de drang zhing legs par byas pa'i lam yin te/ rje 'bangs gnyis/ dpon g.yog gnyis/ rgan gzhon gnyis la sogs kun la drang zhing legs par byas pa'i lam ston na/ de la mi smon pa dang mi 'du ba'i mi su zhig yod/nu na re/ /bran du pha gol po las lhag pa yod rda/ /phu na re/ /yang dag par snying nye ba las/ lhag pa myedo/snying nye la pha gol po yin na/ de las lhag pa yang / ga la yod/ /36

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/snying ring na/ pha gol po yang myi phano/ /snying nye na batshon yang bla'o/ /gcung pos dris pa/ bran du pha khol po'i bu las lhag pa yod dam/gcen pos lan du/ don dam pa'i snying nye ba las lhag pa med de/snying nye ba'i thog la pha khol po yin pa'i bu yin na/ de bas lhag pa ga la yod/sems log na pha khol po'i bu yin yang mi phan no/ /snying nye na gzhan nas bzung ba'i btson pa yin yang chog go /nu na re/ /bran g.yog rgod bag chan dang / blun po ngan pa/bkol na/ chi ltar bya/ /phu na re/ /yong ni/ /ya rabs ni/ drin gyis bkold/ ma rabs ni/ /nan thur gyis bkol zhes bya mod gyi/ /'dzangs ngan kun la yang / drin dang nan thur myed du myi rungo/ rgod bag chan ni/ /nan thur gyis drag du bkug la/ myi byed par thub na/ 'or che zhes/ tshigis bstod ching myig drango/ /ngan pa ni/ chi ltar bya ba'i thabs bstan ching / nug(nyug)chig ches/ yid bsring ste gzhen gdabo/ /bar bar legs pa 'ga' zhig byung na yang /'or che zhes chigis bstod de/ /sems gso' zhing / yi ma chad ma 37

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gram par bya'o/ /nus pa tsham la/ /byed du myi bathub 'am/ /nyes byed na/ /nan thur skyed chig/ /gcung pos dris pa/ bran g.yog ma dul ba dang / blun po/ ngan pa bcas ji ltar legs par bkol lam/gcen pos lan du/ spyir bshad na/ ya rabs ni drin gyis bkol/ma rabs ni nan gcun gyis bkol zhes grags mod kyi/ 'on te bzang ngan kun la yang drin dang / nan po gnyis ka med du mi rung ngo / /ma dul ba dag ni nan tan gyis drag tu gcun la/ rtsing spyod las ldog par nus na legs so zhes tshig gis bstod cing / mig dper 'dren dgos/ blun po la ni/ ji ltar bya dgos pa'i thabs ston zhing / sbyongs shig ces sogs rgyun bsrings te gzhen skul 'debs dgos/ skabs rer cung zad yar skyed byung dus legs so zhes tshig gis gzengs bstod cing / sems gso ba sogs mdor na yi mi 'chad pa dang mi 'thor bar bya'o/ /sgrub nus bzhin du mi byed pa'am/ spyod nyes byed na nan pos gcun zhiganu na re/ /g.yog bran gnyis legs nyes gnyis zhig byas na/ /chad pa dang bya dga' bya ba ched che 'am chung / spyo ba yang mtshangs ma brus na ni snying myi tshim/ /bru drags na ni/ /yi chad na chi ltar bya'/ /38

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/phu na re/ /chad pa ni/ /nyes pa byed du myi gzhug pa'i sdigs mo/ /bya dga' ni/ legs pa'iḥzho shaḥ/ khong na ma lus pa'i/ /myig 'dren pa ste/ /'di ni/ thog tu phebs pa dang / mdong rtsol cher bya ba'i rigaso/ /spyo ba'i gyod tsham la ni/ /kho na nyid gyis/ /chi nyes pa'-i phyir/ spyos pas/ chog gis/ /pha myes la stsogs paḥsmos shing spyos pa ni/ yi chad par 'ong gis/ /mtshang bru ba'i myi rigs so legs pa byas gyang ngo so myed/ /nyes pa byas gyang /gyod myi rma ba ni/ /chis 'jam zhing legs pa ma yin gyi/ 'khrug pa yin no/ /gcung pos dris pa/ bran g.yog gang zhig gis legs pa'am/ nyes pa byas na/ chad pa dang bya dga' so sor sprod pa de gal che'am mi che/ gshe gshe gtong ba na skyon mtshang ma bsngogs na ni snying mi tshim/ bsngogs drags na ni yi chad par gyur tshe ji ltar bya'am/gcen pos lan du/ chad pa ni nyes pa byed du mi 'jug pa'i dran bskul dang / bya dga' ni legs cha'i nus pa khong na ma lus par 'don du 'jug pa'i mig dpe 'dzugs pa'i don du yin/ de rigs ni gnad du 'khel ba dang mngon gsal ches cher bya ba'i rigs so/ /gshe gshe gtong ba la ni 39

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/kho pa rang gi gang nyes pa'i tshad gzhir dpags nas btang bas chog cing /kho'i pha mes la sogs pa'i lo 'phros bgrangs nas dmod par byed pa ni yi 'chad par 'gyur srid pas thal drags pa dag bya ba mi rigs so/ /legs pa byas kyang ngo so med pa dang / nyes pa byas kyang le lan mi 'da' ba ni 'jam zhing legs pa cis kyang ma yin gyi/ don rnams 'khrug pa'i rgyu yin no/ /nu na re/ /sri zhu bya na chi bzang /phu na re/ /bu tshas ni pha ma dang / gnyen bshes myi 'gyod par nus na/ sri zhu'i mchogo/ /g.yog bran gyis ni rjo bo dang dpon po myi gshe bar nus na/ /sri zhu'i mchogo/ /de ltar nus na/ /bdagis chi bya'o chog la/ /bde zhing yangs par 'ong ngo/ /non snying ma tshang ba/ /myi/ gzhan gyi ngag nyan pa dang / bsam pa nor pas/ /rjo bo dang dpon po dang pha ma man chad/ /gnyen grogs dang / /bran yan chad bsad pa dang / /'bye 'thab pa yod do/ 'di lta bu'i myi ni/ /mthong ngo chog gis/ /'dre dang mtshungs par bya ba'i rigaso/ 'di lta bu myi rigs/ ma nyes pa yang / /gsod na/ /des myi ma bsad pa gag yin/ /de la bltas na/ /myi ma yin te 'dre bar mngon no/ /myi la la/ /sha rus gyis 40

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/gnyen ba bas/ /chung ma gnyen bar brtsi ba yod do/ /chung ma chi ltar sdug gyang nyor rnyed gyis/ /pha ma dang phu nu bo chi ltar myi sdug gyang / /gud nas batshal du myi rnyed do/ /de lta bas na/ /bu dang chung ma bas ni/ /pha ma dang phu nu bo/ phangs par brtsi dgoso/ /bu tsha pha mas gsos te/ /phangs pa'i rim 'gro myig dang mtshungs par byas pa yang / /rgas pa'i bsel dang lan glon bar dgosu zad de/ /skyes na slar lan glon zhing chi nus gyis bya ba'i rigaso/ /dper na/ gachan zan/ mtsha' dang bya rgod gyi bu yang / /pha ma'i drin gyi lan glon na/ myi'i bu lta chi smos ma rabs gyis phan gzhan du gdagasu myed gyang / /pha ma'i ngag mnyan te/ yid dang ma gal pe'i rim 'gro cher bya ba'i rigaso/ /pha ma yod gyi bar du/ /bu pho smos/ /shes gyang / blon gdab pa'i rigs gyi/ /so nam gyi dbang bya ba'i myi rigaso/ /bu 'ang thugs thub myi byed na/ mna' ma lta chi smos/ /pha ma dang bla ma la/ sri zhu myed na/ de ni phyugs dang mtshungs gyis/ /myi zhes mying ma gdags shig/ /gcung pos dris pa/ sri zhu bsgrub na ji ltar bgyi ba bzang ngam/gcen pos lan du/ bu tshas ni pha ma dang / gnyen bshes rnams kyi 41

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/yid tshim par nus na sri zhu'i mchog yin no/ /g.yog bran gyis ni rje bo dang dpon po mi khro bar byed nus na sri zhu'i mchog yin no/ /de ltar nus na rang gis gang byas na thams cad bde zhing bag phebs par 'ong ngo / /glo snying ma tshang bar mi gzhan gyi kha la nyan pa dang / bsam pa log pas rje bo dang /dpon po/ pha ma man chad/ gnyen grogs dang / bran 'khor yan chad gsod pa dang / 'byed pa/ 'thab pa sogs byed pa yod do/ /de lta bu'i mi ni mthong ba tsam gyis gdug 'dre phrad pa dang 'dra bar bya ba'i rigs so/ /'di 'dra bar mi 'os/ ma nor ba yang gsod na/ des mi mi gsod pa ga la srid/ de la bltas na kho ni mi ma yin te 'dre 'dra bar mngon no/ /mi la la sha rus gcig pa'i spun nye las/ chung ma nye bar brtsi mkhan yang yod do/ /chung ma ji ltar yid du 'ong yang nyo rgyu rnyed cing / pha ma dang phu nu ji ltar yid du mi 'bab kyang gzhan nas btsal bas mi rnyed do/ /de lta bas na bu dang chung ma las ni/ pha ma dang phu nu gces par brtsi dgos so/ /bu tsha pha mas gsos te brtse ba'i gces skyong mig dang 'dra bar byas pa de yang / rgas pa'i skyel ma dang drin lan 'jal ba'i don du zad na cher longs nas sku drin gang thub ci nus kyis gsol bar rigs so/ /dper na/ gcan gzan 'phar ba dang bya rgod kyi phru gus kyang pha ma'i drin lan 'jal bar byed na/mi'i bu rnams lta ci smos/ ma mthar phan gzhan 'dogs ma thub na'ang pha 42

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/ma'i bka' la nyan te thugs dang ma 'gal ba'i zhabs 'gyur gang che bya ba'i rigs so/ /pha ma nam bzhugs kyi bar du bu dang bu mos shes shing 'jon na yang gsal 'debs zhu 'os pa las/ khyim las kyi dbang cha len par mi rigs so/ /bus kyang the gtogs mi byed na mna' ma lta ci smos/ pha ma dang gong rim la gus zhabs mi byed na/ de ni dud 'gro dang 'dra bas mi zhes pa'i ming ma 'bod ciganu na re/ /byams pa zhig yod na chi ltar bya/ /phu na re/ /legs pa la de'i snying dang mtshungs par/ /rjo bo dang dpon po zhig byams na/ /gag na yang / drod myi thub pa dang / /gzhan la nam zhig na/ bu tsha'i gnod pa'i tshul du ma bye chig bdag shi ba'i phyi na yang / /phangs pa'i mye ngan gzhagi/ /myi phangs pa'-i/ shir dga' ba myi gzhago/ /yong yang myi 'o chog yid 'jog par byos shig/ /gcung pos dris pa/ rang la byams pa zhig yod na de la ji ltar bya'am/gcen pos lan du/ bzang po la ni de'i snying dang 'dra bar bya/ rje bo'am dpon po zhig byams na/ gang du'ang blos mi thub pa dang / mi gzhan gyi don la nam zhig bu tshas pha mar gnod pa'i tshul ltar ma byed cig rang shi ba'i rjes su yang / khong tshor sems la mya ngan 'jog pa las/ mi phangs 43

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/par shi na dga' ba lta bu mi 'jog go /mdor na/ mi tshang mas cha 'jog thob pa zhig gyis shiganu na re/ /yid 'jog pa chi ltar bya'/ /phu na re/ /chi yang myi brdzun na kun yid cheso/ /yid ches na/ /kun yid 'jog pa de nas 'byungo/gcung pos dris pa/ cha 'jog thob pa zhig ji ltar bya'am/gcen pos lan du/ rdzun gyi tshig ci yang ma bshad na kun yid ches pa yin/ yid ches na kun gyi cha 'jog 'thob pa de nas 'byung ngo / /nu na re/ /byams pas chi byin na che/phu na re/ /rjo bo byams na/ srid byin ba lasaḥ/ byin ba che ba myedo/ dpon po byams na 'dzangs lo ba(lob)par byas na/byin ba che'o/ /gcung pos dris pa/ byams pa'i mis ci zhig byin na sbyin pa che'am/gcen pos lan du/ rje bo byams na srid dbang byin pa las sbyin pa che ba gzhan med do/ /dpon po byams na shes yon byang bar bslabs na sbyin pa de che'o/ /nu na re/ /bdag la g.yog mkho' ba zhig yod la/ nor 44

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/byin tu ni/ /bdag gyang dbul bas/ /chen po byin du myi bdog na/ /lan chis glan/ /phu na re/ /de ni srid myi ster pa'-i/ /chos shes par byas na/ /de las lan du che ba myedo/ /nor yang de'i nang na chog par yod do/ /chi la yang byams pa dang / sdang ba gnyis/ /bye brag byed par byos shig byams pa yin ba las/ /ma rig ste/ sdang bar bsams na yang nyeso/ /sdang ba yin ba las/ ma rig ste/ byams par byas na yang nyeso/ /la la snying nas sdang ba ma yin ba las/kho'i chos dang 'thun bar byas na legs pa ma yin/ /nyes ste/ /byed do chog /ma nor nas/ /sdang ba dang mtshungs par 'gyur ba yodo/ /gcung pos dris pa/ rang la phan pa'i g.yog cig yod pa la rgyu nor sbyin pa la ni rang yang dbul bas rngo thogs pa zhig ma mchis na/ lan gang gis 'jal lam/gcen pos lan du/ de ni srid dbang ster ba'i tshul shes par byas na/de las che ba'i lan 'jal du med do/ /rgyu nor yang de'i nang na 'dang nges yod do/ /byams pa dang sdang ba gnyis ci nas kyang dbye ba gsal por phye zhig45

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/byams pa yin pa la de ma shes par sdang bar rtsis na yang nyes so/ /sdang ba yin pa la de ma shes par byams par rtsis na yang nyes so/ /la la snying nas sdang ba ma yin na yang / kho'i jus dang mthun par byas na mi legs shing nyes par gyur te byas tshad tshang ma nor nas sdang ba dang mtshungs par 'gyur ba'ang yod do/ /nu na re/ /de gsum chi lta bu/ /phu na re/ /bdagis nyes gyis dogaste/ /bachos shing gshe ba dang / bdagi skyon drang por smra zhing / ston pa ni/ /byams pa yin na/ /bdagi yid dang myi 'thun bas sdang ba yodo/ /bdagis nyes pa kun la yang / rung zhes bstod ching / bsten(bstun)pa la 'ang / /la la kho bdagis/ /nyes pa sngar rdul(rtul)ba'i grogasu dgos pa'i phyir/ /nor dang man ngag 'dra ba'i tshig gis/ /bzlu zhing / legs shes zer ba yodo/ /'di na sdang ba yin na/ bdagi yid dang 'thun ba'i riphyir/ /byams pa 'dra bar brtsi ba yodo/ /ma tshor bar sdang ni/ /dper na/ /khro ba dang / bsar la sred pa lta bu la/ /de legs zhing bzang zhes zer zhing / bstod pas/ /bdag dang gnyis kas/ ma tshor nas/ ma legs pa la/ legs 46

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/par 'dzin pas/ /yid la bab pa bzhin/ /drang por bstan pas/ /legs pa ma yin te/ stang ba dang mtshungs par/ gyur to/ /gcung pos dris pa/ de gsum ji lta bu yin nam/gcen pos lan du/ bdag cag gis nyes kyis dogs nas de las bzlog pa'i don du gshe gshe gtong ba dang / bdag la yod pa'i skyon rnams drang por smra zhing ston pa dag ni/ byams pa yin na yang / rang gi 'dod blo dang ma mthun par brten sdang bar byed pa yod do/ /yang bdag cag gis nyes pa kun la yang 'grigs song zhes bstod cing bstun pa'ang yod la/ la la dag kho pas bdag gi nyes pa de bdag snga tsam dbang du bsdu ba'i grogs su dgos pa'i phyir/ rgyu nor dang man ngag 'dra ba'i tshig gis sbran zhing legs zhes zer ba yod do/ /de dag sdang ba yin na'ang / rang gi 'dod blo dang mthun par brten byams pa dang 'dra bar brtsi ba yang yod do/ /yang bsam bzhin du ma yin pa'i sdang ba ni/ dper na/ khong khro dang / a gsar la dga' ba lta bu la/ de legs shing bzang zhes zer nas bstod pas/ rang gzhan gnyis kas ma tshor bar mi legs pa la legs par 'dzin pas yid la babs pa bzhin/ drang por bstan na yang legs pa ma yin te sdang ba dang mtshungs par gyur to/ /nu na re/ /bdag la bla ma gshe na chi ltar bya/ /47

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/phu na re/ /bdag dgis nyes na/ /khas long shig/ /ma nyes na/ /byang bar 'jam du shod chig/ /ma nyes pa gshe zhes/ /chu tshad dang log pa nang tshig gyi ste bkyed na/ /bdag la gnodo/ /bdag la g.yo yod na/ bor te/ slar bskor zhing yid ches par bya ba'-i rigaso/gcung pos dris pa/ rang la gong rim nas bka' bkyon gnang na ji ltar bya'am/gcen pos lan du/ rang gis nyes pa yin na ni ngos len zhu dgos/ma nyes na ni rgyu mtshan rnams tshig 'jam pos shod cig ma nyes par gshe gshe gtong ba zhes tshad las brgal te nang nyams kyi tshig shugs che drags na rang la gnod do/ /gal te rang la gnong yod na spangs te slar de las ldog cing / yid ches 'thob par bya ba'i rigs so/ /nu na re/ /myi chigis nyes byas na/ /bye brag dbyer yod rda myed/ /phu na re/ /bye brag dbyer yod de/ /gzho nu'i tshe la ni nyos(nyes)so chog byasu zin gyang / /mkhon du myi rungo/ /blo rdzogaste/ /nyes na ni/ nyes yang dgis/ /mkhon du rungo/ /rje gol gnyis pha 48

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/bu gnyis dpon g.yog gnyisu lnga/ mkhon du gzung baṃ myi gzung de las bya ba'-i rigaso/ /gcung pos dris pa/ mi gcig gis nyes pa byas na de la bye brag dbye rgyu yod dam/gcen pos lan du/ dbye ba dbye rgyu yod de/ na tshod ma lon pa'i dus su nyes pa zhig bsags na'ang / 'khon du 'dzin mi rung ngo / /bsam shes thub nas nyes pa bsags na ni nyes pa byas pa rang yin pas 'khon du 'dzin rung ngo / /rje 'bangs gnyis sam/ pha bu gnyis/ yang na dpon g.yog gnyis su yin yang / 'khon du 'dzin rung ngam mi rung gi tshad de la byed pa'i rigs so/ / nu na re/ /mkhon byung na/ sha gnyer rda myi gnyer/phu na re/ /sha khrims gyis gnyer pas chogo/ /gcung pos dris pa/ 'khon byung na sha lan len thabs byed dam mi byed/gcen pos lan du/ sha lan khrims kyis blangs pas chog go /nu na re/ /myi la la kho'i snying du ni 'ong / /bdagi yid du ni myi 'ong / /ba yod/ /myi la la kho'i yid du myi 'ong / bdagi yid du ni 'ong ba yod na/ /de chi ltar bya/ / 49

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/phu na re/ /myi chos gyis/ /bdag la gang legasu byed ching 'khor ba sdug du brtsi ba yin gyis/ /bdagi yid du myi 'ong yang / /ma skyengs par mgu bar gyis shig /bdag gi yid du 'ong la/ /kho'i yid du myi 'ong ba ni/ /ran par ma bzhag na/ /ma stesna/ /skyengs par 'ong ngo/ /gcung pos dris pa/ mi la la kho'i blo la babs shing / bdag gi blo la mi 'bab pa dang / mi la la kho'i blo la mi 'gro zhing / bdag gi blo la 'bab pa yod na ji ltar bya'am/gcen pos lan du/ mi chos bya dgos/ rang la legs par byed cing 'khor ba dag mdza' mthun du brtsi ba yin gyi/ rang gi blo la mi 'bab kyang ma skyengs pa mgu bar gyis shig rang gi blo la 'gro yang kho'i blo la mi 'bab pa ni/ 'os 'tshams su ma bzhag tshe khos ma bsten na skyengs dgos pa yong srid do/ /nu na re/ /ran par bzhag pa chilta bu/ /phu na re/ /kho la legs shing sdug du bya bya na/ /brnyaste/'thun bar ma rung zhes/ /log pa myi bya bar/ /sngun yong yang ma phrad pa'i tshul bzhin du yong ran par gzhag na rung zhes bya'o/ /50

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/yong ni/ chang ma legs pa la ni/ dngan byamasu ma byams shig/ /ma nyes pa la ni/ /dngan sdang du 'ang ma sdang shig/ /myi pha logs po/ bdagi yid sda/ myi sdug pa zhig yod na yang / /yid du myi 'ong myi sdug ches/ /kha nas smra ba'i myi rigaso/ /de skad byas pa dang / /bdag la ni pham ba myed la/ pha logs po ni myi dga' zhing skyengs par 'ong ngo / /gcung pos dris pa/ 'os 'tshams su 'jog pa ji lta bu bya'am/gcen pos lan du/ kho la legs shing mdza' bar byed pa la/ brnyas thabs kyis mthun par byas pa ma 'grigs zhes spyod log mi bya bar/ mdun phyogs nas yong na'ang ma mthong ba'i tshul bzhin du rang bab la ran par bzhag na rung zhes bya'o/ /spyir na legs pa gang yang ma byas pa la byams drags pa mi bya'o/ /nyes pa gang yang ma byas pa la sdang drags pa'ang ma byed cig mi pha rol po rang gi blo la mi 'gro ba zhig yod na yang / blo la mi 'bab ces kha nas smra ba mi rigs so/ /de ltar byas na rang la gnod pa med la/ phar phyogs kyang mi dga' ba dang skyengs pa mi 'ong ngo /nu na re/ mdza' bos nyes shig byung na/ /grogs dang chu gang chi tsham du bya'/ /51

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/phu na re/ /ngon 'thon gyi thabs gyis byar rung na/ byos shig/ /srid dang nor gyis bshugasu rung ste/ /bdag la myi 'khren byos shig/ /yong ni/ legs pa la mdza' bor nus na/ /mdza' ba yin gyi/ /myi phan bar mngon bzhin du/ /nyes pa laḥlus gyis/ /bshugs pa ni/ 'dza' ba ngan pa yino/ /gcung pos dris pa/ gal te mdza' bos nyes pa zhig byung na/ rogs ram dang sha zhen ji tsam du bya'am/gcen pos lan du/ ngo so thon pa'i thabs shes bya rung ba yod na gyis shig srid thabs dang rgyu nor gyis brje na'ang rung ste/ rang la chags zhen med par gyis shig spyir na bzang po la mdza' bor nus na mdza' ba yin gyi/mi phan pa mthong bzhin du nyes pa la lus kyis brje ba ni mdza' ba ngan pa yin no/ /nu na re/ /chi laḥyang phran yangs na bzang na/ /phrag dogs pa la bzang ba chi yod/ /phu na re/ /rung myi rung la/ dogs par ma byas na/ /srid gyi dkrugs mar 'gyuro/ /zas la dog par ma byas na/ /dugis srog yal to/ chung ma la dog par ma byas na/ /rogs gyuro/ /gatshang 52

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/smre la dog par ma byas na/ myi ngan par skye'o/ /grang dro la dog par ma byas na/ /myi nad du gyuro/ /gcung pos dris pa/ gang la'ang khong yangs pa bzang na/ dogs pa 'chang ba la dge mtshan gang yod dam/gcen pos lan du/ rung dang mi rung la dogs par ma byas na khyim srid kyi chag sgor 'gyur ro/ /zas la dogs zon ma byas na dug gis srog 'phrog go /chung ma la dogs zon ma byas na rogs zla 'gyur ro/ /gtsang btsog la dogs par ma byas na mi ngan par skye'o/ /grang dro la dogs zon ma byas na gcong nad can du 'gyur ro/ /nu na re/ sten du chi bzang chi ngan/ /phu na re/ /nyin par gyi sten du/ rjo bo dang dpon po dang 'dzangs shing drang ba dang / mkhas shing dpa' ba dang / bzo zhing rtsal che ba dang / /snyan ngag dang bka' grims bzang ngo/ /nub mo'i sten du ni chung ma bzango/ /nyin par gyi sten du/ rkun ma gacham bu dang rgyon ma g.yengs pa dang / smyon ba dang 'chal ba dang / sdal ma zhan pa ngan to/ /mtshan mo'i sten du/ na chung ngan to/ /53

da legasabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ —gcung pos dris pa/ bsten byar gang bzang dang gang ngan nam/gcen pos lan du/ nyin mo'i bsten byar rje bo dang / dpon po dang /mdzangs shing drang ba dang / mkhas shing dpa' ba dang / bzo mkhas dang rtsal che ba dang / snyan ngag dang bka' khrims bzang ngo / /mtshan mo'i bsten du ni rang gi chung ma bzang ngo / /nyin mo'i bsten byar rkun ma dang g.yo zol can/ smad 'tshong ma dang g.yeng ba/ smyon pa dang 'chal ba/ sdar ma dang mi spus zhan rnams ngan no/ /mtshan mo'i bsten du na chung ma ngan no//nu na re/ /rjo bo dang dpon po la gnyen ba/ phan du re ba zhig yod na/ myur du bya ba'i rigasaṃ myi rigs/phu na re/ /'di yang yang dag par/ rig na ni/ /myur du bya ba'-i rigaso/ /ma rtogs par gzhan gyi gsung la ma rgyug shig/ /ma rtogs pa mangs na/ /bdag gyang sun/ byams pa yang yid byung la 'chal ches/ gyang zero/ /gachig du na/ /phra mar yang 'gyuro/ /gcung pos dris pa/ rje bo dang dpon po la brten pa phan du re ba zhig yod na/ myur du bya bar rigs sam mi rigs/gcen pos lan du/ de yang yang dag pa yin na ni myur du bya ba'i rigs so/ /rang gis ma rtogs par gzhan gyi kha rjes su ma rgyug cig ma rtogs par bya byed mang drags na rang yang sun zhing / byams pa'i mi yang 54

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/yid 'byung bar 'gyur zhes kyang zer ro/ /skabs rer phra mar yang 'gyur ro/ /nu na re/ /phra ma mnyan tai myi mnyan/ /phu na re/ /mdo che na/ gsang ste rje gachad gyi/ /bye brag ma phyed par mnyan du myi rungo/ /gcung pos dris pa/ phra ma nyan nam mi nyan/gcen pos lan du/ don rtsa che na gsang thabs kyis brtsad gcod bya 'os kyi/ dbye ba gsal bo ma phyed par nyan du mi rung ngo / /nu na re/ /grogs po mdza' bo mangs na/ 'ga' dang mjug tu/ mkhon gyis gyang dogs thog ma nas/ myi mdza' bar gzhag du ni/ /yid 'thun na chi ltar bya'/ /phu na re/ /yongasdiḥjis/ mdza' ba la yang snang ste/ /yon/ po yang ba'i chos la/ yid 'thun te/ /mdza' ba ni/ /mthar yang myi mkhon myi sride/ /de lta bu dang ni/ /chi ltar yid 'thun gyang /mdza' bar bya ba'-i myi rigs so/ drang po lci ba'-i chos la/ yid 'thun te/ mdza' na ni/ rtsod par yang myi 'gyur gyis/ /mdza' ba mang na legaso/ /yong ni/ /mdza' bo yang/ /tshul dang sbyor te gyis shig/ /ji tsham dang ni/ thog ma nas gyang ma mdza' la tha 55

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mar yang ma 'thab na nyen myedo/ /ma mdza' na legs shes ste/ myi mched par byar yang myi rungo/ /mdza' zi dang / chi nas gyang ma rtsod pa dang gzungs yod par gyis shig /nyes pa rdul gyang / /bzod par gyis shig/ /bzod par ma byas dang / nyes khos nyes/ /brjod dang bdag gyang smos par 'ong ngo/ /myi zhig legasu re ste/gros 'debs sam/ legasasu re ste bya ba las/ /bdag myed par gyur tai/ /gdon zoste/ /nyes sam/ kho ni legasu re ste/ zer na/ /bdagi yid la ma bab pa la stsogaste/ /'di lta bu'i bag chig na/ /nyes par gyur gyang / /lan legs pas/ glan no/gcung pos dris pa/ grogs po mdza' bshes mang drags na/ 'ga' dang mtha' mjug 'khon gyis kyang dogs/ thog ma nas mi mdza' bar 'jog pa la ni yid mthun pas na ji ltar bya'am/gcen pos lan du/ spyir na gang la brten nas mdza' bor gyur pa la blta dgos/ 'khyog po mi brtan pa'i tshul la yid mthun nas mdza' bor gyur pa ni mtha' mjug mi 'khon pa mi srid de/ de 'dra ba dang ni yid ji tsam mthun na yang mdza' bar bya mi rigs so/ /drang zhing nan pa'i tshul la yid mthun nas mdza' bor gyur na ni slar mi mthun par yang mi 'gyur bas 56

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/na/ de 'dra ba'i mdza' bo mang na legs so/ /mdor na mdza' bo yang tshul dang bstun nas sgrig par gyis shig thog ma nas kyang de tsam gyi mi nye la/mtha' mar yang de tsam gyi mi rgyang bar byas na nyen med do/ /ma mdza' na legs zhes 'brel 'dris mi byed pa yang byar mi rung la/ mdza' zin pa dang ni ci nas kyang ma gyes pa dang khrel gzhung yod par gyis shig nyes pa chung ngu yang bzod par gyis shig bzod par ma byas pa dang khos nyes so zhes brjod na rang la yang dmod par 'ong ngo / /mi zhig gis bzang po yong bar re nas gros 'debs pa'am/ bzang po yong bar re nas bya ba byas pa las rang brlags par gyur pa'am/ gdon gyis brlams te nyes par gyur tam/khos ni bzang po yong bar re ba yin zer ba de rang gi yid la ma babs pa la sogs te/ 'di lta bu'i rigs shig yin na/ nyes par gyur na yang lan legs pas 'jal bar bya'o/ /nu na re/ /bdag la phan ba myed par/ /lan legs par jir glan/phu na re/ /myi 'di yong gis/ bdag la legasu dga' zhing sems pas na/ /phal bas nye'o/ /gtam rnying pa dag la yang / /nyes pa'i lan legs pas/ /glon ba yod gyi/ /legs pa'i lan nyes pas glon ba ni/ /yongs gyis/ myi srid do/ /gachig tu na/57

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/legs par byas pa/ /spro ba dang / yid bsdu bar yang dgoso/ / sus drin btags gyang / brjed gyang / byar myi rungo/ /drin myed par brjed na/ /byas pa dang / ma byas pa 'dra zhes ngan du zer zhing snying nas/ phan par byed pa myedo/ /su dang 'thabs gyang /rung / rung ba'i mdo la 'thabs dang / de las ma bsgyur de las gles la ma bor chig/ /bcol pa yod dang / myi rung myi nus na ni/thog ma nas/ cha brtulo/ /khas blangs na/ /sgo'i dang 'dra bar bya'o/ /lus las phangs myed de/ dgra' dang gdon gang nas 'ong gtol myed gyis/ /lam nye ring gang 'gro yang / bdog dang g.yog khrid chig/ /rung ba rnams la/ gnon lta ma byed chig/ /bdagi lus la yang / le lo bya na/ /brtson grus bya ba gang yod/ /de lta bas na/ /bdagi lus la yang / /bdagis sri zhu bya ba las 'da' yang myed do/ don yod de/ srog ri ba tsham gyi tshod na/ /gdod lus myi phangaso/ /gcung pos dris pa/ bdag la phan pa med par lan legs pas ji ltar 'jal lam/gcen pos lan du/ mi de spyir na rang la dga' zhing legs par 58

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/sems pas na gzhan las lhag go /sngar gyi gtam rnying dag na yang / nyes pa'i lan legs pas 'jal ba yod kyi/ legs pa'i lan ngan pas 'jal ba ni spyir na mi srid do/ /gcig tu na legs par byed pa rnams yid spro ba dang /mgu bar yang bya dgos so/ /su zhig gis drin btags na yang brjed mi rung ngo / /drin gyis bskyangs pa brjed na/ byas pa dang ma byas pa 'dra zhes smad par byed cing / snying thag pa nas phan par byed pa mi 'byung ngo / /su dang 'thab na'ang rung / lugs dang mthun pa ltar 'thab pa dang / de las ma bsgyur de'i yan lag kyang ma dor zhig bya ba bcol ba yod na/ mi rung ba dang mi nus na ni thog ma nas gsal bar shod dgos so/ /khas blangs na gang bsgo ba de dang 'dra bar bya'o/ /lus las gces pa med pas dgra dang gnod pa gang nas yong cha med na/ lam nye ring gang du 'gro na yang mkho ba'i rgyu nor dang g.yog khrid cig mthun rkyen rnams la snang chung ma byed cig rang gi lus kyi don la'ang le lo byas na brtson 'grus zer ba gang na yod/ de lta bas na/ rang gi lus la rang gis gces skyong byed pa las 'da' mi rung ngo / /don snying chen po rang srog ri ba tsam zhig yod na/ gzhi nas rang lus la phangs pa med do/ /nu na re/ /brel pa'i nang na chis(ma)brel na/ nang na myi bde/ /59

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/phu na re/ /srog dang sems myi brel na/ myi bde ba'i mchog yino/ /gcung pos dris pa/ brel ba'i nang nas gang zhig gis ma brel na/nang na skye bo bde'am/gcen pos lan du/ srog dang sems gnyis ma brel na/ skye bo bde ba'i mchog yin no/ /nu na re/ /srid gyis brel na tshabs myi che 'am/ /phu na re/ /sems gyi nang na/ srid gyang / 'dus te sems myi brel na/ /srid gyang bde bar 'gyuro/ /gcung pos dris pa/ srid kyis brel na tshabs che ba ma yin nam/gcen pos lan du/ sems kyi nang du srid kyang 'dus pa yin te/sems ma brel na srid kyang bde bar 'gyur ro/ /nu na re/ /bu phos mos shig bdog na chi ltar bya/ nor du chi byin na/ che/ /phu na re/ /thabs ni chi la yang legs par bya ba'i rigaso/ /nor du ni/ drang zhing ma nor ba'i gzhung byin na/ /de che ste/ /srog srid gnyis gyang / der 'atuso/ /60

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/gcung pos dris pa/ bu phos mos pa'i bu mo zhig yod na ji ltar bya/nor du gang zhig byin na phan che'am/gcen pos lan du/ thabs shes ni gang dang gang la yang legs par bya ba'i rigs so/ /nor du ni drang zhing ma nor ba'i gzhung byin na de che ba yin te/ srog dang srid gnyis kyang der 'dus so/ /nu na re/ /shes pa chi ltar bya/ /phu na re/ /yongs ni/ /ma bstan par shes pa dang / ma bslabs par lobs pa myede/ mdzangs pa chi yang shes pa yang / /bslab pa la ni 'grus/ /bstan pa la ni nyan/ /legs pa la ni/ /dgra la yod gyang len/ /nyes pa la ni/ /bdag la yod gyang 'dor/ /drang por ston pa la ni gshe yang dga'o/ /log par ston pa ni/ /byams gyang spang ngo/ /de lta bas na/ /pha ma dang / phu nu rgan/ rabs gyis gyang / /bu tsha gzho nu ni/ /shes pa'i zho sha khong na ma lus/ bslab ching sbyang ba la/ /ched che ba myedo/ /de lta bas na/ /ngan yang 'bring por 'ong na/ /'dzangs pa lta smos gyang chi dgos/ /snying rgyu khong na yod gyang / ma bstan ma bslabs/ ching ma sbyangs na/ 'dzangs pa lta 'bring por 'ong na/ /ngan pa lta smos 61

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gyang chi dgos/ /de lta bas na/ /slab pa ched che bar mngon no/ /bus ba gzho nu/ rtse ba'i gor/ yig rtsis la stsogs pa/ /'dzangs gyi snon du 'gro ba dang / phong rtsal la stsogs pa/ /dpa' ba'-i snon du 'gro ba/ lob par bslabs pa'i rigaso/ /yun du phan ba ni/ dka' yang bslab/ /yun du gnod pa ni/ /dad gyang btang na phral gyi lta chi smos/ /bdagi bu tsha bslab ba yang / /dang po ni/su bdag la byams shing 'dzangs pa'i gan du gzhan ste bslab ching dbyang ngo/ /de nas blon po che zhing dbul ba'-i gan du gzhag ching bslab ste dbyango/ /de nas/ rung yang dag na/ grags pa'-i sa gar che bar gzhago/ /gzhung myed na/ /che zhing mtho yang/ /de'i gan du myi gzhago/ /gzhon skyes sten las/ /rdzu ba mang gis/ /myi log pa la sred pa rnams dang / sten ching mdzar myi gzhugo/ /gcung pos dris pa/ yon tan shes pa zhig ji ltar bya'am/gcen pos lan du/ spyir na ma bstan par shes pa dang / ma bslabs par lobs pa zhig med de/ mkhas pa gang yang shes pa rnams kyang bslab pa la ni brtson zhing 'grus/ bstan pa la ni nyan/ legs pa ni dgra la yod kyang len/ nyes pa ni rang la yod kyang 'dor/ drang por ston mkhan la ni 62

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/gshe gshe btang yang dga' zhing / log par ston mkhan ni byams kyang spangs pa bcas las byung ngo / /de ltar yin pas na pha ma dang phu nu rgan rabs rnams kyis kyang / bu tsha gzhon nu dag la shes bya'i rigs rang nus gang yod khong na ma lus par slob cing sbyong ba las gal che ba med do/ /de ltar byas na byis pa glen pa yang 'bring por chags thub na/ rig pa can lta smos kyang ci dgos/ glo snying khong na tshang yang ma bstan ma bslabs shing / ma sbyangs pa yin na byis pa rig pa can yang 'bring pa tsam las mi yong bas na/ glen pa rnams lta bshad ci dgos/ de ltar dpags na slob sbyong ni gal shin tu che bar mngon no/ /byis pa lo chung rtse dgar rol ba'i skabs nas/ yig rtsis la sogs pa slob pa ni mdzangs pa'i kha gsab tu 'gro ba dang / 'phong rtsal la sogs pa slob pa yang dpa' ba'i kha snon du 'gro ba yin pas byang bar slob pa'i rigs so/ /rtag tu phan pa'i rigs ni dka' ngal che yang bslab par bya zhing / rtag tu gnod pa'i rigs ni dad kyang spong bar byas na 'phral gyi phan gnod ni lta ci smos/ rang gi bu tsha bslab pa'i rim pa la yang / dang po ni su zhig rang la snying nye zhing yon tan yod pa'i drung du bzhag nas bslab cing sbyang bar bya'o/ /de nas blon po che zhing dbul ba zhig gi drung du bzhag ste bslab cing sbyang bar bya'o/ /de nas legs par thon na snyan pa'i grags pa gang du che ba'i sar 'jog go /yang dag pa'i gzhung med na che zhing mtho yang 63

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mi de lta bu'i drung du mi 'jog go /gzhon skyes kyis bsten pa las mi dzu bag can phrad pa mang bas/ mi tshul min ngan spyod la sred pa dag bsten pa'am mdza' bar yang byed du mi 'jug go /nu na re/ /bslab pa dang po byams pa'-i gan du bzhag pa dang / phyis blon po che zhing dbul ba'-i gan du gzhag pa/ ched chi ltar che/ / phu na re/ /bslab pa dang po byams pa'-i gan du gzhag pa ni/ /bdagi bu gzhon bas/ /legs nyes gnyis bye brag myi phyed la/ /bya myi bya drod myi zin pas/ /bdag la byams pa nyid ma yin na/ /'khyams shing khrin la thogs par 'ong gachig du na gzho nur gram na//snying rtsa la gnod pa skad gyang bya/ /byams 'ba' shig gis gyang myi chog ste/ /'dzangs pa dang lobs pa'i sa ma yin na/ /bslab ching bstan to chog thog tu myi phebs myi lobaso/ /'dzangs pas ni/ /ji byas gyang / /thog tu phebs la/ bu nyid gyang de'i tshul bslab pa'i phyir ro/ /thang / gzhon zhing shed ma bye' ba'i tshe/ /der bslabaste/ /lobs nas/ /blon po che zhing dbul ba'-i gan du gzhag pa ni/ /blon po de che ba las na/ myi 'dzangs myi srid/ /dbul bas na/ /64

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/drang dkan dang gzhung che ba dang / 'dod chung ba/ ma yin myi sride/ /bdagi bu yang de'i lugs bslab pa'-i phyir/ der gzhagogachig du na/ dbul ba'-i g.yog byed dang / ji la yang / gron chung zhing / nyung dus chog par shes na/ /bla 'og gnyisu/ chi bya 'ang bde bar 'ongo/ /stan(snyan)ngag la stsogs pa/ yi ge bzang po 'chang zhing / glog tu bachug na/ 'dzangs gyi snon du rungo/ /tsha bo dang bu bdagi phyi na 'dug na/ nam zhig mkhon ma lus par/ /mtshungs par bya ba'-i rigaso/ /gcung pos dris pa/ slob pa'i dus thog mar rang la snying nye zhing yon tan yod pa'i drung du 'jog pa dang / de nas blon po che zhing dbul ba'i drung du 'jog pa la rgyu mtshan gang yod dam/gcen pos lan du/ slob pa'i dus dang po rang dang snying nye ba'i drung du 'jog pa ni/ rang gi bu lo chung bas bzang ngan gyi dbye ba 'byed mi shes la/ bya dang mi bya tshod kyang mi zin pas gal te rang dang snying nye shos shig ma yin na/ 'chal zhing khrims la thogs pa'ang 'ong srid/ gcig tu na chung dus 'khyams na snying rtsa la gnod pa zhes kyang grags/ snying nye ba kho nas kyang mi chog ste mkhas shing byang ba thon pa'i sa ma yin na bslabs shing bstan pa 65
