legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rnams gnad du mi 'khel la/ legs par mi shes so/ /mkhas mdzangs ldan pas ni gang zhig bslabs kyang gnad du 'khel ba yin pas bu nyid kyang de'i tshul slob pa'i phyir ro/ /na tshod phra zhing mno mi shes pa'i dus su de lta bur bslabs shing byang nas/ blon po che zhing dbul ba'i drung du 'jog pa ni/blon po de che ba'i rgyu mtshan las ni mi mdzangs pa 'ong mi srid cing / dbul ba las ni drang shugs dang khrel gzhung che zhing / 'dod pa chung ba bcas shig ma yin pa mi srid pas na/ rang gi bu yang de'i tshul lugs slob pa'i phyir de lta bur 'jog pa yin no/ /gcig tu na dbul ba'i g.yog gyis dang gang la'ang gron chung zhing nyung ngus chog shes pa yin na/ gong ngam 'og gnyis gang du bya ba byed kyang bde bar 'ong ngo / /snyan ngag la sogs pa yi ge bzang po 'chang zhing klog tu bcug na mdzangs pa'i snon mar 'gyur ro/ /tsha bo dang bu rnams rang gi shul du lus skabs nam yang zhe 'khon mi skye ba mtshungs par bya ba'i rigs so/ / nu na re/ /bran kol yang mtshungs par/ bya'am/ /phu na re/ /kho na nyid gyi skal ba gud na yod pas/ /yong gis de la myi re ste/ /shas ma byin yang / /mkhon myedo/ /bu tsha zhig pha khu'-i phyi na 'dug na/ /nam du 'ang ngan du dogs pa'-i phyir/btams shing bachos pa dang / spyos/ shing gzhus pa mkhon du 66

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan zhwa 'i mdo/byar myi rungo/ /pha khu dang pha ma las ma bsamaste/ /nyes pa zhig rdul na/ /gzhan la brjod pa'-i myi rigaso/ /brjod dang gnyis ka khrel bar 'ongo/ /gcung pos dris pa/ bran khol dag la'ang mtshungs par bya'am/gcen pos lan du/ kho la rang nyid kyi skal ba gud na yod pas/spyir na de lta bu'i re ba mi byed de/ bca' shas ma byin na yang zhe 'khon med do/ /bu tsha ni pha khu'i shul du lus na/ rtag tu ngan par 'gyur gyis dogs pa'i nan tan gyis gdams shing bcos thabs dang / gshe gshe'am nyes rdung btang ba sogs la 'khon 'dzin byar mi rung ngo / /pha khu dang pha ma la sogs pas bsam gzhig ma byas pa'i nyes pa zhig yod na/ mi gzhan la brjod par mi rigs so/ /gal te brjod na gnyis ka la khrel ba 'ong ngo / /nu na re/ /phu nu bo la/ btams gyang myi nyan/ bachos gyang myi 'gyur na/ chi ltar bya'/phu na re/ /'di na/ /ma nyes par stams las chad pa dang /srog srid gyi dgra yang 'di lta bu las 'byung gis/ /ngo slog phod par/ byas la myur du/ 'gong thod du/ dbyung ba'-i rigaso/gcung pos dris pa/ phu bos nu bo la gdams kyang mi nyan/ bcos 67

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/kyang mi 'gyur na ji ltar bya'am/gcen pos lan du/ 'di na ma nyes khag g.yog gi nyes chad dang /srog dang srid la gnod pa'i dgra yang 'di lta bu las 'byung bas na/ ngo bzlog phod par gyis la myur bar rgyang ring du 'bud par rigs so/ /nu na re/ /gnyen bya na chi ltar bya/ /phu na re/ /mna' ma blangs na/ /mnang dang 'dzangs bdamo/ /der yang myi ldan na/ /mnang dom shig mag pa bdam du yod na/ /'dzangs phyug gnyis dom shigagacung pos dris pa/ gnyen sgrig na ji ltar bya'am/gcen pos lan du/ mna' ma len na/ rgyu nor dang mdzangs spyod gnyis ldan gdam par bya'o/ /de yang ma 'dzoms na rgyu nor 'dems shigamag pa 'dem na mdzangs phyug gnyis ldan 'dems shiganu na re/ /chung ma'-i kha bzhin ched che 'o chung / /phu na re/ /ma 'os pa ma yin na/ /bzang ba ni phral du dgar zado/ /chung ma sdugu ni btsal du rnyed gyi/ /bu ngan pa ni brjer myedo/gcung pos dris pa/ chung ma'i ngag bzhin nyan pa gal che'am chung /68

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/gcen pos lan du/ gal te ma 'os pa ma yin na/ bzang ba ni 'phral mar zur du bkar nas nyan par zad do/ /chung ma yid du 'ong ba ni btsal na rnyed kyang / bu ngan pa ni gzhan dang brje rgyu med do/ /nu na re/ /pha la chen chung gnyis zhig yod na/ /bdagis pha ltar byas na ni/ ma'i yid dang 'gal/ /ma'-i yid ltar byas na ni/pha'i yid dang 'gal na/ /thabs chi ltar bya/phu na re/ /yid gachig pas/ /bsdum dgos ste bdagis gyang /ma dang ma yar mo gnyis sdug tu go mnyam bar bya dgoste/ /yus ma yus la lnga drang por byas la/ /chen chung ni/ /chos gyis/ /rigaste/ /ngo mnyam ba las lhag par/ myi dgos par/ bsams la/ /smad gyis gyang / chu tshad myed pa'i/ /gsag byas ste myi dga' bar/ /ma gyur ba'-i nad bsal la/ /so so nas/ /dang bskyed de/ /yid dang 'thun bar byas na/ /gang gi yid dang myi 'gal te/ /kun la bde'o/ /gcung pos dris pa/ pha la bza' zla chen chung gnyis yod na/ bdag gis pha'i yid ltar byas na ni ma'i yid dang 'gal/ ma'i yid ltar byas na ni pha'i yid dang 'gal na thabs ji ltar bya'am/69

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gcen pos lan du/ blo gcig sems gcig gis 'dum thabs bya dgos te/ rang ngos nas kyang ma dang ma yar gnyis go bab mnyam par bya dgos/ bden mi bden la lnga drang por byed/ chen chung ni srol la dar bas btang snyoms bya ba las lhag pa ma mchis par bsam la/ smad pa'i 'os tshad kyang med pa na ngo dga' byas te mi dga' bar mi 'gyur bas sems nad bsal la/ so sor dang ba 'dren pa'i yid dang mthun par byas na/ phyogs gang gi blo dang yang mi 'gal te kun kyang bde'o/ /nu na re/ /de ltar rung na/ /rab du lnga legs/ de ltar ma rung na/ gang gi yid dang 'thun bar bya/phu na re/ /bu la pha dbang ches/ pha'i yid dang 'thun bar byos shig/ /'on tang dum ba zhar gyis 'byungo/ /gcung pos dris pa/ de ltar thub na rab tu legs kyang / ma thub na su'i yid dang mthun par bya'am/gcen pos lan du/ bu la pha dbang che bas pha'i yid dang mthun par gyis shig 'on kyang 'dum thabs ni zhar la 'byung ngo / /nu na re/ /mna' ma sgyug mo dang rtsod pa ji lta bur bya/ /phu na re/ /'di lta bu mang ste/ /chos gyis srid pa'-i phyir/ /gnyen byaste/ /mna' ma blangs pa la gyos sgyug gis/ /gyang /70

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/bsgran bang brgyad pa'-i myi rigaso/ /gyi(na)/ /btams shing / /bstan pa'-i rigaso/ /mna' mas gyang / /gyos sgyug pha ma'-i go la/ /bsgran ching 'khyal ba'-i myi rigs kyi/ /batshun zhing rim pa yod par bsamaste/ /rim 'gro cher bya '-ib(ba'i)rigaso/ /'di ltar byas na/ /rtsod pa chi las 'byung / /bu khyor dgos pa ni/ /sdug par byas la/ /kho la myed du myi rung ba'/ /pha ma dgrar blangasna/ma nor tam/ /gachig gis gachig thub gyang / legs pa ma yin/ /nyes par mngono/ /yongasdi/ /gzhon ba'-i tshe/ mna' ma byas/ /rgas pa'-i tshe sgyug mo ste/ /myi chigi tshe la/ /rnam pa gnyis byas myong bas/ /bdagi nyams las bsams gyang / /mngon ba'-i rigaso/ /pha bu gnyis gyis/ /drang po rigs pa/ /so sor/ chud par/byas na/ /rtsod pa chado/ /gtang ba dang yul gyis bskal ba'i thabs shig ni/ yod mod gyi/ de ni/ /drang por ma nor par/ /nus pa ma yino/ /gcung pos dris pa/ mna' ma dang a ma rtsod na ji ltar bya'am/gcen pos lan du/ 'di lta bu ni mang ste rang shugs su 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyen bsgrigs nas mna' mar blangs pa la bu'i pha mas kyang thad 71

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/kar tshig ngan pas gshe gshe gtong ba mi rigs so/ /gnas lugs bshad nas blang dor ston par bya'o/ /mna' mas kyang bu'i pha mar rang gi pha ma'i gnas bab tu bkur ba las/ 'dra mnyam lta bus gang byung brjod pa mi rigs shing / ya rabs go rim yod par bsam gzhig byas te gus ldan zhabs 'gyur gang legs sgrub par rigs so/ /de ltar byas na rtsod pa gang las 'byung / bu la dgos pa ni tshims par byas na/ rang la med du mi rung ba'i pha ma dgrar bslangs na ma nor ram/ 'di rigs gcig gis gcig thub kyang legs pa ma yin te nyes par mngon no/ /spyir ni gzhon pa'i dus su mna' ma byas shing / rgas pa'i tshe na sgyug mo ste/ mi tshe gcig la bgo skal gnyis myong ba yin pas rang gi nyams thog nas bsam na'ang rtogs pa'i rigs so/ /pha bu gnyis kyis drang po dang / 'os shing rigs pa so sor khong du chud par byas na rtsod pa'i rgyun 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /tha dad byed pa dang sa thag ring por kha gyes pa'i thabs shig yod mod kyang / de la drang zhing ma nor ba'i nus pa mi ldan no/ /nu na re/ /chung ma dang ha chang mdza' ches na ni/ /gzhan gyis gyang khreld/ /sdang bar byar ni/ /mo'ang yid du 'ong dgu byed na/ chi ltar bya/ /phu na re/ /chi ltar yid du 'ong ba la snang ste/ /legs pa'-i 72

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/yid du 'ong ba byed na/ mdza' zhes/ gzhan gyis myi khrel gyis/ /mos ma nyes par/ /dpyas gyis dogs pa'-i phyir spang ba'-i/ ga la rigaso/ /gzhung gis legs pa ma yin na/ /yid du chi ltar 'ong yang / 'thun bar ma byed chig mos ma nyes dang / sna 'ga'/bdagi sems dang ma 'thun pa'-i phyir/ bdag la dbang yod ches/dngan sdang du ma sdang shig/ /gcung pos dris pa/ chung ma dang ha cang mdza' ches drags na ni/gzhan gyis kyang 'phya/ sdang bar byed pa la ni mo yang snying du sdug gu byed na ji ltar bya'am/gcen pos lan du/ snying du sdug pa'i rgyu rkyen la blta dgos pa ste/legs phyogs nas snying du sdug pa yin na ni/ mdza' drags zhes gzhan gyis 'phya mi srid la/ chung mas nyes pa min bzhin du gzhan gyi 'phya dmod la dogs nas spong ba ni ga la rigs so/ /yang lugs ltar legs pa'i phyogs ma yin na ni snying du ji tsam sdug kyang mthun par ma byed cig de min chung mas ma nyes par bya ba 'ga' zhig rang gi 'dod blo dang ma mthun par brten nas/rang la dbang yod snyam ste brnyas bcos kyi sdang zug ma byed ciganu na re/ /nor gyi drod chis gzung /73

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/phu na re/ /chog shes pas drod gzungo/gcung pos dris pa/ rgyu nor gyi tshod gang gis gzung ngam/gcen pos lan du/ chog shes kyi bsam pas tshod gzung bar bya'o/ /nu na re/ /chi tsham na chog/ /phu na re/ /lto ma bkrem rgyab ma grang / /chu shing la ma bab / rkang ma chad naḥchog shes ste/ /'di rnams 'byor na/ phyug la bde ba yino/ /'di las lhag pa'-i nor bdog pa ni/ /bde zhing phyug pa ma yino/ nor gyis/ /bdag 'khol te/ nor dgrar ldango/ /gcung pos dris pa/ ji tsam gyis chog shes par bya'am/gcen pos lan du/ zas kyis grod pa ma ltogs pa dang / gos kyis lus ma grang ba/ rang gis chu len dang shing 'thu bya mi dgos pa/ rkang thang mar 'gro mi dgos pa bcas byung na chog shes par bya ste/ 'di rnams 'dzoms na phyug la bde ba yin no/ /de las lhag pa'i nor yod pa ni bde zhing phyug pa ma yin te rang nyid rgyu nor gyi bran g.yog tu 'gyur te/ rgyu nor dgra ru lang ba 'ong ngo / /nu na re/ /des chog na/ /gos zas gyang ngan ches la/ /bran dang phyugs gyang nyung ma ches sam0/74

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/phu na re/ /yong dpag pa yang 'og ma la bltas dang /bdag bas dbul bas gyang chus na/ /bdag jis myi chog/ /ltag(lhag)ma las bltas na ni/ /chog pa'-i mtha' yang myede/ /rgyal po yang chog myi mkhyen na/ ha chang de lta bur/ /'dod cheste/ /dpag pa'-i drod chig ma rig dang / srog srid gnyis la dma' 'o/ /gos zas ni/ /dros pa dang 'drangs pa gnyisu dgos par zade/ /tha mal pas/ /dros/ shing 'drangs pas ma chog/ /bran dang phyugs gyang / ngan las la ma bab/ rkang gis ma song bas chogo/ /gyi na/ /yul/ dang khyu na rgas pa lta/ /bdag la myed du myi rung ba chi yod/ /myi'i dpon po bya na/ /'di lta bu/ 'dod pa'-i grangs mngasna/ /'dod pa'-i mu skye'o 'dod pa'-i mu skyes dang / /yon po myi snyoms pa yang / 'a2 las 'ong ngo/ /rje blon gyis bdagi zho sha dang sbyar te/ nor ma byin bar/ nor rnyed pa ni/ /sgyu dang thabs gyis/ brgal te/ /'og ma las ma phrogasna/ nor dang myi 'ong ba la/ /bltas na/ dpon po byed ching / dbul ba ni legs pa'-i mgo che'o/ /75

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gcung pos dris pa/ de tsam gyis chog na zas gos skyo drags la/ bran 'khor dang phyugs rigs kyang nyung drags pa ma yin nam/gcen pos lan du/ spyir bsdur ba yang 'og rim la ltos dang / rang las dbul bas kyang 'khyol na/ rang la des mi chog pa ci yod dam/ gong rim la bsdur na ni 'di tsam gyis chog ces pa'i mtha' yang med de/ rgyal po yang chog shes mi mkhyen na ha cang de lta bur 'dod pa che drags te dpag pa'i tshad cig ma mchis pa dang / srog dang srid la'ang dma' 'beb bo/ /gos dang zas gnyis ni lus dros pa dang lto ba 'grangs pa zhig la dgos pa tsam du zad de/ phal pa ltar dros shing 'grangs pa tsam gyis mi chog pa gang yod dam/bran 'khor dang phyugs rigs kyang / ngan las bya mi dgos pa dang / rkang thang du 'gro ma dgos na des chog go /mi rnams gyi nar yul du 'tsho ba dang khyu na rim gyis rgas pa ltar rang la med du mi rung ba gzhan ci zhig yod/mi'i dpon po bya na 'di lta bu 'dod pa'i rnam grangs mang drags tshe 'dod pa rgya cher skye'o/ /'dod pa rgya cher skyes na mi drang zhing / mi snyoms pa yang 'di las rang shugs kyis 'ong ngo / /rje blon gyis rang gitpas pa dang bstun pa las/ rgyu nor ma byin par rgyu nor rnyed pa ni/ g.yo sgyu dang thabs ngan spyad de 'og ma dag las ma phrogs na/ nor dang rgyu mi 'ong ba la bltas na/dpon po byed cing dbul ba ni legs pa'i phul du byung ba yin no/ /76

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/nu na re/ /ha chang dbul ches na/ /res 'ga' bzhag gya dgosna chis bya/ /phu na re/ /yongasdi/ /'dzangs pa drang pos bzhag na/ /gzhagi ra ba'o/ /dpa' bo/ /thabs mkhas pas bzhag na/bzhagi rab 'og 'o/ /brtan po gzung thub pas bzhag na/ /bzhagi 'bring ba 'o/ /rnon ma nor dang gos gyis/ bzhag pa ni/ /bzhagi mtha' ma 'o/ /gcung pos dris pa/ ha cang dbul drags na/ res 'ga' shul bzhag 'dra dgos na ji ltar bya'am/gcen pos lan du/ spyir na mdzangs pa drang po'i gshis lugs bzhag na bzhag pa'i rab bo/ /dpa' ba dang thabs mkhas pa'i blo rtsal bzhag na bzhag pa'i rab 'og go /brtan po dang rang tshugs thub pa'i kun spyod bzhag na bzhag gi 'bring ngo / /do gal chen pos rgyu nor dang gos kyi bzhag pa ni bzhag pa'i nang gi tha ma'o/ /nu na re/ /chung zad myed na/ /gson po'i yo byad dang / shi ba'-i dur skyibs dang / /bu tsha la dbog pa yang myed na/ /yon por myi 'gyur bar/ nor batshal du rung ba chi mchis/ /77

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/phu na re/ /de rnam pa lnga yod de/ /gachig ni/ /ngon thon gyi/ngo 'phral tshol pa'o/ /gnyis ni/ ngon thon gyi phyugs spel ba'o/ /gsum̐ ni/ ngon thon gyi bran batshem ma'o/ /bzhir ni/ /ngon thon gyi/tshong byed pa'o/ /lngar ni ngo(ngon)thon gyi zhing rmo ba 'o/ /gcung pos dris pa/ rgyu nor cung zad cig med na gson pa'i 'tsho chas dang / shi ba'i dur skyibs dang bu tsha la 'bog skal yang ma mchis pas na/ 'khyog lam du mi 'gro bar rgyu nor btsal du rung ba'i bya ba gang yod dam/gcen pos lan du/ de la rnam pa lnga yod de/ gcig ni 'bad pa chen pos byas rjes bzhag nas bdag rkyen 'thob thabs 'tshol ba'o/ /gnyis ni 'bad pa chen pos phyugs rigs spel ba'o/ /gsum ni 'bad pa chen pos mi gla rgyug pa'o/ /bzhi ni 'bad pa chen pos tshong las byed pa'o/ /lnga ni 'bad pa chen pos zhing las gnyer ba'o/ /nu na re/ /ngo thon gyi thabs 'di rnams byaste nus na phyug por bya 'o bya myi bya/phu na re/ /tsho tshis de 'dra bar byaste/ phyug por nus na/nyes myed pa 'dra mod gyi/ /de yang ran pas chogo/ /myed du rung pa'-i rnams gaches par ma byed chig/ /myi dgos par chud zos 78

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/par ma byed chig/ /gcung pos dris pa/ 'bad pa chen pos thabs de rigs byas te thub na phyug po bya rung ngam mi rung /gcen pos lan du/ 'tsho thabs de lta bu byas te phyug por 'gyur nus na/ nyes pa med pa 'dra mod kyi/ de yang tshod ran par bya'o/ /med kyang 'grig pa rnams la sred zhen ma byed cig dgos med chud zos su ma gtong zhiganu na re/ /nang na chi mang na phyug /phu na re/ /nang na bu mang na phyug /gcung pos dris pa/ khyim na gang mang na phyug pa yin nam/gcen pos lan du/ khyim na bu mang na phyug pa yin no/ /nu na re/ /bu mangs na/ /ngan pa kha chig rkang 'dren du mi 'gyur ram/ /phu na re/ ye ni/ /ngan pa btang na/ /'dzangs pa byung zhes bya'o/ /mang po la ngan du byung ngam/ /gachig pu de/ ngan du drod myi rig ste/ ngan pa byung gis dogs pas na/ /mang du dgoso/ /'dzangs pa gachig yod na/ /ngan pa brgya'i srid zinato/ /ye ni/ /79

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gtam rnying pa dag las bu gachig bdog na/ gachigi nor gyis phyugs/ /gnyis bdog na/ gnyis gyi nor gyis phyug ches bya'o/ /gcung pos dris pa/ bu mangs na ngan pa 'ga' shas thon nas rkang 'dren par mi 'gyur ram/gcen pos lan du/ lar nas ngan pa mang na bzang po'ang thon zhes grags so/ /mang po las ngan pa 'byung ngam/ gcig pu de ngan pa chags nges pa med de/ ngan pa 'byung gi dogs pa yod na mang tsam dgos pa yin/bzang po gcig yod na ngan pa brgya'i 'tsho 'dzin thub bo/ /lar nas sngar gyi gtam dper/ bu gcig yod na gcig gi nor gyis phyug bu gnyis yod na gnyis kyi nor gyis phyug ces zer ba yod do/ /nu na re/ /bdagis nus la/ /gzhan la myi gnod na/ nyes pa yod tai myed/ /phu na re/ /lugs dang ma gal na/ /skyid par byas gyang bla'o/ /gcung pos dris pa/ rang gis sgrub nus la/ gzhan la mi gnod na/nyes pa yod dam med/gcen pos lan du/ lugs dang ma 'gal na/ skyid par byas kyang chog go /nu na re/ /chos lugs bya ba gang yin/ /nus pa'-i tshad chis 80

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/gzung /phu na re/ /chos lugs dang ma gal na/ dpyas myed pa'-i rigs/ /bdag la dpyasu ma gyur na/ /skyid par byas gyang bla'o/ /nus pa'-i tshad ni/ /gzhan la myi smon par nus na/ /gzod nus pa yino/ /gcung pos dris pa/ tshul lugs zhes pa gang yin dang / de'i nus pa'i tshad gang la byed dam/gcen pos lan du/ tshul lugs dang ma 'gal na/ 'phya dmod mi 'byung ba yin/ rang la 'phya dmod ma phog na skyid par byas kyang chog go /de'i nus pa'i tshad ni/ gzhan la smon mi dgos pa zhig byed thub na/ gzhi nas grub pa yin no/ /nu na re/ /yongasni ji bya 'o chog la/ /phyug po dang dbang chen pos bya ba ni sla/ /dbul po dang dbang chung ngus bya ba ni dka' ba 'dra na/ /de ltar lags sam ma lags/ /phu na re/ /'di la yang drang po ma nor ba'-i chos myed na/ /bya 'og sla ba ma yin gyi/ /che ba ni bdud dang nye'o/ /phyug po ni dgra dang nye'o/ /yong ni phyug ching che 'dod na/ /srid gyi yu ba 81

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/nas gzung dgoso/ /srid gyi yu ba zhes bya ba ni/ /drang zhing bag yod la chog shes pa'o/ /dbul zhing chung bas gyang/ /'di ltar nus na 'dzangs shing mkhas shes bya'o/ /yong ni/ phyug po ni/nor gyis phung ba yodo/ /'dzangs pa ni tshig gis brlag pa yod do/ /nor spyad nyes na ni/ /dgra'o/ 'dzangs smra nyes na ni/ gzhan gyi zher 'debaso/ /de las bltas na/ /nor yang ran par spyad/ /'dzangs gyang / /gzhams shing smra ba'-i rigaso/ /'dzangs smra legasna/ /srid gyi mchogo /nor spyad legs na ni/ /so nam gyi mchogi gtam rnying pa dag las/ /yid la dran ba las gyang /legs par smras na/ /kha ni/ dpal gyi sgo mo'o/ /lce ni phrul gyi lde myig ches bya'o/ /nyes par smras na/ /kha ni byur gyi sgo mo/ /lce ni bdud gyi ste re zhes bya zhes gyang grago/ /de las bltas na/ /kha tshas dang marnyas mo shin dang / mthon pa'-i zla gnyer zhing myi bde ba/ 'gran nga ba'i chos/ nyan rna dang phyi ma nang bya ba'-i myi rigs par mngon no/ /bdagi tshod gyang myi rig na/ /gzhan gyi tshod lta ga la rig su che su brtsan/ gtol myed gyis/ /kun gyang batshun 82

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/bar byas ste/ /ma rangs shing yi gachad pa myed par bya' ba'-i rigaso/ /gcung pos dris pa/ spyir na bya ba gang yin rung / phyug po dang dbang chen po yod pas sgrub pa las sla zhing / dbul po dang dbang med pas sgrub pa dka' ba 'dra na/ de ltar lags sam ma lags/gcen pos lan du/ 'di la yang drang zhing ma nor ba'i tshul med na/bya ba gang yang sgrub sla ba ma yin te/ che btsan ni bdud dang nye'o/ /phyug po ni dgra dang nye'o/ /spyir na phyug cing dbang che bar 'dod na/ srid lugs kyi rtsa ba nas gzung dgos so/ /srid lugs kyi rtsa ba zer ba ni/ drang zhing bag yod la chog shes pa'o/ /dbul zhing nyam chung ba rnams kyis kyang 'di ltar bya nus na/ mdzangs shing mkhas zhes bya ba yin no/ /spyir na phyug po ni nor gyis phung ba yod do/ /mdzangs pa ni tshig gis brlag pa yod do/ /rgyu nor spyod nyes na ni dgra'o/ /mdzangs pa smra nyes na ni gzhan gyi snying la phog go /de la bltas na nor yang 'os shing 'tshams par spyad/ mdzangs pa yin yang 'jam zhing mkhas par smra ba'i rigs so/ /mdzangs pa smra legs na srid kyi mchog yin cing / rgyu nor spyod legs na so nam gyi mchog yin te/ sngar gyi gtam dpe yid la dran pa las kyang / legs par smras na kha ni dpal gyi sgo mo dang / lce ni 'phrul gyi lde mig ces zer ro/ /nyes par smras na/ kha ni 83

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/byur gyi sgo mo dang / lce ni bdud kyi sta re zhes bya bar grags so/ /de la bltas na/ tshig rtsub dang / gzhan la brnyas bcos dang / mtho ba'i kha gtad du langs shing / mi bde bar 'gran pa'i tshul dang / so myul dang /phyi ma nang bya ba sogs ni mi rigs par mngon no/ /lar nas rang gi tshod kyang mi lon na/ gzhan gyi tshod lta ga la lon/ phugs su che su btsan gdeng med pas na/ kun la mthun par byas nas ma rangs shing yid gcod pa sogs med par bya ba'i rigs so/ /nu na re/ /brtson 'grusu bya ba gag/ /phu na re/ /ye ni/ legs so chog la/ /brtson 'grusu myi bya ba gachig gyang myede/ /ma rabs gyis/ /gzhan myi nus na rje blas la/brtson 'grusu gyis shig/ /zhud do chog dang bu med gyi bgi gan du ma 'gro shig myi 'gror myi rung / ba myed na/ thong shig/ /gcung pos dris pa/ brtson 'grus byed dgos pa gang dag lags sam/gcen pos lan du/ spyir na legs pa'i rigs kun la brtson 'grus bya mi dgos pa gcig kyang med/ tha shal bas gzhan mi nus na/ rje bo'i zhabs 'degs la brtson 'grus gyis shig 'grul pa'i rigs thams cad dang / bud med kyi 'gram du ma 'gro zhig ma phyin par thabs med pa ma yin na dor cig84

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/nu na re/ /ji ltar legs/ /phu na re/ /zhud do chog gi gan du phyin pa ni/ /nyes dang bdag 'dren chan zhes mying thogs par 'ong ngo/ /bud med gyi gan du rtags ches na/ rgyo zhes mying 'dogaso/ /bud med dang myi 'dza'ar myi rung na rgyang ma nas/ /than phrin gyis/ /'drul ching /res 'ga' phrad pa'-i tshe yang / /zhag tu ma lon ba dang / /che bzhi yod bar byas ste/ /song dang / myi dpyode legaso/ /gcung pos dris pa/ de ji lta bu lags sam/gcen pos lan du/ 'grul pa rnams kyi 'gram du phyin na ni/ nyes pa dang zhabs 'dren zhu mkhan zhes pa'i ming thogs pa 'ong ngo / /bud med kyi 'gram du 'gro mang na/ log g.yem byed pa zhes ming 'dogs so/ /bud med dang 'brel ba mi bya ka med byung na/ rgyang ring nas lan 'phrin gyi 'brel thabs bya'o/ /gal srid 'gro 'ong dang skabs re thug 'phrad byung dus kyang /zhag sdod mi byed pa dang / bar dpang yod par gyis dang / lab gleng mi 'byung bas legs so/ /nu na re/ /dus che zhes bya ba chi lta bu/ /phu na re/ /mtshungs pa la/ /bdagi ltar myi byar myi rung zhes 85

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/zer ba dang / bdagi kha nas/ /byung phan chad/ legs nyes myi rtog ching / /blon myi tshugs pa dang / /yang dag par/ ma nongs pa'-i thabs yod na/ /sla ba 'dam zhing / rung du re ba'-i phyir/ /gdon lto stson ba lta bu yino/ /nyes pa yin par/ rigaste/ gzhan gyis/ chi ltar bya zhes blon btab gyang / myi bathub pa ni/ /dus che ba ma yin gyi/ /legs pa la myi 'gyur ba yino/ /gcung pos dris pa/ dus che ba zhes pa ci 'dra ba yin nam/gcen pos lan du/ dper na rang dang mtshungs pa dag la rang gi don ltar ma byas na mi 'grig ces zer ba dang / rang gi kha nas thon phan chad legs nyes rtog dpyod mi byed cing / gros 'debs mi thub pa dang / nyes skyon mi yong ba'i thabs yang dag pa gzhan yod na yang / las sla ba bdams nas 'grig tu re ba'i phyir gdon la lto skal sbyin pa lta bu byed pa yin no/ /nyes pa yin pa mthong ste gzhan gyis ji ltar bya zhes gros btab kyang / nyan du mi btub pa ni dus che ba ma yin gyi/ legs par mi 'gyur ba yin no/ /nu na re/ /phas btams pa ni/ /rgang nyon cig mas btams pa ni/ /gzhar som zhig ches byung na/ /pha ma la myi mtshungs ste/ /la la rkun ma yon po'i chos byed pa yang yod na/86

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/'di lta bu'i tshig btams na/ mnyan ching bsamasu rung ngam/ /phu na re/ /pha ma gnyis las nye ba myede/ /bus nyes gyis dogs pas na/ /log par myi ston te/ /snying gi tshig drang po legasu re ba'i chos ston pa'i rigaste/ de'i phyir de skad bshad mod//pha mas yon po log pa'-i tshig btamasu zin na/ pha ma'i tshig ches ste/ log par tshor bzhin du/ ma btang na/ ru(rung)ba ga la yin/ nyes pa zhig sngar bdag las byung ba'-i lan/ /gzhan la 'daste/ phyi chad chod par/ bya'o/ /yong yang / bdag che zhing batshun zheste/ tshig du myi rung ba dang / srubasu ma bab pa'-i/brnyas thabs ma zer chig/ /ma 'os shing / myi rigs pa ni/bdagi bu dang rung ma la yang myi bzodo/ /g.yog dang bran la yang byar myi rung na/ gzhan lta chi smos/ /'di na gang na yang / sa myedo/ /ya rabs shes bya ba ni/ /chi yang thogasu 'bab pa yin gyi/ /myi shes shing thog du myi 'bab par byed na/ /ma rabs gyang / /de las chi thu'o/ /grogs la/ ngas bgamasna/ /'di skad zer zhes/ma snyod chig/ /gzhan gyi man ngag bdag la smrasna/ /bdag dang 87

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mdza' ba zhig yod na yang / /ma snyod chig bsnyad gyang bla ba zhig na yang / /bdag nyid gyi tshig pa skad du bya ba'-i rigaso/ /pha log ngan ches ma snyod chig/ /'di rnams bsnyad na/ /grogs bag tsha zhing / /yid myi 'jog par 'ong ngo/ sus chi nyes gyang / /de ltar byasu myi gtang zhes ma smra/ /mna' ma 'dor chig/ /khro pa'i snying ma rtogs pas/ /thog tu bab pa nyungo/ /nyes dang ma yin na/ /ni/ /bdag la gnod/ ma yin na ni/ /mna' zos shing sun par 'ong ngo/ /myi byar myi rung na/ /mna' ma bor bar/ /byar myi rung ba chi yod/ /la la pha logs gyis ma bzod na/ dgrar ba yodo/ /chi la yang / bdag las mkhas skyen zhes myi brjod do/ /sngar pha rol bstode bdar dang / pha rol mo yang / /dga'/ /bdag de bas thu na yang myi dpyas/ /lhag na yang phyis byas pas/ /mngon te/ /ma 'phyiso/ /ngan myi nus yang / bar mngon dang / ran pa tsham du bya'-i/ ma 'dar ma stod chig/ /phar bsteng zhing / bdag bstod pa 'dra bar/ gyuro/ rogs(rigs)la/ 'phya'o chog ni/ pha logs gyi phyas rig pas na/ /bdag 'dzangs pa 'dra bar/ spyom 88

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/shing bsgrags pa'-i phyir/ /gzhan gyi tshig sun 'byin ba yodo/ /'di su bden yang / phan ba myedo/ /su brdzun yang / gnod pa myede/ ched myi ches/ yangs par glod de gzhag na legaso/ /gya tshom du/ yengs ma gtam ma zer chig gtam la la/ /bdagi bzhad gad la/ gzhan gyi zher 'debs pa yod do/ /mngagasna/ /thos slos ma bya ste/ /slar ma ldog par/ bdagis phyin ching rig par byos shig/ /nor la ha chang yang ma dam zhig dam ches na/ /mdza' shing bshes pa la dgos gyang / /myi ster te/ /bdog gyang chi rung / mkhon du 'ong ngo/ ha chang lhod ches na/ /drin yang myed pa'-i steng du/ /ji tsham na/ /bdagis myi bzode ma sbyin na/mkhon du 'ong ngo/ /sbyin ba zhig na yang / /thog ma nas/ bsam dmyigaste/ /sbyin bar byas phan chad/ brdzun ma byed chig/ /myi bdog pa tsham na yang / brdzun bar kha ma yang shig/ /sbyin bar snyad btags la/ brdzun bya bya bas/ /ni/ thog ma nas ma smos dang legaso/ /yong yang chi bya'o la/ /kha lag 'thun bar bya ba'-i rigaso/ /smra 'o chog la/ /dogs pa'-i tshig gron ma gzhug shig89

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dogs so chog la rim 'gro skyed chig/ /sus gtam dris gyang /lan lon chig/ /shags ma rgod chig/ /ra ro na rta ma brgyug shig/ /lce mchin myi dogs pa'-i/ /bzhad gad khas brgya' ba thong shig/ /'di gsum ni/ /bdagi mtshang du gyur ching / srog dang srid la dma'o/ / gcung pos dris pa/ phas gdams pa ni gtso bor nyon cig mas gdams pa ni zhar la soms shig ces grags na/ pha ma yang tshang ma gcig ltar mi mtshungs te/ la la rkun ma'am g.yo khram gyi tshul bskul ba yang yod na/de lta bu'i tshig gdams na nyan zhing bsam par bya rung ngam/gcen pos lan du/ pha ma gnyis las nye ba med de/ rang gi bu nyes kyis dogs pas na log pa'i lam mi ston te/ snying gi gtam drang po legs su 'gyur bar re ba'i tshul ston par rigs pa yin pas/ de'i phyir de skad du grags pa yin mod/ gal te pha mas tshul min log pa'i tshig gdams pa yin na/ log pa yin pa tshor bzhin du pha ma'i bka' yin zhes ma spangs na ga la rung / nyes pa zhig sngar rang nyid las byung ba'i le lan gzhan la mi bda' zhing phyin chad chod par bya'o/ /spyir na nga che nga btsan zhes brjod du mi rung ba'i tshig dang / skabs su ma babs pa'i brnyas thabs ma byed cig mi 'os shing mi rigs pa ni rang gi bu dang chung ma la byung yang mi bzod cing /90

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/g.yog dang bran la'ang bya bar mi rung na gzhan la lta ci smos/ 'di ni gang du'ang spyod pa'i sa med do/ /ya rabs zhes bya ba ni gang dang gang la yang 'os shing 'tshams par spyod pa yin gyi/ mi shes shing 'os su ma babs par byed na/ ma rabs kyang de bas thu ba ci zhig yod/ grogs la/ ngas tshod bgam byas na 'di skad zer zhes ma shod cig mi gzhan gyi man ngag rang la smras na/ rang dang snying nye ba zhig yod na'ang ma shod cig gal te bshad kyang chog pa zhig yod na yang rang nyid kyi tshig yin pa'i tshul du shod par rigs so/ /phar phyogs pa ngan drags zhes kyang ma shod cig 'di rnams bshad na grogs po bag tsha zhing yid rton mi bya ba 'ong ngo / /sus gang nyes na yang de ltar byas rgyal du mi gtong zhes ma smra/ mna' ma skyel cig khong khro ba'i gting mi rtogs pas thog tu 'bab pa dkon no/ /nyes ngo ma yin na ni bdag la gnod/ ma yin na ni mna' zos shing sun par 'ong ngo / /ma byas mthu med yin na mna' ma bskyal bar byed mi rung ba gang yod dam/ la la pha rol pos bzod ma thub par dgrar lang ba yod do/ /gang la yang nga mkhas nga skyen zhes mi brjod do/ /thog mar pha rol por bstod cing btegs pa dang / pha rol po yang dga' la/ rang nyid de las zhan na'ang 'phya dmod mi bzod/ gal te de las lhag na ni rjes su mngon pas phyis mi drags so/ /yang ngan lan mi nus kyang bar gnas dang ran pa tsam du bya ba las ma 91

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ 'dar ma bstod cig des ni phar brnyas shing rang bstod pa 'dra bar 'gyur ro/ /rogs la 'phya ba thams cad ni/ pha rol 'phya ba pos mthong na/ kho rang mdzangs pa 'dra bar ngom zhing sgrog par brten/ gzhan gyi tshig gis sun 'byin pa yod do/ /'di rigs su bden yang phan pa med la/ su brdzun yang gnod pa med de/ gal mi che bas glod de bzhag na legs so/ /bag yangs ngang chig lab rgyag pa la la rang gi bzhad gad ched tsam yang / gzhan gyi snying la phog pa yod do/ /gang zhig mngags na thos lo tsam mi bya ste/ slar phyir ma log par rang gis phyin nas dngos su mthong bar gyis shig rgyu nor la ser sna ha cang che ba ma byed cig che drags na mdza' zhing nye bar dgos dus kyang mi ster te yod kyang ci byed/ 'khon pa'i rgyur 'gro'o/ /nor la ha cang lhod yangs che drags na yang drin du mi bsam par ma zad/ ji tsam na rang yang nad mi theg la/ ma ster na 'khon du 'ong ngo / /gal te sbyin par byed na thog ma nas bsam gzhig byas thog sbyin par khas blangs phyin chad brdzun ma shod cig med pa tsam na yang brdzun ma smra zhig sbyin par snyad btags nas brdzun shod pa las thog ma nas ci yang ma bshad na legs so/ /mdor na bya ba gang la yang kha bshad dang lag len mthun par bya ba'i rigs so/ /gtam gang bshad kyang dogs pa slong ba'i tshig gi lhad ma gzhug pa bya zhing / dogs pa chags rigs la sel thabs gyis shig sus skad cha dris 92

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/na yang lan thobs shig rtsod par dga' ba ma byed cig ra bzi ba'i dus rta ma rgyug cig kha zhe bag med pa'i bzhad gad dam kha mtshar spongs shig 'di gsum ni rang gi skyon mtshang du 'gyur zhing / srog dang khyim srid la gnod do/ /nu na re/ /gzhan bgyi ba'i thabs chi dag mchis/ /phu na re/ /'di'i tshul las/ /ji yang ma nor bar gyis shigamado dang / gzhung shes na/ /bya'o chogi nang du/ /myi nor bar btang du rungo/ bya'o chog dmyigaste/ /bshad na/ myi ma shi bar du/ /zin pa'-i mtha' myedo/ /ye ni/ /chi bya 'o chog la/ ma nor bar rtogs shing gyis shig/ /shes bzhin ba la nor ba byung ba yod do/ bdagis bshad pa 'di yang / kha chig tshig gi zur tsham la/ched che zhing / /gzhung du rung ba yodo/ /gcung pos dris pa/ gzhan yang bya ba byed pa'i thabs gang dag yod dam/gcen pos lan du/ tshul 'di las ci yang ma nor bar gyis shigasnying don dang gzhung lugs shes na bya ba gang dang gang la yang ma nor bar 'jug tu rung ngo / /bya ba mtha' dag la ltos nas bshad na/ mi ma shi bar 93

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/du bsgrubs zin pa'i mtha' med do/ /mdor na bya ba gang dang ci yin na'ang ma nor bar rtogs shing gyis shig shes bzhin du nor 'khrul byung ba yang yod do/ /bdag gis bshad pa 'di dag kyang 'ga' zhig tshig gi zur tsam yang gal che zhing gzhung lugs su brtsi rung ba yod do/ /nu na re/ /'og ma la yid brtan tai myi brtan/ /phu na re/ /brtan du rung ba rnams la rton chig/ /myi rung ba rnams la ma brtan chig/ /ngan pa yod na/ 'dzangs pa yod do/ /chung ngu yod na/ chen po rnyed do/ /dbul po rnyed na/ phyug po yodo/ /blun po yod na/ bzo bo rnyed do/ /kun yang de lta ste/ /phral yun gnyis rig dang legaso/ /gcung pos dris pa/ 'og ma rnams la yid rton nam mi rton/gcen pos lan du/ yid rton du rung ba rnams la rton cig mi rung ba rnams la ma rton cig ngan pa yod na/ bzang po yod do/ /chung ngu yod na/ chen po rnyed do/ /dbul po rnyed na/ phyug po yod do/ /blun po yod na/spyang po rnyed do/ /kun kyang de 'dra ste/ 'phral phugs gnyis rtogs par gyis dang legs pa yin no zhes gsungs so/ /nu bo shin tu yid la bab ste/ /yang dag pa'-i tshig bdog pa 94

phu bos nu bor btams shing bstan pa'i mdo/ni/ /snying 'ba' shig la/ btams pa/ lags gyis/ gzhan la ma bsnyad chiga'adi ltar gachig gis gachig la/ /btams shing / bstan nas/ /'dzangs pa po/ spun nyis/ de nas so sor gyes ste mchis so ཿ ཿgcung po'i yid la shin tu babs te/ yang dag pa'i tshig gsungs pa ni snying khong 'ba' zhig la 'chang ba lags kyi/ gzhan la ma ston zhig ces zhus so/ /de ltar gcig gis gcig la gdams shing bstan nas yon tan can spun gnyis de nas so sor gyes te gnas so/ /(mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun pa'i par gzhi ltar bsgrigs shing /'grel ba chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'o/ /)95

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ ñtsa༄༅/ /shes rab brgya pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa bzhugs so/ /slob dpon klu sgrub/rgya gar skad du/ pradzñā sha ti ka nā ma pra ka ra ṇa/ bod skad du/ shes rab brgya pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa/'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig legs par rtogs pa yis /mi rnams shes rab brgya bskyed pa/ /don gyi bstan bcos lugs dag gi /'byung gnas chen por rab tu bshad/ /mkhas pas don gyi bstan bcos las/ /dngos po gang dag gzigs gyur pa/ /de dag yi ge mang po yis /'jigs pa'i ched du 'dir bsdus byas/ /96

shes rab brgya pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa/yi ge nyung la don mang ba/ /gtan tshigs sna tshogs rnams kyis brgyan/ /'di ni tshigs su bcad pa brgya/ /shes rab brgya pa zhes bya'o/ /mthong dang ma mthong yon tan 'di/ /kun gyi rtsa ba shes rab yin/ /de ltar gnyis ka bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /shes rab yongs su gzung bar bya/ /chos don 'dod dang thar pa yi/ /'byung gnas chen po rig pa yin/ /de ltas dang por gus pa yis/ /shes rab yum chen gzung bar bya/ /shes rab ldan pa gcig rkya yang / /gzhan gyis 'di la gnod mi 'gyur/ /dor thabs ldan pa'i lus chung yang / /mtshan dang ldan pas yo mi brnyas/ /97

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/shes rab kyis ni lus bsrungs la/ /dgra yi tshogs kyis ci byar yod/ /lag na gdugs dang bcas pa la /char gyi rgyun gyis rdzi ba med/ /shes rab rtsal dang bral ba ni/ /gzhan gyi bran byed kho nar zad/ /glang chen ri brtsegs lta bu yi/ /lus dang ldan pa snang ba bzhin/ /shes rab mig phye rnams la ni/ /rgud pa rnam par 'jig 'gyur te/ /lag na mar me thogs pa yi/ /mdun na mun pa med pa bzhin/ /shes rab med pa'i phun sum tshogs/ /gnam babs bzhin du byung ba yang / /skad cig kho nas de dag med/ /ma rungs pa rnams bshes pa bzhin/ /98

—— 3gabazhizabang nga/sbyo1 nga/ stunatheb drarmi ngas:rno zabangs /1 ༷rmirngasno tha//legs par brtags te byed pa la/ /ma rungs pa dag mi snang ste/ /'phrod pa za ba'i lus la ni/ /nad kyi bar chad mi 'byung ngo / /gang la rang don 'phel 'gyur ba'i/ /shes nyen yod pa de mkhas pa/ /chu yis gang ba'i mtsho la ni/ /mkha' la rgyu ba rnams kyang brten/ /gang zhig nyen dang 'brel ba yi/ /nor de yang ni ci ru rung / / sbrul gyi mgo la 'dug pa yi/ /nor bu la ni su zhig reg /rang don bsgrub par bya ba rnams/ /bag med las kyis bsgrub mi bya/ /sbrul so shin tu gdug pa yis/ /don mang bsgrubs par phung bar snang / /

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rang don bsgrub par bya ba rnams/ /bag dang bcas pa'i las kyis bsgrub/ /srin bu pad pa zon can lus/ /khrag 'thungs bzhin du mi mthong ngo / /rang gi gting 'dzugs 'dod pa yis/ /gzhan gyi phan la brtson par bya/ /gting 'dzugs sbyor ba ma byas pa'i/ /sgrub pa po yis ci mi 'grub/ /gzhan gyi phyogs gzhom 'dod pas kyang / /bdag nyid yon tan ldan par bya/ /gzhu ni rgyud dang ma ldan pa'i/ /mdas lta gang du phyin par 'gyur/ /dbri mkhyud med par smra ba dang / /ji skad smras bzhin sgrub pa dang / /chas bzhi nyams dang sbyor ba yi/ /mi pho rnams ni bde bar 'tsho/ /100

shes rab brgya pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa/ya rabs rnams kyi spyod pa la/ /skye bo ngan pas gnod mi 'gyur/ /rin chen sgron ma 'bar ba'i tshe/ /'thor rlung tshogs kyis mi sod do/ /gya nom skyes bu'ang ji zhig ltar/ /ngan pa'i gnas su phyin 'gyur na/ /dur khrod kyi ni me bzhin du/ /grogs ngan bsten las 'jigs pa 'byung / /g.yon can ngag 'jam smra ba la/ /mkhas pas nan tan ma brtags par/ /yid brtan bya bar rung ma yin/ /rma bya yid 'ong sgra sgrogs par/ /zas su dug chen za ba bzhin/ /shes rab can gang dgra la yang /mdza' bshes lta bur sgrub byed pa/ /rgya mtsho bzhin du mi 'khrugs te/ /101

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/skye bo ngan pas drod mi zin/ /phyir rjes su ni lta ba dang / /bag yod khong khro med pa dang / /brtson 'grus brtan zhing mi g.yel ba'i/ /mi la dpal mgon nye bar gnas/ /gang zhig lan la mi re bar /sbyin pa gtong la sems spro ba/ /de ni snyan dngags mkhas pa bzhin/ /mi yul 'di na grags pas mdzes/ /gang zhig dbang po bran lta bur/ /bka' bzhin rjes su mthun byed pa/ /rgya mtsho che la rin chen bzhin/ /de la 'dod dgu phun sum tshogs/ /bya ba ma yin mi byed cing / /bshams pa mkhos su phebs pa dang / /yul la 'dod pa thag bsrings pa'i/ /102

shes rab brgya pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa/skyes bu mkhas pa sus mi bkur/ /mthu rtsal ldan pa'i khengs sems kyis/ /lugs kyi gdams ngag yongs mi spang / /ru shing bzang po'i gzhu mchog kyang / /rgyud med g.yul ngor ci zhig bya/ /g.yon can rnams kyi gron can tshig /mdzangs pas legs par ma brtags na/ /khong glu'i don rnams ma dpyad pa'i/ /ri dwags gzhan gyis brlag par snang / /mkhas pa rtag tu dgra la yang / /mnyen des can du bya dgos te/ /'khri shing mnyen pos ljon shing la/ /'khris nas rtse mor phyin te gnas/ /khong rgyud dog pa tsam gyis 'dir/ /dgos dgu 'grub par mi 'gyur bas/ /yid kyis legs par rnam brtags te/ /103

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ngag gis kun dang mthun par bya/ /ngag gis bzhams te smra bya zhing / /res 'ga' byi la'i spyod pa'ang spyad/ /thabs dang ldan pa'i spyod pa la/ /mkhas pa su yang smod mi byed/ /rngon pa pus mo gnyis btsugs te/ /yan lag rnams kyi gum phag tu/ /byas te khong glu snyan len pas/ /ri dwags sod par mi 'gyur ram/ /rgyal po'i bzhed pa mi sbyor ba/ /mkhas pas rtag tu 'bad de spang / /sa bdag 'khor bcas thag ring zhes/ /khyad du gsad pa rung ma yin/ /lugs la mkhas pa'i blon po yis/ /skye bo ma lus skyong byed pa'i/ /rgyal po gcig pu kho nas kyang / /104

shes rab brgya pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa/sa rnams ma lus chom du phebs/ /gang na rgyal po 'bangs rnams kyis/ /legs nyes sems par byed pa yi/ /yul de rgyal po yod ces bya/ / de ltar de dag gtsor brtag go /gang na rgyal po 'bangs rnams kyis/ /legs nyes sems par mi byed pa/ /rgyal po de dag gtsug lag la/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis brten mi bya/ /yon tan ldan pa chung yang ni/ /'jig rten thabs chen thob par 'gyur/ /zla ba shas tsam lus pa yang / /drag po yis ni spyi la thogs/ /mkhas pa gang zhig bag med pa'i/ /gnas nas byol te 'bros pa dpa'/ /ri dwags rgyal po mi gtsang ba'i/ /105

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gnas nas 'dzur ba ga la ltar/ /legs nyes don chen mi sems par/ /mun sprul brtul ba dpa' ma yin/ /don med dpag tshad brgya yod pa'i/ /g.yang sar mchong ba ci cha yod/ /yon tan ldan yang thams cad du/ /grags chen thob par 'gyur ma yin/ /zla ba'i 'od zer bsil ba rnams/ /padma'i rdzing dang 'phrod mi 'gyur/ /mjug tu skyor 'byin byed pa yi/ /snyan tshig mkhas pa sus mi bsngags/ /gang gis khams 'khrug 'gyur ba yi/ /kha zas zhim po de su za/ /mkhas rnams rna bar mi snyan yang / /phan tshig sman bzhin bsten par gyis/ /re zhig cig na de dag kyang / /106

shes rab brgya pazhesabyaba'irabatubyedapa/da yang dag bdud rtsi lta bur 'gyur/ /rigs pa'i don dang mi ldan pa'i/ /gzhung lugs gang zhig rtsom byed pa/ /de yang dgos pa 'grub mi 'gyur/ /sngags dang bral ba'i sbyin sreg bzhin/ /skyon dang yon tan 'di gnyis la/ /gcig tu mkhas par byas nas ni/ /dgos pa rtsom par byed pa gang / /de la nyes pa rgyab kyis phyogs/ /snying la khong du dam bzung nas/ /bshes pa'i tshig ni ston byed pa/ /de dag mdzes pa ma yin te/ /srin bus zos pa'i sdong rul bzhin/ /gang dag tshig tu snyan smra zhing / /snying la gzhan zhig 'jog byed pa/ /ri dwags gzugs can stag lta bur/ / 107

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/de bas yid brtan gnas ma yin/ /gson tshe grags pa dga' ba'i rgyu/ /'jig rten pha rol phan 'gyur ba/ /de gnyis gcig kyang med pa ni/ /'jig rten gnyis na ci zhig mi/ /gar skyes su ni zad ces te/ /rang gi brtson pa dor mi bya/ /'bad pa med par til dag las/ /til mar thob par 'gyur ma yin/ /kun la mnyen des mi bya ste/ /ha cang des pa gnod par 'gyur/ /chu shing snying po med pa la/ /su zhig spyod par rtsom mi byed/ /gang zhig gtong phod blo ldan dpa'/ /tshig bden gtsang la byas pa gzo/ /de la rtag tu dpal grogs rnams/ /108

shes rab brgya pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa/grib ma bzhin du rjes su 'brang / /nags kyi glang chen zhags pa yis/ /bcings nas dbang du byed pa yang / /thabs mkhas tshul la gnas pa yi/ /yon tan rnams kyi mthu stobs yin/ /rje dpon rang don lhur len pa/ /g.yog 'khor rten par mi byed de/ /sha la brkam pa'i seng ge la/ /wa skya re thag chad pa bzhin/ / gang zhig legs byas mi tshor ba /de la g.yog 'khor rten mi byed/ /tsha sgo can la legs rmos kyang / /lo tog phun sum tshogs mi 'gyur/ /bdog pa ha cang spel ba yang / /mjug tu rgud pas gdungs par 'gyur/ /tshang tshing mang dang ldan pa yis/ /109

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/sa phyogs tshig par 'gyur ba bzhin/ /gang zhig skye dgu 'tsho byed pa/ /de ni las nyid ston par byed/ /byis pa gnas sa ma bye bar/ /nu zho 'thung ba su yis bsten/ /gang la zhe 'gras yod pa yi/ /dgra bo de dang gzhar mi 'grogs/ /za bas bag tsam brjod pa yis/ /sgra gcan 'dzin gyis nyi ma zin/ /bya ba nyams kyis mi lcogs pa/ /gzhan gyis rbad kyang byar mi rung / /dge'o dge'o zhes smras pas/ /me yi nang du su zhig mchong / /ci nas bdag dmus ma byung ba'i/ /las kyis sbyor ba rnams bya ste/ /gsang bas 'di ni slob ma rnams/ /110

shes rab brgya pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa/blon po nyid du 'gyur ram ci/ /phongs pa las gang byed pa ste/ /rnal mar 'dug pas byar mi rung / /mdze can mer ni 'jug ces te/ /de ci gzhan gyi sman yin nam/ /gang gis 'jig rten 'di dang ni/ /gzhan du sdug bsngal mi 'gyur ba/ /'di 'dra ba yi tshul de ni/ /shin tu yun ring dus su spyad/ /gang dag rgas rab mi bsten pa/ /de dag gtsug lag mkhas mi 'gyur/ /gzu lums can gyi spyod pa rnams/ /dgos pa myur du nyams par 'gyur/ /ha cang sog la zhen pa yi/ /bdog pa gzhan gyi don du 'gyur/ /sbrang mas 'bad de bsags pa yi/ /

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/sbrang rtsi gzhan dag spyod par snang / /ngan pa rnams dang bshes 'dod pa/ /phung ba kho nar 'gyur bar zad/ /chu bos drud nas zos pa yis/ /ljon shing 'greng yang 'gyel dang 'dra/ /phan skyabs che la brten na ni/ /chung yang btsan po nyid du 'gyur/ /ri rab btsan la brten pa'i bya/ /gser gyi mdog tu 'gyur zhes grags/ /khangs bzangs zo mdog gya gyu med/ /klan ka mi tshol 'jar la phan/ /sgrub pa'i 'bras bu yod pa yi/ /grogs po rnams la lha yang dga'/ /mang po rnams ni 'jing dril nas/ /longs spyod phyir ni dpung 'chang ba/ /chags pa'i dbang gis phung 'gyur te/ /112

shes rab brgya pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa/nas dang bral ba'i srin bzhin no/ /don rnams kun la mi gsal ba'i/ /ngan pa rnams ni 'dzings bsdongs nas/ /go 'phang thob kyang rlag 'gyur te/ /srin bu re ba'i khar phyin bzhin/ /yul ngan bshes ni ngan pa dang / /chung ma ngan dang 'khor ngan dang / /rgyal po skye bo ngan spong ba/ /de dag rtag tu bde ba 'thob/ /skyes bu mkhas pa gcig rkya yang / /'dod pa'i don mchog 'grub par 'gyur/ /ri dwags rgyal po gcig pu yis/ /glang chen dregs khyu'i klad pa 'gems/ /mang po tshogs par gyur pa yi/ /nang na 'dug na gzhan dag gis/ /de 'dir zad ces mi rtsi ba /113

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/skyes bu tha shal yin snyam byed/ /rang don bsgrub par 'dod pa yis/ /rtag tu skyabs chen btsal bar bya/ /gang dag rgya mtsho cher phyin na/ /rang gi ming yang mi gleng ngo / /rang bzhin ngan pa'i skye bo dang / /shin tu mdza' bor byas kyang ni/ /mar me'i me lce tsha ba bzhin/ /nyid kyi rang bzhin mi 'dor ro/ /khon chen zhags pas phan tshun du/ /glags pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams/ /'chi 'pho skyes na'ang de dag la/ /khon chen de bzhin rjes su 'brang / /dper na sbrul dang ne'u le dang / /bya rog 'ug pa ma he rta/ /tshe rabs gzhan la bsgrubs pa gang / /114

shes rab brgya pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa/de ci 'di la mi snang ngam/ /khro ba la ni brten rnams kyis/ /rang gi don yang mi rigs pas/ /mkhas pas rnam par ma brtags par/ /khro ba'i yus su mi bya'o/ /gang la bzod pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /khro ba'i me ni zhi byed pa/ /gdul ba'i thabs kyi mchog yod pa/ /de la dgra rnams ga la sdang / /g.yung drung chos kyi go 'phang mchog /legs pa'i gzhi la ma 'bad na/ /mthong dang ma mthong phun sum tshogs/ /chu yi chu bur bzhin du g.yo/ /snying la yod pa'i gsang tshig rnams/ /ngan pa rnams la spel mi bya/ /brang 'gro gdug pa khros pa bzhin/ /115

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/de la de yis gnod 'gyur srid/ /blo ldan gang zhig rtsom pa kun/ /chos gtsor byed pa'i dpal ldan pa/ /de la 'di dang gzhan du yang / /bde bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /thabs mkhas cho gar ldan pa la/ /dgra rnams kyis ni rdzi mi 'gyur/ / cho ga rab tu sbyar legs na/ /dug kyang bdud rtsi nyid du 'gyur/ /dgra bcom phyogs dang bral ba yis/ /sems kyi gnod pa ga la spong / /mtshon chag g.yul ngor cher zhugs pa/ /gdon mi za bar pham par 'gyur/ /grogs mi bdog pa 'gas kyang ni/ /dgra dpung gzhom par dka' bar 'gyur/ /tshang tshing nyung zad bsregs pa yi/ /116

shes rab brgya pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa/me yang rlung la ltos dgos so/ /bdag dang gzhan la mi phan pa'i/ /phyug po bkren dang cis mi mtshungs/ /bud shing rnams dang phrad pa'i me/ /bud shing bsregs nas shi ba bzhin/ /gzhan gyis bzung ba'i bud med dag /rum du bcug ste nyal ba ni/ /lcags kyo med par glang po che/ /myos pa'i rgyab tu zhon pas thu/ /gang zhig rtag tu smad 'tshong ma'i/ /bud med rnams la gla 'jal ba/ /ston ka'i chu bo'i rtsa lag bzhin/ /de yi phun sum tshogs pa 'grib/ /blo ldan spyod lam zhi ba yi/ /lus kyi phan pa 'grub par byed/ /chu skyar spyod lam zhi ba yis/ /117

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/spyod pas nya rnams 'byin par byed/ /bdog pa rigs pas nyer bsgrubs shing / /'jig rten kun la phan 'dogs gang / /de ni 'jig rten thams cad kyis/ /spyi la me tog phreng bzhin bkur/ /'jig rten 'di na mkhas pa gang / /dgra rnams snying nang 'jug 'dod pa/ /des kyang bdag nyid rtag par ni/ /yon tan rnams dang ldan par bya/ /gang zhig gzhan dag brlag bya zhes/ /khros pa'i me yis rang rgyud sreg /yon tan lhur len mi byed pa/ /de dag nam nam zhar zhar phung / /gang la rang gi shes rab med/ /de la bstan bcos ci byar yod/ /mig gnyis dang ni bral ba la /118

shes rab brgya pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa/me long gis ni ci zhig bya/ /sbrul la 'o ma blud pa ni/ /dug 'phel 'gyur ba kho nar zad/ /ngan pa rnams la gdams pa yang /tshig pa za 'gyur zhi mi 'gyur/ /yon tan mchog ldan mi rnams ni/ /snying dang yid kyang 'dren par byed/ /mkhas pa yon tan lcags kyo yis/ /lam log glang chen drangs te bkol/ /'jig rten kun gyi dpal 'di ni/ /yid kyis lag tu 'ongs dang 'dra/ /dpa' bo tsham tshom med rtsom pa/ /mthu stobs can gyi dbang du 'gyur/ /dpal gyi 'gro ba bzang mo 'di/ /'di dang rang dbang med par 'dug /mthu rtsal ldan pa'i skyes mchog gis/ /119

le gas bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/lag nas drangs pa bzhin du spyod/ /gang zhig 'byung po thams cad la/ /rtag tu bdag dang 'drar byed pa/ /mdza' bshes 'phel ba 'di la ni/ /phun sum tshogs pa 'tshe ba med/ /btsan la mi 'gyur thabs mkhas shing / /skye dgu rnams kyi gdung ba sel/ /kun la snying brtser bcas pa yi/ /mi dbang rnams ni sprin dang 'dra/ /gnam la sprin chen dal snyoms pa/ / sa la lo tog kun gyi gsos/ /bzod chen grib mar ldan pa yi/ /ljon shing skye dgu'i gdung ba sel/ /mi yi chos lugs legs spyad na/ /lha yul bgrod pa thag mi ring /lha dang mi yi them skas las/ /120

shes rab brgya pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa/'dzegs na thar pa gam na 'dug /don gyi bstan bcos lugs chen po/ /don mang phreng ba brgyus pa las/ /gces pa'i snying po mdor bsdus pa/ /shes rab brgya pa 'di yin no/ / gang zhig gzhan dring mi 'jog par/ /shes rab rtsal gyis 'tsho 'dod pa/ /de yis phyogs 'di brtag byas pas/ /rang gzhan don du spyad pa spyod/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang po rab tu dga' ba brnyes shing / chos kyi dbyings kun tu 'gro ba'i don rtogs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes 'byung gnas 'od ces bya bar lung bstan pa/ sangs rgyas gnyis par grags pa/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa shes rab brgya pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa brgya pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po sarba dzñā de ba dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā pa ban de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/ / 121

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/༄7/ /lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /slob dpon klu sgrub/rgya gar skad du/ nī ti shāst+ra pradzñā daṇḍa nā ma/ bod skad du/lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu zhes bya ba/dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi srun skye bo gdul bar bya/ /yon tan can ni bkur bar bya/ /drang po'i spyod pas dkor mdzod dgang / /rang gi yul 'khor bskyang bar bya /bdag gi gsang dang gzhan gyi gsang / /rang gi bu gces bzhin bsrungs nas/ /rme rnams la ni snyoms gyur pa'i/ /mi ni gces pa rab gces 'gyur/ /122

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/chung ma ngan dang mdza' bo ngan/ /rgyal po ngan dang nye du ngan/ /khyim mtshes ngan dang yul ngan rnams/ /thag ring du ni spang bar bya/ /grogs po nor dad che ba spang / /chung ma log g.yem dad che spang / /bkur dka' so mi mkhas pa yi/ /de lta bu yi sman pa spang / /bye brag phyed pa'i blo ldan yang / /bya ba gros kyis bsgrub par bya/ /'grub 'gyur kho nar ma zad kyi/ /ma grub na yang mdzes pa yin/ /brtan zhing 'jam la tshig nyung gang yin pa/ /de la shin tu shin tu bag bya ste/ /nyi ma sprin bug nang nas byung ba yi/ /'od zer shin tu tsha bar gyur pa bzhin/ /123

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/brtan rnams sdug bsngal myong gyur kyang / /yid ni gdung bar mi byed de/ /zla ba sgra gcan khar zhugs nas/ /'char bar ci ga mi byed dam/ /kun dga' ra ba'i phreng rgyud ltar/ /me tog rgyas pa btu bya yi/ /ji ltar sol ba mkhan bzhin du/ /rtsa nas gcad par mi bya'o/ /gsug dang rgyal po'i bka' drin dang / /smad 'tshong gla dang legs brjod dang / /gru yi gla dang gnas kyi skal/ /'di nyid du ni blang bya ste/ /drug po yun ring thob mi 'gyur/ /rig sngags log par shes pa dug /nad la btang snyoms byas pa dug /rgan pos gzhon nu bsten pa dug /124

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/dbul po nyin par nyal ba dug /dam pa mang po khas 'ches mi byed la/ /gal te dka' bas khas ni blangs gyur na/ /rdo la ri mo bris pa lta bur ni/ /shi yang gzhan du byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /dus su dgra dang 'dum par bya /dus su bshes dang 'thab par bya /bya dang mi bya'i tshod shes pas/ /mkhas pas dus ni 'da' bar bya/ /kha yi nyes pas phung 'gyur te/ /ne tso ri skegs ti ti ra/ /mi smra chu skyar mis mi 'dzin/ /thams cad 'grub byed mi smra yin/ /chas bzhag bstar bas dgra bo gdul/ /gos ngan gyis ni chung ma gdul/ /smyung ba byas pas nad rnams gdul/ /125

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ —goms pa yis ni ma rig gdul/ /rang gi spyod pa sba bar bya/ /'dam gyi nang du lus bcug pa'i/ /gal te myu gus ma bos na/ /padma'i rtsa ba su yis rnyed/ /gal te mngon sum gyur kyang ni/ /mi srid dngos po smra mi bya/ /ri mo la gnas rma bya yis/ /ji ltar nor bu za bar byed/ /gang zhig yid la gnod byed 'dod/ /de la rtag tu snyan tshig brjod/ /rngon pa ri dwags gsod mthong tshe/ /yid 'ong glu snyan len pa bzhin/ /bsam pa gang dang gang gis ni/ /mi rnams yid ni yang dag sbyor/ /des na de yi dbang du 'gyur/ /126

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/sna tshogs nor bu ji bzhin no/ /gzhan gyi khu tshur 'tsho ba bla/ /nags na shing shun gyon pa bla/ /mi rnams shi bar gyur kyang bla/ /nyin re bzhin du brnyas thabs min/ /ma brnyas mi yi rtsa ba yin/ /brnyas pa'i nor gyis ci zhig bya/ /nga rgyal dregs pas rab bcom pa'i/ /nor dang srog gis ci zhig bya/ /bya ba mi lcogs rtsom par byed pa dang / /tshogs dang 'khon zhing stobs ldan dag la rgol/ /bud med la ni yid brtan byed pa ste/ /'chi bdag bzhi po sgo yi drung na sdod/ /rgyal po ngan pa yong ma mthong / /mdza' bo g.yon can yong ma mthong / /'dod ldan chung ma yong ma mthong / /127

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/skye bo sdig can yong ma mthong / /gang zhig kun tu bgrod bya yod pa de/ /rang yul chags pas brlag par ci phyir byed/ /skye bo ngan pa bdag gi khron pa ni/ /'di yin zer zhing ba tshwa can chu 'thung / /skye bo blo dpangs mtho ba la /'di na bde skyid gnyis yod de/ /'du 'dzi thams cad spangs pa'am/ /'byor pa shin tu rgya che ba'o/ /dpal ni rgyab kyis phyogs gyur cing / /rtsol ba don med nyid gyur pa'i/ /dam pa dbul por gyur pa las/ /nags las gzhan du bde ba med/ /dam pa'i 'gro ba gnyis yin te/ /me tog dag gi mgo lcogs bzhin/ /'jig rten kun gyis spyir bkur ba'am/ /128

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/nags nyid du ni dengs par bya/ /ngang gis skad cig 'jig pa yi/ /tshe yi snying po 'di yin te/ /mdza' dang mkhas dang shan ma phye/ /lhan cig bag yangs gnas pa'o/ /bsags na grogs 'khar 'phel 'gyur la/ /spyad na mig sman zad 'gyur ltar/ /dus las 'god pa chung 'gyur ba/ /de nyid kho na mkhas pa yin/ /grogs 'khar dang ni sbrang rtsi dang / /zla ba tshes pa yar gyi ngo / /rgyal po'i nor dang sprang po'i nor/ /cung zad cung zad bsags pas 'phel/ /ha cang sred par mi bya ste/ /sred pa che la nyes pa 'byung / /ha cang sred pas rmongs byas na/ /129

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ce spyang gzhu mchog gtsug tor bzhin/ /bya ba'i don du rjes su 'brang / /byas zin pa la brten mi byed/ /blo ngan zho yi rna ba can/ /bsrung bar bya ba khyod kyis bcom/ /rab tu grags pa 'gro mi bya/ /bdag nyid kyis ni mngon sum bya/ /bil ba chu nang lhung ba yis/ /nags tshal stong par gyur la ltos/ /gnad du 'phog pa'i tshig mi brjod/ /shin tu gnod pa'ang brjod mi bya/ /skyes bu dang ni mtshon cha yi/ /pha rol dag ni shes par bya /dgra bo'i bu ni snyan par smra na yang / /mkhas pa yis ni btang snyoms mi bya ste/ /dug lo shin tu mi bzad yin pas na/ /130

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/de nyid dus gzhan dag tu gnod pa skyed/ /gang zhig dgra bo dag la yang/ /g.yo med sems kyis phan byed pa/ /de la dgra bo thams cad kyang / /thal mo sbyor ba nyid du byed/ /dgra bo zil gnon 'dod pa yis/ /bdag nyid yon tan gyis bstod kyi/ /gnod sems ngan pas ci zhig bya/ /des ni bdag gnod dgra la min/ /mi srun skye bo zhi bas min/ /de dang 'tsham pa'i rtsub pas bsten/ /bu ni mi bsgrub pa dag la/ /phan 'dod pha yis mi bsdig gam/ /ji srid lam ni mthong ba dang / /ji srid rkang pa brtan pa dang / /ji srid shes rab ma nyams pa/ /131

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/de srid rang gi phan pa gyis/ /rnam pa kun tu rang phan spyad bya yi/ /'gro mang nang du gnas pas ci zhig bya/ /skye bo thams cad yongs su mgu 'gyur ba/ /de 'dra'i thabs ni gang yang yod ma yin/ /gzhan las tshol zhing zas zhim 'dod/ /slong mos 'tsho zhing khengs pa che /bstan bcos shes med rtsod par 'dod/ /khyod kyi de gsum bzhad gad rgyu/ /nags bsregs pa yi me la ni/ /rlung gis grogs su 'gyur ba yin/ /de nyid mar me 'jig byed pas/ /nyam chung pa la bshes yod min/ /gzhan la gnod pa ma byas dang / /dman la 'dud pa ma byas shing / /dam pa'i lam ni ma spangs gang / /132

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/nyung ba de ni mang po yin/ /nad kyi 'jigs pa ma byung zhing / /dam pa dag dang 'grogs par brtson/ /dman pa'i tshig ni ma smras pa'i/ /nyin gcig lo brgya bas mchog yin/ /dman pas gang tshe nor ni cung zad rnyed/ /'gro ba thams cad brnyas pa'i nga rgyal ldan/ /dam pa nor gyi 'byor pa thob gyur kyang / /sā lu smin pa lta bur shin tu 'dud/ /rigs rus dma' ba'i sems can dag /nor ram rig pa rnyed gyur na/ /'gro ba kun la rtswa snyam sems/ /pags pa sngon po'i wa bzhin no/ /nor ram rig par ldan gyur na/ /dman pa rnams ni dregs par 'gyur/ /go 'phang gnyis po de dag gis/ /133

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mkhas pa shin tu dul bar 'gyur/ /bogs med tshong dang 'khor ldan dag la 'tshe/ /slong zhing 'gying la nor med 'dod la dga'/ /bud med gzhon la tshig rtsub smra ba ste/ /skyes bu log par spyod pa de lnga'o/ /rma bya so ga'i tsha bas gdungs gyur kyang / /mkha' dkyil char gyi rgyun la re bla yi/ /rdzing bu rnyog pa can gyi chu ngan la/ /dregs pas bstod pa'i mgrin pa ma gdud cig /ti ti ra ni zil ba yi/ /thigs pas srog ni 'dzin byed kyang / /bslang na gtugs pa'i 'jigs pa yis/ /brgya byin la yang mi slong ngo / /de nyid shes na slob dpon ci/ /nad sos sman pa ga la dgos/ /chu bo brgal na gru pas ci/ /134

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/chags bral byad mas ci zhig bya/ /ngan pa ji srid nyam chung ba/ /de srid bar du rang bzhin bzang / /ston ka yi ni chu bo'i chu/ /skye bo kun gyis bgrod pa bla/ /gang du byi bas mdzod pa byed/ /byi las mar ni bsrung ba dang / /khwa yis phyag tshang byed pa yi/ /dngos de la ni smos ci dgos/ /gang na zhal ta byed pa mang / /thams cad mkhas par nga rgyal che/ /kun kyang gtso bo byed 'dod pa/ /de yi tshogs rnams 'jigs par 'gyur/ /nyin par 'khrig dang nyin nyal dang / /chang gsar zho ni gzhon nu 'thung / /sha skam bud med rgan nyal te/ /135

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'di drug lus kyi stobs 'phrog pa'o/ /gang zhig khro na'ang 'jigs med la/ /dga' na'ang phan 'dogs mi nus pa/ /tshar gcod bsdu ba med 'gyur ba'i/ /de khros pas ni ci byar yod/ /nad dang phangs dus byung ba dang / /mu ge'i tshe dang dgras 'jigs dang / /rgyal po'i sgo dang gshin rje'i gnas/ /de rnams kun gyi gnyen por 'gyur/ /dgos pa'i don du 'jig rten sgrub/ /dam pa'i don du de dag min/ /bee'us 'o ma zad mthong nas/ /ba ni ring du spang ba bzhin/ /sdug pa dang bral rang mis brnyas pa dang / /bu lon mang zhing ngan pa dag la brten/ /dbul por mthong nas mdza' bos spangs pa ste/ /136

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/me ma yin pas lus sreg de lnga'o/ /mi mthun chung ngu 'phel ba la/ /mi gang zhi bar mi byed pa/ /sbrang rtsi'i thigs pa 'dzag pa dang / /yul 'khor 'jig par 'gyur ba bzhin/ /gang zhig rigs ldan de bzhin brten pa dang / /dam pa phangs kyang yon tan gtong mi byed/ /nyi ma'i rang bzhin tsha bas gdungs kyang ni/ /kha ba grang ba'i rang bzhin gtong mi byed/ /sdig pa zad 'dod bde bar gshegs la dad/ /skal ba zad 'dod skye bo ngan dang bsten/ /rigs rgyud zad 'dod glen zhing lkugs pa skye/ /'bru rnams zad 'dod pho ba'i me drod skye/ /'dod pas long bas sdig mi mthong /dmus long gis ni gzugs mi mthong /dregs pa yis ni skyon mi mthong / /137

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bdag ltas de nyid mi mthong ngo / /rgyal po yur chu 'khri shing dang / /bud med dmus long lnga bo ni/ /g.yon can blo yis ji ltar khrid/ /khrid rnams gzhan gyi dbang du 'gyur/ /bde ba'i rjes la sdug bsngal te/ /sdug bsngal rjes la bde ba yin/ /mi rnams kyi ni bde sdug dag /'khor lo bzhin du 'khor bar byed/ /ma mthong ba dag mdun du lhags/ /slar yang ma mthong ba ru song / /khyod kyi de ci khyod kyang ci/ / de la mya ngan su zhig byed/ /ji lta ji ltar shing dag ni/ /rgya mtsho che la mnyam 'gro ba/ /dba' rlabs kyis ni so sor phye/ /138

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/de la mya ngan su zhig byed/ /blo gros che ldan khro bas shugs las rgyal/ /skye bo ngan pa khro bas mod la pham/ /pham pas pham par byas pa'i blo ngan dag /blo ldan dag dang lhan cig ci phyir 'gran/ /pha bong 'bad pa chen po yis/ /ri yi rtse mor 'degs par nus/ /cung zad tsam gyis de skur ba/ /rang gi skyon yon de dang mtshungs/ /mi gang bya ba ma yin pa'i/ /bya ba la ni sbyor byed pa/ /des ni nges par phung 'gyur te/ /khyi'u 'byin pa'i spre'u bzhin/ /rang gi phyogs ni yongs spangs nas/ /gzhan gyi phyogs la dga' ba gang / /de ni nges par brlag 'gyur te/ /139

legs bshad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ da wargyal po rab dmar ji bzhin no/ /mkha' la skar mkhan dag gis rtsis byas na/ /zla ba dang ni skar ma'i lam rnams shes/ /khyim na mi dang khyim thab log pa dag /sna tshogs spyod pa de ni mthong ma gyur/ /rnyog med chu nang zla tshes snang gyur pa/ /padma'i rtsa ba len par khyod byed gyur/ /ngang pa chu dang 'o ma 'byed shes pa'i/ /khyod kyi blo gros de ring gang du song / /mi gang bya ba chen po gang / /cung zad byed par 'dod na yang / /de ni bsgrims nas rab bya ste/ /seng ge'i las gcig yin par bshad/ /ji ltar rgyal srid bskyang ba dang / /bsdo ba'i dgra rnams 'dul ba dag /'bangs la re ba ma 'jog par/ /140

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/zhal bzhugs tshe na smyur te mdzod/ /snying du sdug pa'am gzhan gang zhes/ /sems yang pa dag rtse bar byed/ /spyod pa rgya chen ldan pa dag /sa yi dkyil 'khor thams cad gnyer/ /rtag tu snyan tshig smra ba yi/ /rgyal pos skye dgu brid par sla/ /phan tshig sman dang 'dra ba de/ /nyan pa bas kyang smra ba dkon/ /gal te chos don rtogs pa yis/ /zhal che lam srang skyon na ni/ /'gro ba blo ldan gcig gyur kyang / /de las bdag ni rnam par rgyal/ /nor mnyam nus pa mnyam pa dang / /gnad shes 'bad rtsol che ba yi /'khor gyis nges par gnod 'gyur gyi/ /141

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gang dgras mi phung de yis phung / /chu yi nang nas me dbar na/ /me de gang gis zhi bar byed/ /skyob pa las ni 'jigs pa byung / /'jigs pa de las su yis srung / /ma bskul mi snyan dgra ston la/ /bskul nas snyan pa mi sgrogs la/ /'jig rten rnga zlum dang 'dra la/ /de ltar bskul zhing sgra snyan sgrogs/ /sa bdag 'dod la chags pas phan dang gnod pa shes mi 'gyur/ /ji ltar rang dgar rang spyod myos pa'i glang chen bzhin du spyod/ /de 'og 'gyod pas rab gdungs nyam nga'i mya ngan g.yang sar lhung / /de yis 'khor la nyes pa bgod byed rang gi skyon ma 142

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/rig /rtsod dus rgyal po nor tshogs thob pa las/ /srog ni srung gi nor ni gtang bar bya/ /ji ltar shan pas lug gi bal bregs nas/ /srog thar byas pa rnyed pa che ba bzhin/ /rtsa ba brang 'gro rtse mo mkha' lding dang / / yal ga spre 'dzegs me tog bung bas bskor/ /gang zhig gdug pa'i sems can gnas bcas pa/ /tsan dan shing de la ni bsnyen du med/ /gang gis thabs kyis pha rol gnon/ /nus pas ma yin thabs kyis de/ /bya rog gis ni gser phreng gi /sbrul dag gsad par gyur la ltos/ /gang la blo yod de stobs ldan/ /blo med stobs kyis ci zhig bya/ /ci zhig seng ge stobs dang ldan/ /143

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ sdiri bong gis ni srog dang phral/ /bya ba'i thabs kyis grogs byed na/ /blo ldan dag la dri bar bya/ /phun sum tshogs pas smos ci dgos/ /phung gyur na yang mdzes pa yin/ /yon tan tshul spyod rang bzhin gsal ba yis/ /skye bo ngan pa bcos su ga la rung / /tsha zhing drod che rtsub pas bsgrubs pa yi/ /bad kan nad bzhin shin tu 'phel bar 'gyur/ /snying la khon du gzung bya yi/ /de la tshig gis mi bskul bar/ /dgra bo'i rkang pa nas gzung zhing / /tshig gi mtshon chas bsnun par bya/ /ji srid 'jigs pa ma byung ba/ /de srid 'jigs la 'jigs par bya/ /'jigs pa mngon du byung ba'i tshe/ /144

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/'jigs med lta bur gzhom par bya/ /bden pa zhugs par gyur pa la/ /slu byed mkhas pa yin nam ci/ /pang par brten te nyal ba la/ /gsod pa de ci dpa' bo'am/ /gzhon yang rgan pa'i nye bar zhi la dga'/ /mkhas par gyur kyang shes pa'i nga rgyal med/ /gzi brjid che yang bzod cing des pa'i ngang / /je mthor phyin yang nga rgyal dregs pa med/ /rtag tu sems can phan dga' rnams/ /rin chen sgron ltar mchog yin te/ /snum la ltos par mi byed cing / /snod dang sdong bu la ltos min/ /sman pa zas ni ma zhu dang / /rgyal po brdzun du smra ba dang / /rigs ldan sdig pa spyod pa ste/ /145

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'di gsum shin tu mi rigs pa'o/ /mthu che ba dang 'grogs gyur na/ /mthon po nyid du su mi 'gyur/ /me tog phreng bar 'brel ba yi/ /skud pa mgo la 'dogs par byed/ /dus la bab par ston pa dang / /gnas skabs bcas par smra ba dang / /shin tu ngo mtshar gyur la 'god/ /'jig rten chen po nyid thob 'gyur/ /brtson 'grus brtul phod brtan pa dang / /stobs dang blo gros pha rol gnon/ /'bad rtsol yon tan drug ldan pa/ /de la lha yang 'jigs pa skye/ /skyon chad dgra bo pham par byas pa dag /mdza' bor 'dod 'ongs pa la yid mi brtan/ /brag phug 'ug pa'i tshogs kyis gang ba la/ /146

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/bya rog gis ni me btang bsregs la ltos/ /za dang gnyid log 'jigs dang 'khrig pa spyod/ /mi dang phyugs rnams de dag mnyam pa yin/ /chos spyod pa yi mi rnams khyad par 'phags/ /chos mi shes na phyugs dang ci mi mnyam/ /gang zhig chos la smod pa rnams/ /nyi mar 'gro dang 'ong na yang / /de ni mgar ba'i sbud pa yin/ /dbugs 'byin kyang ni gson ma yin/ /sangs rgyas mgon po yongs spangs te/ /lha gzhan la ni phyag byed pa/ /blo ngan gang gā'i 'gram du ni/ /skom nas khron pa byed dang mtshungs/ /yul ni shin tu yun ring gnas kyang nges pa kho nar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /'bral la khyad par ci zhig yod la 'gro ba rang nyid 147

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/sdod mi byed/ /dbang med 'bral bas yid la yong sa su gdung ba mtha' yas skyed par byed/ /'di dag rang gis spong na zhi ba'i bde ba mtha' yas 'thob par 'gyur/ /'dod pa yid 'ong yin pa bde/ /'byor pa mnyam dga' yin mod kyi/ /'on kyang 'tsho ba'i 'jig rten 'di/ /nad med chang 'thung khur par mtshungs/ /'gro ba'i dri ma chags pa 'dra ba med/ /gzhan la gnod pa phrag dog 'dra ba med/ /mdza' bo slong mo pa 'dra yod min te/ /gtong dang mnyam pa'i gnyen bshes gang yang med/ /shes rab dang mnyam mig med de/ /rmongs pa dang mnyam mun pa med/ /nad dang 'dra ba'i dgra med de/ / 1tsho18

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/'chi ba dang mnyam 'jigs pa med/ /de bas shin tu mi bzad pa'i/ /'chi ba nges par 'byung 'gyur bas/ /'dod pa rnams la sems bzlog la/ /dam pa'i chos la dga' bar gyis/ /grogs po 'di na nor de yod legs pas/ /yid bzhin nor khyed rdor 'gyur nor ma byed/ /sbur long rgyan gyi dam par byed 'gyur ba/ /der ni 'di 'dra'i nor bu 'jig rten phung / /gang zhig sa steng 'bru rnams dang / /gser dang phyugs dang nad med rnams/ /de dag kun gyis gcig mi ngoms/ /de ltar shes nas zhi bar gyis/ /'bad pas bsags pa'i nor la ni/ /yang dang yang du nyugs par byed/ /bkren pas byi ba ji bzhin du/ /149

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/nor rnams sdug bsngal kho nar zad/ /'jig rten 'tsho ba brtan ma yin/ /nor dang longs spyod brtan ma yin/ /bu dang chung ma brtan min gyi/ /chos dang grags pa snyan pa brtan/ /rgyal po nor sogs ngoms pa med/ /mkhas pa legs bshad kyis ma ngoms/ /rgya mtsho chu yis ngoms pa med/ /'jig rten sdug la bltas mi ngoms/ /me la shing gis ngoms pa med/ /byis pa 'dod pas ngoms pa med/ /tshul khrims dag dang dul ba dang / /sems ni dul bar gyur pa dang / /gang zhig drang por zhugs pa dag /de la gnas na ci zhig dgos/ /chog shes dbang phyug la gnas na/ /150

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/skye bo ngan pa'i sa dang ring / /longs spyod 'dod pa'i sred pas bcing / /gom re brnyas pa thob par 'gyur/ /lus zhes bya ba skyon ldan 'di/ /yon tan chen po gcig yin te/ /gnas skabs gang dang gang phrad pa/ /de dang der 'gro go ra ba/ /nags kyi glang po rtswa lo za yang stobs dang ldan/ /sbrul ni zas su rlung zar gyur kyang sbegs pa med/ /drang srong rtsa ba 'bras bu tsam gyis dus 'das byed/ /de bas khrel 'dzem chog shes kho na 'byor pa'i mchog /tshod ma dag dang rdul med pa'i/ /chu yi dgon pa ga na'ang yod/ /zla ba thun mong mar me yin/ /'byor pa dag gis ci zhig bya/ /chog shes nges pa'i bdag nyid can/ /151

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'tsho ba gang na'ang btsal mi dka'/ /rtswa dang lo ma chu yi gnas/ /gang na'ang med pa ma yin no/ /nags mchog stag dang glang po'i gtsos bsten par/ /rtswa yi stan byas shing shun gos su gyon/ /shing gi 'bras bu la sogs zas za ba'i/ /nor med nye du'i tshogs nang gson pa min/ /bzang po 'am ni ngan pa yi/ /sbyor ba gang yang rung ba yis/ /lus ni shin tu bsrung bya yi/ /nor la chags pas ci zhig bya/ /bsod nams chen po'i rin gyis ni/ /khyod kyis lus kyi gru nyos pa/ /ji srid chag par ma gyur par/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i pha rol song / /ji srid sdug pa'i dus kyi zla rgyas pa/ /152

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/'chi bdag gza' chen 'di yis ma rnyed pa/ /de srid bag yod par ni gnas bya ste/ /rang gi bya ba dag ni bya ba'i rigs/ /gang tshe 'du shes bral zhing mig mi g.yo/ /skigs bu rgyun 'byung dbugs mthar thug pas slebs/ /mun par g.yang sa cher khrid ltar gyur na/ /de tshe bu dang chung ma gnyen cir 'ong / /snying rjes gdungs pa'i yid dang dbang po dul zhing sems ni chog shes dag la dga' ba dang / /chags bral mngon dga'i sems dang shing drung dag na ltung ba'i 'bras bus bza' ba'i bya ba byed/ /lus rid shing shun gyon zhing rgyal ba zhes ni snyan pa lta bur sgra sgrogs la/ /bā rā ṇa sīr gshin rje'i dbang gyur bcom pa'i lus tshig 'di ni nam zhig spong bar 'gyur/ /bstan bcos 'dzin pas thar pa yin/ /153

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/lus dub pas kyang ma yin te/ /shes rab kyis ni sems btul na/ /thar pa thag nye 'di na yod/ /nyes pa'i skyon ni breg par gyis/ /mgo bo bregs pas ci zhig bya/ /gang zhig yid kyi gos med na/ /ras kyi chos gos ci la phan/ /sems can rnams la gang gi tshems/ /snying rjes brlan par gyur pa dag /thar dang ye shes de yin gyi/ /thal ba ral pa chos gos min/ /gang zhig lang tsho la zhi ba/ /de ni zhi bar bdag gis shes/ /khams rnams yongs su zad pa na/ /ci yi phyir na zhi mi 'gyur/ /mdza' bshes nye du dur khrod du/ /154

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/du ba 'thul nas ldog par byed/ /gang zhig rang dang lhan cig 'grogs/ /las te des na dge ba spyad/ /gang zhig rab tu nyon mongs dang / /chos dang 'gal bar byed pa dang / /dgra la 'dud pa'i nor rnams ni/ /gang gi nor du rung ma yin/ /dam pa legs spyod la sred shin tu bsdams gyur te/ /kun tu'ang skye bos smod 'jigs rtag tu sdug bsngal gnas/ /gang zhig 'dzem med longs spyod dag gi rtsa rtsol ba/ /rigs dang mi rigs dpyod med tha mal skye bo skyed/ /rigs dang mi rigs dpyod pa'i blo med cing / /thos dang sdom pa mang po rnam spangs nas/ /lto ba 'gengs pa tsam zhig 'ba' zhig 'dod/ /skyes bu phyug dang phyugs la khyad ci yod/ /155

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mthong dang ma mthong yon tan gyi/ /'byung gnas chen po rigs pa yin/ /des na de bas don gnyer bas/ /shes rab yongs su gzung bar bya /brgya yi nang nas dpa' bo skye/ /stong gi nang nas mkhas pa 'byung / /brgya stong las ni mdzangs pa ste/ /stong pa skye'am mi skye'ang srid/ /mkhas pas rig pa rnam kun tu/ /na tshod yol yang bslab par bya/ /gal te 'dir 'bras mi ster yang / /skye ba gzhan/ du rnyed pa sla/ /skra dkar gnyer ma lhags dus su'ang / /thos pa bsag par bya ba ste/ /gang du thos mang 'gro 'gyur ba/ /der ni phung po 'gro mi 'gyur/ /156

da wa lugasakyibastan bcos shes rab sdong bu/rgyal po dang ni yon tan ldan/ /de gnyis 'dra ba ma yin te/ /rgyal po rang gi yul na bkur/ /yon tan ldan pa kun tu bkur/ /yon tan ldan pa skyon yod kyang / /yon tan dga' rnams skyo mi byed/ /zla ba rnyog pa yod gyur kyang / /brtan rnams dga' bas lta bar byed/ /yon tan dang 'dra lus kyi rgyan gzhan med/ /sems las dang 'dra lus kyi sdug bsngal med/ /bzod pa dang 'dra lus kyi srung ma med/ /gtong ba dang mnyam gnyen ni gang na med/ /dam pa ring na gnas gyur kyang / /yon tan pho nya nyid byed de/ /ke ta ka yi dri bsnams nas/ /bung ba rang nyid 'ong bar 'gyur/ /157

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/yon tan dag la 'bad bya yi/ /'gying tshul dgos pa ci zhig yod/ /ba ni 'o ma med pa la/ /dril bu btags kyang nyo mi 'gyur/ /dus ni yun thung rig pa'i rnam pa mang / /tshe yi tshad kyang ji tsam mi shes pas/ /ngang pas chu nang nas ni 'o ma bzhin/ /gang zhig gces pa de ni bsten par bya/ /skar ma chen po mang du shar gyur cing / /sa yi rgyan gyur zla ba shar na yang / /gang du nyi ma nub na mtshan mor 'gyur/ /nyi ma ma gtogs shar nub ming mi 'dogs/ /gang zhig shar bar gyur na ni/ /mun pa med cing gzi can byed/ /nyi ma shar ba mchog yin gyi/ /gzhan rnams shar bas ci zhig bya/ /158

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/skyes bu bya ba gang yin gcig byas mthar phyin pas/ /sems 'phags 'gyur te mang po ci la dgos/ /zla ba rgyas pas sa steng gsal ba bzhin/ /skar ma mang po'i tshogs kyis nus ma yin/ /yon tan skyes pa rang khar las/ / rdzas ni bsod nams khar las pas/ /skyes bu la ni ci phyir smre/ /yon tan 'bad pas bsgrub bya yin/ /'bad pa'ang bdag nyid la gnas na/ /gzhan dag yon tan ldan zhes te/ /de ltar gson pa su yis bzod/ /bstan bcos don ni shes pa'i mi /'di na zha bo rnams la'ang mang /ral gri'i rtse mo rnon po yis/ /dgra las rgyal byed de rnyed dka'/ /phyug po kla klo rnams la'ang yod/ /159

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dpa' bo dud 'gro rnams la'ang mang / /sna tshogs don gyi gtam smra ba'i/ /dam pa dag ni kun tu dkon/ /ri bo kun la tsandan med/ /glang po kun la mu tig med/ /yang dag don gyi gtam smra ba'i/ /mkhas pa'ang kun na yod ma yin/ /yon tan shes la de nyid yon tan 'gyur/ /yon tan med na de nyid skyon du 'gyur/ /chu bo'i chu ni shin tu skyon med pa'ang / /rgya mtshor phyin na btung du mi rung 'gyur/ /yon tan ldan pa yon tan la dga' yi/ /yon tan med pa yon tan gyis mi mgu/ /bung ba nags nas padmar 'ong 'gyur gyi/ /sbal ba lhan cig gnas kyang de lta min/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi grags pa ni/ /160

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/mkhas pa nyid kyi nang du 'phel/ /rin chen shel la rin chen dang / /g.yul ngo dag tu dpa' bo bzhin/ /ngang pa khu yi tshogs nang mdzes ma yin/ /cang shes bong bu'i tshogs nang mdzes ma yin/ /seng ge wa yi tshogs nang mdzes ma yin/ /mkhas pa blun po'i tshogs nang mdzes ma yin/ /gang zhig chen pos spyi bos bkur/ /de nyid dman pas rtswa snyam sems/ /mkhas pas phyag byas mchod rten ni/ /khwa dag stan du byed pa yin/ /bdag la grangs med yod gyur kyang / /gzhan la nyung zad yod pa yi/ / yon tan med la dam pa dga'/ /spyod pa 'di ni ngo mtshar che/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i yon tan ni/ /161

da legasabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis mkhyen/ /sa gzhi yi ni lci ba'i tshad/ /mtha' yas nyid kyis shes pa yin/ /gzhan gyis gzhan dag bsgrags na ni/ /med pa'ang yon tan can du 'gyur/ /yon tan rang nyid sgrogs pa ni/ /brgya byin yin yang mi btsun 'gyur/ /gang du yon tan ldan mi mchod/ /mkhas pa de ru ci phyir 'gro/ /gos med gcer bu'i grong khyer du/ /khrus mkhan gyis ni ci zhig bya/ /kye ma 'jig rten glen pa 'di/ /rang rgyud grub pa yod min te/ /gzhan gyis byas pa'i rjes 'brang bas/ /zangs ma'i snod ni stor nas med/ /bzhad gad mkhan dang mkhas pa gnyis/ /162

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/blun la bzhad gad byed pa mchog /bzhad gad mkhan gyis nor rnyed kyis/ /mkhas la nor med stong par 'gro/ /sna tshogs don ldan gtam rgyud kyis/ /mkhas pa dus ni 'da' bar byed/ /dbul po chos kyis phongs gyur pas/ /gnyid log na yang 'thab par byed/ /gang zhig mang po tshogs par gyur pa las/ /skye bo dam pa'i yon tan sten mi byed/ /de ni rang gi ma yi sdug bsngal gyis/ /bskyed de skyes par gyur kyang ci zhig phan/ /mkhas pa'i tshul ni rigs pa yin/ /khu byug tshul ni sgra snyan yin/ /dka' thub tshul ni bzod pa yin/ /bud med tshul ni nyon mongs yin/ /skar rtsis de bzhin grub mtha' dang / /163

legs bshad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ da wa mkha' lding sngags dang sngags smra ba/ /don gyi de nyid gzung bya yi/ /sgra la dpyad par mi bya'o/ /glegs bam la bzhag rig pa dang / /gzhan la tshol ba'i nor dag ni/ /dgos pa'i dus la bab pa na/ /de ni nor min rig pa min/ /bzo slob pa yi yon tan kun/ /yon tan 'tsho ba'i rgyu tsam yin/ /'khor ba gcod pa'i blo gros gang / /ci yi phyir na de mi byin/ /mi ni su la'ang ma brtags par/ /gdams ngag sbyin par mi bya ste/ /spre'u tsam gyi gnas bcas dang / /gnas med par ni byas la ltos/ /kha cig smra ba lhur len te/ /164

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/kha cig mi smra don yang bsgrub/ /'dam bu me tog 'bras bu med/ /star ka 'bras bu me tog ldan/ /ke ta ka yi 'bras bu ni/ /chu rnams dang bar byed mod kyi/ /de yi ming tsam smos pa yis /chu rdul dang bar mi byed do/ /gzhung lugs dag la byang byas kyang / /nyams su len par mi byed na/ /lag na sgron ma yod kyang ni/ /long bas lam ni mthong mi 'gyur/ /zla ba yar ngo mar ngo ltar/ /dam pa dam min bsten pa las/ /yon tan chung ngu'ang rgyas 'gyur zhing / /rgya chen po yang 'grib par 'gyur/ /mkhas pas dgra bor gyur pa'ang bla'i/ /165

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mi mkhas pa dang mdza' ba min/ /rkun pos bram ze bsrungs pa dang / /spre'us rgyal po'i mig bcar bzhin/ /mkhas pa dang ni dul ba dang / /chog shes bden par smra ba dang / /'chi ba na yang 'dug bla yi/ /skye bo ngan dang rgyal srid min/ /sbrul gdug skye bo ngan pa dug /sbrul las lhag par skye ngan dug /sbrul gdug sman dang sngags kyis thub/ /skye ngan gdug pa gang gis zhi/ /skye bo ngan pa yon tan brgya yis phan btags te/ /dga' bar gyur kyang de ni tshig rtsub smra bar byed/ /gang zhig rigs ldan de bzhin brtan pa dang / /bsngags 'os phongs kyang yon tan gtong mi byed/ /rang bzhin ngan pa'i mi dag dang / /166

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/srang gi mtshan nyid dag dang mtshungs/ /cung zad tsam gyis mtho 'gyur zhing / /cung zad tsam gyis dma' bar 'gyur/ /tsan dan gla rtsi ga bur gyis byugs kyang / /sgog skya'i rang bzhin dri nga mi 'dor ltar/ /rigs pa'i gzhung lugs mang po rab bslabs kyang / /rang bzhin ngan pa'i mtshan nyid 'dor mi srid/ /dam pa'i bu la gdong na padma med/ /smad 'tshong bu la klad nas rwa ma skyes/ /ji lta ji ltar log par byed gyur pa/ /de lta de ltar nal bu'i mtshan nyid yin/ /kha nas smras pa'i tshig gzhan la/ /yid la sems pa'i bsam pa gzhan/ /kye ma yon po'i blo gros can/ /'di yi rang bzhin su yis sprul/ /'bad pas skyon ni len par byed/ /167

legs bshad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ dnghad wad —yon tan rtag tu spong bar byed/ /skyon len yon tan spong ba yi/ /skye bo ngan pa chu tshags 'dra/ /skye bo ngan pa sun phyung na/ /dam pa la yang yid mi rton/ /byis pa 'o mas kha tshig na/ /zho la'ang phu yis 'debs shing 'thung / /mtshan mo mtsho nang skar ma'i gzugs brnyan snang ba la//ngang pa padma'i rtsa bar 'khrul pas sun phyung ba/ /nyin mo pad rtsa mngon sum mthong yang za mi byed/ /brdzun smras sun phyung bden pa la yang dogs pa skye/ /bud med zas ni nyis 'gyur te/ /de yi g.yo sgyu bzhi 'gyur ro/ /ngo tsha dag ni drug 'gyur ro/ /'dod chags brgyad 'gyur zhes brjod do/ /sbyin pas ma yin rim gros min/ /168

lugs kyi bstan bcom shes rab sdong bu/—mchod pas ma yin bsnyen bkur min/ /brtan pas ma yin brtson pas min/ /kun tu mi bzad bud med yin/ /mkha' lding dbang pos khyer ba'i tshe/ /pad dkar klu yis smras pa ni/ /gsang tshig bud med la smra ba/ /de yi srog ni de zad 'gyur/ /don dang chos ni rnam par nyams byed cing / /mtho ris dag dang thar pa'i gegs byed la/ /gnod pa kun gyi rtsa ba nyid gyur pas/ /de bas gzhan gyi bud med rtag tu spang / /gang gis tshigs bcad gcig tsam zhig /bla mas slob ma la byin na/ /gang zhig btang nas shog btang 'gyur/ /rdzas de sa steng yod ma yin/ /'du 'dzi kun tu spang bar gyis/ /169

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gal te de spong ma nus na/ /dam pa dag dang 'dre bar gyis/ /de nyid de yi sman yin no/ /'dod pa kun tu spang bar gyis/ /gal te spong bar ma nus na/ /thar pa dag la 'dod par gyis/ /de nyid de yi sman yin no/ /phan med gnyen yang gzhan yin te/ /pha rol yin yang gang phan gnyen/ /lhan cig 'byung ba'i lus sogs nad/ /phan byed dgon pa'i sman bzhin no/ /'bad pa yis ni bzung ba yi/ /bum pa yi ni chu phyed bzhin/ /spyi bo la ni bkur byas na/ /skye bo ngan pa khro bar byed/ /gang zhig yid dang rjes mthun pa/ /170

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/ring na gnas kyang nye ba yin/ /gang zhig yid la brtan mi gnas/ /drung na gnas kyang ring ba yin/ /dam pa min dang lhan cig gnas gyur kyang / /chu dang pad mo bzhin du 'dre mi 'gyur/ /dam pa thag ring dag tu gnas gyur kyang / /zla ba ku mu da ltar dga' bar byed/ /gal te rtag tu mdza' 'dod na/ /gsum po 'di dag mi bya ste/ /rgyan po 'gyed dang nor 'brel dang / /lkog tu chung ma dang smra ba'o/ /ji ltar rwa las 'o ma 'byung / /'dam bu me tog sbrang rtsi 'dzag /gal te bud med bden gyur na/ /skam sa las kyang padma skye/ /bsod nams yongs su dman pa'i mis/ /171

legs bshad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ da wa longs spyod thob kyang spyod mi shes/ /gangs chen mtsho la khyi bzhin du/ /skom na'ang lce yis ldag par byed/ /'jig rten 'di na las byed pa/ /gla med lam brgyags khyer mi btub/ /slong ba dman pa mi mngon par/ /phyi ma'i dus na brgya 'gyur khyer/ /rang nor spangs nas 'gro 'gyur bas/ /skyes bu sbyin pa gtong bar byed/ /shi na'ang nor ni mi 'dor bas/ /sbyin byed ser sna can 'drar shes/ /sbyin na dbul gyur dogs pa yis/ /bkren pa sbyin pa gtong mi byed/ /nges par 'jig pa de nyid kyis/ /mkhas pas nor ni gtong bar byed/ /zas las zan gyi phyed tsam yang /172
