da wa 'u/gsaskyu/ bstan ba3dros shes za(ba sdong bu/slong ba rnams la cis mi ster/ /'dod dang rjes mthun 'byor pa yang / /gang gi tshe na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /las kyis 'byor pa med kyang gdung ba mi skyed kyi/ /'on kyang ci 'byor pa la sbyin pa gtang bya ste/ /lo ma me tog 'bras bu chu dang sman rnams ni/ /thams cad mtha' yas bsngo ba'i stobs kyis mtha' yas 'gyur/ /sbyin dang spyod pas stong pa yi/ /nor des nor bdag yin na go /nor de nyid kyis bdag kyang ni/ /nor gyi bdag po cis ma yin/ /yab gcig 'di ni las kyi sa/ /'di nas pha rol 'bras bu'i sa/ /'di ni gang zhig byas gyur pa/ /de nyid gzhan du nges par spyod/ /173

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gzhan 'byor rigs dang gzugs dang nad med nyid/ /mthong nas 'dir ni ci phyir gdung bar byed/ /gal te 'di kun khyod 'dod bsod nams kyi/ /sa bon las ni 'bras 'byung ma thos sam/ /'byor pa yod kyang gtong med na/ /nye bar 'tsho bas ci byar yod/ /kim pa ka yi 'bras bu ni/ /chag kyang ltogs la ci byar yod/ /gang zhig gzhan la gnod pa med par sbyin gtong ba/ /'di yi longs spyod sna tshogs chu yis mi 'khyer zhing / /me yis mi tshugs rkun po rnams kyis 'phrog mi nus/ /de yi 'byor pa nam yang rab nyams mi 'gyur ro/ /gang zhig dmyal ba'i nad la ni/ /gso ba dag ni mi byed pa/ /sman med gnas su song nas ni/ /nad dang bcas pas ci byar yod/ /174

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/mi srun skye bo sa khung las byung ba'i/ /tshig ni sbrul gyis skye bo dam pa zin/ /dug de zhi bar byed pa'i gnyen por yang / /shes rab bzod pa'i sman dag btung bar bya/ /ji srid 'tsho bar bsad kyang ni/ /dgra bo zad par mi 'gyur gyi/ /de ni dgra bo nyid gsod yin/ /mthu chen bcos su mi rung la/ /bzod pa byar yang ci zhig yod/ /dul ba zhi ba'i spyod pa la/ /bzod par bya yang ci zhig dgos/ /gnod byed 'os pas khro zhe na/ /chos don 'dod dang thar pa dag /mngon sum du ni 'jig byed pa'i/ /khro la khyod ni cis mi khro/ /gzhan gyi 'byor pa dam pa mthong nas ni/ /175

/legasabashad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ da wa da wagang zhig sems 'khrug pa ni skye 'gyur bas/ /don de cung zad rnyed par mi 'gyur gyi/ /'gro de rang gi bsod nams 'joms par byed/ /thams cad chos ni mnyan par bya/ /thos nas rab tu gzung bya ste/ /gang zhig bdag nyid mi 'dod pa/ /de dag gzhan la mi bya'o/ /'jig rten pha rol 'gro ba dag /shes par smra la su zhig mkhas/ /de ni nyams su len pa na/ /drang srong rnams kyang mkhas pa yin/ /'byor pa g.yo zhing lang tsho yud kyis 'jig /srog ni gshin rje'i so gcig gnas dang mtshungs/ /'on kyang 'jig rten pha rol sgrub la lhod/ /kye ma mi yi spyod pa ngo mtshar che/ /blo gros bzang yang le lo yis /176

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/skye ba mthon por mi 'gyur te/ /lag rtsis sa la 'dri ba yi/ /pho long gsher ba dag dang mtshungs/ /gal te 'gro ba 'di kun gyis/ /'chi bdag spyi bor gnas mthong na/ /zas kyang yi gar mi 'ong na/ /bya ba gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /'dus byas zin tam ma zin ces/ /'chi bdag sdod par mi 'gyur bas/ /sang gi bya ba de ring bya/ /phyi dro'i bya ba snga dro bya/ /ji srid nad med lo tog skyes gyur pa/ /nad kyi ser ba chen pos ma brlags shing / /ji srid blo ni bya ba'i rjes 'jug pa/ /'di ni dam chos mnyan pa'i dus yin no/ /bong bu phyugs la me tog phreng ba ci/ /177

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dud 'gro phag la kha zas zhim po ci/ /long la snang dang 'on pa dag la glu/ /glen pa rnams la chos kyis ci zhig bya/ /ji srid 'dod chen ma gyur par/ /de srid yon tan che nyid yin/ /'dod chen nyid la zhugs gyur na/ /yon tan btsun par ga la 'gyur/ /jisrid su la'ang mi slong ba/ /de srid dka' thub gzi brjid can/ /dpa' zhing shes ldan rigs mtho dag /skyes bu zhes kyang de srid brjod/ /dang po'i rtsom pa gang yin pa/ /'di ltar ngo mtshar che ba yin/ /zo chun bzo sbyar gyur pa ni/ /bud med kyi yang dbang du 'gyur/ /drang srong bu ni myur du shi yang rung / /178

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/rgyal po'i bu ni yun ring gson yang rung / /rngon pa'i bu ni shi'am gson mi rung / /dam pa'i bu ni shi'am gson yang rung / /de nas 'byung ba la gnas pa'i/ /mi yi blo ni 'phel bya'i phyir/ /gang gis bstan bcos shes gyur pa'i/ /legs par bshad pa bshad par bya/ /legs par bshad pa'i rang bzhin tshig /gang yang rung ba bsag par bya/ /tshig gi gnas skabs mchod sbyin la/ /nor med ci zhig ster bar byed/ /rig pa bslab dang dpa' bo dang / /gang yang gzugs bzang ldan bud med/ /gang dang gang du 'gro gyur pa/ /de dang der ni dpal chen thob/ /rig par ldan dang rgyal po yi/ /179

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gang du'ang mnyam pa ma yin te/ /rgyal po rang gi yul na bkur/ /rig ldan kun tu bkur bar 'gyur/ /gzugs dang lang tsho phun tshogs shing / /rigs mtho rnams las skyes gyur kyang / /rgya skyegs shing gi me tog ltar/ /rig dang bral na mdzes ma yin/ /lus can rig dang bral gyur pa/ /rigs ldan yin yang ci zhig dgos/ /'jig rten du ni rig pas mchog /rig pa med pas rlag par byed/ /bde ba 'dod na rig pa dor/ /rig pa 'dod na bde ba dor/ /bde ldan rig pa ga la 'grub/ /rig pa don gnyer ga la bde/ /rig dang mdza' bshes med gyur pa'i/ /180

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/mi ni rtag tu sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /rig dang mdza' bshes ldan gyur pa'i/ /mis ni rtag tu dga' ba 'thob/ /rig dang ldan pa gzhan yul gang / /snyan par smra la pha rol su/ /gnas dang ldan pa khur lci gang / /brtson dang ldan la thag ring ci/ /rtsol ba yi ni grogs yod la/ /ri rgyal rtse mo'ang mtho ba min/ /sa yi 'og kyang dma' ba min/ /rgya mtshos chod pa'ang pha rol min/ /rig pa glegs bam la bslabs kyi/ /bla ma'i thad rnams ma bslabs pa/ /'phyon ma'i bud med sbrum ma bzhin/ /tshogs pa'i nang du mi mdzes so /bla ma gang zhig yi ge gcig /181

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ster ba la ni brnyas byed pa/ /khyi yi skye gnas brgyar brgyud nas/ /rigs ngan du yang skye bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig la ni yi ge gcig /bla mas slob ma la byin na/ /gang zhig btang nas shog gtong ba'i/ /nor ni sa steng yod ma yin/ /skyed par byed dang legs slob dang / /gang zhig rig pa ster ba dang / /zas ster ba dang mi 'jigs sbyin/ /lnga bo 'di dag pha ru bshad/ /rgyal po blon po'i chung ma dang / /de bzhin mdza' bo'i chung ma dang / /spun zla'i chung ma ma nyid de/ /lnga bo 'di dag ma ru bshad/ /blun po rnams la gdams pa ni/ /182

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/'khrug par 'gyur gyi zhi mi 'gyur/ /sbrul la 'o ma blud pa ni/ /dug 'phel 'gyur ba kho nar zad/ /mngon sum pa yi rkang gnyis phyugs/ /blun po yongs su spang bar bya/ /ma mthong tsher ma ji lta bar/ /tshig gi zug rngus gnod par byed/ /blun pos blun po mthong gyur na/ /tsan dan bas kyang bsil bar byed/ /gal te mkhas pa mthong gyur na/ /pha gsod pa ni lta bur sems/ /skye bo ngan la phan pa dag /byas kyang gang la'ang byas mi gzo/ /dam pa cung zad bkur na yang / /ji srid 'tsho bar rang dbang 'gyur/ /blun po chu yi ri mo ltar/ /183

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gang zhig byas pa de myur 'jig /dam pa rdo yi ri mo ltar/ /shin tu chung ngu'ang brtan par gnas/ /skye bo ngan pa snyan smra yang / /'di la yid brtan rung ma yin/ /rma bya sgra snyan sgrogs na yang / /zas su dug chen za ba yin/ /e ma skye bo ngan pa dang / /bad kan dag gi rang bzhin mtshungs/ /'jam po yis ni 'khrug 'gyur la/ /rtsub po yis ni zhi bar 'gyur/ /skye bo ngan dang gser dang rnga/ /mi srun rta dang bud med dregs/ /brdungs nas dul ba nyid 'gyur gyi/ /de dag legs byas snod ma yin/ /skye bo ngan dang lhan cig tu/ /184

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/dgrar gyur mdza' ba'ang mdzes ma yin/ /khyim ni rtse bar byed pa'am/ /lhag pa'ang mdzes par 'gyur ma yin/ /sbrul bas kyang ni mi srun gdug /sbrul gdug sman dang sngags kyis zhi/ /mi srun cis kyang zhi mi byed/ /mi srun pa yi nyes pa ni/ /ngo bo nyid kyis rjes 'jug la/ /gang zhig mi srun dang 'dres de/ /mi srun las kyang mi srun 'gyur/ /pha yi spyod pa ma mthong yang / /bu ni rjes su 'jug byed de/ /ke ta ka yi shing las ni/ /skyu ru ra 'bras 'byung mi 'gyur/ /pha dang ma dang de bzhin spun/ /chung ma rjes mthun 'jug pa rnams/ / 185

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/de yis sdig pa byas pa gang / / de ni mi des byas dang mtshungs/ /sa 'di rgya mtsho chen po dang / /ri bor bcas pa khur min gyi/ /gang zhig byas pa mi gzo ba/ /de ni shin tu khur lco yin/ /tshul khrims ldan dang lhan cig gnas/ /'byung po kun la phan par dga'/ /gshin rje 'jigs byed gang yin pa/ /de ni mkhas pas rab tu bsngags/ /mkhas pa dang ni dul ba dang / /chog shes bden smra lhan cig tu/ /btson ra ra gnas pa'ang gnas bla yi/ /mi srun nang gi rgyal srid min/ /dam pa dag dang lhan cig 'dris/ /mkhas dang lhan cig smra ba dang / /186

lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu/brkam med lhan cig mdza' ba nyid/ /byed pa skyong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /shin tu yun ring dus su yang / /gang gis 'jig rten 'di dang ni/ /gzhan du sdug bsngal mi 'thob pa'i /blo ni chos mthun nyid du bya/ /sems ni dga' bar byed na yang / /rnam smin gnod byed ci ru rung / /gang gis khams ni 'khrug byed pa'i/ /kha zas zhim po'ang ci ru rung / /gnod kyang phan par 'gyur ba ni/ /mkhas pas sman bzhin btung bya ste/ /'di yi 'bras bu rjes thob pa/ /mtshungs pa med pa nyid du 'gyur/ /don 'dir rigs dang ldan pa yi/ /rgyal pos bsdu ba byas na ni/ /187

da legasabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ thog ma dbus dang tha ma ru/ /de ni gzhan du mi 'gyur ro/ /rgya mtsho 'jig pa'i dus su ni/ /gzhung las rgal bar 'gyur zhes grags/ /dam pa 'chi na'ang gzhung lugs las/ /nam yang 'da' bar mi byed do/ /lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu zhes bya ba/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa las le'u gnyis pa logs shig tu bsgyur pa/ rdzogs so/ /lo tsā pa shī len dra bo rnyi dang / ba nde ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/ /188

lugs kyi bstan bcos skyebo gso thigs/༄༅/ /lugs kyi bstan bcos skye bo gso ba'i thigs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /slob dpon klu sgrub/rgya gar skad du/ bya sha su dzantu bind+ra po sha nā ma/ bod skad du/lugs kyi bstan bcos skye bo gso ba'i thigs pa zhes bya ba/'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal gyi 'byung gnas 'jam dpal kun gyi dpal/ /mtha' dag byams pas khyab pas 'jam pa'i ngang / /'jam dang dpal du grags pas thugs rje'i mgon/ /'jam dpal kun gyi mgon la phyag 'tshal te/ /blo dman skye bo mun nag lta bu la/ /snyan ngag sgron me rab tu gsal bya'i phyir/ /bdag lta dman pas snyan ngag sgron med kyang / /blun po gso phyir chu thigs tsam zhig brjod/ /189

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gzhan gyi skyon rnams brjod mi bya/ /gzhan gyi skyon rnams ci brjod pa/ /de bzhin bdag la'ang yod pa ste/ /dper na wa dang bud med bzhin/ /bdag nyid la ni bstod mi bya/ /bdag nyid la ni gang bstod pa/ /de ni blo chung shes rab zhan/ /dper na ka lan da ka 'dra/ /grogs ngan bsten par mi bya ste/ /grogs po ngan pa sus bsten pa/ /ma gu ta ni bsten pa yis/ /shig rnams phung bar gyur la ltos/ /ngan pa rnams la gros mi gdab/ /ngan pa rnams la gros btab na/ /legs par smras kyang nyes par 'gro/ /spre'us ka lan da ka yi/ /190

lugs kyi bstan bcos skyebo gso thigs/tshang bshig pa yi tshul la ltos/ /spyod pa rnams la bag yod bya/ /bag med rgyun du spang bar bya/ /glang chen myos pa lta bu ni/ / nam yang bya ba ma yin no/ /tshig rnams brjod 'dod rtag tu ni/ /ji ltar brtags shing de ltar smra/ /gang zhig ma brtags par smra ba/ /dper na smyon pa'i bsnyon tshig bzhin/ /dgos pa med pa'i brdzun tshig ni/ /nam yang brjod par mi bya'o/ /bdag mi phan par gzhan gnod pa/ /dper na ne tso'i brdzun tshig bzhin/ /brdzun gyi tshig rnams brjod mi bya/ /brdzun gyi tshig rnams brjod byas na/ /myur bar gzhan gyis shes 'gyur te/ /191

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dper na byi la'i brdzun tshig bzhin/ /tshul 'chos spyod par bya ba yis/ /tshul 'chos spyod pa gang byed pa/ /de ni btsun par mi 'gyur te/ /bram ze na ya'i rgyal mo bzhin/ /mdza' bshes ngan pa'i tshig mi mnyan/ /mdza' bshes ngan pa'i tshig nyan pa/ /'dod don med par bslu bar 'gyur/ /dper na rus sbal spre'u bzhin/ /g.yon can ngag 'jam tshig mi mnyan/ /de yi tshig rnams nyan byed pa/ /dper na dbang po'i rgyal mtshan gyis/ /lha min la sogs bslus la ltos/ /gnod sems can gyi tshig mi mnyan/ /de yi tshig rnams nyan byed pa/ /bdag la phan pa mi 'byung ste/ /192

lugs kyi bstan bcos skye bo gso thigs/wa ni sreg pas phung ba bzhin/ /sdig pa'i grogs po yid mthun zhing / /dga' bas sna tshogs tshig brjod kyang / /sdig can de ni bdud yin te/ /dper na gling gi srin mo bzhin/ /phyug po kla klo la yang yod/ /dpa' bo dud 'gro la yang yod/ /don dang mthun pa'i gtam smra ba/ /'jig rten 'di na shin tu dkon/ /de phyir yon tan dag la ni/ /srog dang bsdos te 'bad par bya/ /gang zhig yon tan mi slob pa/ /de ni blun po phyugs lta bu/ /yon tan med pa'i kha nyid ni/ /sa yi bu ga dag dang mtshungs/ /yon tan rab kyis brgyan pa yi/ /193

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/kha ni pad mo yid 'ong ldan/ /gzhon pa'i dus su rig pa bslab/ /zho 'dod pa ni dgun nas gso/ /drod gsher ldan dus sa bon gdab/ / 'di gsum 'phral du smin pa'i rgyu/ / yon tan dag la 'bad bya yi/ /'gying tshul dgos pa ci zhig yod/ /'o ma med par gyur pa'i ba/ /dril bu btags kyang nyor mi 'dod/ /bdag la phun sum tshogs bcas kyang / /gzhan la brnyas par mi bya ste/ /zhun mar lta bu'i sems kyis su/ /yon tan mtha' dag khong du sba/ /shes rab ldan pa lus chung yang / /dor thabs can gyis brnyas mi bya/ /dper na blo gsal ri bong gis/ /194

lugs kyi bstan bcos skye bo gso thigs/seng ge srog dang phral ba bzhin/ /kun la mtho dman med pa yis/ /nyi ma lta bu'i phan byas na/ /kun gyi lan rnams ldon 'gyur te/ /byi bas glang chen bslang ba bzhin/ /sems can kun la phan sems bskyed/ /res 'ga' rtswa bzhin zhum par bya/ /res 'ga' me bzhin 'bar bar gyis/ /res 'ga' gangs ri lta bur bya/ /res 'ga' dmag la bab pa bzhin/ /gzhan gyi yul na gnas pa dang / /gzhan gyi 'tsho bas 'tsho ba'i tshe/ /ji lta bur ni brnyas gyur kyang / /kha rog 'dug pas bde ba 'thob /skye bo ngan pa yun ring bsten byas shing / /bza' btung zhim pa mang po bsten byas kyang / /195

legs bshad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigasad/ ge spre—des ni nges par grogs po spong 'gyur te/ /dper na khron par lhung ba'i mi bzhin no/ /mi gang blo ni rnam par 'gyur byed pa/ /de yi mdza' bshes rtag par mi 'gyur te/ /rab tu nyon mongs mi de ci 'dra na/ /shing shun tshon gyis ras dkar btsos pa bzhin/ /gal te blo ldan mkhas pa dgra bo dag /rab tu mi dga' bar ni byed 'dod na/ /tshig rtsub mi smra rab tu ngag 'jam gyis/ /des ni de la gnod pa chen por 'gyur/ /rgya mtsho dang ni ri rab gling la sogs/ /'jig rten sa rnams bdag gi khur min gyi/ /'jig rten byas pa mi gzo gang yin pa/ /de ni bdag gi khur chen dag tu 'byung / /mi gang sems ni mi rgod cing / /byas pa gzo dang byas pa tshor/ /196

lugs kyi bstan bcos skye bo gso thigs/byas pa chud gson mi byed pa/ /de ni mkhas pas rab tu bsngags/ /chos bde byams pa bde ba ste/ /'jug ngogs bde ba'i chu klung bzhin/ /grogs la 'khu ba med pa dang / /nga snyems nga rgyal zad pa bde/ /khengs dang zol byed nga rgyal che/ /sdig pa'i grogs po bsten pa dang / /stobs ldan rnams la rgol byed pa/ /de dag yid ni bde mi 'gyur/ /de phyir khengs par mi bya ste/ /khro ba rnam par spang bar bya/ /khengs dang khro ba 'ongs gyur na/ /de dag rnams kyi grags pa 'jig /gang zhig rgan po byis pa nad pa dang / /nyam chung thabs stor de bzhin dman pa dang / /197

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rgyal pos spangs dang skyabs med pa dag la/ /snying rje med pa de dag mir mi rung / /rang gi yul 'khor gnas spangs te/ /gzhan gyi ljongs su phyin pa na/ /tshig ngan so sor ldog pa la/ /bzod pa chen po bskyed par bya/ /dka' thub tshul ni bzod pa yin/ /gtso bo'i tshul ni dka' spyod yin/ /shar ba'i tshul ni dka' zlog yin/ /bud med tshul ni dka' thub yin/ /de ltar ma yin rang bzhin ngan pa'i mi/ /byams la lan med gzhan bgyis phan byas brjed/ /sdang bas gnod pa ji snyed byas gyur kyang / /brnyas thabs byas pa de yang chu bzhin 'thung / /tshe dang longs spyod gnyen bshes kun dar dkon/ /de dag rgud pa shin tu rnyed par sla/ /198

lugs kyi bstan bcos skye bo gso thigs/de phyir sems ni dmas par gyur pa'i tshe/ /khu bzhin mi smra kha rog 'dug par bya/ /gal te nor med bdag gi phyogs nyung la/ /mdza' bshes phyogs kyi stobs kyang chung gyur cing / /dgra bo'i phyogs kyi stobs tshul ldan pa'i tshe/ /tshig ngan mi smra kha rog 'dug par bya/ /ya rabs tshul med khengs pas shin tu nga rgyal che/ /g.yo sgyu dad med khwa bzhin shin tu mu cor smra/ /gzu lums phrag dog brkam dang khrel med ngo tsha bral/ /mi de bur gyur kyang ni gzhan bzhin spang bar bya/ /de lta bu yi dman zhing ngan pa de/ /mthon po'i sar mi 'drong zhing der mi gzhag /sa der bzhag kyang dregs dang khengs mi thub/ /dper na pags pa sngon po'i wa bzhin no/ /skye bo rmongs pa 'ga' zhig ni/ /log pa'i chos la rab zhen pas/ /199

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'dod pa'i don des bslu 'gyur te/ /rus sbal so yis bya bslus bzhin/ /rab tu mi gzo'i skye bo rnams/ /sdug bsngal 'byung ba'i rgyu dag la/ /dang blangs don du gnyer byed pa/ /gcan gzan gal sgor bcug pa bzhin/ /dregs pa log pa 'ga' zhig ni/ /rang gi skyon rnams ma bsams par/ /yon tan phra mos rab mgu ba/ /khron pa'i sbal ba ji bzhin no/ /rmongs pa long ba 'ga' zhig ni/ /chos kyi de nyid ma rtogs par/ /log pa'i chos kyis rab mgu ba/ /blun po nor bu len pa bzhin/ /shin tu blun po la la dag /'chi ba'i rnam pa rab brjed nas/ /200

lugs kyi bstan bcos skye bo gso thigs/bya ba mang po rtsom byed de/ /bdud kyis bslus par rig par bya/ /'gro ba bzang po bzang mo la /gang zhig rab tu chags byed pa/ /srog chags me la mchong ba bzhin/ /'dod pas phung bar 'gyur ba yin/ /rta dang ma he glang po sogs/ /'ga' zhig de la chags byed pa/ /'dod pa can gyi skyes bu yis/ /rmi lam nor rnyed bslus pa bzhin/ /sdig pa'i las la rab dga' zhing / /dge ba dran par mi byed la/ /'jig rten dag la rab tu chags/ /dug dang 'dra ba'i skyes bu des/ /'dir yang sdug bsngal chen po can/ /phyi ma mnar med rab tu 'jigs/ /201

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bar do'i srid par las rnams dran/ /gsal ba'i me long rab 'jigs pas/ /las kyi dge sdig rnam par 'phye/ / rang 'dod gnas su gnas dbang med/ /mi 'dod pa ru rnam par 'khrid/ /las kyi rgyu 'bras mi slu ba/ /kho bos mthong gi rnam pa'am/ /gzhan yang rab tu grangs mang ltos/ /de phyir dam pa'i skye bo rnams/ /rgyun du 'chi ba dran par bya/ /rang gis ci byas las rnams bgrang / /yud tsam pa yi tshe 'di la/ /thang cig 'dug pa'i blo can de/ /de ni shin tu 'khrul pa ste/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi rdzu 'phrul bzhin/ /de phyir rtag pa'i sems mi bskyed/ /202

lugs kyi bstan bcos skye bo gso thigs/ngan song gsum po dran par bya/ /srog gcod la sogs lus kyi ni/ /nyes pa rnam par bsdam par bya/ /brdzun sogs ngag gi nyes pa dang / /ma lus pa ni bsdam par bya/ /de bzhin yid kyi nyes pa yang / /ma lus rab tu bsdam par bya/ /de ni skyes bu dam pa'i tshul/ /rab tu tsha zhing grang ba yi/ /dmyal ba nyi ma gcig bzhin dran/ / bkres skom dag gis rid pa yi/ /yi dwags dag kyang dran par bya/ /rmongs pa'i sdug bsngal rab mang ba'i/ /byol song blta zhing dran par bya/ /de rgyu rnam spang bde rgyu spyad/ /thob dka' 'dzam gling mi yi lus/ /203

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/de thob dus su ngan song rgyu/ /rab tu bsgrims te gcad par bya/ /'dir bdag mi yi lus thob nas/ /phyi mar smon lam 'debs byed pa/ /de ni blun po le lo can/ /ngan song gnas su rab 'gyod de/ /gro bzhin skyes kyis rdo 'jog gi /yi dwags mthong ba ji bzhin no/ /'di yi tshe ni ma nges pas/ /de ring sang ngam zla ba'am/ /lo yi rnam pas 'chi 'gyur te/ /de phyir dge la brtson par bya/ /dam pa'i chos la rab 'jug na/ /rigs dang bran mo lta bu dang / /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po yang /bran mo btsun par thub pas gsungs/ /204

lugs kyi bstan bcos skye bo gso thigs//dam pa'i chos la mi 'jug cing / /'jig rten khrel la mi srung ba/ /shin tu smad cing bshung 'gyur te/ /bi ra li ba'i dka' thub bzhin/ /ri brag 'dom gang sogs yod zabs/ /de la'ang rab tu srung byed na/ /shin tu gting med gyur pa yi/ /g.yang sar ltung ba cis mi srung / /yungs 'bru tsam gyi rma khung yang / /shin tu bsgrims te 'chos byed na/ /'tsho med tshal par gas pa yi/ /rma de ci phyir 'chos mi byed/ /nyin par 'ga' zung tsam du yang / /zas skom gyis dbul mi bzod na/ /bar gyi bskal pa la sogs su/ /zas skom mi brgyong ci phyir bzod/ /205

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rang lus dag la tsher ma yi/ /rtse mo'ang bzod par mi 'gyur na/ /gzhan gyi lus la mtshon dag gis/ /srog dang 'bral ba ci phyir bzod/ /rma 'bu dug srin shing srin dang / /sa bon myu gu sdong skyes me/ /de bzhin ngan pa'i mi rnams ni/ /rang rten kho na phung ba bsgrub/ /phyi ma shes pa mdzangs pa'i tshul/ /nyon mongs dgra thub dpa' bo'i tshul/ /chags pa med pa chos byed tshul/ /mkhas pa'i tshul ni rtogs pa yin/ /rtogs pa'i tshul ni byed pa yin/ /skyo ba med pa sbyin pa'i tshul/ /tshul khrims tshul ni ma dpyas pa/ /bzod pa'i tshul ni chos nyid shes/ /206

lugs kyi bstan bcos skye bo gso thigs/brtson 'grus tshul ni 'chi ba dran/ /bsam gtan tshul ni g.yeng med yin/ /rnam par 'byed shes shes rab tshul/ /sangs rgyas 'dod pa dad pa'i tshul/ /rtog pa chung ba rnal 'byor tshul/ /zang zing gnyen bral sgom mkhan tshul/ /phan sems che ba sgrin pa'i tshul/ /drang po'i tshul ni mi slu ba/ /bag yod nyam nga med pa ni/ /de ni rgyal po'i tshul du bshad/ /de lta'i tshul dang ma ldan la/ /dman zhing smad pa'i tshul byed pa/ /las kyi rgyu 'bras mi slu'i tshul/ /'og gi tshul ni 'di yin no/ /yon tan ldan la ser snas bcings/ /bslangs na khro ba dang bcas pa/ /207

—legasabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ —sdug bsngal chen pos non 'gyur te/ /shu ma ra yi mi sdug bzhin/ /mnyam sogs dag la phrag ma dog /'dir yang sdug bsngal che 'gyur la/ /phyi mar rnam smin che 'gyur te/ /dper na gzhon nu wa dang 'dra/ /dregs med shin tu dul bar bya/ /kun la gsong por smra bar bya/ /khro med nga rgyal spang bar bya/ /kun la 'dzum zhing drang por smra/ /don med ca co smra mi bya/ /'du ba mang po'i sar mi 'gro/ /chang sogs myos pa btung mi bya/ /ci 'dod sbyin pa gtang bar bya/ /bshes med mi la byams par bya/ /dge ba'i chos la brtson par bya/ /208

da lugasakyibastanabacosaskyesdogasothigs//da khrims sogs blangs la bsrung bar bya/ /de ltar byas nas mang po'i mi/ /ngang gis bde ba thob par byed/ /da ni shin tu ngan pa'i mis/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa nub tu nye/ /da ni ma bsngags ngan spyod dang / /log par lta ba ngan pa'i mi/ /rmongs pa dag gis bcom ldan gyi/ / bstan pa'i ljon shing bcad kyis med/ /da ni snying rje med pa yis/ /chos lugs bor zhing rang bzo byed/ /brkam chags pha rol mi mthong bas /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsnyal gyis med/ /da ni gdul dka' ngo tsha med/ /sdig la dga' zhing tshul 'chos byed/ /sdig can rnams kyis thub pa yi/ /209

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bstan pa'i zam pa bcag gis med/ /da ni mgo bregs nyams mi len/ /spyod 'chal smad pa lus la 'chos/ /ngan g.yo can gyis thub pa yis/ /bstan pa'i tshong 'dus bcom gyis med/ /da ni khro dang nga rgyal dang / /rgyags chos byed cing rnyed la zhen/ /sdig pa sna tshogs byed pa'i mis/ /chos kyi gru bo bcag gis med/ /da ni thub pa'i bstan pa yang / /cung zad tsam zhig lus par zad/ /thub pa'i bstan pa gangs chen mtsho/ / ring por mi thogs skam par 'gyur/ /seng ge'i sgra yi bstan pa ni/ /dus kyi 'khor los rab bcom nas/ /myur ba nyid du 'jig par 'gyur/ /210

lugs kyi bstan bcos skyebo gso thigs/gang dag 'di 'dra'i dus bab tshe/ /bde 'dod rnams kyis phan pa'i don/ /de ni legs par brtag pa'i rigs/ /dus kyi 'khor lo ngan byed pa/ /ma rabs shes rab 'chal pa dang / /tshul can dag dang sten mi shes/ /nyes pa bsten zhing tshul khrims spang / /dben pas 'jigs shing 'du 'dzi 'dod/ /mi mkhas bslab nyes slob dpon nor/ /gdug rtsub nga rgyal brnyas nga che/ /ngan pa'i mi la yid rton pas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa ma rungs byas/ /zhi zhing bde ba'i dus ni zad/ /gdug rtsub mi bzad dus ni byung / /shes rab can gyi mi rnams dang / /dbang gyur skye bo rnams ni zad/ /211

legs bshad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ da wa de lta'i dus rnams byung ba'i tshe/ /rang gi yul 'khor gnas spangs te/ /gzhan gyi ljongs su phyin nas su/ /der yang nags 'dabs dben pa ru/ /smra ba bsnyungs te gnas par bya/ /dkar po'i chos rnams yid la mi 'jog skye bo rnams la ni/ /mi chos phul du byung ba yid la 'jog pa nyid la ni/ /cung zhig dge bar 'gyur snyam nas ni 'di rnams bris pa yin/ /dge bas blun po ma lus grol zhing yun du gnas par shog / lugs kyi bstan bcos skye bo gso ba'i thigs pa zhes bya ba/ slob dngo na klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī lend+ra bo rnyi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā pa ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur pa'o/ /212

da wa ponalagadams bka' nan gyi skor/༄7/ /ma ṇi bka' 'bum glegs bam gnyis pa zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor bzhugs so/ /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po/oṃ ma ṇi padme tsū/ thugs rje chen po yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po des/ bod yul srin po gdong dmar 'dul ba'i don du/thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis bod yul gyi rgyal por sku sprul nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad de/ thugs rje chen po'i zhal gzigs shing chos bshad lung bstan te/ dus rtag tu rgyal po la thugs kyis dgongs so/ /sprul pa'i rgyal pos zhus pa/thugs rje chen po yi dam lha'i lha/ chos thams cad kyi don gar 'dus/ nyams su ji ltar blang / thag gar cad bka' stsal du 213

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gsol zhes zhus pas/ thugs rje chen pos bka' stsal pa/ nyon cig/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ chos thams cad kyi don ni brjod du med pa'i chos nyid don gyi gnas lugs ma bcos rang byung du lhun grub ye nas gnas pa de bzhin nyid la 'dus/ de yang sangs rgyas sgom ste ma mdzad/ sems can sgrin te ma bcos par snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad tshig gis brjod du med/ don la bsam du med/ ma bcos pa'i chos nyid rang byung du gnas pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i chos de nyams su ji ltar blang na/ chos nyid de bzhin nyid kyi rgyu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa de logs nas bsgrubs pa'am/ btsal ba'am bsams nas rnyed du yod pa lta bu ma yin pas/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la gnas pa yin no/ /de yang sems kyi ngo bo stong pa cir yang ma grub pa yin/ stong pa las rtsal ma 'gags pas sangs rgyas la sku dang ye shes su shar/ sems can la dug lnga dang rtog par shar ba yin no/ /de la sems kyi ngo bo stong par 'dug pa de chos kyi sku rang la gnas pa yin/ rtsal dug lnga dang rnam rtog ma 214

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/'gags par shar yang rtsa ba stong pa yin pas/ ma 'gags par rang shar/ mi gnas te rang grol bas ye shes su shar ro/ /sems nyid ngo bo stong pa chos skur nyams su blang / ma 'gags par gsal ba longs skur nyams su blang / sna tshogs su 'char ba rang shar rang grol ba sprul skur nyams su blang ngo / /de ltar nyams su blangs pas 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku gsum rang la 'char ba yin no/ /nyams su de ltar long zhig dgongs pa'i thag ni chos thams cad ma spangs kun grol/ rang gnas ka dgarang byung phyogs bral/ lta ba mtha' bral rten med la thag bcad do//sems nyid stong gsal rang byung ye shes/ ma bcos gsal dag rang gnas/ sgom pa stong gsal 'dzin med la thag bcad do/ /rig pa rang shar rang grol la dug lnga dang rnam rtog rang dwangs su song bas/ spyod pa rang shar rang grol la thag bcad do/ /sems nyid stong pa chos skur brtan/ gsal ba longs skur brtan/ rtsal ma 'gags pa sprul skur brtan pas/ 'bras bu sku gsum rang la gnas par thag bcad do/ /chos skyong ba'i rgyal po chen po lta ba'i 215

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mtha' ni rtogs pa brtan pa la thug go /sgom pa'i mtha' ni goms shing 'dris pa la thug go /spyod pa'i mtha' ni 'dzin med rang grol la thug go /'bras bu'i mtha' ni sku gsum rang sa zin pa la thug go /thugs rje chen po'i mtha' ni sems can gyi don stong pa nyid dang snying rje zung du 'brel ba la thug go /chos skyong ba'i rgyal po 'gro drug 'khor ba'i gnas nas 'don zhing byang chub lam la 'dren par byed pa bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung gi snying po yi ge drug pa 'di bgrongs shig oṃ ma ṇi padme rghaṃ zhes pa 'di bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa yin pas/'akro ba rigs drug gi skye sgo gcod cing sgrib pa sbyong ba yin te/ oṃ gyis lha ltung ba'i sdug bsngal sbyangs nas lha'i skye sgo gcod/ mas lha ma yin 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal sbyangs nas lha ma yin gyi skye sgo gcod/ ṇis mi 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal sbyangs nas mi'i skye sgo gcod/ pad kyis byol song bkol btsog gi sdug bsngal sbyangs nas byol song gi skye sgo gcod/ mes yi dwags bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal sbyangs nas yi dwags kyi skye sgo gcod/ hūm̐ gis dmyal ba tsha 216

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/grang gi sdug bsngal sbyangs nas dmyal ba'i skye sgo gcod pa yin no/ /'gro drug gi gnas sbyong ba'i snying po 'dis sems can gyi don gyis shig bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams gdul dka' ba 'di/ chos skyong ba'i rgyal po khyed kyis 'dul ba'i zhing yin pas sems can gyi don la blo stobs bskyed cig dus kyi mtha' la yang gsung gi yi ge drug pas 'dul bar 'gyur bas/ 'gro ba'i don la dgongs la thugs rje rgyun ma bcad cig ces bka' stsal to/ /rgyal po srong btsan sgam po la thugs rje chen po dngos kyis gdams pa'i thugs rgyud do/ /sgrir// //oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo /thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po yab gnam ri srong btsan gyis rgyal sar bton te/ mnga' ris dkor nor longs spyod thams cad gtad nas/ rin po che'i khri la bzhugs su gsol te/ phyag btsal bskor ba byas nas zhus pa/e ma ho/ thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' lags/ bdag bod srin po gdong dmar gyi rgyal khams la 217

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dbang byed pa'i rgyal por gyur pas/ sdig pa'i rnam smin mang po bsags/ nga lus rgas pas sems rig mi gsal/ tshe la long med pas thugs rje chen po'i gdams ngag tshig gcig gis sangs rgya ba cig zhu 'tshal zhes zhus pas/ sprul pa'i rgyal pos bka' stsal pa/ yab chen po nyon cig khams gsum 'khor bar skyes pa'i sems can la bde ba med/ sdug bsngal gyi btson dong du tshud pa yin/ de la skyabs dang skyob par byed pa la jo bo thugs rje chen po min pa'i mgon med/ de la thugs rje chen po'i gdams ngag tshig gcig la/ chos sku thugs rje chen po rang sems stong gsal rang byung rang la ye nas gnas pas logs nas bsgrub tu med/ rang dang gnyis su med pa yin pas de ngo shes par mdzod cig 'di nang ngo shes na nang sangs rgya/ nub ngo shes na nub sangs rgya/ 'di kho na ngo shes na bsgom du med de stong zhing gsal/sgrub tu med de rig cing gsal/ 'bral du med de ye nas gsal/rje lags/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ thugs rje chen po'i yang snying yi ge drug pa grag stong rgyun chad med par zlos/ lta ba stong gsal 218

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/rtogs/ sgom pa gting gsal skye/ spyod pa rang dwangs spyod/'bras bu ye stong grub/ mnga' bdag thugs la zhog rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob ces gdams so/ /yab rtogs grol dus gcig tu sangs rgyas so/ /ṣṭṛ// //oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ thugs rje chen po sprul pa'i sku/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam po la/ yum 'bri bza' thod dkar mas/ pho brang rgyal khab dang / 'khor 'bangs longs spyod thams cad gtad de/ phyag btsal bskor ba byas nas/ e ma ho/ thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa/ rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' lags/ bdag lus sems bskyed pa'i ma lags pas/ spyir sems can thams cad kyang skyes kyi rting la sdug bsngal las ma 'das/ sgos mi lus thob kyang bud med sdug bsngal gyi gzhir gda' bas/ da res bud med kyi lus 'dis skye ba rgyun chod pa'i thugs rje chen po'i gdams ngag tshig chod gnad dang bcas pa cig zhu 'tshal zhes zhus pas/sprul pa'i rgyal pos bka' stsal pa/ ma yum chen mo/ ma lus kyi sgrom bu lags pas/ bdag la shin tu drin che thugs la dgongs 219

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mdzod cig rang gi byang chub kyi sems skye ba med pa 'di la/ dang po skye ba med pas 'di nas byung bya ba med/ bar du gnas pa med pas dngos po dang mtshan ma med pas 'di na gnas bya ba med/ tha ma 'gag pa med pas 'dir 'gro bya ba med/ dus gsum du rgyun chad pa med de/ sems ngo bo stong pas skye ba med/ngos bzung med pas gnas pa med/ 'chi rgyu med pas 'gag pa med/ 'chi ba'i dus su lus 'bor bas rdo dang 'dra/ ngag gi smra ba 'gag brag ca dang 'dra/ sems stong pa skye med du yal/gnas med du thim/ 'gag med chos skur sangs rgyas/ mngal kha stong par bzhag 'gro drug skye gnas khegs/ 'khor ba rtsad nas bcad/ yum chen mo sems stong pa skye med du rtsad chod tsam na/ skye bar 'dod kyang skye rgyu med/ sa bon rul ba la myu gu mi skye/nam mkha' stong pa la gzung sa med/ yum chen mo'i lus nam mkha'i lus su 'gyur/ 'khor bar skye dogs med/ skye med kyi lta ba ltos/ gnas med kyi sgom pa sgoms/ ris med kyi spyod pa spyod/ 'gag med kyi 'bras bu 'char/ snying po yi ge drug pa zlos/220

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/yum gyi thugs la de ltar zhog ces gdams pas/ yum rtogs grol dus gcig tu sangs rgyas so/ /ndha// //o ma ṇi padme tsū/ thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa rgyal po srong btsan sgam po la/ jo mo khro gnyer ma'i sprul pa bal mo bza' khri btsun gyis/ khab sgo longs spyod thams cad phul nas/ lha sa 'phrul snang du gab tse dgu brtseg gi gdan la bzhugs su gsol/spyan gzigs dang zhal skyems sna tshogs drangs/ phyag btsal bskor ba byas nas/ e ma ho/ sprul pa'i sku/ gsung chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong la mnga' brnyes pa/ chos kyi sku'i thugs la 'gyur ba med pa/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa thugs la mnga' ba/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/bdag bud med kyi lus bya ba mang la g.yeng ba che bas chos bya mi dgos par tshe 'di la sangs rgya ba'i gdams ngag cig zhu 'tshal zhes zhus pas/ sprul pa'i rgyal pos bka' stsal pa/ bal mo bza' nyon cig chos bya mi dgos te/ byas pa'i chos kyis sangs mi rgya/ byas pa'i chos thams cad 'dus byas yin/ chos nyid 221

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/byang chub kyi sems ye gdod ma nas lhun gyis grub pa yin/ rang byung du sangs rgyas pas chos bya mi dgos/ rang sems chos skur rtogs pas sangs rgya/ da gzod bya rtsol byas nas bsgrub tu med/'on kyang rang lus thugs rje chen por rtogs kyang yi dam gyi lha mi spang / ngag gi smra brjod snying po yin kyang yi ge drug pa 'di zlos/sems dran rtog chos nyid yin yang rang grol du thongs/ lta ba stong pa mtha' bral lta ru med/ /sgom pa bsam med spros bral sgom du med/ /spyod pa byar med ris med rtsol ba med/ /'bras bu bsgrub med thob med thob bya med/ /chos la byar med bal mo bza'i thugs la zhog tshe 'di la rtsol ba mi dgos pa'i sangs rgyas rang byung yin zhes gdams pas/ bal mo bza' rtogs grol dus gcig tu sangs rgyas so/ /ṭā// //oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa rje srong btsan sgam po la/ lha mo sgrol ma'i sprul pa rgya mo bza' kong jos/ khab sgo longs spyod thams cad phul nas/ ra mo cher gab tse dgu brtseg gi gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ spyan gzigs dang zhal skyems sna 222

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/tshogs drangs te/ phyag btsal bskor ba byas nas/ e ma ho/mnga' bdag chen po lags/ bdag bud med du gyur pas las ngan/ gti mug shas che bas chos mi go bar gda' bas/ gdams pa tshig gcig gis rtogs grol dus gcig tu 'ong ba cig zhu 'tshal zhes zhus pas/ sprul pa'i rgyal pos bka' stsal pa/ rgya mo bza' nyon cig sems can gyi blo ma rig pas 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin/ ma rig pa de sel bar byed pa la gdams ngag tshig gcig las med/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems yin/ sems de phyi na med pas nang du ltos shig bltas pas sems kyi ngo bo gang du yang ma rnyed cir yang ma grub pa/ ngo bo stong pa/ rnam pa gsal ba nyams su myong ba cig 'dug pa de lta ba/ stong gsal ngang las dus rtag tu ma yengs pa de sgom pa/ rang ji ltar 'dug kyang gsal stong dang mi 'bral ba de spyod pa/ stong gsal gyi ngang las lus bor ba'i dus su sangs rgya ba 'bras bu'o/ /rgya mo bza'/ lus ni thugs rje chen po'i sku/ /ye nas ma bsgrubs rgyal ba'i sku/ /ngag ni thugs rje chen po'i gsung / /ye nas ma 223

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/zlos rgyal ba'i gsung / /yid ni thugs rje chen po'i thugs/ /ye nas ma bcos stong gsal dang / /ma rig mun pa gting nas sangs/ /las ngan 'khor ba'i bag chags dag /thugs rje chen por lhun gyis grub/ /sems can sangs rgyas sku ru gyur/ /rgya mo kong jo thugs la zhog /ces gdams pas rgya mo kong jo rtogs grol dus gcig tu sangs rgyas so/ /phroṃ// //oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa rje srong btsan sgam po la/ sras gung srong gung btsan gyis/ mgul g.yu me ru 'od 'bar dang / stag g.yu ke ru 'od chags mgul nas bkrol nas/ yab kyi mgul du btags/ 'bras chang ding bas dngul skyogs sha ba can dang / rgya phor gser ris can bkang nas phyag g.yas g.yon du drangs te/ e ma ho/ yab rje mnga' bdag chen po lags/ thugs rje chen po sprul pa'i sku/ tshangs pa'i dbyangs yi ge drug pa'i gsung / stong gsal chos nyid kyi thugs la/ lus ngag yid gsum spyi bos gus pas 'dud/ gdong dmar bod kyi mi rnams chos kyis ji ltar 'dul/ rang sems thugs rje chen por 224

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi zhes phyag dang bskor ba byas nas zhus pas/sprul pa'i rgyal pos bka' stsal pa/ lha sras rgyal bu nyon cigagadong dmar srin po bod kyi mi ni/ spre'u dang brag srin mo'i bu yin pas 'dul bar dka'/ nang du snying rje bsgoms la phyi ru rgyal khrims dam par gyis la chos kyis thul cig rang gi sems nyid thugs rje chen po yin pas gzhan nas btsal du med/ stong gsal kun la khyab pa nam mkha' 'dra ste lta ba yin/ rang dwangs ngos bzung med pa bar snang 'dra ste sgom pa yin/ gsal dag rgyun du mi 'bral 'ja' tshon 'dra ste spyod pa yin/ rig stong rang gsal skyi ser 'dra ste 'bras bu yin/ lus ni thugs rje chen po'i sku/ /bsgom du med par ye nas grub/ /ngag ni thugs rje chen po'i gsung / /rang byung 'bru drug ye nas bzlas/ /yid ni thugs rje chen po'i thugs/ /'gyur med chos skur ye nas gnas/ /sku gsung thugs su ye nas grub/ /thugs rje chen po de ltar sgrubs shig 'jig rten gyi rgyal srid mnga' thang che yang / phyi mar ngan song du skye ba'i rgyu yin/ bod khams thugs rje chen po'i chos la 225

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'khod/ sems can rnams la byams pa dang snying rjes zungs/ mi ngan dad med rnams tshar chod la bka' nan drag tu stsol zhes gdams so/ /de nas lha sras rgyal bu yang yab rje'i bka' bzhin du spyod do/ /ā// //oṃ ma ṇi padme rghaṃ/ thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa rgyal po srong btsan sgam po la/ lha gcig khrom pa rgyan gyis/ rang gi lus kyi gser g.yu'i rgyan bkrol te/ maṇḍal gyi rgyan du bkod pa phul nas/ e ma ho/ yab chen po sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sprul pa'i sku/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' lung zhal nas gsungs pa'i chos kyi gsung / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa thugs la mnga' ba'i spros bral gyi thugs/bdag gis chos la ji ltar spyad par bgyi/ lus ngag yid gsum thugs rje chen po'i sku gsung thugs su ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi zhes myag dang bskor ba byas nas zhus pas/ sprul pa'i rgyal pos bka' stsal pa/ lha gcig sras mo nyon cig bud med khyim la 'bags nas 'khor ba'i btson rar tshud pa yin pas skyes pa'i 'khri ba chod 226

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/la bde sa zungs shig sdig pa spyod na ngan song gi gnas su 'gro bas mi dge ba bcu spongs shig mtho ris thar par 'gro ba'i lam yin pas dge ba bcu spyod cig byang chub lam sna 'dren pa'i sgron me yin pas byams pa dang snying rje rgyud la sbyor cig sangs rgyas kyi sa bon drung po yin pas/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed thob cig de ltar byas na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur du thob pas chos la de ltar spyod cig lus kyis mi dge ba spongs la thugs rje chen po'i sku ru sgoms shig lus kyi sgrib pa byang nas thugs rje chen po'i skur 'gyur ro/ /ngag gis mi dge ba spongs la yi ge drug pa zlos shig ngag gi sgrib pa byang nas thugs rje chen po'i gsung du 'gyur ro/ /yid kyis mi dge ba spongs la gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang la zhog cig yid kyi sgrib pa byang nas thugs rje chen po'i thugs su 'gyur ro/ /lta ba rang stong chen po yin/ /lta rgyu med pa lta ba'i mchog /sgom pa rang gsal chen po yin/ /sgom rgyu med pa sgom pa'i mchog /spyod pa phyogs med chen po yin/ /spyod rgyu med pa spyod pa'i mchog /'bras bu skye med chos sku yin/ /skye 227

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rgyu med pa 'bras bu'i mchog /lha gcig phyi ma la lus blang rgyu med/ /skye med don ston bka' ltar gyis/ /gzhung ltar spyod/ bud med sangs rgyas nye zhes gsungs so/ /phroṃ// //oṃ ma ṇi padme rghaṃ/ chos skyong ba'i rgyal po thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa srong btsan sgam po la/ phyi blon nang blon rnams kyis/gser gyi maṇḍal la rin po che sna tshogs kyi gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa phul/ gzhan yang 'jig rten gyi spyan gzigs dang /zas kyi bye brag sna tshogs pas rin po che'i phra men gyis snod bkang nas drangs/ gdan gab rtse dgu brtseg la bzhugs su gsol/phyag dang bskor ba byas nas thon mi sasto ṭas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /e ma ho/ ngo mtshar can gyi rgyal po thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa/ bdag cag bod khams rnams la thugs rjes gzigs 'tshal/ bod kyi mi rnams blo dman pas chos mi go skal ba chung bas chos mi thos/ shes rab dang mdzangs la ring du gyur pas thos bsam gyis khong mi khrol/ gti mug dang chung grogs su song bas rang sems ngo mi shes/ mi lus thob kyang chos med bod kyi 228

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/rgyal khams su song bas/ lha thugs rje chen po 'di bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams kyi lha skal yin pas/ sgrub thabs dang gdams pa cig zhu 'tshal zhes zhus pas/ sprul pa'i rgyal pos bka' stsal pa/bod kyi mi rnams nyon cig mi lus thob pa la tshe snga ma la bsod nams dpag tu med pa sogs dgos pa yin la/ da lta mi lus thob pa la thos bsam gyis gros ka dgos/ chos med na byol song phyugs kyi bu dang 'dra/ tshe phyi ma la ngan song du song na thar dus mi 'ong / da lta rdog sna ma 'dreg pa gal che/ ngan song gsum las skyob pa la/ spyir dkon mchog gsum la brten pa gal che/sgos thugs rje chen po 'di 'gro ba rigs drug spyi'i lha skal yin pas/ nyin mtshan med par thugs rje chen po'i spyan gyis gzigs pa yin/ khyad par bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams kyi mi rnams kyi lha skal mdzad pas byin rlabs khyad par du che bas gsol ba gdab dgos/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ zhes pa'i yi ge drug pa 'di bzlas na 'gro drug gi g.yang sa gcod pa yin pas nyams su longs shig de la thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs la/ phyi mtshan nyid ltar bsgrub pa 229

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/la don gsum ste/ lta ba mngon pa dang bstun/ sgom pa mdo sde dang bstun/ spyod pa 'dul ba dang bstun no/ /de la dang po lta ba mngon pa dang bstun pa ni/ dang po kho na thugs rje chen po bsgrub par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas sems bskyed par bya ste/'di ltar chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa gsal la rtog pa med pa ma byung ma skyes pa'i ngang du sgoms/ de ni don dam pa byang chub kyi sems yin/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems ni/ bdag gis thugs rje chen po'i sku thob par byas la/ 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du sems can gyi don bya snyam du bsam/ sgom pa mdo sde dang bstun pa ni/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥbasams la/de'i 'od kyis lus dkar lam pa cig zhu nas/ bdag nyid thugs rje chen po'i skur gyur par bsgom ste/ sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas dang po na mu tig gi phreng ba bsnams pa/ g.yon dang po na padma'i sdong po/ 'og ma gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ zhabs gnyis padma dang zla ba'i steng na skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ spyan 'gro 230

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/drug la thugs rjes gzigs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa cig tu bsgom/ ljags padma 'dab drug la/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ zhes pa'i sngags bsams mkhas pa klog 'don pa ltar skad che la brda gsal ba lding khugs dang bcas par bzlas pas/khams gsum gyi sems can gyi sa thob pas/ 'gro drug gi sgrib pa dus gcig tu sbyangs/ rang gi sgrib pa yang dus gcig tu sbyangs nas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa shel gong phyis pa ltar dkar sangs la dag par bsgom mo/ /spyod pa 'dul ba dang bstun te/lus kyi sgo nas sems can gyi srog mi gcod par srog 'don/ ma byin par mi blang sbyin pa btang / 'dod log mi spyad grogs kyis chog shes par bya/ ngag gi sgo nas rdzun mi smra bden pa'i chos bshad/ phra ma mi bya bar 'thab rtsod bzlum/ tshig rtsub mi smra bar zhi des gsong por smra bar bya/ ngag 'khyal mi bya bar chos kyi gtam bya/ yid kyi sgo nas brnab sems mi bya bar rang nor gyis chog shes par bya/ gnod sems mi bya phan sems dang ldan par bya/ chos la log lta mi bya nges shes bskyed par bya'o/ /de ltar byas 231

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/na tshe 'di la bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan zhing / phyi ma la mi'am lha'i lus thob nas bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs nas/ lta ba mngon pa dang bstun/ sgom pa mdo sde dang bstun/ spyod pa 'dul ba dang bstun no/ /de'i lta ba bden gnyis dbyer med/ sgom pa mdo sde zhal thon/ spyod pa mi dge bcu spong dge bcu dang du len no/ /'khor rnams dga' mgu yi rangs nas phyag dang bskor ba byas/ blon 'bangs rnams la gdams pa mtshan nyid sde gsum dang bstun nas gsungs pa'o//zhal gdams brgyad po 'di zhus lan gyi skor yin no/ /ldi/ //༄7/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos skyong ba'i rgyal po chen po sprul pa'i sku dngos kyis/ yab la zhal gyis gdams pa'i ngo sprod la/ thugs rje chen po nyams su len pa la/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel bsgom ste/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i skabs su thugs rje chen po'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon lta bu/ sgom pa gsal 'grib med pa nyi ma lta bu stong pa dang snying rje dbyer med du bsgom ste/ sems stong pa 232

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/ngos bzung med pa bar snang stong pa lta bu/ snying rje la phyogs ris med pa nyi ma kun la snyoms nas 'gro ba lta bu'o/ /bden gnyis dbyer med bsgom ste/ kun rdzob tu rang snang ma 'gags pa sgyu ma'am/ rmi lam lta bu/ don dam du cir yang mi bden te sgyu ma bshig pa'am rmi lam sad pa lta bu'o/ /snang stong dbyer med bsgom ste/ snang la ma 'gags par rang gsal du 'dug pas gzugs brnyan nam chu zla lta bu/ stong la rang bzhin med pa/gzugs brnyan dang chu zla snang yang rang bzhin med pa ngo bo stong pa lta bu'o/ /rang gzhan gnyis med bsgom ste/ rang lus la gces par 'dzin pa/ bu ma la gces par byed pa lta bur rang lus btsas la chos bya/ rang bas gzhan gces par 'dzin pa/mas bu la rim gro byed cing gces par 'dzin pa ltar/ sems can la snying rje rang bas gzhan gces su bsgom mo/ /thugs rje chen po nyams su len pa'i dus na yid 'gyu ba rang grol bar snang stong pa'i bser bu lta bu/ sems wal po rjes med chu la ral gri brgyab pa lta bu/ rnam rtog rang byung rang grol chu la chu bur thim pa 233

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/lta bu/ rig pa cer mthong cer grol sngar 'dris kyi mi dang phrad pa lta bu/ nyon mongs pa chos nyid kyi grogs su shar ba me 'bar ba la shing bsnan pa lta bu/ rkyen snang rang sar yal ba nam mkha' la khug rna yal ba lta bu'o/ /thugs rje chen po nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ sgrib pa sbyong ba'i snying po/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ grag stong brag ca lta bur bzlas/ sems can la snying rje bu gcig pa ltar rgyun mi 'chad par bya/ rang don du stong nyid nam mkha'i dkyil ltar bsgom/ tshogs bsags/ dge ba'i rtsa ba sems can gyi don du spyi nor ltar bsngo/ 'gro ba'i don la brtson pa las byed kyi khol po lta bur 'bad/ re ba med pa'i smon lam bu lon khyer ba lta bur rgyas gdab bo zhes gsungs so/ /nyams len thun mong ma yin pa yab la zhal gyi gdams pa gsungs pa'o/ /rdzi// //oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos/ yum la gdams pa'i man ngag thugs rje chen po bsgom pa'i rten gyi gang zag gis/ sems can la snying rje bsgom pa gal 234

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/che ste/ phyogs ris med pa sman pa mkhas pas nad 'chos pa lta bu'o/ /sems can la byams pa bsgom ste mas bu skyong ba lta bu'o/ /sems can gyi don la brtson 'grus bskyed de zhing pa so nam byed pa lta bu'o/ /sems can gyi don du dge ba la brod pa bskyed de gser khung brdol ba lta bu'o/ /sems can gyi don la dka' ba dang du blangs te tshong pa khe byed pa la mthar 'gro ba lta bu'o/ /sems can gyi don la gnyugs bsrings la mthar 'don pa pha mas bu pho mo gsos nas 'bogs rdzongs byed pa lta bu'o/ /thugs rje chen po nyams su len pa'i rten gyi gang zag gis/ rang lus lhar shes kyang thugs rje chen po'i skur sgom/ sgra tshig sngags su shes kyang /o ma ṇi padme hūm̐ zhes pa'i yi ge drug pa grag stong brag ca lta bur bzlas/ dran rtog chos nyid du shes kyang rnam rtog rang dgar mi btang / chu la chu bur thim pa ltar rang shar rang grol du btang /rang sems la dri ma med kyang dam tshig gi dri ma mi gzhag 'phral ngag tu bkru bshal lta bur bya/ dug lnga ye shes yin yang nyon mongs pa tha mal du mi btang / gnyen po ye shes kyis rang grol rdo 235

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/tshan la kha ba babs pa ltar btang / 'gro 'dug nyal langs spyod lam yin yang tha mal gyi lus su mi btang / lus dang grib ma bzhin du thugs rje chen po'i mdzad spyod dang 'grogs/ thugs rje chen po la mos pa byed pa'i rten gyi gang zag gis/ bla ma spyi bor khur la mos pas bsten/ mgo bo'i thod dang 'dra bar mi 'bral/yi dam thugs rje chen po la gus pas gces par bsgrubs te khong gi snying ltar btsa'/ snying po/ o ma ṇi padme hūm̐ zhes pa rgyun du bar mtshams med par bzlas te mkhas pa klog 'don pa ltar ngag la btsa'/ mchod pa dus la ma yol bar mchod de nangs nub zas za ba ltar mchod/ gsol ba dus rgyun chad med pa nan tan chen pos ma thos bar du 'bod pa ltar/ byin rlabs ma byung bar du gsol ba gdab/ sgrub pa grub rtags ma thon bar du bsgrubs te/ phyi'i rgya mtsho la tshong pa nor bu len pa ltar/ rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don ma grub cher bsgrubs la mthar dbyung ngo / /thugs rje chen po'i nyams len gnad du gzhug pa/ yum la gdams pa drug gsum bco brgyad pa'o/ /ndha// //236

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ/ thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos/ jo mo bal mo bza' khri btsun la/thugs rje chen po'i don gyi ngo sprod dpe don du gdams pa/ thugs rje chen po'i lta ba nam mkha' la ngo sprod pa la gsum ste/ nam mkha' ltar thugs rje chen po'i dgongs pa la mtha' dbus med/nam mkha' ltar thugs rje chen po'i dgongs pa chos nyid shong yangs che ba yin no/ /de yang logs na thugs rje chen po'i dgongs pa yod pa ma yin te/ rang gi sems la ngo sprad do/ /thugs rje chen po sgom pa bar snang gi 'ja' tshon la ngo sprad pa la gsum ste/ thugs rje chen po'i sgom pa rig pa sems gsal la ma bsgribs pas 'ja' tshon lta bu/ gsal la ngos bzung med pas 'ja' tshon lta bu/ gsal la mdangs dang ldan pas 'ja' tshon lta bu'o/ /de lta bu'i sgom pa de yang logs na med de/ rang rig gsal la ma 'gags par shar ba de la bya'o/ /thugs rje chen po'i spyod pa skyi ser rlung la ngo sprad pa la gsum ste/ rlung ltar thugs nde chen pos thogs rdugs med par 'gro ba'i don byed pa dang /237

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rlung ltar dmigs pa dang dngos po'i mtshan mar mi 'dzin pa dang /rlung ltar rnam par rtog pa'i dwangs snyigs phye nas chos nyid gsal bar byed pa yin no/ /de yang legs na yod pa ma yin te snying rje dang stong pa dbyer med pas sems can gyi don byed pa la bya'o/ /thugs rje chen po'i 'bras bu nyi ma la ngo sprad pa la gsum ste/ nyi ma'i snying po ltar chos nyid stong pa nyid chos kyi sku yin pa dang /nyi ma'i 'od zer phyogs bcur gsal ba ltar sems nyid la rig pa'i rtsal shar bas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin pa dang / nyi ma'i 'od zer kun la snyoms nas 'gro ba ltar/ rig pa'i rtsal rnam rtog rang shar rang grol bas sprul pa'i sku yin no/ /de lta bu de yang logs na yod pa ma yin te rang rig pa sku gsum du gnas pa la bya'o/ /thugs rje chen po'i dam tshig shel gong la ngo sprad de de la gsum/ shel gong la dri ma med pa ltar rnam rtog dang dug lnga'i dri ma sems la mi 'jog pa'o/ /shel gong la phyi nang med pa ltar sems dang kha gnyis so so ma yin par khong nas skyon med pa'o/ /shel gong la sgrib pa med pa ltar rang sems gsal la ma 238

da wa zhalagadams bka' nan gyi skor/bsgribs par rang la yod pa de gzhan la ston zhing gsal bar byed pa'o/ /thugs rje chen po'i phrin las yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che la ngo sprad de/ de la yang gsum/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che la phyogs ris med pa ltar thugs rje chen po'i thugs sems can la mnyam par dgongs pa dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che la gsol ba btab pas dgos 'dod 'byung ba ltar/ thugs rje chen po la gsol ba btab pas ci bsams pa'i dngos grub 'byung ba yin/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che la phyogs ris med pa ltar/ snying po/ oṃ ma ṇi padme rghaṃ zhes zlos pa la byin rlabs 'byung zhing sgrib pa 'dag par byed pas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i snying po ma nor ba yin no/ /de ni thugs rje chen po'i phrin las yin no/ /sprul pa'i rgyal pos bal mo bza' la gdams pas des grol nas grub pa brnyes so/ /dzo// //oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos/ jo mo rgya mo bza' kong jo la/ thugs rje chen 239

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/po'i don gyi gdams pa ngo sprad pa/ thugs rje chen po'i sku phyag rgya la ngo sprad pa ni/ thugs rje chen po'i sku la tshul gsum ste/ sku de snang la rang bzhin med pa nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon lta bu/ sku de gsal la ngos bzung med pa chu nang gi zla ba lta bu/ sku de gsal la rtog pa med pa nam mkha'i zla ba lta bu'o/ /thugs rje chen po'i sku de yang logs na med de/ rang gi sems kyi cho 'phrul yin pas/lus/ sha khrag gi gdos bcas 'di'i zhen pa bzlog pa'i ched du ye shes sgyu ma la ngo sprad pa'o/ /thugs rje chen po'i gsung yig 'bru la ngo sprad pa ni/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ zhes pa'i yi ge drug pa 'di bzlas so/ /gsung ma 'gags pa brag ca lta bu tshig tu brjod kyang ngo bo stong pa pi wang gi sgra lta bu'o/ /yi ge drug pa bzlas pas sgra la yid chags/ yid chags pas ngag grag stong du ngo sprad pa yin no/ /thugs rje chen po'i thugs mar me la ngo sprad pa ni/ mar me de gsal ba rtog med du 'dug pa ltar/ thugs rje chen po'i thugs kyang rtog med du 'dug pa'o/ /mar me de gsal la ma bsgribs par 'dug pa ltar/ thugs rje chen po'i thugs ye shes de yang 240

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/gsal la ma bsgribs par 'dug pa'o/ /mar me'i 'od kyis mun pa bsal nas mi gnas pa bzhin du/ thugs rje chen po'i thugs ye shes kyis ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal nas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rang byung du shar ba yin no/ /de yang thugs ye shes de logs na yod pa ma yin te/ rang gi sems rnam par mi rtog pa gsal la ma 'gags par 'dug pa 'di/ thugs rje chen po'i thugs dang dbyer med par ngo sprad pa yin no/ /sku'i byin rlabs lus la bde bar ngo sprad pa ni/ lus thugs rje chen po'i skur bsgoms pas lus la bde bas khyab pas skyes pa bud med dang phrad pa lta bu'o/ /bde ba drod du 'bar bas nyi mas lus dros pas rngul 'byung ba lta bu'o/ /bde ba nyams su 'bar bas/ 'khrab pa dang / gar byed pa dang / gar chang 'thungs pas bzi ba lta bu'o/ /de rnams ni thugs rje chen po'i sku'i byin rlabs lus la ngo sprad pa'o/ /gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la nus par ngo sprad pa ni/ ngag tu/ o ma ṇi padme hūm̐ zhes bzlas pas snying po 'grub pas/ phyi gdon bgegs thul ba'i nus pa nam mkha' la thog babs pa lta bu'o/ /bar na tsha 241

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'joms pa ba mo la nyi ma shar ba lta bu'o/ /nang dug lnga 'joms pa rdo tshan la kha ba babs pa ltar rang grol du 'gro'o/ /de rnams ni thugs rje chen po'i gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la nus par ngo sprad pa yin no/ /thugs kyi byin rlabs sems la ngo sprad pa ni/thugs rje chen po'i thugs spros bral gyi nyams ni/ nam langs nas mun pa sangs pa'i nam mkha' ltar gsal la ma 'gags pa'i nyams skye/ chos nyid rang byung gi nyams nyi ma shar ba ltar phyogs mtshams kun tu gsal ba'i nyams skye/ thugs mnyam pa ris med du 'char ba nyi ma bzhin du kun la snyoms nas 'gro ba'i nyams skye'o/ /thugs rje chen po'i thugs kyi byin rlabs sems la ngo sprad pa yin no/ /rgya mo bza' shin tu drin du gzo'o/ /phroṃ// //oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa rje srong btsan sgam pos/ sras gung srong gung btsan la gdams pa/ thugs rje chen po'i skur sgom pa de sku drug dang sbyar na/ sku de mtshan dang dpe byad du ldan pa nyi ma lta bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ gsung grag stong sna tshogs su ma 'gags par 'char ba zla ba lta bu sprul 242

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/pa'i sku/ thugs skye ba med pa stong pa mi 'gyur bar 'dug pa nam mkha' lta bu chos kyi sku/ yon tan sems can gyi don rgyun chad med par mdzad pa gza' skar lta bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ phrin las 'gro drug gnas su gang la gang 'dul ci la cir ston pa sman lta bu 'byung bas mngon par byang chub pa'i sku/ thugs rje chen po sems can gyi don la 'pho 'gyur med par dus gsum du rtse gcig tu bzhugs pas rdo rje lta bu'i sku'o/ /de ltar sku drug rdzogs pa'i thugs rje chen po de logs nas bsgom bsgrub byas nas grub pa cig ma yin te/ rang sems thugs rje chen por bsgom pa rang shar du shar bas/ sku la bgres pa dang / rgud pa dang / skye shi mi mnga' bas/ lus gzugs brnyan ltar snang la rang bzhin med par grol lo/ /gsung thugs rje chen po brag ca lta bu la 'gag pa mi mnga' bas/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ zhes chos nyid kyi rang sgra mi 'chad pas/oṃ gyis nga rgyal zhi nas lha'i gnas sbyangs skye ba'i rgyun bcad/mas khong khro zhi nas lha ma yin gyi gnas sbyangs skye ba'i rgyun bcad/ṇis 'dod chags zhi nas mi'i gnas sbyangs skye ba'i rgyun bcad/243

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/pad kyis gti mug zhi nas byol song gi gnas sbyangs skye ba'i rgyun bcad/ mes ser sna zhi nas yi dwags kyi gnas sbyangs skye ba'i rgyun bcad/ hūm̐ gis zhe sdang zhi nas dmyal ba'i gnas sbyangs skye ba'i rgyun bcad do/ /nyon mongs pa drug zhi/ rigs drug gnas stongs nas 'khor ba rang shar rang grol ba'o/ /de lta bu de yang logs na yod pa ma yin te snying po yi ge drug pa bzlas pa las byung ba yin no/ /thugs rje chen po'i thugs ni me long ltar gsal la rtog pa mi mnga' ba ye shes lnga dang ldan pas rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes/ sems rang byung rang shar bas chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ gsal la ma 'gags pas me long lta bu'i ye shes/ mnyam pa ris med du gnas pas mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ rang shar rang grol bas rang sar zhi ba so sor rtog pa'i ye shes rgyun chad med par gsal stong dbyer med kyi ngang la gnas pas bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes so/ /de lta bu de yang logs na yod pa ma yin te/sems nyid rang las byung zhing rang la thim pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rang shar rang grol gyi dgongs pa yin no/ /sras la gdams 244

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/pa sku gsung thugs kyi ngo sprod zhal gdams drug pa'o/ /ndha// //o ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos/ sras mo khrom pa rgyan la gdams pa/thugs rje chen po'i lta ba ni snang stong dbyer med nam mkha' dang 'dra/ phyi rol gyi snang ba rnams snang la ma 'gags pa cir snang yang / sems kyi snang ba rang snang yin/ sems kyi ngo bo stong pa yin/ snang ba'i ngo bo stong pa snang la rang bzhin med pa yin/thugs rje chen po'i sgom pa ni gsal stong dbyer med nam mkha'i 'ja' dang 'dra/ sems gsal la ma bsgribs pa rang byung rang shar ngo bo stong pa yin/ thugs rje chen po'i spyod pa ni rig stong dbyer med nam mkha' la nyi ma shar ba dang 'dra/ rig pa sems la ci shar ba gang yang ma 'gags zhen pa med par spyod pa/ spyod kyang dngos por mi 'dzin stong pa la spyod/ thugs rje chen po'i 'bras bu ni bde stong dbyer med sems nyid ma bcos dbyings na bde/ stong la 'dzin pa med pa chu zla 'dra/ /spros pa'i mtha' dang bral bas ngos bzung med/ /ye nas rang la gnas pas sgrub tu 245

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/med/ /thugs rje chen po'i dam tshig ni/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /rtags kyi rnam pa lta bu yis/ /khams gsum sem/sa can thams cad la/ /dmigs pa med pa'i snying rjes bzung / /mnyam pa ris med ngang la spyad/ /thugs rje chen po'i phrin las ni/ /sangs rgyas sems can gnyis med kyi/ /snying rje zhags pa lta bus zungs/ /stong pa'i mtshon gyis sdug bsngal bsad/ /bde chen sa la sems can drang / /thugs rje chen po'i ngo sprod zhal gdams drug pa/ sras mo la gdams pa'o/ /sbyo// //oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos/ thon mi sasto ṭa la sogs pa'i nang blon rnams la/ thugs rje chen po'i ngo sprod gdams pa la phyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug la ngo sprad pa ni/ rlom sems med pa'i sbyin pa btang ste/ nor bu rin po che la dgos 'dod 'byung yang rlom sems med pa lta bu'o/ /dri ma med pa'i tshul khrims bsrung ste/padma 'dam nas skyes kyang 'dam gyis ma gos pa lta bu'o/ /khong khro med pa'i bzod pa sgom ste/ mas bu la brtse bar byed pa lta bu'o/ /246

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor /le lo med pa'i brtson 'grus brtsam ste/ skyes pa skra la me shor ba lta bu'o/ /g.yeng ba med pa'i bsam gtan la mnyam par bzhag ste/mar me rlung gis bskyod pa lta bu'o/ /'chal ba med pa'i shes rab sgom ste/ gsal la ma bsgribs pa shel gong la phyi nang med pa lta bu'o/ /de ltar pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis 'gro ba'i don spyod pa ni thugs rje chen po'i mdzad spyod do/ /thugs rje chen po'i rnal 'byor pas/ nang lam drug la ngo sprad pa ni/ chos spyod lam rim la brten nas ded dpon lam rgyus mkhan lta bus tshogs lam bgrod/ bskyed pa'i rim pa la brten nas lha bzo ba lha 'dri ba lta bus sbyor lam bgrod/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa la brten nas mun khung du sgron me bteg pa lta bus mthong lam bgrod/ gnyis med zung 'jug la brten nas lus dang grib ma lta bus sgom lam bgrod/lta sgom spyod lam la brten nas nam mkha' la nyi ma shar ba lta bus mthar phyin pa'i lam bgrod/ lta sgom spyod pa zung 'jug gsum la brten nas bar snang la nyi ma shar ba lta bus mi slob pa'i lam bgrod/ thugs rje chen po'i rnal 'byor pas/ gsang ba lta sgom 247

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gyi don drug la ngo sprad pa ni/ thugs rje chen po'i lta ba'i dus na phyogs 'dzin med de kun la khyab pa nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /thugs rje chen po'i sgom pa'i dus na sems nyid chos nyid la gsal 'grib med de nyi ma lta bu'o/ /thugs rje chen po'i spyod pa'i dus na nyam nga ba dang bag tsha ba med pas seng ge lta bu'o/ /thugs rje chen po'i 'bras bu'i dus na re dogs med pa rin po che lta bu'o/ /thugs rje chen po'i dam tshig gi dus na dri ma med pa shel gong lta bu'o/ /thugs rje chen po'i 'gro don gyi dus na rgyun chad med de chu bo lta bu'o/ /de ltar pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi sgor zhugs/ lam drug ma nor bar bskyed/ lta sgom gyi don drug ma nor bar nyams su blangs/ snying po/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ zhes pa 'bru drug bzlas pas/thugs rje chen po'i zhal mthong / dngos grub thob par gdon mi za'o zhes gdams pas nang 'khor ba rnams dga' mgu yi rangs so /dzo// //o ma ṇi padme rgyu/ thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos/ phyi blon rnams la gdams pa'i ngo 248

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/sprod la/ thugs rje chen po sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ dang po sbyor ba byang chub kyi sems kyis zin pa sems can thams cad la snying rje bu gcig pa'i ma lta bu'i sems bskyed/ snying brtse bas sems can snying phugs su bzhugs/ bar du dngos gzhi lha bsgom pa ni/ thugs rje chen po'i sku rmi lam lta bu snang la rang bzhin med pa gsal la rtog pa med pa sgom/ mjug mi rtog pas rgyas gdab pa ni/ me long la has btab pa 'dus pa ltar rim par bsdus te mi dmigs pa stong pas rgyas gdab/ spyod pa rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin chu 'bab pa lta bu rgyun chad med par nyams su blang /4 dam tshig dri ma med pa shel gong lta bur rang rig dri ma med pa drang por bsrang / re ba med pa'i smon lam bu lon khyer ba thag chod pa ltar rgyas gdab bo/ /bla ma mgo bo'i thod bzhin khur la gsol ba gdab/ yi dam snying gi dkyil du bsgoms la rang gi srog bzhin du btsas la sgrub/ snying po/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ zhes chu bo rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin bar mtshams med par bzlas/ gsol ba ma la bus 'bod pa ltar gus par dung nga gdab/ gtor tshogs ri ltar 249

da legasabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/spungs la mkha' 'gro chos skyong mchod/ snying rjes sems can bu ltar bzung la stong pa nam mkha'i dkyil ltar rgyas gdab/ thugs/ rje chen po nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ slob dpon byed cing slob ma gso bas pha mas bu tsha gso ba ltar bslab/ bde bar gshegs pa'i snying pos 'gro ba yongs la khyab pas/ stong pa dang snying rje dbyer med du rgyud la sgom du gzhug sems can kun gyi don du yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bur rlom sems med par 'gro don bya/ sems can thams cad kyis pha mes bu tsha nye 'brel ma byas pa med pas/ kun la nyi ma lta bur snying rje snyoms par bya/snying poji/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ zhes pas 'gro drug sgrib pa sbyong ba yin pas ba mo la nyi ma shar ba lta bur bzlas/ thugs rje chen po'i spyod pas 'gro ba la bu bzhin brtse bar bya'o/ /phyi blon rnams la gdams pa'o/ /ṣṭṛ// //zhal sadams brgyad po de ngo sprod du gdams pa'i skor yin no/ /༄7/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa rje srong btsan sgam pos/ yab yum 250

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/gnyis la 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs su gdams pa/ yab yum lags 'khor bar skyes pa'i rting la bde ba med pas/ khams gsum 'gro drug gi sems can 'khor ba las mi thar zhing dbyung dka' bas/rgya mtsho chen por byed pa lta bu/ de las thar par byed pa'i gru lta bu ni lha thugs rje chen po/ sngags oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ zhes pa'i yi ge drug pa 'di yin pas 'khor ba'i chu bo las thar par 'dod pas thugs rje chen po la brten cig khams gsum gyi sems can 'dod sred kyi gling du chud pa ni/ tshong pa zong zad 'phyes pas srin mo'i gling du chud pa lta bu/ de las thar par byed pa'i mgon ni rta'i rgyal po sprin gyi shugs can lta bu lha thugs rje chen po yin no/ /de las grol bar 'dod pa'i blos srin mo dang bu la ma chags pa lta bu/ da lta grogs dang bu tsha la ma chags par bya'o/ /rta'i rgyal po la 'jus na 'gro ba lta bu/ o ma ṇi padme hūm̐ zhes pa'i yi ge drug pa 'di yin no/ /'khor ba'i bslu brid gang la yang ma chags par bya'o/ /khams gsum gyi sems can skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal gyis sbyangs nas gar 'gro cha med pa ni/ lam cha med 'jigs pa 251

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/chen po yod pa lta bu'o/ /de las skyob par byed pa mi 'jigs pa'i skyel ma lta bu ni/ lha thugs rje chen po yin no/ /lam ma nor bar byed pa'i lam rgyus mkhan lta bu/ rigs drug gi skye sgo gcod nga/ra byed pa byang chub kyi lam sna 'dren par byed pa'i thabs ni/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ zhes pa'i yi ge drug pa 'di yin pas snying po 'bad pa drag pos bzla bar bya'o/ /khams gsum gyi sems can rnams 'khor ba'i gnas nas thon par dka' ba ni/ btson dong du bcug nas btson rdzis bsrung ba lta bu/ de las skyob par byed cing btson bslu ba'i bdag po lta bu ni/ lha thugs rje chen po yin no/ /btson gyi bslud ma gzhal nas btson thar par byed pa lta bu ni/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ zhes pa'i yi ge drug pa 'di yin pas/ 'di dus rgyun du nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i gnas ni nyon mongs pa'i sdug bsngal gyis zin pa ni/ po/cong nad drag pos zin pa ltar shin tu 'tsho dka'o/ /nad des zin pa gso bar byed pa'i sman pa mkhas pa lta bu ni/ lha thugs rje chen po yin no/ /nad de gso bar byed pa'i 252

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/sman lta bu ni/ o ma ṇi padme rtsu zhes pa'i yi ge drug pa 'di yin no/ /'di nyams su blangs pas 'khor ba'i gcong rnying gi nad/ bla na med pa'i byang chub tu 'tsho bar byed pa 'di yin no/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can rnams g.yang sa chen por lhung ba lta bu'o/ /g.yang sar lhung ba'i dpyang thag 'dren mi lta bu ni/ lha thugs rje chen po yin no/ /'khor ba'i g.yang sa las thar pa byang chub kyi lam sna 'dren pa'i dpyang thag lta bu ni/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ zhes pa'i yi ge drug pa 'di yin pas/ bzla bar bya/ bsgrub par bya/ rje yab yum lags/ 'khor ba'i gnas nas sa bdag rgyal por skyes kyang bde ba med/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por skyes kyang rgyal srid sna bdun bzhag nas 'gro/ 'khor ba'i rgyal srid mnga' thang longs spyod thams cad bslu brid byed pa'i sgyu ma yin/thugs rje chen po'i chos la sbyangs na 'di bde phyi mar byang chub thob/ yab yum la gdams pa 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs kyi zhal gdams so/ /phroṃ// //oṃ ma ṇi padme rtsu/ thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa chos skyong ba'i 253

legs bshadabastanabacosaphyogasabaṇḍigs/rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos sras po la gdams pa/ rgyal bu lha sras nyon cig rgyal srid chos kyis ma bzung na/ /'jig rten rgyal srid ngan song 'khor ba'i rgyu/ /tshe 'di'i rgyal srid chos dang ci mthun gyis/ /slob dpon zhabs 'degs dka' la 'bri 'don gyis/ /phyi 'khor zhi bas bskyangs la nang 'khor zas kyis skyongs/ /gcen gcung bka' la btags shing yab mes gdan sa zungs/ /lha ru dkon mchog mchod la gros phugs chos la gtod/ /rang don byang chub sgrub cing gzhan don chos la gzud/ /dge ba'i las ka sgrub cing sdig pa'i las ka spongs/ /skye shis 'jigs pa'i skyel ma thugs rje chen po tshol/ /'gro drug skye gnas spong ba'i yi se/ drug pa zlos/ /rigs drug g.yang sa bcad nas de yi skye sgo khegs/ /mtho ris skas la 'dzeg pa'i dge bcu dang du longs/ /ngan so nga g.yang sar 'khor ba'i mi dge bcu po spongs/ /dal 'byor mi lus thob pa chud ma gsan/ /mnga' thang longs spyod rgyas kyang bzhag nas stong par 'gro bas bla ma dkon mchog mchod/ /spyin pa sngar btang sngon na sdod pas phyi ma'i don du sbyin sogs 'bad 254

da wa —da zhalashadamasabaka' nan gyi skor/pa bskyed/ /rgyal srid mtha' ru rgyas kyang shi ba'i nangs par gcig pur 'gro bas thugs rje chen po sgrubs/ /pho brang gnas khang bzang yang gtan du bsdad dbang med pas zhing khams dag par sbyongs/ /rgyal khrims dam par bsdams kyang sdig dang ngan song rgyu yin chos khrims bde la khod/ /mi ngan kha thabs mi btang rgyal srid chos dang bstun la bca'/ /lta ba chos nyid gdengs kyis zin pas snang ba zil gyis gnon/ /sgom pa gsal stong nyams kyis zin pas gsal btang sbyang / /spyod pa snying rjes zin pas kun la bu bzhin bya/ /'bras bu 'dod pas mi sgrub sangs rgyas zhar la 'byung / /dam tshig gzhung bzhin bsrungs la rang sems gtsang sar thon/ /'gro don phyogs med byas la chos dang ci mthun gyis/ /de ltar byas na yab kyi gdung 'dzin lha sras yin/ /chos dang mthun pas chos skyong rgyal po chen po yin/ /'jig rten dregs chos rgyal po ngan song sna 'dren yin/ /rgyal srid mnga' thang ldan yang dmyal ba'i ded dpon yin/ /dkor nor longs spyod ldan yang 'khor ba'i yi dwags yin/ /shes rig gros la mkhas 255

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/kyang byol song sems can yin/ /rgyal po chen po yin yang 'khor ba'i ded dpon yin/ /yab kyi bka' la gson la chos skyong rgyal po gyis/ /chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /lha sras rgyal bu thugs la de ltar zhog /lha sras rgyal bu la gdams pa/rgyal srid chos dang bstun cig pa'i zhal gdams so/ /phroṃ// //oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos/ lha gcig sras mo la gdams pa/khrom pa rgyan nyon cig bud med lha lcam du skyes kyang chos med na 'bangs mo dang 'dra/ rang rig byang chub sems su ma shes na/ /rig pa sgrin la bkra yang lkugs ma yin/ /rang gsal sems nyid bya ra ma byas na/ /lus la byi dor byas kyang byi la'i khrus dang 'dra/ /yo byad yod kyang sbyin pa ma btang na/ /gter bsrungs 'dra ste rang la phan mi 'gyur/ /tshe 'di yun thung long med chos la gzhol/ /bsags pa bsdus pas sbyin pa ci grub thongs/ /mi lus stong log ma byed tshul khrims gtsang mar srungs/ /sems nyid nor bu rin chen chud ma gsan/ /sems nyid stong gsal rang byung ye shes 256

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/sgoms/ /de ltar nus na 'di bde phyi ma skyid/ /de ltar ma nus sdig grogs khyo ma 'dod/ /khyo bzang ji ltar byas kyang mgur mi btub/ /khyo ngan byur gyi gdos thag skyong ba dka'/ /pha mas dka' las byas kyang bu rnams tshim pa med/ /rgas na mi 'dod khong gi nyes skyon brjod/ /lus la gces par bzung yang bral nas phyi ru lus/ /gser g.yu'i rgyan gyis spras kyang mi gtsang rang bzhin yin/ /dar zab re phrug gyon yang phung po g.yar po yin/ /nor rdzas ci tsam bsags kyang 'chi tshe lag stong 'gro/ /bud med las ka zin med 'phro ru lus/ /bu khyo 'khor 'dab rgyas kyang 'chi tshe gcig pur 'gro/ /'di phyi gnyis ka'i mgon skyabs dang brten sa lha thugs rje chen po min pa gzhan gyis mi phan pas gsol ba thob cig 'dzad pa med pa'i long gtam la mtha' thug pa med pas/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ zhes pa'i yi ge drug pa zlos/ sdig sgrib thams cad zad nas bla na med pa'i byang chub thob/ rnam rtog dug lnga la zad pa med pas tha mal shes pa rang dgar mi btang rang shar rang grol gyi ngang la zhog tshe 'di mthar phyin kyang yud 257

legs bshad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ dnghasko—tsam yin/ phyi ma la mtha' med pas da res kyi mi lus 'di la 'khor ba'i gdos thag chod cig chos kyang thugs rje chen po byin rlabs che la sgrub thag nye bas/ brtson 'grus bskyed la dad gus mos pas sgrubs/ de ltar byas na bud med yin yang blo ldan skal ldan yin pas/ 'dir bde phyi mar byang chub thob par 'gyur ro/ /lha lcam gson mdzod cig bud med du skyes nas chos ma dran pa rnams mi'i lus la byol song gi sems yin/ khong grims col chung chos med g.yas chung mdo med yin/ /mdzangs bkrag ldan yang chos med rang mdo shor ba yin/ /bu mang dpal du che yang chos med rabs chad nag mo yin/ /zas 'bras gos 'bras bzang yang chos med lag 'bras ngan pa lag stong yin/ /'phral du zas la yengs kyang chos med rang mdo shor ba yin/ /chos dang ldan na bud med mdzangs bkrag ldan pa yin no/ /dus da res rang mdo phyal par ma btang / lha gcig khrom pa rgyan la zhal chems su bzhag pa'o/ /phroṃ// //o ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos/258

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/jo mo bal mo bza' khri btsun la/ thugs dam bka' rgyas btab pa/ bal mo bza'/ chos nyid byang chub kyi sems skye ba med pa'i don cig ma rtogs na/ gzugs byad skye 'bras legs kyang phung po bor nas 'chi ba yin pas/ rang rig rang gsal 'bral med sgoms/ rig pa dri med rang shar rgyud la ma skyes na/ bu tsha rgyal bu mnga' thang rgyas kyang rang re 'gab bcad 'khor bar 'khyams pas/ rnam rtog dug lnga rang shar rang grol rgya yis thob/ chos nyid yangs pa'i don cig rang la ma rnyed na/ 'jig rten khang khyim yul zhing bzhag nas stong par 'gro bas/ rang sems sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams dag par sbyongs shig rang sems nor bu rang la ma rnyed na/ longs spyod zas nor phyug kyang ser sna'i rgyu yin/sems nyid rang byung rgyun chad med par spyod/ snang ba rang grol zhing khams dag par ma shes na/ mnga' ris rgyal srid thams cad bdud kyi las yin/ 'jig rten khams kun thugs rje chen po'i zhing du sbyongs/ rang sems rang shar yengs med ngang la ma bsdad na/ 'jig rten zang zing byis pa'i rtsed mo yin pas/ rang shar 259

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/sems kyi ltad mo ma yengs par ltos/ rnam rtog dug lnga skye med ngang du ma bcom na/ nga bdag phyogs ris dgra la zad pa med pas/ dug lnga rnam rtog gnas su choms la rang grol du thongs/rig pa 'dzin med phyogs med ngang la ma bzhag na/ phyogs 'dzin lta ba 'dod pas 'ching bas/ lta ba zhe 'dod spangs la phyogs med mtha' bral ltos/ rang gsal 'dzin med ngang la ma bzhag na/blo sgom sems 'dzin rig pa btson du 'dzin pas gsal stong yengs med sgoms/ rang grol rtsol med ngang du ma bzhag na/tshul 'chos lo 'dod sdig sgrib ma tshor bar sogs pas shugs 'byung 'gag med chod/ ye nas sku gsum rang ngo ma shes na/rtsol sgrub 'bras bu 'dod pas 'ching ba rang sems sangs rgyas yin par rtogs/ rang sems rang dag gtsang mar ma shes na/dam tshig bsrung mtshams ma shes nyams pa yin pas sgyu med zol zog spongs/ rang nyid thugs rje chen por ma shes na gzhan nas bsgrubs pas mi 'grub rang nyid lha ru shes par gyis/ snying po gsal dag rang sgrar ma shes na/ /bzlas brjod mi tshig 'dres 260

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/pas mi 'grub pas/ o ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ yi ge drug pa rdo rje'i bzlas pa gyis/ 'khor ba spangs pas mi spong grol bar dka' bas/thugs rje chen po bsgrubs na grol bas/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ zhes pa zlos/ nga'i snying gtam yin pas bal mo bza' snying la chongs/gzhan la ma ston dang du longs/ 'khor ba rang grol byang chub lam la 'gro zhes gdams so/ /rje'i thugs dam bka' rgya'i skor ro/ /s+ho/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos/jo mo rgya mo bza' kong jo la gsang gtam gal chen gdams pa/lha gcig kong jo dang po skyes las che/ mi lus gtsang ma thob nas chos med pa mi tshe stong log byed pa yin pas/ skye med sems kyi rang bzhin rtogs pa gal che/ bar du dar la bab las che/gzhon tshe chos ma dran pa smyon pa smyon ma dran pa ma rnyed pa yin pas/rang sems rang gis ngo shes par byas la nyams su blang ba gal che/tha ma rgas las che/ rgas khar chos med pa khong na snying med pa yin pa/ chos nyid gsal stong rgyud la brten pa gal che/ tshe zad 'chi 261

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/las che/ 'chi khar chos dang ma 'grogs na mdo med sdig pa khur ba'i theg pa can yin pas/ chos sku 'chi med rtogs nas 'du 'bral med pa gal che/ pha ma drin can dang 'bral las che/ gus pas sri zhu bskyed nas shi na ngan song gnas nas 'don pa gal che/gtan grogs 'dus nas 'bral las che/ grogs dang 'thab rtsod med par rang rig ye shes grogs dang 'grogs nas 'gro ba gal che/bu tsha gsos phog nas so sor 'gro las che/ rang rig bu dang ye shes bu mo la pang chos byed pa gal che/ bsags pa 'dzad las che/sbyin pa ser sna med par btang nas phyi ma'i rgyags phye grabs su gzhug pa gal che/ yul mkhar sa gzhis bzhag nas 'gro las che/rang sems btsan sa zin nas chos nyid yangs par sdod pa gal che/phyi ma skyel ma med las che/ spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba btab nas 'di phyi'i skyel ma bcol ba gal che/ long gtam 'chal gtam gyis sdig sgrib sog las che/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ zhes rgyun du zlos pa gal che/ sems kyi sdig sgrib sog las che/ dug lnga rang shar rang grol du gtong ba gal che/ phyogs 'dzin can gyi lta bas 262

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/'ching las che/ phyogs med 'dzin med kyi lta bas bzlo ba gal che/sems 'dzin sgom pas gzung las che/ gsal stong 'dzin med ngang la gnas pa gal che/ ched byed spyod pa byed las che/ byed spyod tshul 'chos med pa gal che/ re dogs 'bras bu sgrib las che/rang gnas sku gsum ngo shes pa gal che/ dam tshig nyams chag 'ong las che/ rang sems gtsang sar thon nas nyams grib skyon gyis ma gos pa gal che/ rgyun du tha mal du sdod las che/ sgo gsum thugs rje chen po'i sku gsung thugs dang mi 'bral ba gal che/gal che ba bcu drug po 'di nga'i gsang gtam yin pas/ rgya mo bza'i thugs la zhog 'di ltar byas na mi lus thob pa don can yin pas phyi ma byang chub lam du phyin/ sems la zhog la gzhan la gsang ngo zhes bka' rgyas btab nas gnang ngo / /rgya mo kong jo la gdams pa gsang gtam gal po che'i skor lags so/ /phroṃ// //oṃ ma ṇi padme rghaṃ/ thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos/ nang blon rnams la bzhag pa'i zhal gdams/ spyir lho 'dzam bu gling du skyes/ sangs rgyas shākya thub 263

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/pa'i bstan pa dang 'dzom pa rnams sngon tshogs dpag tu med pa bsags pa yin/ sgos bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'di lha thugs rje chen pos 'dul ba'i zhing du gyur pa yin pas/ thugs rje chen po'i chos la spyod cig thugs rje chen po'i mdzad spyod stong pa dang snying rje zung 'jug yin pas/ rang don du thugs rje chen po'i lta ba ni/ phyogs med 'dzin med ngang la zhog thugs rje chen po'i sgom pa ni/ gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang la zhogathugs rje chen po'i spyod pa ni/ byar med ris med kyi ngang la zhogathugs rje chen po'i 'bras bu ni/ re med rang gnas kyi ngang la zhog thugs rje chen po'i dam tshig ni/ sems can la byams snying rjes zung zhig thugs rje chen po'i phrin las ni/ 'gro don gang la gang 'dul gyis shig tshig drug po 'di las lhag pa thugs rje chen po dngos dang mjal yang de las bstan du med pas/ 'di'i don la gnas par gyis shig ma rtogs pa'i rtogs rdzun ma 'debs/ ma bsgoms par sangs rgyas ma re/ ma bsgrubs par grub pa mi thob pas yi dam thugs rje chen po sgoms/ snying po/ oṃ 264

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/ma ṇi padme hūm̐ zhes pa'i yi ge drug pa zlos/ 'gro drug gnas sbyong ba yin no/ /dus phyi ma'i gang zag lta ba la zhen nas/ chos la ris su gcod cing chos spyod spong / thugs rje chen po dang yi ge drug pa rgan rgon dang byis pa'i chos yin zer nas khyad gsod byed pa 'ga' 'ong bas/ de rnams ni bdud ngag la zhugs pa bya ba yin no/ /phyi ma la gtan sdug 'khor ba'i gting du 'gro bas thugs rje chen po'i chos la the tshom ma za bar sgrubs/ sgrub thag 'di las nye ba med do/ /byin rlabs 'di las che ba med do/ /thugs rje chen po'i lta ba gting nas rtogs kyang chos gzhan la skur ba ma 'debs/sangs rgyas dang sems can mnyam par rtogs kyang / sems can la snying rjes zin par gyis la gnod pa ma byed/ yang dag pa'i don la byar med du rtogs kyang chos spyod bcu mi spong / dgongs pa sangs rgyas dang mnyam par rtogs kyang lha dkon mchog gsum mchod/ snang srid kyi chos rang sar grol yang / bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la gsol ba thob/ sems la rang dbang thob nas rig pa bkol du btub kyang grogs phugs chos la gtod/ sa lam la 265

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/sbyong bgrod med par chos nyid ngos zin yang 'dus byas kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rgyun mi bcad/ sems nyid sangs rgyas yin yang rang sems gsal dag byi dor gyis/ cir snang sems kyi rol ba yin yang 'khor ba'i chos la tha mal gyi shes pa 'jug chos nyid bsam du med pa la longs spyod kyang byang chub sems dang ldan par mdzod/'bras bu chos sku rang la ye nas yod par shes kyang yi dam thugs rje chen po dang 'grogs/ sems la skye 'chi med par rtogs kyang 'chi ba dran par gyis la sgoms/ bsod nams dpag tu med kyang chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pa ci grub thongs/ sangs rgyas logs nas sgrub tu med kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngos/ da ltar gyi snang ba rang gi sems kyi snang ba yin kyang thugs rje chen po zhing khams su shes par gyis/ sgra grag pa thams cad/ o ma ṇi padme hūm̐ zhes pa'i yi ge drug pa'i sgrar shes par gyis/ sems kyi dran rtog thams cad rang shar rang grol du shes par gyis/ thugs rje chen po'i mdzad spyod yin pas 'jig rten 'di'i grags pa'i don du/ phyi ma'i rnam smin la mi 'dzem pa'i las ma byed/ sems can 266
