zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/rnams la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang mi 'bral bar gyis/mi dge ba bcu spongs/ dge ba bcu dang du longs/ dug lnga ma sog ched med la dgrar ma lta/ g.yo dang rdzun dang / rku 'phrog gis zas nor ma tshol/ phyi ma la rnam smin mi theg yi dwags gnas su skye/ dgos pa med par smra ba mang pos pha rol po'i sems la phog nas gnyis kas sdig pa sog sdig pa byed pa'i mi dang ma 'grogs sdig pa zhor la 'go yon tan can dang 'grogs na yon tan zhor la 'go zhe sdang skye ba'i sar ma sdod/ zag pa zhor la sog chags pa skye ba'i sar ma sdod sdug bsngal zhor la 'ong / lus sems bde bar bsdad na dge ba ngang gis 'phel/pha ma dang slob dpon la rim gro bskyed na tshogs rdzogs shing sgrib pa byang nas lan chags khyer/ thugs rje chen po bsgoms nas/oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ zhes pa 'di bzlas na sgrib pa byang nas byang chub thob bo/ /'di la yid mi ches pa rnams sngon gyi las 'phro med pas 'khor bar 'khyam du tho ba yin/ des na thugs rje chen po nyams su longs shig sprul pa'i rgyal pos nang blon rnams la bzhag pa'i 267

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/zhal gdams so/ /ndha// //oṃ ma ṇi padme rghaṃ/ thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos/ phyi blon rnams la gdams pa/bod kyi rgyal po snyan khung srab la gros kha yang / bod kyi blon po gdug pa che la chos la gnag gzhon pa shar rnams ni ngo mi rtag la 'gyur ldog che/ bud med rnams ni khong mi srun la dbang che/byis pa rnams ni shes bzhin rags la col chung / spyir mi thams cad nyon mongs pa rags la snying du 'gong po zhugs nas/ bod khab brgya byang bu rgyun chad pa ltar/ sil bu sil bur song nas/nang 'khrug dang dme 'khrug byed/ pha spun nang mi 'cham so kha phyi sgo la gtod/ gang la tsher mas bskor/ mthon po skyogs kyis 'debs/ che rigs dug gis gsod/ drag rim mtshon gyis gsod/ shar ra mda' stan byed/ dpa' bo rdo stan byed/ bod kyi rgyal khams thams cad 'khrugs nas bde ba mi 'ong bas/ de'i tshe bod kyi mi rnams 'dod sems langs nas/ bzang ngan nor gyis 'byed/ tshong dang khe spogs kyi sbyor ba dang du blangs nas/268

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/bande btsun pa'i cha byad byas nas mtha' nor dbus su drangs/dbus nor mtha' ru skyel/ mtha' mi rnams dbus kyi chos byed pa la dad pa skye yang / dbus kyi mi dang chos byed rnams nyon mongs pa'i dbang du song nas khe grags che/ 'khor su mang dang bsod nams su che 'gran/ sgom sgrub kyi rtsal mi 'dren par nor dang bsod nams 'gran/ dam tshig dang sdom pa mi bsrung bar che ba dang grags pa 'gran/ grub pa thob pa nam langs pa'i skar ma bas nyung / de lta bu'i dus ngan pa cig dus kyi mtha' la 'ong bas/de'i dus su chos byed rnams kyi kha bzung nas gcig la gcig skur ba 'debs shing smod/ chos byed rnams gcig la gcig gshe zhing rtsod/ lta ba kha la khyer nas nyams su mi len/ chos dar la ma smin pa'i dus cig byung tsa na/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i bstan pa nyams pas/ btsun pa khyim thabs byed/ gnas gzhi sde 'khrug byed/ dus de tsam na thugs rje chen po'i bstan pa dar nas/ o ma ṇi padme hūm̐ zhes pa yi ge drug pa rang byung du shar nas/ bod thams cad yid ches par byed pas/ de'i dus su thugs rje chen 269

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/po sgrubs shig yid brtan par gyis la thugs rje chen po'i chos la blo ma ldog cig rtogs pa'i lta ba la the tshom ma za zhig sgom pa bying rmugs su ma song bar gsal stong gi byi dor gyis shig nyams rgyud la shar ba de yal du ma gzhug brtson 'grus kyi go chas lus ngag yid gsum tha mal du ma sdod par thugs rje chen po'i sku gsung thugs su sgrubs/ bla ma dran par gyis la gsol ba thob/snang ba rang khar ma btang bar chags sdang rang sar grol du chuganyin mtshan dus gsum du sems kyi rgyud la ltos shig mi dge ba'i rnam par rtog pa rang sar yal du chug dug lnga rang kha mar ma btang rang shar rang grol du thongs/ yul snang 'dzin pa ngos bzung med par zhog rnam rtog dug lnga 'gyu ba rjes med rang dwangs ngang la zhog snyan mi snyan gyi tshig brag cha lta bur thongs/lus kyi nad dang sems kyi sdug bsngal sngon gyi las su soms/ nye 'bral drung po la sogs thugs rje chen po'i chos la khod/ pha'i dod du thugs rje chen po sgoms/ /ma'i dod du yi ge drug ma bgrongs/ /grogs kyi dod du chos nyid bag ma longs/ /bu'i dod 270

zhal gdamasabaka'ananagyiskor/ wadu thabs kyi don la ltos/ /bu mo'i dod du shes rab ye shes ltos/ /spun zla'i dod du rig pa rtsal sbyong gyis/ /zas kyi dwangs mar ting 'dzin bde gsal zo/ /skom gyi dwangs mar bla ma'i gdams ngag 'thung / /gos kyi dam par sdom khrims gtsang mar srungs/ /rgyan gyi mdzes par ma bcos rang sar zhog /lta ba'i mtha' ni rtogs pa'i gdengs dang ldan pa la thug go /sgom pa'i mtha' ni goms pa brtan pa la thug go /spyod pa'i mtha' ni ma bcos pa la thug go /'bras bu'i mtha' ni sku gsum rang la gnas pa la thug go /dam tshig gi mtha' ni rang sems dri ma med pa la thug go /snying rje'i mtha' ni rang bas gzhan gces pa la thug go /thugs rje chen po'i mtha' ni/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ zhes pa'i yi ge drug pa 'di la thug go /rang don sgrib pa sbyong ba yang yi ge drug pa 'di yin no/ /gzhan don 'gro drug gi gnas sbyong ba yang yi ge drug pa 'di yin no/ /tshe 'di la thun mong gi dngos grub 'byung ba yang yi ge drug pa 'di yin no/ /phyi ma la thugs rje chen po'i dngos grub 'byung ba yang yi ge drug pa 'di yin no/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ zhes 271

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/pa'i yi ge drug pa 'di zlos shig sgrogs shig sgrub cig ston cig shod cig snga ma'i sangs rgyas kyi gshegs shul/ da ltar gyi sangs rgyas kyi brten sa/ phyi ma'i sangs rgyas kyi lam yin no zhes phyi blon rnams la gdams pa'o/ /ndha// //oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa srong btsan sgam pos/ thugs rje chen po'i zhal gdams bod kyi blon 'bangs rnams la bzhag pa/ lho 'dzam bu'i gling du skyes/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i bstan pa dang 'dzom/ kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'di lha thugs rje chen pos 'dul ba'i zhing khams yin pas/ bod kyi mi rnams skyes pa khyo gar skyes/ skyes nas 'chi ba ma dran pa rnams snying med pa yin no/ /sngar ma shi ba med/ da lta mi 'chi ba med/ phyis mi 'chi ba mi 'ong bas 'chi nges pa yin/ tshe la dus btab med pas nam 'chi cha med/ 'chi rkyen mang bas nam 'chi cha med/ tshe nyin mtshan gnyis kyis 'dzad pas 'chi ba la zhag myur du 'gro/ 'chi ba la dam pa'i chos min pa skyabs gzhan med/shi nas 'gro ba rigs drug 'khor ba'i skye gnas sdug bsngal gyi 272

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/btson ra nas mi thar pas/ thugs rje chen po min pa mgon med skyabs med/ 'gro drug gi skye gnas gcod pa la/ o ma ṇi padme hūm̐ zhes pa'i snying po yi ge drug pa 'di min pa'i thabs med/ lha thugs rje chen po sgoms/ snying po yi ge drug pa 'di zlos shigabod kyi mi rnams spyang po dang drung por 'khrungs 'khrungs nas/chos med dang mdo med ma byed cig /'chi khar sdig pa ma khur cig /dbang che kha drag 'tshong 'tshong nas/ /rang tshabs rang la byas nas/ /ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal ma sgrub cig /sdang ba'i dgra bo 'dul 'dul nas/ /nyon mongs dug lnga ma thul bar/ /dmyal ba'i yul du ma 'gro zhig /mnyam gnyis 'thabs 'og tu 'dzud 'dzud nas/ /rang rgyud khengs pa ma thul bar/ /lha ma yin 'thab rtsod kyi yul du ma 'gro zhig /g.yo khram sna tshogs sgrub bsgrubs nas/ /sdig pa rnam smin khur du khur/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i 'dre lag tu ma 'gro zhig /kha smras dang tshig rtsub kyi ru shags 'debs 'debs nas/ /nga bdag 'gong po'i phyi ru 'grengs nas/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i lha shags 'pham du ma gzhug cig /zhe sdang 273

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ —'gran sems byed byed nas/ /zhe nag 'gran sems dang ma bral bar/ /dmyal ba'i lcags mkhar sgo med nang du ma 'gro zhig /tshe 'di'i 'dun ma sgrub bsgrubs nas/ /tshe phyi ma dran pa med par bzhag nas/ /mi tshe stong log byas nas ngan song gi gnas su ma 'gro zhig /pha yul mkhar khyim du sdod sdod nas/ /mi tshe yengs ma lam du zad nas/ /rten med gnas med du ma 'gro zhig /mgo skor grogs la chags chags nas/ /bu tsha rigs rgyud kyi 'dam du tshud/ /gtan sdug gi yul du ma 'gro zhig /nor rdzas yo byad sog sog nas/ /ser sna'i mdud pa ma grol bar/ /yi dwags kyi yul du ma 'gro zhig /gnyen bshes grogs po skyong bskyangs nas/ /nor dgra rdzas 'dre rdzas dang kha lan du btang nas/ /rang 'chi khar lag pa stong bar ma 'gro zhig /gos 'jam po legs po gyon gyon nas/ /mdzes sdug lus la brgyan byas nas/ /gos med gcer bur ma 'gro zhig /gzhan dag rgas pa'i lus la lta lta nas/ /rang re rgas pa ma tshor bar/ /rgas khar chos med ma byed cig /gzhan na ba la rim gro byed byed nas/ /rang nyon mongs gcong 274

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/nad kyis zin pa ma tshor bar/ /nad bcos kha med par ma gzhag cig /gzhan 'chi ba la mya ngan byed byed nas/ /rang la 'chi ba 'ong ba ma tshor bar/ /'chi khar chos med ma byed cig /bod kyi mi rnams/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po khur/ /thugs rje khong las che ba med/ /rgyab rten du mtshan ldan bla ma bsten/ /byin rlabs khong las che ba med/ /yi dam thugs rje chen po sgrubs/ /yi dam 'di las bzang ba med/ /snying po yi ge drug pa zlos/ /sgrib sbyong 'di las lhag pa med/ /bka' srung ye shes mkha' 'gro mchod/ /grogs su 'di las bzang ba med/ /chos su thugs rje chen po spyod/ /chos skal 'di las bzang ba med/ /thugs rje chen po'i lta ba ni/ /phyogs med mtha' bral gyi ngang la ltos shig /lta ba 'di las bzang ba med do/ /thugs rje chen po'i sgom pa ni/ /gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang la sgoms shig /sgom pa 'di las bzang ba med do/ /thugs rje chen po'i spyod pa ni/ /rang shar rang grol ngang la spyod cig /spyod pa 'di las bzang ba med do/ /thugs rje chen po'i dam tshig ni/ /rang sems sgyu med drang por 275

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bsrong zhig /dam tshig 'di las gtsang ba med do/ /thugs rje chen po'i mdzad spyod ni/ /stong nyid snying rjes sems can zungs shig /thugs rje 'di las che ba med do/ /thugs rje chen po'i 'bras bu ni/ /rang sems sku gsum du grub pas sgrubs shig /'bras bu 'di las sgrub tu med do/ /nga ni bzhugs kyang de las med do/ /nga dang bral yang de las med do/ /dus phyi ma'i sems can rnams de ltar spyod cig ces rgyal pos skyes pa rnams la gdams pa zhal chems su bzhag pa'o/ /ndha)// // oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos/ bod 'bangs spyi mthun la gsungs pa/ bod kyi mi rnams nyon cig bod kha ba can gyi mi rnams spre'u dang brag srin mo'i bur song bas/ khong tsol chung bas kha sgrin/khrel 'dzem dang ngo tsha chung la gsar 'grogs la dga'/ dad pa chung la sdig par mi 'dzem/ 'gran sems che la phrag dog che/'dod thag nye la tshig mi btsan pas/ dus phyi ma'i mi rnams chos dang gang zag gnyis ka la gsar 'grogs che bas chos byed pa la 276

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/sgro skur 'dogs/ chos la ni gsar sngas che bas dar skyen la nub skyen/ sgrub mi nus par bshad 'dod/ bsod nams dang 'du 'dzi la dga'/ chos brgyad kyi grags pa 'dod pa sha stag 'byung bas/ de'i dus su thugs rje chen po'i bstan pa dar bas lha dkar po bsgom pa mang / rdo dkar po za ba'i dus/ chos dar la ma smin pa'i dus bya ba yin pas/ de'i tshe thugs rje chen po'i chos byed par 'dod na 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid mi rtag pa yin/ rang rtag tu re ste tshe'i 'grib lugs bud med kyi dru bu 'thul ba bzhin 'dzad pa yin/ nyi ma nub pa'i grib so bzhin 'ded de/ bros pas mi thar/ tho yor la bya sgro btsugs pa rlung gis g.yo ba ltar nam 'chi cha med pa yin/ btson gsod sar khrid pa ltar 'chi ba la je nye je nyer song nas 'chi nges pa yin/ mi sha 'o dang mi dong ba phrad pa ltar 'chi ba la blu thabs med pa yin/ de la tshe 'di bas phyi ma gces te mi dran pa yin/ de ltar dug lnga rang khar sbyar na/ zhe sdang gi me 'bar bas dgra ma thul gyis dogs nas rang gi srog la mi lta/ 'dod chags kyi chu dugs pas gnyen ma skyongs 277

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/kyis dogs nas/ nor rdzas la gdung sems kyis zas 'dod pa dang 'dra/ gti mug gi mun par tshud pas rang ngo rang gis ma shes pa mun khung du rdzas tshol ba dang 'dra/ nga rgyal gyi ri bo la 'dzegs pas nga bdag gi 'gong po dang ma bral ba chu rtsal can chus khyer ba dang 'dra/ phrag dog gi tshub mar tshud pas gnyis ka phung ba stobs can g.yang sar 'dzings pa dang 'dra/ nyon mongs dug lnga rang khar song ba rtswa la me mched pa dang 'dra/ dug lnga rang khar spyad pas zhe sdang gis dmyal bar skye/ tsha grang gi sdug bsngal myong / ser snas yi dwags su skye/ bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal myong /gti mug gis byol song du skye/ bkol spyad kyi sdug bsngal myong /'dod chags kyis mir skye/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal myong / phrag dog gis lha ma yin du skye/ 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal myong / nga rgyal gyis lhar skyes/ 'pho ltung gi sdug bsngal myong / 'gro drug sdug bsngal gyis gcig nas gcig tu 'khor bas sdug bsngal gyi mtha' mi chod pa yin no/ /sdug bsngal de las bzlog pa'i thabs bka' rgya che lung grangs mang yang / 'gro drug gi sdug bsngal las 278

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/thar par byed pa la thugs rje chen po las lhag pa med/ snying po yi ge drug pas rigs drug gi skye sgo gcod pa yin/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/oṃ ye shes lnga ldan lha yi skyabs/ /'pho ltung zhi nas skye sgo gcod/ /ma snying rje chen po lha min skyabs/ /'thab rtsod zhi nas skye sgo gcod//ṇi byams pa chen po mi yi skyabs/ /'gyur ba zhi nas skye sgo gcod/ /pad dga' ba chen po byol song skyabs/ /glen lkugs zhi nas skye sgo gcod/ /me btang snyoms chen po yi dwags skyabs/ /bkres skom zhi nas skye sgo gcod/ /hūm̐ thugs rje chen po dmyal ba'i skyabs/ /tsha grang zhi nas skye sgo gcod/ /thugs rje chen po'i lta ba dgongs pa phyogs med mtha' bral/ sgom pa rang gsal 'dzin med/ spyod pa mnyam pa ris med/ 'bras bu chos sku 'gyur med/ dam tshig dri med rnam dag phrin las 'gro don phyogs med/ thugs rje chen po'i lta dgongs yin no/ /rang gi grogs su dam pa'i chos bzang bas thugs rje chen po'i chos la spyod cig skyel mar dkon mchog gsum bzang bas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro rgyun ma bcad cig sun mar bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum bzang bas 279

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gsol ba rgyun ma chad par thob cig rgyab skyor du lta sgom spyod pa gsum bzang bas nyams su longs shig sdig pa phra mo nas spongs shig thigs pa bsags pas rgya mtsho tsam du 'gro'o/ /dge ba phra mo nas gyis shig ri rab chen po yang rdul phra rab nas grub bo/ /ci byas dge ba'i rtsa ba bla med byang chub tu bsngos shig phyi'i rgya mtsho la mchil ma gcig bor ba mi 'dzad pa ltar yin no/ /chos thugs rje chen po'i yang snying / oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ zhes pa 'di las lhag pa med do/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i snying po ma nor ba yin no zhes sprul pa'i rgyal pos bod khams spyi la gdams pa'o rkyu// //oṃ ma ṇi padme rghaṃ/ thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos nang 'khor gyi bud med rnams la gdams pa/ kyai/ skye ba dman pa za ma bud med du skyes/ chos la go ba med pas gti mug gi mun par tshud/ tshe phyi ma dran pa med pa'i snying med tsho/ mi lus thob nas chos med pa mi tshe stong log byas pa yin no/ /pha'i snying po thugs rje chen po khur cig /'jig 280

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/rten 'khor ba'i pha 'di mi rtag 'bral ba yin/ /ma'i snying po yi ge drug ma khur cig /'jig rten 'khor ba'i ma 'di mi rtag 'chi/ /grogs kyi snying por rang byung ye shes dang 'grogs/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i khyo dang 'dus pa 'bral/ /bu yi snying por nor bu 'dzin pa bskyed/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i bu 'di phog kyang stong pa yin/ /bu mo'i snying por rig sngags 'dzin ma bskyed/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i bu mo brdzangs kyang don med yin/ /longs spyod snying po yi ge drug pa zlos/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i longs spyod yod cing 'dod/ /nor gyi snying por chog shes dgos med sogs/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i nor rdzas yod cing 'dod/ /khang khyim snying por rang lus sgom khang zungs/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i khang khyim btson khang yin/ /zhing gi snying por dad pa'i zhing sa bskyed/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i zhing 'di gtan mi 'debs/ /so nam snying po chos spyod 'bad la gyis/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i las la zin pa med/ /'du 'dzi'i snying por ting 'dzin spro bsdu gyis/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i g.yeng ba sangs pa med/ /mchod gnas snying por 281

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dkon mchog gsum po khur/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i 'khor 'di skyong bar dka'/ /gos kyi snying por ngo tsha khrel 'dzem gyon/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i snal ma 'dzad pa yin/ /rgyan gyi snying por sdom khrims gtsang ma srungs/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i gser g.yu rin thang che/ /gnyen gyi snying por rang sems bya ras/ skyongs/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i gnyen 'di mthun kyang 'bral/ /dgra yi snying por dug lnga drag tu thul/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i dgra 'di btul cing gyong / /nyon cig skal ldan bud med rnams/ /dad pa can gyi las can tsho/ /lta ba'i snying por rang sems snying po ltos/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos 'di ltos thing g.yengs/ /sgom pa'i snying por rang sems stong gsal sgoms/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos la nyon mongs ldang / /spyod pa'i snying por dug lnga rang grol chod/ /'jig rten 'alor ba'i chos la chags sdang rgyun mi 'chad/ /'bras bu'i snying por rang sems sangs rgyas rtogs/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i bsam pa grub pa med/ /mdo don snying po yi ge drug pa dril/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i rang don 'chal ba yin/ /de 282

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/rnams ldan na bud med ma yin byang chub sems ma yin/ /bud med chos med na byol song rkang gnyis ma yin pas mdo don chos la dril cig ces sprul pa'i rgyal pos nang 'khor bud med rnams la gdams pa'o/ /ndha// //o ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos/ phyi 'khor gyi bud med rnams la gdams pa/ kyai/ skye ba dman pa bud med rnams nyon cig bdag 'dzin bud med che bas/ bu khyo la bdag 'dzin gyi mdud pa khrol lam zhe na/ 'dod chags bud med che bas/ nor rdzas la ma chags skyes pa'i 'khri ba chod/ blo sna bud med mang bas bsam blo ma mang blo sna chos la bsgyur/ bya ba bud med mang bas/ don med pa'i bya ba rtsol ba ma che mdo don chos la dril/ dug lnga bud med che bas/ nyon mongs rlung gis khyer bas sems la gnyen po chug go ba bud med chung bas/ rang sems gsal dag rtogs la snang ba khrol du thongs/ le lo bud med che bas/ tshe la long med brtson 'grus chos la bskyed/ ser sna bud med che bas/ phyi ma'i 283

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rgyags phye dgos so bla ma dkon mchog mchod la sbyin pa ci 'grub thongs/ smra ba bud med mang bas/ zer la 'dug lo'i smra mchu tshums la/ lus ngag sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i yi ge drug pa zlos shigaphyi bdar rgyan la bud med dga' bas/ gser g.yu rim/ thang che bas lus ngag yid gsum thugs rje chen por sgoms/ khyo dad bud med che bas/ khyim thab bdud kyi btson ra yin pas skyes pa'i 'khri ba chod/ bu dad bud med che bas/ 'khor ba'i 'then thag bu dang bu mo yin pas gcig pur dam chos sgrubs/ nor dad bud med che bas/ ser sna'i mdud pa khrol la sbyin sogs ci 'grub thongs/ snam dad bud med che bas bkal ba'i snam bu byas shing 'dzad pas/ rang sems bal ltar g.yengs/ gzung 'dzin gru gur thul/ gnyi ga 'dzin thags su thogs/ de ltar byas nas 'dir bde phyi ma skyed pas byang chub lam du 'gro/ bud med bzang ngan thams cad bskyed pa'i gzhi ma yin pas bu tsha chos la tshud/ khyim gyi gnas brten yin pas bza' 'khor byams pas skyongs/ zas nor bdag mo yin pas zas la yangs su gyis/284

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/'phral dbang bud med che bas nye 'khor zas dang byams pas skyongs/ 'di bas phyi ma ring bas chos dang ci mthun gyis/ /'di phyir byin rlabs 'byung bas dkon mchog zhabs nas theg /bsags pa sgyu ma yin gyis sbyin pa ci 'grub thongs/ /dad pas kun nas slong la ci byed chos phyogs gyis/ /'di phyi'i mgon skyabs yin pas thugs rje chen po sgrubs/ /byang chub lam sna 'dren pas yi ge drug ma zlos/ /rnam rtog phra rags 'gag pas rang shar rang grol thongs/ /snang ba sku ru khyer la thugs rje chen po'i zhing du sbyongs/ /grag pa gsung du khyer la yi ge drug pa'i sgra ru zungs/ /dran rtog thugs su khyer la gsal stong 'dzin med ltos/ /rang lus tha mal gyi zhen pa chod la thugs rje chen po'i sku snang la rang bzhin med par sgoms/ ngag tha mal gyi zhen pa chod la/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ zhes pa sgra grag stong rgyun chad med pa zlos/ yid tha mal gyi zhen pa chod la rtog med rig gsal ltos/ phyogs 'dzin 'dod pas ma bcos phyogs med lta ba ltos/ /sems 'dzin sgom pa ma byed sgom med ngang la zhog /ched byed spyod pa ma byed rang byung 285

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/shugs 'byung thongs/ /re dogs 'bras bu ma sgrub sku gsum ngo bo rtogs/ /dam tshig bsrung sdom ma byed bsrung med ngang la zhog /'gro don phyogs ris ma byed phyogs med phyal bar gyis/ /snying rjes nye ring ma byed dgra gnyen nye ring spongs/ /nga bdag gnyis 'dzin ma byed nga med bdag med gyis/ /chags sdang rjes phyi ma 'brang rang sems glod la zhog /de rnams go rtogs nyams su longs na bud med skal ldan byang chub sems ma yin/ de ltar ma shes ma rig ma rtogs na/ 'di ltar gyis/ rang btsun pa mis mi gshe ba/ /gyos sgyug pha dang ma bzhin khur/ /las kyi zla grogs yin gyis khyo la mig bzhin ltos/ /las kyi lan chags yin gyis bu tsha brtse bas skyongs/ /'dus pa 'bral ba yin gyis yun du mthun par 'grogs/ /bzang ngan nor gyis 'byed pas zhib thigs chud ma gsan/ /lto srog 'brel ma yin pas so nam gtsang mar gyis/ /'jig rten rnam thar yin gyis 'phral mgron bzang du gyis/ /bsags pa chud ma gsan par chos phyogs ci 'gro gyis/ /lar chos med phyug cing btsan kyang mi tshe stong log yin/ /bud med 286

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/mdzangs bkrag ldan yang chos med ngan ma mdo med yin/ /bud med bu mang dpal che 'khor g.yog ldan yang chos med rabs chad grogs med gcig pu ngan song gnas su 'gro ba yin/ /skye 'bras gzugs byad phun sum tshogs kyang chos med zog mo lkugs ma glen ma dud 'gro'i lus can yin/ /spyang la sgrin la go shags phyed kyang chos med g.yas chung te pa ta rang mdo med yin/ /nor sogs zas dang khral la yengs kyang chos med rang mdo shor nas mi tshe stong log yin/ /ci byed chos dang bstun cig 'bangs mo bud med rnams/ /'di bas phyi ma ring ngo za ma bud med rnams/ /rang don 'chal bar ma gtong a ce bud med rnams/ /zhes sprul pa'i rgyal pos phyi 'khor bud med rnams la gsungs pa'i zhal gdams so/ /ndha// //oṃ ma ṇi padme rdzu/ thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos/ bud med rnams la bslab bya gdams ngag tu gsungs pa/ za ma bud med rnams nyon cigaspyir lho 'dzam bu gling du skyes nas/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i 287

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bstan pa dar ba dang 'dzom/ sgos bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'di lha thugs rje chen pos 'dul ba'i zhing du gyur pa yin pas/bod kyi rgyal khams su za ma bud med du skyes nas 'chi ba ma dran pa rnams snying med pa yin no/ /lar nyon cig za ma bud med rnams/ /pha yul bzhag nas gzhan gyi g.yog la 'gro/ /bud med bu la pha yul med/ /rang nor khyer nas mi yi khol mo byed/g.yog mo bla med yin/ rang nor khyer nas gzhan nor sog pa'i tshong khe can tsho/ bu khyo'i bdag mo dang dpal mo che/ khyod kyi mi lus gtsang ma thob nas chos mi dran pa/ las dang bya bas g.yengs pa ma tshor bar/ ngal ba don med ma byed cig 'chi ba rjes su ma dran pa'i brjed ngas can tsho/ 'chi khar chos med ma byed cig ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal la mi 'jigs pa'i 'jigs sran can tsho/gtan sdug gi yul du ma 'gro zhig /bu khyo 'dul ba'i dpa' mo tsho//mi tshe stong zad ma byed cig /nang nor phyugs la spyod pa'i longs spyod can tsho/ /'chi khar nor rnams bzhag nas ma 'gro zhig /lus la byi dor byed pa'i skye 'bras can tsho/ /'chi khar phung po 288

zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor/bzhag nas ma 'gro zhig /bal thags mkhas pa'i gos bzang can tsho/ /'chi khar gos med gcer bur ma 'gro zhig /brngo 'thag g.yo yang mkhas pa'i lag g.yang can tsho/ /'chi khar rgyags phye med par ma 'gro zhig /las la zin pa med pa'i rem ma tsho /'chi khar yul zhing bzhag nas ma 'gro zhig /bu khyo gso ba'i gzhung bzang ma tsho/ /'chi khar bu med khyo med du ma 'gro zhig /khral thong 'jal len byed pa'i go chod ma tsho/ /'chi khar khral ma 'khor bar ma 'gro zhig /'khor g.yog skyong ba'i theg pa can tsho/ /'chi khar 'khor med gcig pur ma 'gro zhig /lar nyon cig za ma bud med tsho/ /mchod gnas dkon mchog gsum la gyis/ /rten sa 'di las bzang ba med do/ /bla ma mgo bo'i thod bzhin khur/ /bkur gnas 'di las bzang ba med do/ /yi dam thugs rje chen po sgoms/ /sgrub rten 'di las bzang ba med do/ /snying po yi ge drug ma zlos/ /sgrib sbyong 'di las lhag pa med do/ /dad gus mos pas gsol ba thob/ /byin rlabs 'di las che ba med do/ /slob dpon mchod gnas zhabs nas theg /bkur gnas 'di 289

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/las bzang ba med do/ /las ngan mi dge bcu po spongs/ /las su 'di las bzang ba med do/ /dge ba bcu la lag len gyis/ /chos su 'di las bzang ba med do/ /pha dang ma la bkur snyi gyis shig /drin la de las che ba med do/ /phyugs dang sgo khyi rem la gsos shig /bsod nams 'di las che ba med do/ /ltogs phongs can la sbyin pa thongs shig /sbyin pa de las che ba med do/ /dug lnga skye ba'i 'phong ra spongs shig /chags sdang de las che ba med do/ /zer lo 'dug lo'i smra mchu tshums shig /zag pa de las sogs pa med do/ /nang nub skyabs 'gro rem la gyis shig /chos spyod de las lhag pa med do/ /bla ma dngos su byon yang gdams ngag 'di las med/ /pha ma dngos su byung yang bslab bya 'di las med do/ /bslab bya 'di la nyan pa rnams ni/ byang chub thob par the tshom med la/ mi nyan pa rnams ngan song gsum du skye bar 'gyur ro zhes sprul pa'i rgyal pos/ za ma bud med rnams la bslab byar gsungs pa'i zhal gdams so/ /ndha// //bcu gnyis po de zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor yin no/ /290

slob dpon padma'i zhal chems/༄7/ /slob dpon padmas bod kyi rje 'bangs rnams la bzhag pa'i zhal chems bzhugs so/ /slob dpon padma 'byung gnas/de nas slob dpon padma lho nub srin po 'dul ba la gshegs par dgongs pa'i tshe: lha sras mu tig btsan po la sogs pa'i rgyal po rnams kyis zhus pa: slob dpon bod du mi bzhugs rgya gar yul du gshegs dgongs na: phyi rabs bod kyi rgyal po rnams kyis ji ltar bgyid: ces zhus pas: bod kyi rgyal po rnams la gsungs pa:bsod nams ldan pa'i bod kyi rgyal po rnams:rgyal po'i rang bzhin 'bangs dang zla mi bya:rgyal pos 'bangs kyi spyod pa bya ba min:291

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gzhung thub zo bzang rab tu brtan par gyis:thugs ches nang byon bka' gros dri ba la:dgos don thugs chod lhug par gsung bar gyis:srid la gnod pa'i gros la gsan mi bya:khro gtum mi bya zhi zhing dul bar bya:gcigs dang bya dga' blo gros mdzad kyang ni:ha cang ma che ran tsam mdzad na legs:blon po 'dod pa che zhing rig pa med:srid kyi mkhar ni 'jig pa'i nyen che'o:rgyal kha blon gyis sgyur ba'i dus su ni:dkor dang sdig la shin tu 'dzem par gyis:rgyal srid nyams na rgyal po gya ba yin:bsgyur bar ma sla snyan khung mthug par mdzod:phyed tsam khong du bsad nas khong ba bskyed:srid kyi mu mtha' ring bas gdod mchi'o:btsun mo rnams dang bud med gzhan dag la:292

slob dpon padma'i zhal chems/'dod chags phyir na thugs la btags drags na:nga khyod 'dres shing bzang ngan med par 'gro:yid ches med pa'i mi la blo ma gtod:legs par mi 'ong rang srog 'gums nyen yod:phyi 'khor zhi bas skyongs la nang 'khor zas kyis skyongs:phyogs ris bor la bka' nan mnyam mnyam mdzod:gtsug lag khang dang lha khang mchod rten rnams:bsod nams che ste tha ma sdig pa'i rgyu:de bas sngar yod rnams la bkur snyi mdzod:dam sdos bsgyur la zhu gtugs dag par mdzod:lan gcig dus na bka' la tshad mar 'dzin:dkon mchog gsum la spyan ltar gces par mdzod:theg pa'i chos la 'jug lugs re re ste:kun gyi sgo nas 'bras bu thob mod kyang:gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa dang du longs:spra spro bzhugs gnas mang po phung ba'i nyen:293

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/yod pas shin tu brtan cing brtag par mdzod:mtha' mi lho bal rig shes med pa la:yid ches ma mdzad slu ba'i nyen mchis so:bang so bzhugs gnas ma spo chung ba'i nyen:thugs khral ma mdzad brtan cing lhun chags bzhugs:btsun mo rnams kyang srid kyi gzhi yin pas:khong yangs che zhing theg pa che bar mdzod:zas la bzang zhing lag byad gtsang bar mdzod:lus tshugs thub cing bca' ga 'thag par mdzod:yengs la ma 'byams spyod lam thub par gyis:smra ba ma mang ngag 'jam zhe la srings:phyi 'khor nang 'khor bzang dang snyan pas skyongs:lha sras lcam dral rnams kyang chos la tshud:'dir btsun phyi mar lha mi'i mtho ris 'thob:padma 'byung gnas bdag ni da 'gro bas:da ltar bzhugs dang slad nas 'byon pa yi:294

slob dpon padma'i zhal chems/bod kyi rgyal po rnams kyi thugs la de ltar zhog:ces gdams so: slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs dri ma med pa las: slob dpon padmas bod kyi rgyal po rnams la zhal chems su bzhag pa'i le'u ste nyer bzhi pa'o: :de nas khri bzang yab lhag la sogs pa'i blon po rnams kyis slob dpon la zhus pa: gu ru mi bzhugs rgya gar yul du gshegs dgongs na: phyi rabs blon po rnams kyis ji ltar bgyi: zhes zhus pas: slob dpon gyis gsungs pa:bod kyi rgyal po'i blon po byed pa rnams:rje yi rim gro lus ngag gus par gyis:nang gi khab so btsun mo'i zhabs tog gyis:phyi yi chab srid chos dang mthun par skyongs:'bangs kyi so tshis sha tsha brtse bar gyis:blon po'i sku gnyer rje yi bka' blon gyis:rgyal khab bde la bkod cing rgyal khrims btsan par gyis:295

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dkon mchog gsum gyi rten gzugs theg chen chos grwa tshugs:pho brang rgyal khams gzhung bzung so kha phyi la bstan:byams sdang ngo shes legs nyes don rtogs pas:snga gros mi zhan logs nyes sems par gyis:phyis 'gyod mi phan thal zin bcos mi thub:dang po bsams nas byas na phyi nas ma legs byung yang 'gyod pa med:chos la gnas shing dang ba che la dkon mchog mchod na chos blon yin:gros mkhan rig pa che la legs par brtag mkhas mdzangs blon yin:dpa' la zon thub dgra bo thabs kyis 'dul na dpa' blon yin:khong du zhe gnag med cing mdzangs shing srid thabs mkhas na 'phrul blon yin:296

slob dpon padma'i zhal chems/rgyal po'i rgyal srid legs nyes blon po bzang ngan yin:legs par lta rtog thong la rgyal po'i rgyal srid skyongs:padma 'byung gnas bdag ni da 'gro bas:da ltar bzhugs dang slad nas 'byon pa yi:phyi rabs blon po rnams kyi thugs la de ltar zhog:ces gsungs so: slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs dri ma med pa las: slob dpon gyis blon po rnams la zhal chems su bzhag pa'i le'u ste nyer lnga pa'o: :de nas gnyags dzñā na ku ma ra la sogs pa'i bod kyi rab byung rnams kyis zhus pa: gu ru mi bzhugs rgya gar yul du 'byon dgongs na: phyi rabs bod kyi rab byung rnams kyis ji ltar bgyi zhus pas: slob dpon gyis gsungs pa:thar pa'i lam la gshegs pa'i phyi rabs btsun pa rnams:mi chos nang nas bros te thar pa'i lam la zhugs:pha ma gnyen bshes bor nas chags pa med par gyis:skra bzhar ston pa'i chos gos gyon nas rab tu byung:297

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mkhan slob khrims dbang mdzad pa'i mkhas btsun la:dge slong dge tshul sdom pa tshul khrims blang:bslab pa'i rim pa nyes byas med par srungs:bzhugs pa'i gnas dang lhung bzed bkru la sogs:mkhan slob dge 'dun bsgres kun zhabs tog dang:maṇḍal chag chag byi dor legs par bya:mchod pa thams cad yid 'ong legs par bkod:srod dang tho rangs mi nyal dge sbyor bya:dge ba chos spyod lam rim sna tshogs bya:'dul khrims nyams pa'i bshags pa dus su bya:bslab pa shes bzhin bzung la pham ltung med par bya:dge 'dun sde gral sdod cing khyim pa'i sar mi sdod:khyad par bud med ma sring yin kyang bsten mi bya:kun gyi mchod gnas yin pas kha na ma tho spongs:de ltar byas na 'dir bde phyi mar lam sna zin:'khor ba spangs nas bud med btsun ma byas pa rnams:298

slo ba dpon padma'i zhal chems/las ngan skye ba dman pas mkhas btsun blos mi lcogs:skyes pa'i 'khri ba chod la 'dul khrims gtsang mar srungs:khyim pa'i sa la ma 'gro btsun ma'i sde la sdod:nyan bshad slob gnyer bya zhing dge ba ci nus bsag:kha ton bya zhing bskor ba phyag la nan tan skyed:bslab pa'i khrims la g.yo sgyu tshul 'chos med par srungs:btsun ma log na 'dir gshe phyi ma dmyal bar ltung:de bas sems stobs skyed la tshul khrims dam par srungs:padma 'byung gnas bdag ni da 'gro bas:da ltar bzhugs dang slad nas 'byon pa yi:bod kyi rab byung pho mo rnams kyi thugs la de ltar zhog:ces gsungs so: slob dpon padma'i skyes rabs dri ma med pa las: slob dpon padmas bod kyi btsun pa pho mo rnams la zhal chems su bzhag pa'i le'u ste nyer drug pa'o: :de nas ska cog rnam gnyis la sogs bod kyi dge bshes ston pa rnams kyis zhus pa: gu ru mi bzhugs rgya gar yul du gshegs 299

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dgongs na: phyi rabs bod kyi dge bshes ston pa rnams kyis ji ltar bgyi zhus pas: slob dpon gyis gsungs pa:mkhas shing yon tan ldan pa'i bod kyi dge bshes rnams:slob dpon mkhas grub ldan pa'i bla ma la:'dri klog nyan dang bsam brjod legs par gyis:sde snod gsum dang gsang sngags phyi nang ste:theg pa'i chos rnams kun la mkhas par slobs:shes bya rnams kyi yul kun sbyang ba'i phyir:rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la mkhas par slobs:mi gzhan bkur ba'i gnas gyur nas:bsod nams 'du 'dzi byung ba'i tshe:nga rgyal khengs sems phrag dog spongs:rang mthong che ba'i las mi bya:kha nas smra ba'i tshig rjes bslab:kun dang mthun par chos bzhin spyod:nga mkhas gzhan ni mi mkhas zhes:300

slob dpon padma'i zhal chems/kha na ma tho phrag dog spongs:slob gnyer 'dod pa'i gang zag la:ci dga' ci mos chos rnams slobs:rang gi bla ma slob dpon la:lus ngag yid gsum bkur snyi gyis:nor zas la sogs ci yod phul:chos la ngoms skyen ma byed par:mkhas pa rnams la 'dri zhing gtugs:che bcos stong ldir ma che bar:yon tan chos kyis gang bar gyis:mched grogs rnams la 'gran sems spongs:cung zad yon tan rnyed pa'i tshe:khengs shing rang 'dod ma che bar:gtsor ni kun la snying rjes zung:tshad med bzhi yi go cha bgos:rang rgyud chos kyis ma dul na:301

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gzhan dag 'dul bar ga la nus:mkhas nas rang rgyud dul bar gyis:padma 'byung gnas bdag ni da 'gro bas:da ltar bzhugs dang slad nas 'byon pa yi:bod kyi dge bshes ston pa rnams kyi thugs la de ltar zhog:ces gsungs so: slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs dri ma med pa las: slob dpon padmas bod kyi dge bshes ston pa rnams la zhal chems su bzhag pa'i le'u ste nyer bdun pa'o: :de nas sangs rgyas ye shes la sogs pa'i bod kyi sngags pa rnams kyis zhus pa: gu ru mi bzhugs rgya gar yul du gshegs dgongs na: phyi rabs bod kyi sngags pa rnams kyis ji ltar bgyi zhus pas: slob dpon gyis gsungs pa:gsang sngags sgor zhugs bod kyi sngags pa rnams:gsang sngags rtsa ba bla ma grub thob tshol:302

slob dpon padma'i zhal chems/gsang sngags chos sgo rim pa dbang gis phyes:gsang sngags srog tu dam tshig gtsang mar srungs:rdo rje slob dpon yan lag mgo ltar khur:yi dam lha ni khog pa'i snying ltar chongs:mkha' 'gro dam can lus kyi grib ltar bsten:gsang sngags zab mo mig gi 'bru ltar btsa':snying po zab mo khong gi dbugs ltar bgrang:bskyed rdzogs zab mo lus dang srog ltar sgoms:lta sgom spyod pa 'bras bu rlabs kyis bcad:mi dge bcu spongs dge bcu dang du longs:chos kyi phyir ni rang gi srog dang sdos:gtso ru bsnyen sgrub dang du blang ba gces:nya stong brgyad dang nyi shu gsum la ni:tshogs dang gtor ma btang zhing skor gsol bya:gdol spyod res chod mi bya slob dpon bzang la brten:'phrin las bon gyer mi bya gyer dang bsgom du bstun:303

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bsnyen sgrub 'phrin las rnam bzhi gzhung bzhin snyegs:gsang sngags dag la yid gnyis the tshom spongs:gsang sngags nor du mi btsong spel mi bya:rang gis bsgrub na dngos grub ci bsam 'grub:padma 'byung gnas bdag ni da 'gro bas:da ltar bzhugs dang slad nas 'byon pa yi:bod kyi sngags pa rnams kyi thugs la de ltar zhog:ces gsungs so: slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs dri ma med pa las: slob dpon padmas bod kyi sngags pa rnams la zhal chems su bzhag pa'i le'u ste nyer brgyad pa'o: :de nas zhang skye med rtogs grol la sogs bod kyi sgom chen rnams kyis zhus pa: slob dpon mi bzhugs rgya gar yul du gshegs dgongs na: phyi rabs bod kyi sgom chen rnams kyis ji ltar bgyi zhus pas: slob dpon gyis gsungs pa:ting 'dzin gtsor spyod bod kyi sgom chen rnams:lta ba thag chod dgongs pa can la zhus:304

slob dpon padma'i zhal chems/ sgom pa'i nyams len nyams rtogs can la nyon:spyod pa'i bya ba mnyam bzhag rjes thob sres:'bras bu sku gsum rang gsal rtogs par gyis:gsal 'debs bka' dang rgyud lung man ngag ltar:tshig la ma 'byams don la lta rtogs thong:gdams ngag can gyi bla ma bzang por bsten:sgom chen thos pa che na gol sa chung :yid ches med par sgom pa'i tshul mi bcos:the tshom bcad phyir grub thob rnams la gtugs:mi shes bzhin du tshul 'chos las mi bya:chos nyid mnyam pa'i don la gnas pa'i tshe:bying rgod la sogs skyon gyi khar mi btang:stong gsal ngang la nyin mtshan med par sgoms:chos nyid don thong rgyud la skyes pa'i tshe:bde sdug gang byung dge sbyor grogs su sgyur:chung ma byams kyang sgom chen g.yog mi bcol:305

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bud med slob ma zhabs tog che ba dang:mos gus che yang zhabs 'dren rgyu yin pas:'khor g.yog zhabs tog che yang rgyangs srings shig:'du long bsod nams bar chod g.yab mo yin:rang sems dpang du tshugs la yengs mi bya:de 'dra'i sgom chen mi lus rgyal ba'i thugs:padma 'byung gnas bdag ni da 'gro bas:da ltar bzhugs dang slad nas 'byon pa yi:bod kyi sgom chen rnams kyi thugs la de ltar zhog:ces gsungs so: slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs dri ma med pa las: bod kyi sgom chen rnams la zhal chems su bzhag pa'i le'u ste nyer dgu pa'o: :de nas nyang 'khrul zhig la sogs pa'i bod kyi rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis slob dpon la zhus pa: slob dpon mi bzhugs rgya gar yul du gshegs dgongs na: phyi rabs bod kyi rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis ji ltar bgyi zhus pas: slob dpon gyis gsungs 306

slob dpon padma'i zhal chems/pa:lta sgom gdeng dang ldan pa'i bod kyi rnal 'byor pa rnams gson dang:chos nyid ma bcos don gyi rnal 'byor pa:rig pa'i ye shes rtogs phyir rnal 'byor pa:rnal 'byor zhes pa ming du btags pa yin:lta ba zhe 'dod med pas phyogs ris khar mi btang:sgom pa dmiṭa gtad med pas sems 'dzin khar mi btang:spyod pa blang dor med pas ngar 'dzin khar mi btang:'bras bu spang thob med pas der 'dzin khar mi btang:dam tshig srung mtshams med pas zol zog khar mi btang:chos la phyogs ris med pas grub mtha'i khar mi btang:snang ba 'khrul ba yin no tha mal khar mi btang:kha zas srog 'tsho yin no mu to'i khar mi btang:nor rdzas sgyu ma yin no 'dod pa'i khar mi btang:gos ni lhags skyob yin no 'phyor gos khar mi btang:307

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mnyam pa gnyis med yin no 'khor gyi khar mi btang:rgyal khams phyogs med yin no pha yul khar mi btang:phug stong sdod sa yin no dgon pa'i khar mi btang:gcig pu rnal 'byor yin no 'dus pa'i khar mi btang:chags med zhen med yin no 'dzin chags khar mi btang:rang grol zhig po yin no zol zog khar mi btang:padma 'byung gnas bdag ni da 'gro bas:da ltar bzhugs dang slad nas 'byon pa yi:bod kyi rnal 'byor rnams kyi thugs la de ltar zhog:ces gsungs so: slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs dri ma med pa las: slob dpon padmas bod kyi rnal 'byor pa rnams la zhal chems su bzhag pa'i le'u ste sum cu pa'o: :de nas myos rin chen grags la sogs pa'i bod kyi skye bo rnams kyis zhus pa: slob dpon bod du mi bzhugs rgya gar yul du gshegs dgongs na: phyi rabs bod kyi skye bo rnams kyis ji ltar bgyi zhus pas: slob dpon gyis gsungs pa:308

slob dpon padma'i zhal chems/phyi rabs bod kyi skye bo rgas gzhon rnams:rgyal po'i rgyal khrims gnyan par zung:rje yi bka' lung gnyan par zung:sgos spyod yal bar dor nas ni:gtso bo'i spyi chos srog tu ltos:mna' ni gzan du mi bor zhing:chad pa thams cad btsan par bya:mang po rnams ni kha bsdus la:ngan pa khyad du mi gsod par:spyi gros byas na 'gyod pa med: mdzangs ma rnams kyis 'dun gros gyis:grwa gzungs thub la blo gtad bya:bsam shes rnams kyis zhal lce chod:dpa' bo rnams kyis dmag sna drongs:mtshon cha rnams kyis dmag dpung skyed:'khor g.yog rnams kyis mel tse gyis:309

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bran 'bangs rnams ni rim par skos:mis blo gtad na yid ma gcod:skyes pa mdzangs par 'gyur bas na:nor du srid dang gtam snyan sgrubs:bu tsha chos la mkhas bslab na:gtan gyi nor ni phyi phyir che:ci byed las la bsam gzhig bya:ma bsams byas na nyes pa mang:gal te bcos su yod na ni:de la mi dga' bya ci dgos:gal te bcos su med na ni:de la mi dga' byas ci phan:dal bus phyin na gar yang sleb:'jigs sar bskor na dgras mi 'phrog:'jam por smras na sus kyang go:zhal ta skad che kha phor go:310

slob dpon padma'i zhal chems/yun du bsrings na ci yang 'grub:dang drags yun thung gra sha 'chad:'di phyi'i don du lha chos gyis:yun gyi srin du 'di ka bzang:padma 'byung gnas bdag ni da 'gro bas:da ltar bzhugs dang slad nas 'byon pa yi:bod kyi skye bo rnams kyi thugs la de ltar zhog:ces gsungs so: slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs dri ma med pa las: slob dpon padmas bod kyi skye bo rnams la zhal chems su bzhag pa'i le'u ste so gcig pa'o: :de nas 'brom bza' byang chub ma la sogs pa'i bod kyi bud med rnams kyis zhus pa: slob dpon bod du mi bzhugs rgya gar yul du gshegs dgongs na: phyi rabs bod kyi bud med rnams kyis ji ltar bgyi zhus pas: slob dpon gyis gsungs pa:srid kyi mtsho mo bud med rnams:gnas kyi gzhi ma yin pas khyim gyi ga dar gyis:311

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/srid kyi mtsho mo yin pas bu tsha chos la tshud:lus kyi zla grogs yin pas khyo la bkur ste gyis:khyo bzang snying dang 'dra bas ci zer khyag par gyis:khyo ngan las 'phro yin pas rngan can snying ma ring:gyos sgyug pha ma 'dra bas bkur snyi phu dud gyis:yab skud pha ming 'dra bas zas dang khrel gyis skyongs:snyid mo 'grogs yun thung bas bkur la bzang bar gyis:mis 'phya rang la len pas ci gtam 'dzum dang sbyor:khro gtum nga rgyal che na su yang 'khor mi nyung:snang ba dgra ru sdang bas rtag tu dang spro srings:smra mang bud med lod pas 'jab 'jib ma mang mdzod:pha ming bstod cing bkur nas khrel la bzang bar gyis:bu lho'i lam rgyags yin pas mgron la yang bar gyis:'khor dang gnyen bshes zas kyis skyongs la gdung sems skyed:nor la 'dzin pa ma che zas la yang bar gyis:312

slob dpon padma'i zhal chems/ngo 'dzum gsal bo gyis la gtsang sbra che bar gyis:nub mo nyal phyi nang par sngar langs la:dus kyi so nam brtson 'grus phyir ma bshol:phyugs dang sgo khyi 'khor g.yog snying rjes sos:ci yod dkar po dge ba'i phyogs su thong:tshe 'dir byin rlabs phyi ma bde ba 'thob:padma 'byung gnas bdag ni da 'gro bas:da ltar bzhugs dang slad nas 'byon pa yi:bod kyi bud med rnams kyi thugs la de ltar zhog:ces gsungs so: slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs dri ma med pa las: slob dpon padmas bod kyi bud med rnams la zhal chems su bzhag pa'i le'u ste so gnyis pa'o: :de nas lo brgyad nyi khri 'bum la sogs pa'i bod kyi yon bdag rnams kyis zhus pa: slob dpon mi bzhugs rgya gar yul du gshegs dgongs na: phyi rabs bod kyi yon bdag rnams kyis ji ltar bgyi zhus pas: slob dpon gyis gsungs pa:313

legs bshad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ da wa da —trechos la klog 'don byed pa'i yon bdag rnams:mchod gnas rnams kyang bris klog legs par sbyongs:bris mkhan rnams kyang dang po yi ge ni:gzugs dang 'dogs ni legs par sbyongs:dkar nag phyed ni mnyam pa dang:lhag chad med la skyen par bris:yon bdag khe drags med pa yis :mchod gnas yon gyis mnyes par gyis :dad pa'i sems kyis yon phul la:zhe 'dod med par bzhes nas ni:rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob pa'i rgyur:mchod yon thun mong bsngos byas na:gnyis ka bsod nams rdzogs par 'gyur:yon bdag bsam pa ma dag cing:mchod 0/nas 'dod pa ma bskangs na:dge/ rtsar byas kyang sdig par 'gro:314

———— rnyesabatshod11zud nga//1:re pon95 bya)zugs//klog 'don byed pa'i mchod gnas rnams:dang po sgra skad byang bar slobs:bar du 'dren khungs sde dang sbyor:tha ma tshig gi lhag chad bsal:'don dus gzhan dang gtam ma smra:lhag chad med par gus pas thon: chos la lag g.yog med pa dang:thu yug 'gom yug ma gus spongs:bdag nyid bstan pa'i bdag ngo/ yis:chos kyi rnga chen sgrog pa'i tshe:'gro ba rigs drug sems can rnams:chos thos grol bar bsams nas bton:thun mtshams la sogs 'jog pa'i tshe:dge rtsa yon bdag mchod gnas kyis:thun mong byang chub thob par bsngo:yon bdag dad dang ldan pa yis:35

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mchod gnas mnyes pa'i 'du shes kyis:zas skom la sogs bzang ba dang:yon gyis mchod gnas mnyes par bya:de ltar byas na yon mchod gnyis:'dir bde phyi ma byang chub 'thob:de ltar ma yin yon mchod gnyis:tshar gyi grangs bzung yon gyi thang bcad na:mkhas kyang mi phan yon bdag mgyogs la dga':mkhas pa rnams kyis mi gzabs bshur nas 'don:mi mkhas rnams kyang thon skyon zin skyon byed:yon bdag rnams kyis rgyags phog bkur sti med:yon gyi bla mchod ma mnyes zhe 'khon song:mchod gnas yon la brten nas sdig pa bsags:yon bdag bsod nams 'dod kyang sdig pa 'phel:de 'dra'i yon mchod dus kyi tha mar 'ong:de ltar ma byed chos su ci 'gro gyis:316

slob dpon padma'i zhal chems/padma 'byung gnas bdag ni da 'gro bas:da ltar bzhugs dang slad nas 'byon pa yi:bod kyi yon mchod rnams kyi thugs la de ltar zhog:ces gsungs so: slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs dri ma med pa las: slob dpon padmas bod kyi yon mchod rnams la zhal chems su bzhag pa'i le'u ste so gsum pa'o: :de nas bla sman ne ru tse la sogs pa'i bod kyi sman pa rnams kyis zhus pa: slob dpon bod du mi bzhugs rgya gar yul du gshegs dgongs na: phyi rabs bod kyi sman pa rnams kyis ji ltar bgyi zhus pas: slob dpon gyis gsungs pa:'tsho mdzad sman pa lha rje bla sman kun:dang po sman gyi slob dpon mkhas pa'i rtsar:lag len sman sbyor rma chings legs par slobs:bar du slob dpon mnyes byas gdams ngag zhus:tha ma nad pa bcos dus snying rje skyed:rtsa chu phyi yul brtag la nad ngos zung:317

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ nad ngos mi zin sman sbyor byas pa yis:sman du ma song dug tu so nga bar 'ong:nad kyi ngos zin sman sbyor btang ba yis:me yi gnyen por chu yis gsod dang 'dra:dang po lag len ma byas sman pa'i nyams brod med:bar du gdams ngag med pas nad kyi ngos ma zin:tha ma sman bcos byas pas sman yang dug tu song:de ni nad pa'i gshed ma mtshon cha thogs pa yin:de ltar ma byed mkhas shing byang bar slobs:mkhas pa rnams kyis snying rje byams sems skyongs:nor gyi 'dod pa khong du bcug nas ni:myur du bcos na sos kyang na ru bcus/:zas skom bzang ngan ngor blta skyen bul byed:da lta 'tsho yang da rung na ru bcug:mi na rin rkang gla ha cang mi rigs phab:nad pa sos kyang log 'tsho phyi mar lji:318

ste—— da —dro—bhe/snya—dnghazi slobatsū/napadma'izhalardilo /byang chub sams dang nga nu/ kā gyur py-isaḥ'adod ༵ khong ṭwāṃ med nga sa shesamazengabasaḥnadnghapa ngarje snal sbyan zug gar zlo/cagaḥṭwāṃng ra~X sman ༵na me byaṭwāṃ bzang bas naḥm lhadirgyal bla darī/rdoskyeba' land bye/da ba// da 'byungaḥnd ṭwāṃ ku~X kyang spyoga'an bla ༵na~Xḥgyizas zug ngas rngasno sdi/bzhi pas skya/sa saḥsman rin gtong rag gces mi gces dang sbyor:py-id sdos/ zlonapa ṭwāṃgu bar ma byas naṭwāṃ 'ar la la ma dmyal bar 'aḥyangashiyang sos dmyal brno skye bar 'gyuraḥpadma 'byungaganasabadag da'asbya bsa~X da ltar bzhugs dang ༵da nas 'a/pazlond pa sman pa rnams thugs la ltar gamyoces gsungs soḥ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi skyes 9

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rabs dri ma med pa las: slob dpon gyis nad pa dang sman pa rnams la zhal chems su bzhag pa'i le'u ste so bzhi pa'o: :de nas bai ro tsa na la sogs pa'i slob dpon slob ma rnams kyis zhus pa: slob dpon mi bzhugs rgya gar yul du gshegs dgongs na: phyi rabs bod kyi slob dpon rnams kyis ji ltar bgyi zhus pas: slob dpon gyis gsungs pa:bod kyi dpon slob chos 'brel byed pa rnams:dang po slob dpon rnams kyang mkhas pa'i phul du phyin par slobs:bar du bsgrub par brtson pas chos la rtags thon bya:tha mar byang chub sems kyis 'gro don phyogs med gyis:lta ba thag chod gting dang ldan pa dang:dam tshig ma nyams pa la gzhi bzung nas:dbang dang lung nod rim pa thob par bya:ting 'dzin shes rab sbyor ba nyams su longs:mthun 'jug thabs kyi spyod pa la dor gyis:320

slob dpon padma'i zhal chems/gsang sngags mtha' drug rdzogs nas slob dpon bya:slob mas slob dpon btsal ba rnams kyis kyang:slob dpon brtags la mkhas grub mtshan ldan btsal:mnyes pa'i yon phul gus pas gdams ngag zhus:thos bsam sgom gsum chos la nan tan skyed:dbang dang lung nod rim pa rdzogs par zhus:sgrub la brtson pas rang don mthar phyin bya:grub rtags thon na gzhan don lha ru longs:slob dpon slob ma ma brtags snod med chos kyis 'brel:slob mas slob dpon ma brtags bcud med chos 'brel byed:chos kyi byin rlabs med pas bsgrubs kyang 'bras bu med:gnyis ka dam tshig ma bsrungs be'u sbrel g.yang la lhung:dmyal ba rin gyis nyos pas thar pa thob dus med:de ltar ma byed slob dpon slob ma rtog:slob ma dad gus che la snying rjer ldan:321

dge s+hoonabacosaphyokagog/ — ———dherha—rharha snang ba ṭwāṃṭwāṃ pas bla madhosangasargyasaltaḥmegurdzu papho sdus lda~X ngas da~X nga lhal daḥg1nga da la bana'agrudī4bal med:de 'dra'ibu lagabyerdzus ngag gsaparasloṭwāṃs:kha 'jam thabs sa 'dod gdong ltas da:ṭwāṃ che nga btsaṭwāṃ khengs ༵'i py-i rgyalabyed:jenaṭwāṃtang nus ga sgyu dga~X can:da da rnams la bstan ṭwāṃ dam grog nyams:padma 'byung gnas bdag da'abyo bas:yi~X ltar zlozhuṭwāṃs dang slad ṭwāṃs 'anardo :'olob dan ba ma rnam/sa ༵gsal ltar/ga:kyiskyeces gsungs so: slob dan padma 'byung gnas / sa rabs dri ma med pa las: slob dpen padmas bod kyi slo ba dpon /grobye khroX/ /byerto /nyebye /bye(/chesgo /ste/thes(sa 'al da pa rnams la zhal mas su bzhag pa 'u / lnga nga///9 ོ bi ske bo kyispyi nas slo ba dpan 4sa tso rabs da mthun rnams la

slob dpon padma'i zhal chems/'al chems su gsungs pa:mtha' 'khob bod kyi rgyal blon rje 'bangs rnams:snying rje phan sems chung ba gdong dmar srin po'i rigs:khrel 'dzem ngo tsha chung ba spre'u pha yi rigs:gtong sme zhe sdang che ba brag srin ma yi rigs:yid blo chos la gnag pa nag po bdud kyi rigs:nor la 'dod sred che ba byol song mi yi rigs:dge ba ma spyad phyi ma ngan song gsum du lhung:tshe la long med 'chi bas brjed ngas ma che 'i/ga:'dus pa 'bral ba yin no 'thab rtsod ma mang zhig:bsags pa lus pa yin no nor dad ma che zhig:chags na 'ching ba yin no zhen pa ma che zhig:skyes pa 'chi ba yin no phyi ma dran par gyis:sdig pas dmyal bar 'gro bas bzod glags ga la yod:ser snas yi dwags skye bas bkres skom sdug bsngal yod:chos med byol song yin pas khyod kyis shes par gyis:323

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mi tshe g.yar po yin no gar 'bor cha med do:snang ba sgyu ma yin no mi rtag go bar gyis:zas nor zil pa yin no nam 'bor cha med do:'khor g.yog shul ka'i mgron po yin pas shes par gyis:dgra sdang 'khrul pa yin pas 'khrul par go bar gyis:gnyen 'brel 'khor ba'i 'brid mkhan yin pas cha yod gyis:bu tsha lan chags snyeg mi yin pas shes par gyis:mi tshe yengs pa'i gtam la zad pa'i mtha' med pas:'chi bdag gshin rje'i nyul ma byung ba ma tshor ram:gdong dmar srin po bod kyi mi rnams nga la nyon:ngan song gsum gyi skyel ma dkon mchog gsum la tshol:'di phyi'i brten sa bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gror gyis:thar pa'i 'gro sa lta sgom spyod gsum nyams len gyis:bod kyi lha skal thugs rje chen po lha ru zung:mi dge bcu spongs dge ba bcu po dang du longs:324

slob dpon padma'i zhal chems/de ltar byas na 'dir bde phyi ma je bder 'gro:padma 'byung gnas bdag ni da 'gro bas:da ltar bzhugs dang slad nas 'byon pa yi:bod 'bangs spyi mthun rnams kyi thugs la de ltar zhog:ces gsungs so: slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs dri ma med pa las: slob dpon padmas bod 'bangs spyi mthun rnams la zhal chems su bzhag pa'i le'u ste so drug pa'o::zhes slob dpon padma'i rnam thar zangs gling ma las 'byung ba'o: :325

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ ༄༅/ /kha che pha lu'i 'jig rten las 'bras rtsi lugs kyi bslab bya bzhugs so/ /oṃswasnyi/ sngon rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul na sangs rgyas dgung lo bcu la phebs pa na/ 'dzam gling spyi dang lhag par yul dga' ba'i g.yas g.yon du rtags dang rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa dang / rdzu 'phrul mkhas btsun grangs med du mdzad pa rnams 'dri dgos dang / shod dgos byung na mi tshe'i kha la mi tshe mang po dgos 'dug pas/ mtshams kyis zhu bar/ dgung lo bcu la phebs pa'i dus / dang po drang po'i gter mdzod/ gnyis pa khrims kyi 'byung khungs/ gsum pa ngo tsha'i rgya mtsho/ bzhi pa sbyin pa'i rgyal po/ lnga pa chos gnang ba sogs rtsa ba lung dang mnyam pa'i sdong po la lo 'dab rgyas pa lta bu'i chos 'jig rten/ las rgyu 'bras/ khrel ngo tsha/ byams snying rje/ lam lugs srol sogs gang ci rgya mtsho 326

—da da ༷—chephalu'i'ajig rten las 'bras rtsi lug/sa/thigs pa'i thigs pa dum bu brgya phrag mang por btang ba'i bslab bya'i tshigs bcad mu tig dar la brgyus pa bzhin 'di brtsams tshig dag kha che pha lu 'ju yis yig thog tu bkod pa'i bslab bya dngos grub chu mig ste/bslab bya le'u dang po/chos kyi 'byon khungs rdo rje'i khri yi thog /rgyab tu chos kyi brag ri dbu 'phang mtho/ /mdun du snying rje'i mtsho mo 'od kyis khengs/ /dbyar dgun med pa nyin mtshan ring thung snyoms/ /dbyar kha dro rgyu dgun kha grang rgyu med/ /dbyar dgun ring thung dro grang ldan pa'i sa/ /nyi ma nam mkha'i dgung du slebs pa'i dus/ /khang khyim mun pa grib so 'khor rgyu med / /de tsho 'dzam gling lte ba'i brtag dpyad yin/ /lte ba de nas lte bar 'gro ba'i lam /lte ba'i lte ba de kru phyag 'tshal lo/ /327

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bod kyi skad du dkon mchog rin po che/ /rang re'i skad du go brtswa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du 'gro 'dod na/ /sems pa'i yul na gti mug shul med bzos/ /'dod chags nag po rgya mtsho'i gting la bskur/ /chags sdang zhe sdang dmar po'i me la spor/ /bsam rgyu gcig la bsgom rgyu dran rgyu gcig /gcig la gnyis kyi 'brel so med zer na/ /chos la 'gro chas sgrigs shig pha yi bu/ /'gro gin 'gro gin ltad mo mthong yong ngo / /byas tshad chos dang btang tshad lam la 'gro/ /bsams tshad thog dang dgos tshad lag tu thebs/ /lab tshad gtam dang dgos tshad 'ben la phog /de 'dra'i sa ru 'gro 'dod yod zer na/ /dgos rgyu'i snying po don gyi rdo kha gsum/ /dang po sems dpa' me long bzhin du dwangs gcig dgos//328

kha che pha lu'i 'jig rten las 'bras ji lugs/gnyis pa dam tshig gtsang chu bzhin du gtsang gcig dgos//gsum pa la rgya seṅge bzhin du che gcig dgos/ /de gsum 'dzoms na de ru slebs pa red/ /de 'dra'i sa ru slebs pa'i pho gzhon tsho/ /rang la rang gis go ba ma bskon na/ /'jig rten 'di yi 'khor du thim yong ngo / /sang sang gnangs gnangs zer gyin 'gyangs yong ngo / /de 'dra'i ngang nas 'bod mkhan slebs yong ngo / /de dus 'gyod pa'i gling la brgyab yong ngo / /kha sur sdong po skam po'i rdo la skyes/ /yal ga lo 'dab de ma thag tu rgyas/ /'dab lo re re'i thog tu mtshan re 'khrungs/ /mkhas pa yongs kyi rig pa mi nyams pa/ /lte ba'i snyan zhu lte ba'i drung du phul/ /bka' shog rgyab dang dam phrug sku rgyab tu/ /gtsug gi nor bu don gyi rdo kha'i tshig /329

legs bshad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ — da wasdig chen bdag dang 'khor ba'i sems can sogs/ /chos kyi lam sna zin pa'i snyan zhu dang / /'di dang phyi ma gnyis kyi bzhag sa la/ /'bral ba med par thugs rjes rgyang nas gzigs / /ye shes spyan gyis gzigs nas thugs la zhog /byams dang brtse bas bskyangs nas 'a/ma sna drongs/ /skar chen 'od kyi gling la zhal gzigs nas/ /skar chung tshig brgya lnga bcu nga gnyis bar/ /smyu gu'i bshad pa smyu gus go song ngo /nag po'i ri mo dkar po'i tshig gis khengs/ /kha che pha lu'i bsnyel gso dran pos phul/ /bslab bya le'u gnyis pa/chos dang 'jig rten khag khag so so red/ /sems dang lus po rang rang so so red/ /sems pa dka' ba spyad nas 'gro 'dod kyang // /lus po zhim pa bzas nas sdod 'dod che/ /330

kha che pha lu'i 'jig rten las 'bras rtsi lugs/lus po skyid por sdod pa zhag gsum dang / /sems pa sdug pa phugs nas phugs su sdug /sems skyid 'dod na lus kyis dka' ba spyod/ / lus po bsams na sems pa sdug la sbyor/ /nga la nyan na lus sems dbye ba chod/ /gser dang ra gan brje mi smyon pa red/ /g.yu dang do lo nor na lkugs pa red/ /'di dang phyi ma'i khe gyong mi shes na/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i mi tshe 'khyol 'gro zer/ /lo gcig lo gnyis mi dgos brgya yi bar/ /tha ma sa rdo'i phung po sa la thim/ /rgyal ngo gser khri'i steng du bzhugs pa dang / /sprang phrug ben po'i 'og tu sdod pa gnyis/ /mi rtag 'chi ba byung dus 'dra 'dra red/ /zas kyi zhim ma ngar lce nas mid pa'i bar/ /'khor ba'i skyid sdug zhag gsum 'di yi ring / /331

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/sprang po sdug kyang mi tshe 'khyol 'gro lo/ /rgyal po skyid kyang tha ma shi 'gro lo/ /de snga song ba'i grangs ka mi shes 'dug /da dung 'gro rgyu'i gdeng tshod su yis shes/ /yong gin yong gin 'gro gin 'gro gin 'dug /don du yong mi tshang ma 'gro mi red/ / 'khor ba 'di la rtag pa gcig kyang med/ /rtag pa med par bden pa su la yod/ /rtag pa brtan pa med pa'i mi tshe 'di/ /la mgo'i kha yi khri gdugs nyi ma 'dra/ /byon na ma gtogs bzhugs rgyu yong mdog med/ /da dung phru gu'i snang bas ma yengs par/ /mkhas pa yin na don gyi rdo kha sgril/ /don rtsa bsgril na dpa' bo'i yang rtse red/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i las la snying po med/ /'khor ba gtan du sdod pa'i sa ma red/ /332

kha che pha lu'i 'jig rten las 'bras rtsi lugs/'grul pa zhag gsum gnas tshang gnas mgron red/ /so so'i bsam blo so sos btang ba dga'/ /'grul pas 'gro chas sngon nas ma bsgrigs na/ /gnas tshang rgyab tu khyer nas 'gro rgyu med/ /gnas mo rogs la khrid rgyu yod mdog med/ /rang nor rang la bdag dus bsam blo thongs/ /lde mig mi la shor dus 'gyod pa'i rgyu/ /pha ma shi ba mang po byung yod 'gro/ /phru gu bsdad pa mang po mthong yod 'gro/ /a ma'i rjes la o lo 'gro mdog med/ /a ma'i mjug la bu mo 'gro mdog med/ /so so'i nam dus so sos bskyal nas 'gro/ /khyod rang khyod ra'i bsam blo khyod ras thongs/ /gcig pur 'gro ba'i lam gyi lam chas 'di/ /sngon sngon sngon la sprang po'i lag tu skur/ /nor gyi rta la 'gro ba'i bang 'gros slobs/ /333

wa9stukhabashadako— bcosaphyogs bsgrigs/ —phyi ma 'gro ba'i lam la thon chog gyis/ /pha rol phyug po longs spyod dgos 'dod na/ /'di ru sprang po'i skyid sdug bltas pa bzang /sa yi 'og tu kham bu za 'dod na/ /sa steng 'di ru kham sdong btsugs pa bzang / /kun la bde ba'i rtsa ba btsugs pa bzang / /chos kyi rtsa ba mi sem/sa 'dzin rgyu med/ /chos kyi snying po gzhan don 'grig le red/ /a rang a ra'i 'dod pa zin 'dod na/ /chang dang a rag de las lhag pa med/ /nga nga nga rgyal zer ba'i bang rgyal can/ /gser dngul bzang dang gtam don nga zer zhing / /zhim po nga dang 'jam po nga zer gyi/ /legs po nga dang mdzes po nga zer gyi/ /gnas bzang bskor kyang rkang chung na rogs red/ /ri khrod 'grims kyang rna cog tsha rogs red/ /334

kha che phalu'i'ajigartenalasa'abraṣartsi'ugs—/—ṅgerlung la gcus bskor mthong yang stong pa red/ /rde'u bcud len rang sdug rang gis nyos/ /bya lugs byed lugs ldan pa'i pha rgan tsho/ /'dod pa can gyi chos pa brgya las lhag /rang 'dod can gyi mi la ngo tsha med/ /ngo tsha med pa'i mi de dud 'gro'i rgyud/ /bu mo rgyan dang gos kyis spud gyur kyang / /nor bzang rgya lu'i btsun mor nyan mdog med/ /semyo/sa gos ma chod lha chos byas gyur kyang / /me long mun pa'i gling du gsal mdog med/ /chu 'thag glang gi mig de yol bas bsgribs/ /nyin gang so/nga yang dgong mo sa der lus/ /'dod pa'i zhags thag rkang nas ma khrol na/ /lha chos byas song zer yang stong pa red/ //gshog sgro dar gyi skud pas bsdams pa na/ /rgod po yin kyang nam 'phang gcod mdog med/ /33 5

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dam tshig sems dang brtson 'grus snying nas dgos/ /thug rgyu gang yod ci yod sems la thug /lam bu 'di ni sems pa drung gi lam/ /sems la gad bdar yang nas yang du rgyob/ /tshang mas smon rgyu e yong ltos shig ang / /gtam bzang 'khyer rgyu e yong ltos shig ang / /srol bzang gzhag rgyu e yong ltos shig ang / /de gsum 'dzoms na dang po'i dang po red/ /kha che pha lu'i snying gtam bshad yod do/ /nyan dang mi nyan so so'i bsam blo red/ /yin kyang rgya shog ri mos khengs song ngo / /rgya smyug ser po'i blo kha rdzogs song ngo / /bslab bya le'u gsum pa/rgyal po chen po yul gyi rgyan cha red/ /khrims dang mthun na rgyal gzhis mnga' thang ldan/ /khrims 'go non na bsam don lhun gyis 'grub/ /336

kha che pha lu'i 'jig rten las 'bras rtsi lugs/khrims gzhung ldan na bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /mtsho mo 'atātags na nya mo las kyis 'atākṣa/ /lung pa dbul na rgyal po las kyis dbul/ /rje dpon dar zhing rgyal po sa sde'i 'phrul/ /yul sde med pa'i rje dpon dgod re bro/ /dpon 'bangs nad pa em rje'i dpe bzhin du/ /gtsag bu btsugs pa'i shul la rma sman thobs/ /bka' bkyon dgongs 'tshoms gzhug la byams skyong mdzod/ /dang po nyes pa bca' yang phebs dang bstun/ /gnyis pa nyes pa'i thog tu nyes rdung thongs/ /gsum pa mi ngan rtsa med bzos kyang rung / /de 'dra'i mi la snying rje lta dgos med/ /lu gu ma khyer gong la spyang ki srungs/ /yul bde ma 'khroms gong la mi ngan phud/ /rgyal po zho ltar chags nas nyal bsdad na/ / 337

legs bshad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ da wa yul sde khrag ltar 'khrugs pa mi shes so/ /lug rdzi ja chang gnyis la mgo 'khor na/ /lu gu spyang kis 'khyer ba dngos bden red/ /gang la mkhas pa'i mi de las la mngags/ /shing bzo mkhas kyang lha bris yong mdog med/ /spyang ki dga' yang lug rdzi nyan mdog med/ /las 'bras can la mi yi rje dpon skos/ /lu gu spyang ki'i kha la bcug yong ngo /yon tan can la don gyi rdo kha sgril/ /nor bu dgos na rgya mtsho'i gting la yod/ /dam tshig gtsang ma'i mi la blo gtad bcol/ /rdo rje'i brag la 'gyur ba ci la srid/ /nyin mtshan med par mkhas pa'i mi dang bstun/ /tshwa kha'i khyi ro mtha' ma tshwa la 'gro/ /sha cha can la skyong mthar rim par sprod/ /byas rjes drud shul byung na blo kha rdzogs/ /338

da wa khachephalu'i'ajigartenalasa'abrasatram̐(kha sa /wabyas pa can gyi sems pa pham ma bcug / bya rgyu mdun du yod dus byed mkhan mang / /blo gtad bcol mi rnams tsho mtha' nas skyongs/ /'dzam bu'i gling 'dir gtam bzang skad kyis khengs/ /dpa' rtsal can la dal dus bdag po sprod/ /'gag rtsar thug dus dgos pa'i dus shig yong / /rgyun du bang mdzod nor gyis brgyang rgyu gyis/ /rkyen rtsa lhag yong dgra bo mchongs yong ngo / /dgra mgo 'dul bar dgos rgyu'i dgos cha gnyis/ /nor dang dpung gis dgra bo cham la 'bebs / /nor rdzas med par dpung rogs yong thabs med/ /dpung rogs 'tshol bar nor rdzas med thabs med/ /de gnyis 'dzoms na dgra bo las kyis 'joms /nor la pha mas bu tsha gso gso mdzod/ /lo mang song ba'i rgad po'i kha la nyon/ /skyid sdug mang po myong ba'i mi rgan red/ /339

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/lcags kyi lcags ri'i mtshams su slebs pa'i dus/ /gzhon pa'i shed las rgad po'i jus bya bzang / /dgra bo 'phral gang 'phral la 'dul 'dod na/ /skabs thog grogs la bkug nas bsdad pa bzang / /thabs kyi sgo nas don rtsa lon zer na/ /mda' gri mdung gsum 'phyar rgyu smyon pa'i las /mi thub dgra dang 'dzing 'dzing bzhag pa dga'/ /mdzog rum gtsag bu'i steng du rgyag mdog med/ /'dan ma mi dgos ge sar dngos yin kyang / /'grig tsam byung na 'grig pa gtso don che/ /gdong bsu dpa' bo rgyal khams nyes su khag /thabs rnams 'phrul gyi me mda' rgyang nas 'phen/ /dang po thabs rnams dgu bcu go dgu gtod/ /brgya la 'khrug dgos byung yang bya thabs med/ /go ba med pa'i mi de khyi las lod/ /khyi ngan byung na ber ga rna la bkri/ /340

kha che pha lu'i 'jig rten las 'bras rtsi lugs/phyin gtong zer na phyin rgyu'i lam bu thongs/ /'dzing thongs zer na gom gsum sngon la spos/ /'dzem re khong khro slong dus ma dran na/ /rjes su dran na rang gi kha la rgyob/ /don rtsa 'jam po'i sgo nas lon zer na/ /nga rgyal khong khro don med stong pa red/ /khong khro dbang du 'dus na mkhas pa'i rtags/ /khong khro'i rjes la 'gro mi glen pa red/ /bsam blo sngon la thongs na mkhas pa dang / /rkyen rtsa mdun du lhags pa sus kyang mthong / /dung dkar g.yas 'khyil gcog pa sus kyang mthong /chag pa sgrig dgos byung na nya sgrig yong / /dgra bo mgo bo bsgur nas slebs byung na/ / snying gi khong khro sems kyi gting nas thon/ /mgo bo bsgur ba'i dgra bo pham ma 'jug /yin kyang khram dang g.yo sgyur dogs zon dgos/ /341

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gtsang po mkhar gyi dkyil zhabs rgyugs pa de/ /rags rgyag ma byung mtha' mar mkhar la gshed/ /ngan pa bskyangs na bzang po brdungs pa 'dra/ /rkun po gsos na chos pa bsad pa 'dra/ /dug sbrul bzhag na mgo nag mi la gnod/ /spyang ki bzhag na g.yang dkar lug la ngan/ /khyi yis mi la rmugs pa yin mi zhu/ /khyi ngan bdag 'dzin byed mkhan mi ngan red/ /dgra mgo 'dul mkhan gnyen mgo skyong mkhan dgos/ /'jam rang drags na dgra bo gnya' rengs yong / /gyong rang drags na 'gag la thug pa'i nyen/ /'jam rtsub bsres nas kun la mdong lugs mdzod/ /dgra gnyen tshang ma thabs kyis grogs su khugs/ /'phral dang phugs kyi rgyal sa 'dzin 'dod na/ /nye ring med par gser khri'i thog nas drongs/ /yul bde mi bde yong ba'i dgongs pa dang / /342

kha che pha lu'i 'jig rten las 'bras rtsi lugs/dgong mo sa la babs la chos la 'bungs/ /lus ngag yid gsum phyag 'tshal smon lam thobs /gtan gyi re sa dkon mchog gsum la zhu/ /rin chen skar ma'i bdag po'i bka' dang bstun/ /'di phyi gnyis kyi dbu 'phang mtho dgos na/ /mi rtag 'chi ba ma brjed thugs la zhog /'dod 'dod kha che pha lu'i gros gros kyi/ /don gyi snyan zhu mu tig dar la brgyus/ /khams gsum dbang 'dus drung du phul yod do/ /rin thang skor dus brgya star grangs su tshud/ /bslab bya le'u bzhi pa/'jig rten 'di ru sgang gshongs mang zhig 'dug /skyid sdug ring thung sbom phra grangs med red/ /'dra 'dra gcig kyang med pa mthong gsal red/ /'di la chog shes rang gis byas pa dga'/ /thod pa'i ri mo bsubs kyang zub rgyu med/ /343

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/de las ri mo'i 'gro lugs bstun pa dga'/ /lcog rong bong bu sdug kyang rang sdug red/ /sgal pa'i rgyab khur ma khyer ka med red/ /sems gos chod na nor la mang nyung med/ /chog shes med pa'i rgyal po sprang po dang / /sems gos chod na sprang po de las lhag /rgyal po rgyal gzhis zos nas ltogs lhang lhang / /sprang phrug thang rkyal khengs nas spo dgye dgye/ /bkod pa'i las la chog shes ma byas na/ /rang sdug rang gis nyo ba don med red/ /chog shes ldan na phyug dang ma phyug med/ /las la bkod na dgra nor rang gi nor/ /ma bkod pha nor bu la bdag pa dka'/ /ljang pa rdo yi steng du skye mdog med/ /sbag sbag sig sig byas pas ci la phan/ /sems pa shor na pha bzang bu la shor/ /344

kha che pha lu'i 'jig rten las 'bras rtsi lugs/chog shes byas na lus sems bde la 'jog /lag len ngan pa'i rigs la spang bya gyis/ /pha bde bu skyid yong ba'i bsam blo thongs/ /'di phyi gnyis kyi gtam don lag pa'i mthil /kha che pha lu'i snying gtam kha nas lus/ /snying gi bu tsho snying nas rna ba nyon/ /go ba yod na go rgyu bris yod do/ /mang po med kyang bro ba bcud dang ldan/ /bslab bya le'u lnga pa/dbyar kha lcag/sa dang dgun kha rdzo la ltos/ /dbyar dgun med pa dmar po'i lce la ltos/ /snying gtam snying gi grogs la shod tshod gyis/ /snga grogs dgong dgrar song ba mang po yod/ /gser dngul mi la bcol dgos byung yang 'chol/ /bcol po gtod kyang btsal nas rnyed pa red/ /snying gtam mi la bcol bcol mang drags na/ /345

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/lag mgo kha la bcug nas sdod dgos yong / /gtam gyi bdud po snying gi dong du tshud/ /kha la lcags dang lce la sgo lcags rgyob/ /bdud po dong nas shor na mi pho gsod/ /'a rdzi byas pa tsam gyis ci la phan/ /mi shod dgu shod shod rgyu mang drags na/ /mi la ma shod zer gyin sdod dgos yong / /nar nar lce la bdag po ma brgyab na/ /ril ril dbu la 'o rgyal bzos yong ngo / ma bshad gtam de ga dus bshad bshad red/ /bshad nas 'gyod dgos byung na tha ma'i las/ /ma bshad bar du gtam la rang dbang thob/ /bshad na gtam gyi dbang du shod mkhan tshud/ /bzang po yongs la ngan pa lab nyen che/ /bzang po'i bslab bya ngan pa'i dgra la 'gro/ /de las bzang ngan tshang ma bzang pos skyongs/ /346

kha che pha lu'i 'jig rten las 'bras ji lugs/bzang po dgra mgo ngan pas bzlog pas bstun/ /gtam la drang ba'i mi de sems nas drang / /sems pa drang na chos kyi lam sna zin/ /da lta de las phugs yul skyid kyang skyid/ /'di phyi gnyis kyi bsam don lhun gyis 'grub/ /kha che pha lu'i 'dod dang snag smyug thug /dkar po'i thog tu nag po'i bris cha gsal/ /bris mi sa 'og bris cha sa yi thog /'dzam gling ma bsnyel bsam blo'i dran gso mdzod/ /bslab bya le'u drug pa/'dzam gling me long phar blta tshur blta red/ /'khor ba brag ri bzhin du kha lan slog /rang gis gar bltas me long nang du gsal/ /rang gis gang lab brag ris kha lan slog /bzang na bzang dang ngan na ngan gyi lan/ /'di ni yong rgyu 'jig rten 'khor ba'i las/ /347

da legasabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/tshang mas smon pa'i 'dod pa med zer na/ / gzhan la ma lab rang la dogs zon gyis/ /tshang ma rang gi mdog dang mthun yong ngo / /gang byas lag pa'i mthil du gsal yong ngo /gzhan la dga' tshod khyed rang dga' med yin/ /gang ltar bzang la bzang dang ngan la ngan/ /dug shing sdong pos kham bu ster mdog med/ /kham bu dgos na kham sdong 'gram la song / /rin chen gser gyi 'dod pa yod zer na/ /don med mun pa'i gling du ma song zhig /gzhan nas lags lags lugs lugs dgos zer na/ /rang la lagasalags lugs lugs mang nyung dgos/ /che 'dod cajid la che ba yong ba dka'/ /de yi thabasdo/ la che 'dod bzhag pa dga'/ /byams po byas na dgra yang gnyen la 'gro/ /rtsub tshod ma zin bu yang zhen pa log /348

kha che pha lu'i 'jig rten las 'bras rtsi lugs/thod pa'i ri mo gyen la yod pa'i mi/ /so dkar 'dzum legs mi sems 'dzin par mkhas/ /las bzang byas nas thar pa'i lam bu la/ /gtam bzang khyer nas song zhig pha yi bu/ /ri mo thur la yod pa'i mi ngan la/ /dug sbrul khyi smyon gnyis kyi brtag dpyad tshang / /nyin mtshan med par rmug rgyu kho las med/ /lag len ngan pas thal ba bslangs nas 'gro/ /bzang po 'ongs pa'i rjes la gtam bzang yod/ /bzang po'i lo la bzang po'i 'bras bu smin/ /ngan pa'i 'bras bu ngan pa'i ske la 'khril/ /ngan pa'i rjes la ltas ngan gtam ngan yod/ /rgya smyug ser po'i kha nas tshig gsum lus/ /rgya shog dkar po'i sems la gsal yong ngo /rgya skad bod kyi skad la 'gyur song ngo /kha che pha lu'i blo thag chod song ngo / /349

/legasabashadabastanabacosaphyogasabasgri.u—/da wa— rha da da wabaslab bya le'u bdun pa/dma' sa bzung nas gang cir bzod pa sgoms/ /don gyi rdo kha rang gi snying du zhog /mi sems 'dzin pa'i skad cha shod kyin song / /rang don sgrig pa'i jus cha gtong gin song / /stong pa kha yis khengs pa'i don rtsa longs/ /de 'dra'i thabs la dma' sa bzung ba dga'/ /dma' sa bzung ba'i mi la dga' mkhan mang / /de 'dra'i mi la yid nas phan mkhan mang / /mi tshe ja chang longs spyod ngang la 'gro/ /'dir bzhugs 'dir 'byon zer mkhan mang po yong / /'dod pa'i rta rgod tshod kyi srab kha 'then/ /gang sa ci thad rang tshod rang gis zungs/ /'gro tshod sdod tshod shod tshod byed tshod dang / /skyid po byed tshod sdug po'i 'khur tshod dang / /zhim po'i za tshod 'jam po'i gyon tshod rnams/ /350

da wa da wa —da wa khachephalu'i'ajig rten las 'bras rtsi lugs/mi la tshang na mkhas pa'i yang rtse yin/ /de 'dra'i mi la skar ma'i bdag po rnyed/ /da lta de las phugs yul las 'bras yang / /'dod pa tshod kyi phyi la shor dang gcig /tshod la sems kyi bkod pa med dang gnyis/ /de 'dra'i mi dang bsdebs nas bsdad gzhan 'dra/ /de 'dra'i chag sgo'i nang la khrid yong ngo /las la tshod med tha ma phung ba'i gzhi/ /tshong la tshod med mtha' gzhug pham pa'i gzhi/ /kha la tshod med rkub la nyo ba'i gzhi/ /dgod la tshod med mtha' gzhug ngu ba'i gzhi/ /'khor ba'i g.yas g.yon g.yang dang gad pa'i gling / /zag na zag chog ril na ril chog red/ /de 'dra'i lam du 'gro bzo sdod mkhas mdzod/ /gdong drug 'khor ba 'brog pa'i sho dang 'dra/ /spa ra lca mo gang thon nges med red/ /351

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/khe gyong snying la bcangs nas 'gro lugs mdzod/ /khe yi sgo mo dbye rgyu'i thabs la ltos/ /gyong gi lam bu dgag rgyu'i byus la ltos/ /khe gyong gnyis la sbom phra shor ba'i dus/ /sdug snying mnan nas sdug tshod bzung ba dga'/ /tshod med kha che pha lu'i tshod nas shor/ /gtam gyi nor bu shog bu'i thang la shor/ /rin thang bskor dus skor thang ma log mdzod/ /nom pa 'dzir nas yod do pha yi bu/ /bslab bya le'u brgyad pa/zhim tshad ma za 'jam tshad ma gyon cig /kha lus gnyis kyis sdug la sbyar yong ngo / /khog pa'i bongs tshad che yang de thams cad/ /za ma gcig po'i sdod sa yin mdog med/ /mig dang grod pa gnyis la khengs rgyu med/ /lto tshod za tshod rang gis byas pa dga'/ /352

kha che pha lu'i 'jig rten las 'bras rtsi lugs/grod pa thab la 'tshod 'tshod mang drags na/ /sdug rtswa thug dus sbyid bu grang ba mthong / /mi la re ba'i ja chang longs spyod las/ /rang gi rtswa rkyang chu rkyang bro ba zhim/ /las ngan shan pa'i dreg khu bza' ba las/ /dmar dad langs na shig kyang za ba dga'/ /za rgyu nyal rgyu ba dang bong bu'i las/ /de 'dra byas pa e dga' pha yi bu/ /khyi dang grod pa lag nas shor song na/ /rta ro bong ro'i thog la shor nyen che/ /grod pa'i sgo la bsdam tshod ma byas na/ /gtam gyi nor bu rku la shor ba'i nyen/ /gtam gyi phu thung 'jol 'jol dgos 'dod na/ /grod pa'i lag mgo thung du bcug pa dga'/ /chu nang nya mo spags la dad pas phung / /byi ba byi'u 'jol pad kha zos pas lan/ /353

legs bshad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ — — ——— byi ba smug chung ltogs la za 'dod kyis/ /sa mda' sko la zug pa za ma'i skyon/ /byang thang wa mo rang tshod ma zin na/ /mgo lpags thang la bshu ba za ma'i skyon/ /stag dmar ngar bzhin bu bzhin 'dzin rgyu 'di/ /stag rgan lug la khyi ltar mchongs pas nyes/ /mkhas pa 'di yin zhu rgyu med lags kyang / /dkar po'i thog tu nag po'i bris cha gsal/ /kha che pha lu sa 'og song na yang / / rgya shog logs kyi snag tsha'i ri mo 'di/ /sa steng yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /tshang ma'i yid du 'ong ba'i bkra shis shog /bslab bya le'u dgu pa/'jig rten lta lugs gcig la mthong lugs gnyis/ /lta lugs gcig la rigs kyang rigs gcig 'dug / pha yis bu dang bu yis pha byed pa/ /354

kha che pha lu'i 'jig rten las 'bras rtsi lugs/de 'dra bsams na thung thung ga nas yin/ /ma bsams gyur na pha bu'i dam tshig nyams/ /dam nyams lag len sdang ba'i dgra la 'gyur/ /phru gu pha ma med pa mi srid kyang / /lag thog ston rgyu yod pa re re tsam/ /tshe stod yod kyang tshe smad med pa mang /pha bu'i dam tshig bsrung dus bsrungs pa dga'/ /dus tshod chu tshod ma 'gyangs grol nas 'gro/ /'thus shor med par bu la yon tan slobs/ /yon tan kun gyi rtsa ba yi ge dang / /yon tan yongs kyi rgyal po yi ge red/ /phru gu'i yi ge gser khri'i steng du skyol/ /mi pho'i yi ge stag gdan steng du 'jog /bla ma'i chos rar yi ge me long red/ / rgyal po'i khrims rar yi ge 'bras bu red/ /yig yod mig yod mkhas pa sprul pa'i rgyud/ /355

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ yig med mig med long ba lkugs pa'i rgyud/ /kyog kyog yi ge gzhu ltar 'khyog gyur kyang / /don rtsa mda' las 'drong ba de ru tshang / /yon tan rin chen dgos 'dod kun 'byung red/ /dgos 'dod kun 'byung dgos mir thogs pa med/ /don du mi la yon tan tshang ba dgos/ /nor rdzas mtshams re song 'gro mtshams re yong / /nor la bskyur brlag rkun mas 'khyer ba'i nyen/ /yon tan rin chen 'dzad med phugs kyi gter/ /na so gzhon dus bu la sbyong thar slobs/ /na so longs nas bslab dgos med pa gyis/ /lcang gsar gzhon dus 'drongs na 'drongs pa red/ /lcang rgan srong srong mang na chag pa'i nyen/ /ngan pa'i mi dang grogs la bsdongs pa na/ /dug dang bsdongs na dug gi kha rlangs phog /ngan pa'i tshogs dang nag po'i sol ba 'dra/ /356

kha che pha lu'i 'jig rten las 'bras rtsi lugs/tsha mos bsreg nyen grang mos rdzas nyen che/ /khe dang gyong gi bskor phyogs gtong gin song / /yag dang nyes kyi skad cha shod kyin song / /yag na yag pas ngo bstod bdag rkyen sprod/ /nyes na nyes song zer bas nyes thag thongs/ /a ma'i kha la sgo lcags brgyab drags na/ /phru gus chag sgo'i rgyal sgo phye nyen yod/ /rdo la phyi bdar thon na nor bu dang / /lcags la 'jam sha thon na me long yong / /yon tan phun sum tshogs na snying gi bu/ /bya lugs byed lugs ngan na dgra las lod/ /de tsho sems pa dkar ba'i skad cha red/ /bu yod pha tsho thugs la de ltar zhog /bslab bya le'u bcu pa/de nas gson dang a ma'i snying nye tsho/ /byams dang brtse ba can gyi drin chen ma/ /357

legs bshad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ da —da wa da wa phru gu chung dus a ma'i mgo ru sdod/ /lang la gtong rang gtong na a mas gtong / /kha la mi ster dgu ster a mas ster/ / lus la mi g.yog dgu g.yog a mas g.yog /chung dus a mas lang la btang ba'i bu/ /lang shor tha ma a ma dga' mi khug /de 'dras mi gsod byas nas phung ba mang / /de 'dras rta 'khyer byas nas bros pa mang / /a mas sdug snying mnan nas ma bsdad na/ /a mas phru gu rlung la bskur yong ngo / /rkun ma rku dus thug thug rdung ba dga'/ /ham gyi yod na gleg gleg ster ba dga'/ /sgo nga rku dus khrig khrig ma bzos na/ /bya mo khyer pa'i rjes la rta pho 'khyer/ /zhim po ster ster 'jam po g.yogs g.yogs zhog /bya lugs byed lugs 'gro lugs sdod lugs sbyongs/ /358

kha tshepha lu'i 'jig rten las 'bras ji lugs/byed lugs med kyang kha la za lugs slobs/ /tha ma de 'dra'i smyo smyo su zhig smyo/ /wa phrug thang nas thang la zags rgyu med/ /rgod phrug g.yang la zags pa snying yang rje/ /sprang phrug rgyal khams bskor ba sprang po'i las /phyug po sprang la 'khyams pa dgra la 'gyur/ /nyan mkhan yod na go rgyu bshad yod do/ /lta mkhan yod na mthong rgyu bstan yod do/ /smyu gu'i kha yi don gyi rdo kha'i tshig /thugs kyi dkyil du zhog mdzod a ma'i tshogs/ /bslab bya le'u bcu gcig pa/de nas nyon dang a ma'i o lo tsho/ /stag gzig nags kyi dkyil nas thon 'dra rnams/ /phru gu ma yi khog nas thon pa'i dus/ /lte ba ma dang 'brel nas yong ba'i dus/ /rtser rtser zer ba tsam las sha rdog gcig /359

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/nu zho kha la sbyar kyang 'thung mi shes/ /rkang pa yod kyang gom pa spo mi shes/ /rna ba yod kyang tshig brda sprod mi shes/ /mig gnyis yod kyang mthong rgyu ma las med/ /sems pa yod kyang bsam rgyu ma las med/ /ngo la 'khor ba'i sbrang ma dkrog mi shes/ /mig la 'tshangs pa'i thal ba 'don mi shes/ /grang ngu 'khyag ngu ltogs ngu rgyag pa'i dus/ /pha ma gnyis po'i dgong mo'i gnyid thebs bcag /skam pa bu dang rlon pa pha mas byed/ /'jam pa bu dang rtsub pa pha mas byed/ /da lta'i de 'dra de dus yin mdog med/ /phru gu chung dus lte ba pha mas sgrol/ /bya lugs byed lugs 'gro lugs sdod lugs sbyongs/ /gang byas yong ba'i yon tan pha ma'i drin/ /kha nas phri ste bsags tshad bu yi don/ /360

kha che pha lu'i 'jig rten las 'bras rtsi lugs/las 'bras rlung la bskur rgyu bu yi don/ /bsam rgyu bu dang dran rgyu bu las med/ /dgos rgyu bu dang 'degs rgyu bu las med/ /bka' drin can gyi pha ma rnam pa gnyis/ /na so rgas pa da lta e shes la/ /drin can drin du bsams pa e yod lags / /khrel dang ngo tsha dgos pa 'di ru red/ /tshogs dang bsod nams gsog pa'i rtsa ba red/ /gong na go banā gsham na pha ma gnyis/ /de gsum las lhag su yang yod pa min/ /nyin mtshan med pa pha ma'i bka' dang bstun/ /snga dgong med pa pha ma'i zhabs la bcar /zhim po phul nas e mnyes sems kyis ltos/ /'jam po bsgron nas e mnyes yid kyis ltos/ /snyan po zhus nas thugs sems e spro ltos/ /yag po zhus nas dgongs pa e spro ltos/ /361

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/pha ma mnyes na 'di phyi gnyis yod red/ /pha ma ma mnyes 'di phyi gnyis med red/ /pha ma yod dus bka' drin ma bsams par/ /med dus 'gyod pa skyes pa tha ma'i tha/ /'gyod pa de ni phugs nas phugs su 'gyod/ /da lta sa steng 'gyod pa de las 'gyod/ /de ltar pha ma 'dzoms pa'i phru gu tsho/ /gtam gyi nor bu snying gi sgam du chugs/ /bud med khram dang g.yo sgyu gyod kyi gzhi/ /bslu ja ster nas pha bu 'phral yong ngo / /de 'dra dmyal ba'i gting du bskyur yong ngo / /ra thang g.yogs pa rna bas thos yod 'gro/ /rtsa mchog zil pas skad cha go tshod 'gro/ /mi rgyud mi dgos lha rgyud yin gyur kyang / /bud med yin na bdud kyi yan lag red/ /de 'dra'i bshad tshad nyan na phung la sbyor/ /362

da wa khachephalu'i'ajig rten la sa 'bras rtsi lugs/byas tshad lam la btang na rlung la skur/ /bdud dang bsdongs dus mi la dogs zon dgos/ /'dre dang grogs po byed na bla ma sgoms/ /gyon pa rnyings na gsar pa bzos pas chog /mna' ma med kyang mna' ma bsus pas chog /'tshol dgos byung na pha ma rnyed mdog med/ /pha ma gnyis dang mna' ma brje mdog med/ /'dra 'dra'i khrod du sdod pa ngo yang tsha/ /'jon mdog byas kyang 'jon rgyu de ga red/ /pha ma mna' ma'i dbye 'byed ma shes na/ /mi lus de 'dra thob kyang khyi las lod/ /khyi ngan smyo yang bdag po ngos kyis 'dzin/ /khyi las lod pa'i mi de ya yang nga / /de 'dra'i lus rten sdang ba'i dgra la 'gyur/ /mi ngan gcig gis mi brgya rlung la skur/ /mi lus yin kyang rgya mtsho'i gting la bskyur/ /363

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/lam ngan btod nas 'dzam gling phung la sbyor/ /ba mo gcig gis mi yi zhing zos nas/ /ba mo yongs kyi 'gro ba'i lam bu bkag /ces pa'i dpe ltar spyod ngan 'dor shes pa/ /rig pa gnad du khod cig pha yi bu/ /bsam blo 'drongs la thongs shig jo jo'i snying / /re dang 'jigs pas dbyar sa dgun sa nas/ /thar pa'i gling gi las su skya seng seng / /bzang gi re dang ngan gyi nyes yod na/ /lam bu de ga red do skal ldan tsho/ /'khor ba mi srid srid pa'i khron pa ru/ /las nyon mi srid srid pa'i sku dus 'dir/ /don rtsa bsgril nas rdog thon byed pa'i dus/ /re sa lta sa go banā khong la zhus/ /las 'bras snying la bcangs nas 'gro lugs dang / /dkar nag sems la bzhag nas bya lugs mdzod/ /364

kha che pha lu'i 'jig rten las 'bras rtsi lugs/las 'bras kha nas shod mkhan mang po yong / /lag len lag tu lon pa gser las dkon/ /de la bltas na 'gyod pa snying nas bskyed/ /de 'dra bsams na skyo ba gting nas bskyed/ /de ring bris pa'i yi ge nag chung 'di/ /kha che pha lu smyo ba'i smyo lab red/ /gti mug snying gi dkyil la rtsol rtsol 'di/ /rang gi mi shes mi la bshad le 'dra/ /rang skyon mi mthong mi skyon ston le 'dra/ /chag pa gas pas phyogs la ham le 'dra/ /nga la bla mas thugs rjes rgyang nas gzigs/ /kha dang lag len 'grig pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /mdog dang bro ba mthun pa'i bkra shis shog /kha che pha lu'i bsam blo'i rgya mtsho nas/ /bton pa'i nor bu shog bu'i nang du btums/ /rgyal sde khrom pa'i dkyil du bzhag yod do/ /365
