rma bya'i lus la khu byug gsung snyan 'di/ /skyid skyid zer bas phyogs kun khyab par shog /kha che pha lus kun la gdams pa'o/ /

thar 'dod dpa' bo'i snying nong/ ༄༅/ /mnyam med jo bo chen po rgya gar la phebs khar lha bla ma byang chub 'od la zhal gdams su stsal pa thar 'dod dpa' bo'i snying nor zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /mnyam med jo bo rje/na mo gu ra be/ jo bo rje nyid dang po mnga' ris su byon pa'i dus na mnga' ris su lo gnyis bzhugs nas/ lha byang chub 'od kyis dbu mdzad pa rnams la gdams pa mang po gnang nas rgya gar du gshegs par dgongs nas lam du bzhud khar/ lha byang chub 'od kyis da dung zhal gdams shig zhu byas pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas sngar gyi des chog lags gsungs pa la/ lhas nan bskyed pas gdams pa 'di gnang ba'o/ /e ma'o /mkhyen pa mtho zhing thugs dgongs shin tu gsal ba'i grogs 367

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dag la/ /rang 'khos med pa'i blo dman bdag gis mchid gros gsol pa mi rigs kyang / /snying nas gces pa'i grogs po dam pa khyed kyis bdag la bskul pas na/ /byis pa blo chung bdag gis grogs kyi thugs la mchid gros 'di 'debs so/ /grogs dag byang chub ma thob bar du bla ma dgos pas bshes gnyen dam pa bsten/ /gnas lugs ma rtogs bar du thos pa dgos pas bla ma'i gdams ngag nyon/ /chos ni shes pa tsam gyis sangs mi rgya bas shes pas mi chog nyams su longs/ /sems la gnod pa'i yul dang thag bsrings rtag tu dge ba 'phel sar sdod/ /brtan pa ma thob bar du 'du 'dzis gnod pas dben pa'i 368

thar 'dod dpa' bo'i snying nor/nags khrod bsten/ /nyon mongs skye ba'i grogs po spongs la dge 'phel grogs bsten de sems zungs/ /nam yang bya ba'i las la zin pa med pas zhog la lhan gyis sdod/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu dge ba bsngo zhing rtag tu rang sems bya ra gyis/ /man ngag yod pas bsgom pa min na ci byed bla ma'i gsung bzhin sgrubs/ /gus pa chen pos bsgrubs na ring por mi thogs 'bras bu 'phral du 'byung / /snying nas chos bzhin byas na lto rgyab gnyis ka zhor la 'byung tshul 'dug /grogs dag 'dod pa rnams la tshwa chu 'thungs bzhin ngoms pa med pas chog shes mdzod/ /dregs rlom nga rgyal khengs pa'i sems kun smod la zhi zhing 369

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dul bar gyis/ /bsod nams zer ba'i 'du 'dzi de yang chos kyi bar chad yin pas spongs/ /rnyed dang bkur snyi bdud kyi zhags pa yin pas srang kha'i rdo bzhin sol/ /bstod dang grags pa'i tshig rnams slu brid yin pas mchil snabs bzhin du dor/ /da lta'i bde skyid gnyen gsum 'dzom yang yud tsam yin pas rgyab tu skyur/ /'di bas phyi ma ring bas phyi ma'i rgyags phyer nor rnams gter du sbos/ /thams cad bor nas 'gro bas cis kyang byar med gang la'ang zhen med gyis/ /dman pa rnams la snying rje bskyed la khyad du gsod dang brnyas pa spongs/ /dgra zun sde ris kun la zhen cing chags pa'i phyogs ris 370

thar 'dod dpa' bo'i snying nor/med par mdzod/ /yon tan can la phrag dog mi bya gus par gyis la yo na tan blang / /gzhan skyon mi brtag rang skyon brtags la rang skyon khrag ngan bzhin du phyungs/ /rang dge mi bsam gzhan dge bsams la kun la bran bzhin gus par mdzod/ /'gro ba kun la pha ma'i 'du shes bskyed la bu bzhin byams par gyis/ /rtag tu 'dzum pa'i bzhin dang byams pa'i yid kyis khro med gsong por smos/ /'brel med smra ba mang na 'khrul ba 'byung bas tshod bzung ran par smos/ /don med bya ba mang na dge sbyor 'chag pas chos min bya ba zhog /snying po med pa'i las la rtsol ba ma che ngal ba don med yin/ /371

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gang yang 'dod khar mi mchi pha rol las las grub pas lhod kyis glod na bde/ /kwa ye dam pas khrel na shi dang 'dra bas g.yo med drang por srong / /tshe 'di'i bde sdug snga ma'i las las byung bas gzhan la gyod mi gda'/ /bde ba thams cad bla ma'i byin rlabs lags pas drin du gzo bar mdzod/ /rang rgyud ma thul bar du gzhan rgyud mi thul bas na thog mar rang rgyud thul/ /mngon shes med par gzhan dag smin par mi nus pas na sgrub la brtson par mdzod/ /bsags pa'i nor rnams bzhag nas 'gro bar nges pas nor phyir sdig ma gsog /longs spyod g.yar bo 'di la snying po med pas sbyin pa yon gyis brgyan pa thong / /372

thar 'dod dpa' bo'i snying nor/tshe 'dir mdzes shing phyi mar bde bas rtag tu tshul khrims rnam dag srungs/ /snyigs ma'i dus na zhe sdang bdo bas khro med bzod pa'i go cha gyon/ /le lo'i dbang gis da dung lus pas sgrub pa'i brtson 'grus me ltar sbor/ /yengs ma lam du mi tshe zad pas da ni bsam gtan bya bar ran/ /log lta'i dbang gis gnas lugs don mi rtogs pas yang dag don la gzhigs/ /grogs dag 'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab 'di na skyid med thar pa'i skam sar gshegs/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag tshul bzhin bsgoms la 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal chu bo skems/ /rang gi sems la chongs dang kha tshig min gyi gros la gsan par rigs/ /373

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/de ltar mdzad na bdag kyang dga' la rang gzhan kun kyang skyid par mchis/ /rmongs pa bdag gi gdams ngag 'di la khyed kyis cis kyang gsan par zhu/ /zhes jo bo rje lha gcig gis lha btsun byang chub 'od la gdams pa'o/ /bkra shis/374

mi chos gnad kyi phreng ba/༄7/ /mi chos gnad kyi phreng ba bzhugs so/ /'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/kho bos byang gi phyogs nas gtso bo'i bu/ /kho bos sa mtha' bskor pas mi mthong myong / /rna gtam mang du thos pas bshad pa tsha/ /yin min mgo ltag phyed pas grung por grags/ /gnas dang phyogs rnams gang du 'gro yang rung / /gzhi dang gnas mal gang du byed kyang rung / /grogs dang 'grogs lugs su la 'tshol yang rung / /gzhan dang bstun pa mi chos rtsa ba yin/ /de yi steng nas 'dun ma bshad kyi nyon/ /bya byed yongs kyi mgo ltag phye yi nyon/ /lha zhi klu zhi'i gdams pa bshad kyi nyon/ /chos la mi chos zab pa 'di ltar legs/ /375

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/su yi don du dka' spyad byed na yang / /bya shes ko long sdug yus chung bar mdzod/ /las dang bya ba ji ltar byed na yang / /mdzad spyod thams cad mi dang mthun par mdzod/ /rang la yon tan ji tsam yod na yang / /gzhan la khyad gsod brnyas pa chung bar mdzod/ /rang nyid nor la chags zhen che na yang / /gzhan gyi nor la hab sha chung bar mdzod/ /rang nyid las thabs 'dun ma mkhas na yang / /spyi yi khrims la sa chod chung bar mdzod/ /rang nyid bsags pa'i nor rdzas yin na yang / /mang po'i gseb tu lkog nor chung bar mdzod/ /rang nyid kun gyis tshad mar khur na yang / /nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal chung bar mdzod/ /rang nyid kun las khyad par 'phags na yang / /che ba'i nga rgyal cung zad med par mdzod/ /376

mi chos gnad kyi phreng ba/rang nyid dge ba'i bshes su gsol na yang / /mkhas dman kun la brnyas pa chung bar mdzod/ /rang gi gong na che ba gzhan med kyang / /'og tu zhugs la 'jug pa bde bar mdzod/ /gzhan gyi tshogs dpon ji ltar ngan na yang / /gus pa'i tshul gyis phyag dang phyag lan mdzod/ /rang dang mnyam pa'i gang zag su byung yang / /mgo yang mtho ba'i bkur sti gus par mdzod/ /mdze sprang la sogs su yis chos zhus kyang / /kun gyi dbus su gdams ngag lhug par ston/ /gal te mtho 'tsham kha tshod lta na yang / /ha cang phul du phyin pas lhag par ston/ /tshogs dang bsnyen bkur sogs kyis mchod 'os kyang / /de la ma lta kun la thang mo rdol/ /nges par gang la gsang bar 'os pa rnams/ /lkugs pa'i tshul gyis kha rog dben sar bzhugs/ /377

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/de yang rags pa spyi yi rnam gzhag yin/ /da dung snying gtam lags pas gsan mdzod dang / /'grogs lugs dgra la 'tshol dang zab pa yin/ /snying gtam bu la gsong dang brtan pa yin/ /kha 'don gre bar bskyil dang btsun pa yin/ /mtshang gtam bar du gsong dang mkhas pa yin/ /rang mtshang rang gis brus dang mkhas pa yin/ /gzhan mtshang lhod la zhog dang dge ba yin/ /blo gtad snying gis skyong dang ngo mtshar che/ /snying gtam lags pas da dung gsan mdzod dang / /'phrad ma thag tu snying gtam 'chad pa mtshang /ma brtags pa la blo gtad byed pa mtshang / /brtags nas 'khrul na da rung byed pa mtshang /bag med mi la bya byed 'tshol ba mtshang / /sha mi tsha la phug bsre chol ba mtshang /dad pa med la slob mar bsten pa mtshang / /378

mi chos gnad kyi phreng ba/snying rje med la bla mar khur ba mtshang / /khrel gzhung med la grogs por bsten pa mtshang / /mi nyan pa la kha ta byed pa mtshang / / mi shes pa la gros phugs 'dri ba mtshang / /mtshang du shes nas da rung mi 'dor na/ /rang nyid smyon pa yin par shes par bya/ /snying gtam lags pas da dung gsan mdzod dang / /bza' btung za dus thams cad bka' slob bde/ /zhag gsum 'grogs nas rang mtshang ston pa mang / /nye ring yongs la lo gcig ma brten par/ /bya byed bcol na myur du nongs par 'gyur/ /rang la brten pa'i mtshang gtam ngan pa yin/ /gcig gi sems la shar na gtor 'gong yin/ /gtam de gnyis la grags na phung byed yin/ /gsum la grags na gtam ngan rlung khyer yin/ /mi mngon dbyings su yal na mkhas pa yin/ /379

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ngag mtshang thabs kyis shes na gad mo 'chor/ /dgos pa rang gis bsus na bdud rigs dga'/ /phung byed grogs su bsgyur na mtshang re che/ /snying gtam lags pas da dung gsan mdzod dang / /zas la zhen pa ma che mi la byin/ /nor la ser sna ma che chos la mchod/ /bzhin la 'gyur ldog ma mang 'dzum gyis bsus/ /dgra zun bsha' ral ma mang spyi snyoms sten/ /'khor la bstod ra ma mang blo khog sdoms/ /myur du smad ra ma mang thabs kyis spongs/ /su la khas len ma mang lag len skyongs/ /gang la'ang nyes kha ma 'ding gros kha skyed/ /nyes na 'gyod thal ma byed phyis 'byung sdoms/ /snying gtam lags pas da dung gsan mdzod dang / /sdug kha dgra yi g.yab mo legs par chod/ /bya mang byur gyi sna 'dren legs par chod/ /380

mi chos gnad kyi phreng ba/blo mang 'dun ma'i dkrug shing legs par chod/ /gshis ngan dgra bo'i tshogs sa legs par chod/ /rnam rtog sdug 'dre'i pho khrom legs par chod/ /'khor ngan gtam gyi gzhi ma legs par chod/ /grogs ngan 'gyod pa'i rtsa ba legs par chod/ /yul ngan sdug gi 'khor ba legs par chod/ /mi chos rkang ba'i thi gu legs par chod/ /snying gtam lags pas da dung gsan mdzod dang / /dus ngan snyigs ma lnga ru bdo ba'i dus/ /chos pa yongs kyi bgegs 'dre chags sdang gnod/ /gang du phyin kyang chags sdang chung bar mdzod/ /ji ltar bgyis kyang dman cha blang bar 'tshal/ /thag ring bal bo'i thang ni tshad pa che/ /kha skom btung ba'i tshogs la gzab par 'tshal/ /la stod lho yi phyogs ni dgra 'jigs che/ /zhe sdang ngan sngags tshogs la gzab par 'tshal /381

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/nyang shab byang gi phyogs ni smre mchu mang / /long gtam tshig gi tshogs la gzab par 'tshal/ /pur rgyal bod kyi yul ni khrel gzhung ngan/ /yid 'byung khong khro'i tshogs la gzab par 'tshal/ /deng dus skye bo'i tshogs ni gsar 'grogs che/ /bslu brid 'khor gyi tshogs la gzab par 'tshal /snying gtam lags pas da dung gsan mdzod dang / /yi dam lha la re ltos ma shor bar/ /dung ngan mi la re ltos chung bar mdzod/ /'grogs pa'i mi la khrel gzhung ma chung bar/ /legs nyes gang la bshad gzhung nyung bar mdzod/ /dkar po chos la phyi bshol ma 'dings par/ /dam pa'i chos la sbyor ba thob par mdzod/ /'dun ma yongs la skyid 'dod ma che bar/ /bla ma'i phyogs su sgo gsum gus pa mdzod/ /mdor na mtho ba thams cad zhwa bzhin khur/ /382

mi chos gnad kyi phreng ba/dma' ba ral gri'i so bzhin kun nas skyongs/ /mnyam pa rmos dor bzhin du dga' bar 'grogs/ /bya ba gang la'ang rang 'dod chung bar mdzod/ /'dun ma yongs la spyi snyoms che bar mdzod/ /'di ltar khyod la bslab bya gdams pa 'di/ /byi'u sgo nga'i 'du shes ma shor bar/ /legs bshad 'di dag lañdza'i yi ger bkod/ /dben pa'i gnas su ltad mo che bar ltos/ /yun du bsrings na shin tu 'phrod par gda'/ /'di nas bzung ste skye ba thams cad du/ /'phrin las mnyam du 'gro ba 'dren byed cing / /kun tu bzang po'i smon lam ji lta ba/ /dga' ba'i smon lam gcig tu gdab par bgyi/ /zhes 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis gsungs so/ /383

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/༄7/ /rang gi slob ma la zhe thag pa nas gros 'debs pa'i yi ge snying gi thur ma bzhugs so/ /bu ston rin chen grub/swa snyi phra dza bhyaḥbu ston gyis rang gi slob ma la zhe thag pa nas gros 'debs pa'i yi ge snying gi thur ma zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la phyag 'tshal lo /gang gis bskal pa'i bskal par dka' ba dpag med kyis/ /tshogs gnyis rab bsgrubs byang chub bdud rtsi mchog brnyes nas/ /'gro ba nyon mongs nad kyis gdungs pa'i gdung sel ba/ /384

sprasa'adebasayigesnyingagithuram /wasman pa'i rgyal po thub dbang de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi yi cha lugs dge sbyong tshul las ma g.yos kyang / /nang gi tshul khrims nyon mongs dbang gis rul gyur pa/ /kuṣṭhaṇḍa yi shing thog smin pa lta bu yi/ /snying med po khyed don 'di rnams la bsam mno thongs/ /rgya mtsho chen por phyogs bzhi'i rlung gis g.yeng ba yi/ /gnya' shing bu gar rus sbal mgrin pa chud pa ltar/ /shin tu rnyed dka'i mi lus rin chen thob gyur nas/ /don med chud zos byas nas 'gyod par ma gyur tam/ /shin tu rnyed dka' rnyed kyang ring du mi gnas shing / /tshe 'di mi brtan mar me rlung gis bskyod pa bzhin/ /yud tsam zhig kyang gnas par nus pa'i gdeng med la/ /gshin rje'i kha ru nges par chud pa mi shes sam/ /bstan pa'i snying po tshul khrims bslab pa rin po che/ /'phral dang yun du bde legs thams cad 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /med thabs med pa'i tshul khrims rin chen dor nas ni/ /385

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ —dga' dga' ltar spyad ci ste khyod kyi snying ma gas/ /tshul khrims 'chal ba'i 'bras bu mi bzad de/ /ltung ba yang rim bzhin du yang sos sogs/ /dmyal ba rnams su rim bzhin skye bar gsungs/ /zla ba sgron mas zhus pa'i mdo las kyang / /ji snyed chos kyi rnam pas byang chub kyang / /thos pas rgyags nas tshul khrims mi bsrung na/ /tshul khrims 'chal bas ngan 'gro der 'gro ste/ /de la thos pa mang pos bskyab mi nus/ /khyod ni gser snod mi gtsang 'phyags pa bzhin/ /dal 'byor mi lus thob pa chud gsan te/ /long med tshe 'di bag med spyod pas zad/ /shi nas ngan 'gror 'gro ba mi 'tsher ram/ /las 'bras mi shes blun po mi 'jigs pa/ / bden mod khyod ni sde snod don shes shing / /dkar nag rgyu 'bras shes shing bag med par/ /386

gros 'debasayigesnyingagithuramad/ spyod pa khyod snying lcags kyi gar bu'am ci/ /log par g.yem pas dmyal ba bsdus 'joms su/ /gsal shing 'bar bas ro smad 'bigs par 'gyur/ /de nas mi ru skyes kyang ma ning 'gyur/ /rmi lam bud med spyad pas ro myang yang /dmyal ba padma ltar gas nang du ni/ /bum par 'tshod cing gtun gyis 'tshog 'gyur na/ /dngos su spyod pa lta yang smos ci dgos/ /bud med mthong nas tshul min yid byed na/ /mig ni zangs zhun 'bar bas bsreg par skye/ /bud med glu dbyangs thos nas chags gyur pa/ /rna bar ro nye bskol ba ldug par skye/ /bud med glu dang gar la chags pa yis/ /khu ba phyung nas 'gyod par mi byed pa/ /lcags kyi me mdag char ba lus la 'bab/ /gzhan gyi chung ma la spyad rdzun smra ba/ /387

legs bshad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ da wangu 'bod chen por mun pas kun khyab par/ /spyi bo nas phug lce chung bcad kyang ni/ /skad cig re re skye zhing gcod par skye/ /mi ru skyes kyang dmus long 'on pa dang / /lam zan slong ba dag tu skye bar 'gyur/ /dge bsnyen ma la log par g.yem pa yis /rab tu tsha bar thal ba'i lhag ma yang / /med par bsreg cing tshe rabs bzhi brgya ru/ /za ma dag tu skye bar 'gyur ba yin/ /grogs kyi chung ma bslus nas spyad pa yi/ /rab tshe a la la zhes zer ba ru/ /skyes nas tsha ba'i rlung gis phyogs bcur 'khyer/ /tshe rabs stong phrag du mar yi dwags su/ /skyes nas rang gi sha la za ba dang / /phag tu skyes nas ma sha za ba dang / /mi ru skyes nas pho mtshan gcod par 'gyur/ /388

gros 'debs yi ge snying gi thur ma/bla ma'i chung ma log par g.yem pa yis/ /snying rje chen po zhes pa gong 'og tu/ /mtshon cha gnyis kyis gcod par skye bar 'gyur/ /mi ru skyes na btsas ma thag tu 'chi/ /bdag nyid mi dbang bu mo la spyad pas/ /klad par seng ge sbrul gyis rtsib logs dang / /rgyab nas stag gis za zhing mes bsreg la/ /gshin rje phyogs rnams kun nas mda' 'phen 'gyur/ /bud med mtshan ma snyan ngag gis bstod pa/ /skye ba lnga brgyar mngal gyi srin 'bur skye/ /chags pas spyad cing reg pas smos ci dgos/ /khrims 'chal yul 'khor bsod snyoms spyod pa ni/ /lcags gong me lce 'bar ba za bar skye/ /khrims 'chal dge 'dun btung ba 'thung ba yis /zangs zhun 'bar ba 'thung bar skye bar 'gyur/ /thos ldan khyod la mang du smos ci dgos/ /389

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/tshul khrims 'chal bas sa ni gom gang dang / /zas ni kham gcig btung ba chu phor gang / /tsam zhig dge 'dun rdzas la longs spyad na/ /log 'tsho yin te dmyal bar skye bar gsung / /de sogs nyes dmigs dpag med mdo las gsungs/ /gal te khyod ni sdig lta'i dbang gyur te/ /ma mthong 'bras la yid mi ches na yang / /mthong ba'i chos kyi nyes dmigs mang po zhig /rang gi blo yis mthong bar ma gyur tam/ /dal 'byor lus la bslab gsum rgyan dang ldan/ /bstan la zhugs nas sgrub pa gtsor byed pa'i/ /dge slong 'dus nas las la spyod pa'i tshe/ /shing rul bzhin du spong ba ma mthong ngam /bstan pa'i mtshor skyes legs bshad 'dab stong can/ /bslab gsum dri bsung rab tu 'phro ba la /tshul khrims sbrang rtsi don gnyer bung ba 'du/ /390

gros 'debs yi ge snying gi thur ma/sad khyer me tog bung bas mi spong ngam/ /tshul khrims mchod rten legs bshad bang rim can/ /bshes gnyen gser gyi mchod rten mthong ba'i tshe/ /dad ldan skye bos phyag dang mchod pa byed/ /mi gtsang mi gtsang khyod dor ma mthong ngam/ /sde snod thos pa'i cha shas yongs rdzogs shing / /bslab gsum dri med ri dwags mtshan mas brgyan/ /snyan pa'i bsil zer 'phro ba'i 'od dkar can/ /gzas bzung mya ngan byed pa ma mthong ngam/ /mi 'jigs smra ba'i spobs pa dang ldan yang / /lung rigs chos smra seng ge'i khri steng du/ /sngon chad rang bas dman dang mnyam pos kyang / /wa skyes yin zhes brnyas pa ma mthong ngam/ /sngon chad rang gi yon tan cha tsam yang /bsgrun par mi nus gsar bu khā ta'i tshogs/ /thos pa'i nor bu'i gdengs kas mdzes pa'i sbrul/ /391

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/shi ba'i ro bzhin brnyas pa ma mthong ngam /sngon chad rang gis bskyangs shing smin pa'i 'khor/ /legs bshad zer gyis blo gros kha phye rnams/ /mtshan phyed dus kyi padmo ji bzhin du/ /ngo 'dzum rab tu zum pa ma mthong ngam/ /sngon chad rang gis rgyud gyong tshogs gsum gyis/ /phan btags gyur pa'i grogs ngan srin bya'i tshogs/ /gtam snyan nyi 'od nub nas gtam ngan gyis/ /skad ngan phyogs bcur sgrog pa ma mthong ngam/ /sngon nas rang la phan 'dogs 'dris 'brel ba'i/ /ma bzhin sha tsha snying nye'i grogs mchog kun/ /bu gces shi ba'i ma ma ji bzhin du/ /mya ngan khung bur bcug pa ma mthong ngam/ /sngon chad rang la phrag dog 'gran sems can/ /mi mnyam mnyam du re ba 'byung po'i bya/ /gtam ngan mun pas 'thibs par shes nas ni/ /392

gros 'debs yi ge snying gi thur ma/skad ngan gad mo dgod pa ma mthong ngam /sngon chad 'gras 'dris med pa'i lam chen mi/ /chags sdang gnyis kas dbeen pa'i skye bo yang / /lo legs snye ma sad kyis khyer mthong nas/ /mya ngan ca co sgrog pa ma mthong ngam/ /sngon chad chos dang zang zing gnyis ka yis/ /phan 'dogs bka' drin che ba'i slob dpon yang / /dkor mdzod rku la shor ba'i bdag po bzhin/ /mi dga' bzhin du thabs med ma mthong ngam/ /khyod ni rab tu byung nas da yi bar/ /lung nas mkhan pos pha ltar bya gsungs bzhin/ /kho bos chos dang zang zing gnyis kas bskyangs/ /dge bshes mkhas btsun ldan pa re ba la/ /gru chen chu yi dbus su zhig pa ltar/ /don ma grub pa re ba'i don bslus pas/ /mya ngan chu yi klung du bying 'jug pa'i/ /393

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/khrel med khyod la la yogs mi yong ngam/ /dge tshogs sa gzhir dal 'byor ljon shing skyes/ /bslab shes yal ga 'chad rtsod lo 'dabs bklubs/ /tshul khrims me tog snyan pa'i sbrang rtsi 'dzin/ /grags pa'i dri bsung phyogs bcur ldang ba yi/ /bshes gnyen dpag bsam sdong bor re ba la/ /legs bshad char 'bab yongs 'dzin sprin tshogs dang / /ma bral bzhin du me tog sad kyis khyer/ /ljon shing 'bras bu med pa yi re mug /bslab gsum rin chen dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga shes pa'i 'od dang ldan/ /mi shes mun sel nyin par tsha ba 'joms/ /bshes gnyen nor bu lta bur re ba la/ /dran dang shes bzhin go ba nus pa chung / /chom rkun bdud mo'i tshogs ni stobs che bas/ /mngon sum rig bzhin chom rkun tshogs rnams kyis/ /394

gros 'debs yi ge snying gi thur ma/nor bu rin chen 'phrog pa yi re mug /so thar sdom pa'i tshul khrims lhun stug cing / /byang sems sdom pa'i bang rim mdzes pa can/ /rig 'dzin sdom pa'i char khebs tog dang ldan/ /gser gyi mchod rten lta bur re ba la/ /nyon mongs makṣika yi rdzas sbyor dang / /bdud mos sol ba'i me yis bsregs pa'i mthus/ /yud tsam zhig la gser gyi mchod rten ni/ /thal ba'i phung por byas pa yi re mug /tshul khrims srog shing rab tu brtan pa la/ /bshad sgrub snying brtses brgyan pa'i lhab lhub can/ /rtsod rtsom snyan pa'i ba dan phyogs bcur g.yo/ /mkhyen brtse rin chen tog dang ldan pa yi/ /bshes gnyen bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan re ba la/ /yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes kyis bzung bzhin du/ /bdud mos nyon mongs skyogs sdo 'phangs pa'i mthus/ /395

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rgyal mtshan srog shing bcag pa yi re mug /dal 'byor gru chen sdom gsum /nyam thag bsdams/ /stong nyid snying rje byang sems rlung dar can/ /thabs dang shes rab gru skya rab bcas nas/ /rnam dpyod brtson pa'i mthu yis rab bskyod pas/ /gdul bya 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol ba yi/ /bshes gnyen gru chen lta bur re ba la/ / bdud mos chu srin so yis nyag thag bcad/ /gru chen rgya mtshor zhig pa yi re mug /dal 'byor rnyed dka' rnyed kyang myur du 'chi/ /tshul khrims 'chal ba'i nyes dmigs rnam pa mang / /de la skyob pa'i thabs ni gang zhig yod/ /rang gi snying la gros dris bsam mno thongs/ /bu ston kha ches rang gi slob ma la/ /nges par gros 'debs snying gi thur ma 'dis/ /snying rlung tshul 'chal nad rnams nges bcom ste/ /396
nges 'byung tshul khrims nad med thob par shogarang gi slob ma la zhe thag pa nas gros 'debs pa'i yi ge ma zhes bya ba bu ston gyis sbyar ba rdzogs so/ /

jus 'god pa/ rin chen don grub/ padma rdo rje/ mkha' 'gro tshe ring /rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ rin chen don grub/deb gzhi'i bzo 'god pa/ zhin ling /dpar spran 'gan len pa/ yi'u chi'u hwa/legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ (deb dang po)zhal gdams kyi skor/slob dpon klu sgrub sogs kyis brtsams/krung go bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas chos lugs zhib 'jug khang gis dag sgrig byas/ṭāṭwāṃ sta~X /spel/ mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang /(zi ling grong rṣa thun rin lam sgo rna10)ge sprag ang810001 kha par6143426brgyud 'tshong / mtsho sngon zhing chen zhin hwa dpe khang /par 'debs/ mtsho sngon mi rigs par khang /deb tshad/ 85077྾116877 1732dpar shog 13yig grangapas/ khri25par thengs/ 2006lo'i zla4bar par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/dpar thengs/ 2006lo'i zla4bar dpar thengs dang po dpar/dpar grangs/ 1da 4 000dpe rtags/ 1sdu2sku7—5420—1215—072 53rin gong / sgor16 00bar dbang 'di gar yod pas par bshus brgyab na khrims chad phog(shog ngos chad nor slog skyon gang rung yod tshe par khang la dri gtug bya)

lko shu 4rwarsābam̐ṣā zammuzarke khri/zalokā1za0ṇḍaṃ ༈rwarsāz-iṣā0skya༅kā༈ṣyo zlo.oṃmyongubaci//loṣṭha7 ṣṭhayā.oṃrkilko(1)tsa spyo// ::77glozo tsherngi2tsho ༄dzeezlolo dzra(ṣkaṣātshollī tshospyo rsā rṣaṭhaṣṭhabolornyetram̐(thidzotshwakhrakhrilko10rnya)sgotshongarmicha810001 thuglo61434260 :khri oṃlolngarshastsa riṭhangub 6/ rsārṣaṭhaskra'ingukṣaṣka/khabyer thong 8507①྾11687sku 1732ngub bye: 13lha ma 250tholo oṃ 2006ro4(lko1glongukṣa gle 2006jo4(lko1mngukṣaṣka//ngukṣa ༷yi 1—4000༈ jo 152sa7—542tshi1215—072 53(ṭhaṭwāṃ)lha yi/ 1600rkeskya7yorshakhāe ༅ngu'i/2oṃ(oṃtshokrekhriwo྾(⑫(ṣṭhayi1 oṃrsādzeengukṣa6/khalkolko)
